messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2026-04-25 06:30: The comprehensive excavation team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the cleaning of the coal bunker and shotcrete on the ground in the industrial square. 10 personnel were responsible for cleaning the coal bunker on the ground.
- 2026-04-25 06:55: The team leader received the portable methane detection alarm and self-rescuer in the instrument distribution room.
- 2026-04-25 07:10: The person in charge of the operation received the portable methane detection alarm and self-rescuer in the instrument distribution room.
- 2026-04-25 08:00: 10 people including the operation leader and team leader arrived at the coal bunker on the ground in the industrial square; two people put on safety belts and put them into the bunker from under the observation port, and stood at the lowest point of the floating coal to clean the bunker.
- 2026-04-25 09:20: During the coal feeding process of the coal feeder at the bottom of the coal bunker, the floating coal slid down, and the two people entering the bunker became unstable and were buried by the floating coal.
- 2026-04-25 09:22: On-site personnel reported an accident in the coal bunker to the duty room through the coal bunker phone on the ground and requested an ambulance to go up the mountain.
- 2026-04-25 09:23: The dispatch room attendant reported to the leader on duty that day, who then reported to the mine director; the mine did not report to the local regulatory authorities and the Qinghai Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2026-04-25 09:35: The mine rescue team arrived at the coal bunker after receiving the order, and organised personnel to clean up the floating coal and perform rescue operations.
- 2026-04-25 10:03: The casualty team leader was pulled from the observation port of the coal bunker to the top platform of the coal bunker. On-site inspection showed that he was breathing normally and was conscious.
- 2026-04-25 10:24: Rescuers pulled the person in charge of the buried operation to the top platform of the coal bunker, cleaned his mouth and nose of slime and vomit, and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation; then the two injured were sent to the hospital respectively, and the person in charge of the operation died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2026-04-26 03:46: After verification and supervision by the Qinghai Bureau of the State Administration of Mine Safety Supervision, the coal mine submitted a written accident report to the Qinghai Bureau.
- 2026-04-26 03:47: The coal mine submitted a written report of the accident to the Emergency Management Bureau of the Dachaidan Administrative Committee.
- 2026-04-26 03:52: The coal mine submitted a written report of the accident to the Haixi Prefecture Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2026-04-26 03:56: The coal mine submitted a written accident report to the Qinghai Provincial Emergency Management Department.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty entered the ground coal bunker of the industrial square to clean the floating coal, but did not set up a working platform according to technical measures. Two people entering the warehouse stood on the floating coal and tied a safety rope of unreasonable length around their waists. After the coal feeder was turned on to discharge coal, the floating coal slid down. The two people became unstable and were buried by the falling floating coal. One person escaped through rescue, and the other died due to suffocation and failed to be rescued by the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal bunker cleaning operation platform was not set up according to technical measures, and personnel stood on the floating coal to work; after the coal feeder was turned on to discharge coal, the floating coal collapsed, and the workers became unstable, buried and suffocated.
2. key contributing factors: Technical measures were not effectively learned and implemented, hazardous operation site management personnel were not arranged; safety rope selection and use were unreasonable, communication tools were not carried, and risk assessment failed to identify the risks of personnel burial and suffocation.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the mine safety responsibility system of enterprises and key positions, and organise production in accordance with laws and regulations.
2. Ensure that safety management personnel and security inspectors are on-site during key projects such as coal bunker cleaning, and empty shifts and illegal operations are strictly prohibited.
3. Establish a risk analysis and judgment mechanism to comprehensively investigate safety hazards both above and below the mine and implement precise management and control.
4. Improve the pertinence and operability of technical measures for dangerous operations, and strengthen the procedures, skills and emergency response training for employees.
5. Improve emergency rescue capabilities, activate plans after an accident occurs and report proactively, timely and truthfully.
6. Carry out accident case warning education and make up for the shortcomings in on-site management and operating standards.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-10-31 06:00: A pre-morning shift meeting was held in the No. 1 excavation work area to arrange tasks such as transporting unit supports to the 2315 track (outer) development heading; personnel went down the well after the safety oath.
- 2024-10-31 12:20 (approximately): Three workers who were temporarily arranged to transfer the transfer belt assembly collected packaging tools and materials in the -610 track transportation lane to prepare the transfer belt tail buffer bed.
- 2024-10-31 13:30: Under the on-site supervision of the safety supervisor, the monorail crane driver installed the first belt conveyor tail buffer bed onto the flatbed truck and sealed the truck; three operators pushed the truck to the track north of the intersection and parked it.
- 2024-10-31 14:21 (approximately): Three workers were manually pushing the flatbed truck equipped with the second buffer bed. After passing the turnout and curve, it collided with the front flatbed truck; the buffer bed, which had a right center of gravity and was not securely sealed, fell over, injuring the operator pushing the truck on the right rear side.
- 2024-10-31 14:26: On-site workers reported the accident to the dispatch room; the dispatch room notified the underground shift staff and relevant management personnel to rush to the scene for rescue.
- 2024-10-31 14:40 (approximately): On-site personnel used a monorail crane to lift the overturned buffer bed, rescue the casualty and carry them to the north wing track downhill parking lot.
- 2024-10-31 14:55 (approximately): The management personnel who rushed to the scene checked the casualty and found that he was unresponsive and had no pulse; they then organised the casualty to take a mine car up the shaft.
- 2024-10-31 15:23: After the casualty person was lifted underground, 120 emergency personnel waiting at the mine entrance performed on-site rescue.
- 2024-10-31 15:30: 120 emergency personnel announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-10-31 15:53: The mine continued to report to the dispatch room of the Shandong Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-10-31 15:58: The mine continued to report to the dispatch room of Jining Energy Bureau that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-10-31 16:00: The mine continued to report to the Wenshang County Emergency Management Bureau that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The morning shift staff temporarily changed to a transfer belt assembly and installed the second belt tail buffer bed side down onto the flatbed truck. Because the center of gravity was tilted to the right and the truck was not reliably closed as required, the three operators were in improper positions when pushing the truck manually. After the vehicle passed the turnout and curve, it collided with the flatbed truck in front. The buffer bed tipped to the right, crushing the worker pushing the truck on the right rear side; he died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The center of gravity of the buffer bed at the end of the transfer belt conveyor was unstable, the vehicle was not securely sealed, and the person pushing the cart was in an improper position. After the vehicle collided, the buffer bed fell over and crushed the worker, causing his death.
2. key contributing factors: illegal transportation of over-length and over-height materials under manned cart conditions, imperfect temporary operation organisation and technical measures, and inadequate implementation of on-site inspection supervision, risk management and control, and personnel training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the approval, reporting and on-site control of high-risk operations and sporadic projects, and assign dedicated personnel to guard key positions.
2. Implement "no work without monitoring" and supervise workers to work according to standard posts and standards.
3. Improve the mine safety responsibility system for all employees, risk investigation and rectification, and responsibility review mechanisms.
4. Higher-level enterprises should improve the professional safety management system and strengthen supervision, inspection and business guidance on key tasks of affiliated coal mines.
5. Clarify the operation process and construction sequence based on the on-site equipment, strictly review the safety technical measures collectively and implement them on-site.
6. Carry out warning education based on accident lessons, and strengthen training on job responsibilities, standardized operations, self-protection and mutual protection, and risk identification.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-02 13:00 (approximately): Three workers in the middle shift entered the mine from the +458m mine entrance, and one of them took away the temporarily stored civil explosive materials as arranged by the team leader.
- 2023-05-02 13:40 (approximately): 3 people arrived at the +200-37# north mining face of the second mining area and used an air leg rock drill to drill holes.
- 2023-05-02 16:00 (approximately): Unlicensed operators detonated explosives while loading in violation of regulations. An explosion occurred on site and one person was buried in coal and waste rock.
- 2023-05-02 16:00 (approximately): On-site personnel reported that someone was buried, and the dispatching room organised underground personnel to participate in the rescue and clear the transportation channel.
- 2023-05-02 16:50 (approximately): The buried personnel were rescued from the accident working face and loaded into mine cars for transportation.
- 2023-05-02 17:20 (approximately): The casualties were transported to the surface through the +500 waste well.
- 2023-05-02 18:00 (approximately): The casualty was sent to Longyan No. 2 Hospital and was confirmed dead by the doctor.
- 2023-05-03 09:56: The mine reported the accident to the Xinluo District Coal Industry Service Center.
- 2023-05-03 11:00 (approximately): The Xinluo District Coal Industry Service Center reported the preliminary verification situation and issued an on-site processing decision to the coal mine to suspend production and withdraw personnel.

【Accident Mechanism】
Mid-shift workers carried previously stored civilian explosives to the north mining face to drill holes. An operator without blasting qualifications detonated explosives while charging in violation of regulations. The explosion shock wave injured the operator and penetrated the goaf area above the mining surface. He was subsequently buried by falling coal and waste rock. He was rescued and sent to the hospital where he was confirmed dead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: An operator without blasting qualifications detonated explosives while charging in violation of regulations. After the explosion, the coal and waste rock collapsed and buried him to death.
2. key contributing factors: The collection, removal and storage of civil explosives are out of control; there is a lack of qualified blasting personnel and safety officers for on-site management of blasting operations, and the company's main responsibility for safe production and training are not implemented in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Unused civil explosive items must be returned to the warehouse in a timely manner and the ledger must be checked.
2. Blasting operators must undergo special safety training and obtain qualifications before taking up their posts.
3. Strengthen on-site management of the entire process of loading explosives, detonators and detonation, and set up warning signs and alert personnel.
4. Revise the accident emergency plan and conduct drills, and truthfully report production operations and accident information.
5. Strictly carry out registration, on-duty clearance and inventory verification of civil explosive items, and equip them with qualified blasters, blasting safety officers and special detonation facilities.
6. Carry out special training on blasting operation management, roof management, anti-violation, support operations and emergency rescue.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-08-21 14:20: A total of 8 people from the 202 team and the 208 team entered the mine one after another to clean up the floating coal in the C39S transport lane and dig in the C39N transport lane.
- 2025-08-21 19:08: Team 208 fired a cannon for the third time in the C39N transportation lane. After the smoke from the cannon blew away, eight workers entered their respective working faces to work.
- 2025-08-21 20:01: A gas explosion occurred underground; an operator drove to about 60 metres away from the signal cave, heard an explosion and was burned, and then went to the signal cave to report that the workers were trapped.
- 2025-08-21 20:05: The mine dispatching room received a report of an underground explosion.
- 2025-08-21 20:11: The mine leader on duty on the surface reported the underground accident to the mine director.
- 2025-08-21 21:01: The mine manager arranged to call 120 for help.
- 2025-08-21 21:04: The mine rescue team entered the mine to carry out initial rescue.
- 2025-08-21 22:10: Local government personnel arrived at the coal mine and reported the accident to the county government duty room.
- 2025-08-21 23:28: The mine director reported the accident to the Datian County Industry and Information Technology Bureau.
- 2025-08-21 23:30: The county-level rescue headquarters launched the emergency plan and deployed additional rescue forces to carry out comprehensive rescue.
- 2025-08-22 04:10: All seven victims were found and transported out of the well. Medical staff confirmed that all had no vital signs, and the on-site rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The conditions of the coal seam at the head of the C39S transport tunnel changed, the top coal continued to fall, and the gushing gas accumulated and overflowed in the high risk areas at the head and adjacent Shimen. The underground workers illegally lit a fire and smoked, which ignited the gas. The explosion affected 8 workers, causing 7 deaths and 1 minor injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The accumulated and overflowed gas at the head of the excavation and the high risk area of ​​Shimen was ignited by illegal lighting and smoking by underground workers, causing an explosion.
2. key contributing factors: changes in coal seam conditions and inadequate ventilation gas management due to top coal risk, failure to effectively determine and control gas risks; ineffective on-site management, accident reporting and emergency response.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the safety management organisation and equip safety management and special operations personnel.
2. Carry out regular inspection and management of hidden dangers, and report production plans and mining projects to regulatory authorities in a timely manner.
3. Detail the “one pass, three defenses” safety control measures and responsibility list.
4. Supplement and improve disaster prevention plans, emergency plans and on-site disposal plans, and conduct regular gas explosion emergency drills.
5. Formulate and implement a gas risk rectification plan, strengthen the control of key links such as ventilation gas management, ignition and blasting, and strictly implement "one shot, three inspections" and "three-person chain blasting".
6. Produce and carry out accident warning education, and incorporate gas risk assessment, explosion prevention and control, and emergency response into all-staff training and drills.

- 2025-09-14 09:00 (approximately): The safety inspector arrived to inspect and explain the precautions before leaving.
- 2025-09-14 10:00 (approximately): When two workers dug the leg sockets of the support and set up the pillars, the upper left roof collapsed from the layer, and an excavation worker was crushed.
- 2025-09-14 10:10 (approximately): On-site personnel organised cardiopulmonary resuscitation; one person went to the telephone to ask for help from the ground dispatch room, and returned with the patrol team leader to participate in the rescue.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty drove along the coal exploration and development heading without reporting as required and without preparing operating procedures. When the support at the heading was far away from the heading, two workers were digging the support leg sockets in the empty ceiling area. The top left waste rock suddenly separated from the layer and collapsed, crushing one of the excavation workers. He was confirmed dead after being rescued.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal mine violated regulations for coal prospecting and excavation, and the workers were working in the open roof in violation of regulations. After the top waste rock separation layer fell off, they were crushed to death.
2. key contributing factors: The working face was not reported, work procedures were not compiled, monitoring, personnel positioning, water supply and communication facilities were not installed; on-site safety management and hidden danger investigation were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Optimize mining connections and standardize various production systems to ensure safe and smooth exits.
2. Strictly implement the reporting procedures for mining working surfaces, and strictly prohibit illegal production and construction.
3. Update drawings in a timely manner and scientifically prepare mining operation procedures and job operating procedures.
4. Report production safety incidents strictly according to time limits.
5. Prepare and strictly implement mining operation procedures, perform working face reporting procedures, and improve working face safety monitoring, personnel positioning, water supply, and communication facilities.
6. Conduct training on operating procedures, roof management, and on-site risk prevention and control for employees, and they are not allowed to operate in empty roof areas without safety confirmation.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-11-29 06:30 (approximately): The team leader and 2 operators entered the mine and went to the +60m-39# east cut eye + 79m trough maintenance working face in the sixth mining area.
- 2025-11-29 07:30 (approximately): Three people arrived at the working face and began to carry wooden pillars and planks at the heading.
- 2025-11-29 08:00 (approximately): After the material transportation was completed, two people clean up the floating coal and waste rock and push it to the chute mouth; then one person digs out the leg socket of the bracket, and the team leader lays the chute.
- 2025-11-29 08:15 (approximately): The upper right coal gang about 3 metres away from the head direction collapsed, and the team leader was completely buried; another operator escaped and rushed to the communication phone with his companions to report for help, and then returned to provide rescue first.
- 2025-11-29 08:21: The on-site operator reported the accident to the mine dispatching room by phone.
- 2025-11-29 08:32: The ground dispatching room received the report and reported it step by step; the mine director arrived at the underground site and organised group support, clearing channels and preparing materials for rescue.
- 2025-11-29 20:18: The rescue headquarters ordered a professional rescue after research and judgment.
- 2025-11-29 21:21: The mine’s chief engineer reported the accident to the Xinluo District Coal Industry Service Center.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the workers on duty went to the +79m trough maintenance working face to transport materials and clean up the floating coal and waste rock, an operator dug out the leg sockets of the bracket at the heading. The working face was not effectively supported according to the operating procedures, and the shed was not reinforced from the outside to the inside according to safety technical measures; the upper right coal gang collapsed, completely burying the team leader to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The maintenance working face was not supported according to the operating procedures, the workers did not reinforce the shed from the outside to the inside, and the team leader was buried to death by the coal wall chip gang.
2. key contributing factors: The coal seam conditions are complex and no effective measures have been taken to address the structure; production shutdown and rectification of safety technical measures, team leadership, safety confirmation and on-site training are not implemented in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Standardize production systems such as mining, ventilation, transportation, and drainage, and clarify the boundaries of mining areas.
2. Timely identify changes in geological structures and formulate targeted support and control measures.
3. Strictly implement the mine leadership guidance, on-site follow-up and safety confirmation before starting work.
4. Report production safety accidents promptly and truthfully as required.
5. Improve support according to operating procedures and supplement safety technical measures under complex geological conditions, and strictly implement safety confirmation and follow-up management before starting work.
6. Conduct training on operating procedures and maintenance safety technical measures for all employees to ensure that operators understand the requirements for repairing each frame from the outside to the inside.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-07 22:30: The coal mining team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 10 personnel to work at the bottom layered coal face of Section 2 of the Eastern District 1.
- 2023-06-07 23:00: The operators began to enter the mine. After arriving at the working face, they transported the pillars, cleaned the tunnel and erected supports.
- 2023-06-08 05:30 (around): The team leader detonated the coal wall rock in the upper tunnel to process the coal wall rocks. He found that the 77 to 79 groups of scaffolding pillars were tilted and unstable and reported to the deputy mine director of production.
- 2023-06-08 06:00 (approximately): When the workers were setting up pillars in the empty ceiling area of ​​the blasting site, the roof rock fell and knocked down the pillars, causing one person's head injury.
- 2023-06-08 07:31: The casualties were transported to the ground in a mine cart and sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2023-06-08 09:05: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the night shift coal miners blasted the rocks on the coal wall, three sets of scaffolding pillars tilted and became unstable. When the operator used a hydraulic gun to set up pillars in the empty roof area where the safety of the roof was not confirmed, the roof rock on the side of the coal wall fell and knocked down the pillar. The pillar hit his head and killed him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the blasting caused the pillar to tilt and become unstable, the operator illegally set up the pillar in the empty ceiling area. The roof fell and knocked down the pillar, causing his head injury and death.
2. key contributing factors: Blasting operations and roof management are not standardized, on-site safety inspections fail to stop empty roof operations; personnel training, implementation of operating procedures and risk identification are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the "one shot, three inspections" and "three-person chain blasting" systems.
2. Strengthen the risk analysis of composite roofs and implement measures to prevent pillars from falling.
3. Implement full on-site supervision of key operations such as blasting and supporting.
4. Those who have not been trained and qualified are not allowed to enter the mine.
5. Reinforce the single hydraulic prop of the working face before blasting, and strictly implement the blasting, support and on-site safety confirmation system.
6. Strengthen training on blasting qualifications, roof risk identification, support operations and pre-shift safety measures.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-11-28 06:00 (approximately): The six teams in the accident area held pre-shift meetings to arrange on-duty tasks.
- 2023-11-28 07:00 (approximately): 47 operators began to enter the mine.
- 2023-11-28 08:30 (around): Personnel enter the work locations on the 10th floor of the second-level West Five Mining Area.
- 2023-11-28 11:00 (approximately): After the drainage of the second left belt channel was completed, some personnel moved to work near the belt joint and belt head.
- 2023-11-28 12:37 (approximately): A gas explosion occurred on the second installation surface from the left, and shock waves and a large amount of dust appeared in the tunnel.
- 2023-11-28 12:38: The underground personnel reported the accident to the dispatch room; the mine notified personnel on the 10th floor of the West Fifth Mining Area to evacuate.
- 2023-11-28 12:53: The mine established a temporary rescue headquarters and arranged personnel to rush to the scene.
- 2023-11-28 14:20: The scene reported that 11 people were missing at the second installation surface from the left.
- 2023-11-28 15:00: On-site personnel entered the second left aisle to conduct search and rescue operations, and found victims one after another.
- 2023-11-28 16:40: The mine rescue team arrived at the left second belt tunnel to carry out search and rescue.
- 2023-11-29 02:00 (approximately): All 11 victims were lifted underground and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The drainage holes on the second installation surface on the left are not sealed and connected to the pipe, so the gas is naturally discharged; the single-channel damper in the return air lane is open, causing a short circuit in the air flow. There is no wind or light wind in the air inlet lane, and the gas accumulates to an explosive concentration. The detonated cable continued to be charged and generated sparks, igniting gas and killing 11 people and injuring 6 others.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Gas is naturally discharged and local accumulation caused by ventilation short circuit, and sparks from the failed cable cause gas explosion.
2. key contributing factors: Illegal installation of single-channel dampers, failure to seal drainage holes and continuous pumping, monitoring sensors not connected to the Internet; failure of ventilation, gas, electrical and on-site safety management.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly prohibit illegal natural gas emissions and implement gas drainage compliance management.
2. Make sure the ventilation facilities are reliable and the wind is measured according to regulations.
3. Strengthen the networking and maintenance of electrical explosion-proof and safety monitoring systems.
4. Improve the emergency rescue and accident reporting system, evacuate people in a timely manner and notify the rescue team.
5. Seal holes as designed and connect pipes for drainage, improve ventilation facilities and gas monitoring and control, and eliminate explosive electrical equipment.
6. Carry out gas explosion warning education, ventilation gas management and emergency escape training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-12-20 06:30 (around): Each team in the third mining area held a pre-shift briefing to assign day shift tasks.
- 2023-12-20 07:10: Operators entered the mine one after another and took mine trucks to arrive at various operating locations.
- 2023-12-20 09:00 (around): The coal mining team began to dismantle the middle trough and cable trough of the scraper conveyor on the fully mechanised mining face, and installed the flatbed truck for transfer by the retrieval team.
- 2023-12-20 14:10: After the coal bunker is full, coal mining at the fully mechanised mining face stops, and personnel prepare to lift the shaft; 5 mining cars form a mixed load train, and 31 people ride on it.
- 2023-12-20 14:31: The winch driver started to lift the truck after receiving the signal to pull the truck.
- 2023-12-20 14:36: The wire rope broke 40 metres away from the hook head, and the stringer slid down and tipped over 387 to 400 metres away from the winch.
- 2023-12-20 14:40: On-site personnel reported the sports car to the dispatch room and began search and rescue along the roadway.
- 2023-12-20 14:54: The dispatch room was informed that more than 10 people were dead and 7 to 8 injured underground.
- 2023-12-20 15:30: Mine personnel arrived at the accident site, repaired the track and wire ropes in groups, and searched and rescued people in distress.
- 2023-12-20 15:47: All 12 victims and 13 injured were found.
- 2023-12-20 17:31: All 13 injured people were lifted underground and sent to the hospital separately.
- 2023-12-20 19:30: All 12 victims were transported to the ground and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
In the illegally mined third mining area, the mine used winches that were not suitable for lifting inclined shafts and broken wire ropes that exceeded the standard, and arranged for people to ride on string cars carrying mixed goods to lift the shaft. The steel wire rope broke due to overload during the upward movement, and the sports car was connected with the car and tipped over, killing 12 people and injuring 13 others.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The use of steel wire ropes with excessive broken wires and insufficient strength to lift mixed loads of people and goods in violation of regulations. The wire ropes were overloaded and broken, causing a string of sports cars.
2. key contributing factors: illegal mining, illegal use of dispatch winches and non-important steel wire ropes; no sports car protection, lack of maintenance and inspection, long-term illegal pedaling of personnel and insufficient training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to use non-passenger devices to transport people and transport people and goods together.
2. Strictly design and select lifting devices, wire ropes, safety testing and daily inspections.
3. organise production in accordance with the law, and it is strictly prohibited to conceal the operating area or conceal accidents.
4. Improve emergency plans and report accidents promptly and truthfully.
5. Stop illegal production, select lifting equipment and qualified wire ropes in accordance with regulations, set up sports car protection and implement inspection and maintenance.
6. Carry out lifting transportation, separation of people and goods, wire rope inspection and emergency response training.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2024-05-20 17:00: At about 17:00, liquid carbon dioxide began to be injected into the closed track tunnel of the retreat working face.
- 2024-05-20 17:00: From 17:00 to 17:45, personnel entered the sealed front twice to monitor the gas. After no abnormality was found, the spraying personnel entered the track tunnel for operation.
- 2024-05-20 19:01: The material transport personnel found frost in the filling pipe, bubbling and white mist in the water, and informed the on-site personnel.
- 2024-05-20 19:51: On-site personnel reported an abnormality to the first section substation.
- 2024-05-20 20:02: The methane examiner measured the total track lane carbon dioxide concentration up to 4% 20 metres inside the damper, and then returned.
- 2024-05-20 20:13: The methane examiner reported to the person in charge of the ventilation area, and wore a self-rescuer as arranged to enter and check, and found that the person fell to the ground.
- 2024-05-20 20:27: Report the accident to the mine dispatch room.
- 2024-05-20 20:29: The rescuers stopped filling, closed the valve and the tanker, and put on respirators to enter the search and rescue operation.
- 2024-05-20 22:05: 4 injured people were sent to the bottom corner of the first section.
- 2024-05-21 00:20: The five victims were transported to the ground and the on-site rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When dealing with natural fire hazards in the goaf, the mine illegally used the original grouting pipeline to inject liquid carbon dioxide, and at the same time arranged for personnel to spray grout in the track lane. The rubber gasket of the pipeline flange was brittle and damaged at low temperature, and the liquid carbon dioxide leaked, vaporized and spread, suffocating the workers in the alley, resulting in 5 deaths and 4 injuries.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The non-low temperature resistant original grouting pipeline sealing gasket was brittle and damaged, and the liquid carbon dioxide leaked and vaporized, causing the workers spraying grouting in the same tunnel to suffocate.
2. key contributing factors: Natural fire prevention and fire extinguishing measures were not implemented; sufficient risk identification was not carried out; liquid carbon dioxide injection and shotcrete were organised simultaneously in violation of regulations, and there was a lack of dedicated transportation pipelines.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. After mining, the coal face shall be closed permanently and promptly in accordance with regulations.
2. Establish a fire prevention and fire-fighting forecasting system and implement comprehensive fire-fighting and fire-fighting measures.
3. Evacuate personnel from the dangerous area when safety cannot be guaranteed during hidden danger management.
4. Improve monitoring, emergency plans and rescue drills.
5. Use special inert gas delivery pipelines that meet low temperature and pressure resistance requirements, stagger filling and personnel operations, and implement risk management and control.
6. Strengthen fire prevention and extinguishing, inert gas injection, gas monitoring and self-rescue and mutual rescue training.

- 2025-02-19 15:20: The miner reported the accident to the Hunjiang District Emergency Management Bureau and the Jilin Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau on the way to hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
The construction team replaced the designed battery-electric locomotives with human-powered carts at the underground parking lot for auxiliary transportation. After the heavy truck in front was pushed away, 18 mine cars lined up continuously in the inclined shaft and on the negative slope empty car line became unstable and rolled away, squeezing the operator who was dragging the sand ore truck between the mine car and the narrow alley, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The construction unit used human-powered carts instead of designed battery-electric locomotives for transportation without authorization. 18 consecutive mine carts became unstable and rolled away, squeezing the workers to death.
2. key contributing factors: Safety management, training, risk identification and hidden danger management of the construction unit and project department are not in place; the hidden danger of insufficient pedestrian space in the parking lot has not been eliminated, and the coal mine does not strictly supervise the construction unit.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out systematic risk identification and comprehensive hidden danger investigation on work positions and links, focusing on rectifying habitual violations.
2. Rectify hidden dangers and implement closed-loop management according to responsibilities, measures, funds, time limits and plan requirements.
3. The construction unit shall set up a safety management organisation and safety and technical persons in charge in accordance with regulations to strengthen the management of the project construction process.
4. organise auxiliary transportation strictly according to safety facility design, standardize job responsibilities, operating standards and on-site inspections.
5. Carry out safety training for all employees and implement closed-loop management of training, assessment and induction.
6. Prevent the mine car from rolling away and workers from being squeezed in the narrow parking lot.

- 2025-03-14 14:00: The victims were transported to the ground and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The renovation team only constructed 5 top pillars at Sanchakou and failed to reinforce adjacent supports as required by the measures. When the operator went to open the valve of the coal slurry water pipeline, he passed through a dangerous area with insufficient support. The broken roof and affected by concentrated pressure suddenly collapsed, burying him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the Sancha intersection was broken and the pressure was concentrated during the renovation. The adjacent supports were not reinforced as required during the operation. When people passed through the dangerous area, the roof collapsed and buried them.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient risk identification, technical measures preparation and on-site supervision; no timely reinforcement measures were taken for roof sinking, and operators were put on duty without strict assessment.

1. Carry out safety surveillance for high-risk operations such as tunnel maintenance, and complete safety inspections, eliminate hidden dangers, and confirm safety before proceeding.
2. Strengthen the observation and analysis of roof structure and lithology changes, and promptly correct designs and measures.
3. Establish a comprehensive risk-level management and control and self-examination and self-correction mechanism for potential accident hazards.
4. Revisit the design and technical measures of the roadway repair roof, and supplement the support design and management measures for the broken zone, high stress area and three-way intersection.
5. Carry out education on laws, regulations, procedures, measures and accident cases to improve the pertinence of safety education before class.
6. Ensure that the support reinforcement, safety confirmation and on-site monitoring of tunnel maintenance are in place to prevent roof collapse and buried pressure.

- 2025-05-18 06:20: The side-unloading coal loader rolled over the cable when reversing, triggering the feed and main feed switches to trip.

- 2025-05-18 08:40: The hospital confirmed that the casualty had no vital signs during transportation and was clinically dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the side-unloading coal loader was reversing, it rolled over the unregulated cables, causing the feeder switch to trip. The driver of the side-unloading coal loader cut off the damaged cable without authorization and connected the wiring without implementing measures such as power outage lockout, power inspection and discharge; the methane examiner illegally transmitted power, causing him to get an electric shock while holding an exposed copper core, and he died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the side-unloading coal loader illegally made live wiring, and the methane examiner illegally transmitted power, causing the driver who was wiring to be electrocuted.
2. key contributing factors: The cables were not hung in a standardized manner and were rolled over by the caterpillar tracks; the power supply outage system and the allocation of special operations personnel were not implemented, and the investigation of hidden dangers and on-the-job training were mere formalities.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen on-site surveillance of key links and key positions in the mining working face, and seriously investigate and deal with the "three violations".
2. Carry out risk management and hidden danger investigation in key links such as transportation upgrades and power outages on a regular basis.
3. Improve the responsibility awareness and professional supervision capabilities of the mine supervision personnel.
4. Strictly implement the power outage system and the principle of "whoever loses power will deliver power", and staff all shifts with underground electrical special operations personnel.
5. Carry out targeted training and warning education based on job risks, and only those who pass the assessment can take up the job.
6. Prevent non-electrical personnel from illegal power transmission and live wiring operations without implementing power outage measures.

【Accident Mechanism】
Maintenance personnel were working in the B107 return air tunnel where temporary support was not set up and measures were not taken to prevent the expansion of disrepair. Affected by the mining of the adjacent coal face and the surrounding rock fragmentation, the left side became unstable due to the disturbance of the operation. Two people were pushed down and buried under the coal rock. One of them died and the other was injured.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The B107 return air tunnel maintenance point was not provided with temporary support and did not prevent the expansion of the scope of disrepair. The broken surrounding rock was completely fragmented under the disturbance of the operation, and the workers were buried.
2. key contributing factors: The risk of excessive tunnel height and surrounding rock fragmentation has not been fully studied and judged; support design and anchorage force test requirements are missing, and on-site safety inspection, supervision and training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Revisit the management measures for roadway roof repairs and scientifically verify support parameters such as roof bolts.
2. Clarify the standards, frequency and responsible entities for surrounding rock observation, roof separation layer observation and anchorage force test.
3. Carry out special inspections on high-risk locations such as maintenance work surfaces and stop illegal operations in a timely manner.
4. Carry out a comprehensive investigation of hidden dangers such as roof detachment, anchorage strength, temporary support, superelevation of tunnels, and surrounding rock fragmentation.
5. Temporary supports must be set up for maintenance tunnels, and targeted measures must be formulated to prevent the scope of disrepair from expanding.
6. Carry out pre-shift risk reminder and warning education in conjunction with the roof-falling accident in the gang, and those who fail the assessment will not be allowed to work.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2026-04-07 09:30: The mechanic arrived at the +160m water pump room to conduct inspection and maintenance, and found that the sealing packing of the electric gate valve of the No. 3 main drainage pump was leaking.
- 2026-04-07 10:53: The mechanic boarded the platform to deal with the leak, removed the inner fixing nut of the packing gland and loosened the outer nut.
- 2026-04-07 10:59: The mechanic went under the platform to observe the leakage of the valve.
- 2026-04-07 11:03: High-pressure water vapor in the pipeline sprayed out from the gap in the sealing packing, knocking down the mechanic and injuring him.
- 2026-04-07 11:07: The mine duty dispatch received the report of the underground accident, activated the emergency plan and asked the hospital for help.
- 2026-04-07 11:10: The casualty was lifted underground.
- 2026-04-07 11:12: The casualties were sent to Baishan Central Hospital by ambulance personnel.
- 2026-04-07 14:10: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died due to central circulatory failure due to open craniocerebral injury.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the inspection, the mechanic discovered that the sealing packing of the electric gate valve of the No. 3 main drainage pump was leaking. He closed the main pipeline main valve and loosened the packing gland nut, but did not open the pressure relief valve to release the pressure in the pipe. High-pressure water vapor suddenly erupted from the gaps in the filling, knocking him down and causing injuries. He later died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When repairing the valve packing of the pressure-bearing drainage pipeline, the high-pressure water vapor in the pipe was not released according to regulations. The high-pressure water vapor sprayed out knocked the operator to death.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient safety training, system implementation and on-site supervision; lack of supervision mechanism for single-person and single-post operations, and pressure relief requirements for pressure pipeline maintenance have not been implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a supervision and management system for single-person and single-post operations, and clarify approval, operation time limits, and communication requirements.
2. Strengthen on-site supervision of high-risk operations such as pressure pipeline maintenance, and those who fail to perform pressure relief confirmation procedures will be dealt with as serious violations.
3. Establish a closed-loop management mechanism for hidden danger investigation, registration, evaluation, rectification, acceptance, and account cancellation.
4. Set pressure relief confirmation in the pressure pipeline maintenance work ticket. The operator and supervisor must confirm that the pressure has returned to zero before work can start.
5. Carry out training that combines theory, practise and case studies and establish a personal training ledger. Those who pass the assessment will take up their posts.
6. Ensure that pressure relief is carried out first before maintenance of pressure-bearing pipelines, to prevent high-pressure media from ejecting and injuring people.

- 2023-05-05 08:15: The coal washing plant held a shift meeting and the fitter shift union, and arranged for three people to cut recycled iron pipes and rails in the industrial square.

【Accident Mechanism】
When gas cutting of scrap iron pipes was carried out in the industrial square of the coal washing plant, the aged and damaged propane gas transmission hose leaked. The propane accumulated to the explosion limit and exploded when exposed to the gas cutting flame. The worker who was cutting gas was knocked down by the impact and died, and two people nearby were slightly injured by the shock wave.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The aging and damage of the propane gas transmission hose during gas cutting caused propane leakage and accumulation, which caused an explosion when encountering the gas cutting flame.
2. key contributing factors: Gas bottles and hoses were not inspected before operation, equipment maintenance and hidden danger investigation were insufficient, risk management and control, on-site management and special operation training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Check valves, pressure reducers, pressure gauges, hoses, joints and labor protection supplies before operation.
2. Give full play to the on-site supervision role of class leaders, team members and safety officers, and strictly investigate illegal operations.
3. Superior companies and local departments should strengthen safety supervision of ground production systems such as coal washing plants.
4. Strengthen risk management and equipment inspection of gas cutting operations, replace aging and damaged hoses in a timely manner, and ensure that gas bottles, pressure reducers, cutting torches and accessories are in good condition.
5. Carry out safety technical training for special operations personnel such as gas welding and cutting, and take up their posts after obtaining valid operating qualifications.
6. Prevent gas cutting equipment with leakage and aging defects from being put into use, and avoid leakage, accumulation and ignition of flammable gas.

- 2023-10-30 15:05: Medical staff at the mine entrance declared the casualty dead and the rescue was over.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the relocation personnel transported the emulsion tank to the new pump station, one person used a hand chain hoist to lift the tank alone. Because the hoisting operation was not coordinated according to the measures and the fixed lifting points did not meet the requirements, the emulsion tank rolled over, crushing the operator to death.

1. Direct cause: The operator illegally lifted the emulsion tank with a hand chain hoist alone, causing the tank to roll over and crush him to death.

2. Conduct on-site safety confirmation before operation and arrange for cadres to follow the inspection.

4. Use safe and reliable transport vehicles and lifting points that meet the requirements. The lifting of major equipment must be carried out by multiple people according to safety measures.
5. Carry out targeted training around hoisting safety technical measures, risk identification and self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.
6. Identify and control the risk of overturning when transporting and hoisting emulsion tanks, and prevent illegal lifting by a single person.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the 808 parallel channel has separated from the layer, the original support has deformed and its strength has decreased. The workers cut the anchor net and expanded the roof without strengthening the support and temporary support. The roof suddenly collapsed in a large area, causing one person to be buried to death and another person to be injured after his feet were buried.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof detached and the original support deformation operation point did not implement strengthened support and temporary support, that is, illegal expansion and cutting. The roof fell and buried 2 people, causing 1 death and 1 injury.
2. key contributing factors: Ineffective on-site safety confirmation and violation control, no designated rotating safety inspector, inadequate implementation of support measures, training and superior mine supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】

2. Implement safety learning and accident warning education in pre-class meetings.
3. The superior company strengthens the duty performance inspection and daily safety supervision of the mine supervisors.
4. Strengthen support in stress concentration areas or broken roofs, implement temporary support, support first and then dismantle, sound the roof and ribs and conduct on-site inspections.
5. Strengthen roof expansion cutting safety technical measures, three major regulations, self-protection and mutual protection training, and implement assessments.
6. Ensure safety confirmation and enhanced support were completed before roof repair and expansion cutting to prevent injuries caused by empty roofs and roof collapses.

- 2024-09-04 14:00: The second development crew was assigned before the shift.
- 2024-09-04 14:39: Shift personnel entered the mine.
- 2024-09-04 16:35: The workers arrived at II3₁12 machine roadway and started to install roof bolts.
- 2024-09-04 19:16: The roof-bolt support on both ribs was completed, the roadheader-bolter began cutting, and then the roof bolts, cable bolts and rib bolts were installed.
- 2024-09-04 at approximately 21:50: The safety supervisor inspected and found that the anti-rib-spalling mesh was not hung at the heading and pointed out the problem.
- 2024-09-04 22:52: Workers entered to deliver the roof bolts at the heading.
- 2024-09-04 22:55: Coal and waste rock fell at the heading, and workers were knocked down and buried; rescue commenced immediately and the mine control room was notified.
- 2024-09-04 23:53: The casualty was transported to the upper yard of the mining area, and the underground doctor provided first aid.
- 2024-09-05 01:36: The casualties were sent to the hospital for first aid.
- 2024-09-05 02:45: Death was confirmed after unsuccessful resuscitation.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the development heading passed through the fault, no anti-rib-spalling mesh was constructed, and spalling occurred at the heading. The construction worker did not sound the roof and ribs and entered to deliver the roof bolts at the heading. He was knocked down by falling coal and waste rock and buried under pressure. His head hit the edge of the motor box of the roadheader-bolter and was injured.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When excavation through faults, no anti-rib-spalling mesh was constructed, and the workers did not knock on the top of the gang to enter the gang at the heading, and were crushed by falling coal and waste rock.
2. key contributing factors: Fault crossing safety technical measures and roof on-site management are not implemented in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the support design and on-site inspection of fault sections.
2. Implement the system of roof-and-rib sounding procedure at the heading.
3. When excavation through faults, strictly implement anti-slip support and roof-and-rib sounding.
4. Strengthen roof and fault construction safety training.
5. Prevent the excavation head from crushing personnel.

- 2023-10-10 22:20 (approximately): The night shift personnel arrived at the construction site on the upper mountain section of the May Day track; the driver of the rake loader was working on the left side of the equipment, and another on-site personnel was on guard about 30m below.
- 2023-10-11 00:20 (approximately): The security personnel found that the rake bucket rock loader had stopped running. They went to check and found that the equipment was tilted to the left, the ground anchor was uprooted or deformed, and the driver fell on the roadway ground on the left side of the equipment and complained of abdominal pain.
- 2023-10-11 00:20 (later): On-site personnel reported to the deputy captain; the mine arranged to escort the casualty up the well and reported to the dispatching room, which arranged first aid personnel to enter the mine and call 120.
- 2023-10-11 01:20 (approximately): Mine emergency station personnel checked the casualty near the bottom of the well and found that he was not breathing and unconscious, and his vital signs did not recover after performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
- 2023-10-11 02:30 (approximately): The casualty was confirmed dead after being inspected by 120 emergency personnel after rising underground.
- 2023-10-11 05:00 (approximately): The mine arranged for follow-up matters and decided not to report the accident to relevant government departments and superior companies.
- 2023-11-12: When the Handan Municipal Government checked the reporting clues, the relevant personnel concealed the accident in a unified manner.
- 2024-07 (later): After review and review, relevant personnel admitted that a production safety accident occurred in the mine on October 11, 2023, resulting in the death of one person.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the night shift undercover operation, the floor rock at the accident site was eroded by water for a long time and became soft, and the strength of the ground anchor of the rake bucket loader was weakened. The driver operated the equipment without making safety confirmation and without supervision. The rock loader became unstable and tilted to the left. The operating rod pressed against the driver's abdomen. He was later confirmed dead after rescue.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The soft floor eroded by water weakened the ground anchor strength, the rake bucket rock loader became unstable and tilted to the left, and the operating rod pressed against the abdomen of the driver who was operating the equipment without confirming safety, causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The hidden dangers of water erosion of the floor and weakening of ground anchor strength were not checked; equipment operation was unsupervised and safety directed, and risk prediction, inspection and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Increase the frequency of on-site inspections and improve the inspection items of the rake rock loader and the ground anchor tightness records.
2. Confirm environmental risks such as water damage and geological changes before each operation, and stop the machine immediately if any abnormalities are found.
3. Implement equipment operation monitoring and safety command requirements.
4. Report accidents in a timely manner in accordance with regulations, and strictly guard against late reporting, false reporting, and concealment of reporting.
5. Before operation, fully confirm the on-site environment and check the tightness of key parts such as ground anchors; stop the machine immediately if any abnormalities are found and take safety measures.
6. Strengthen training on rake bucket rock loader operation, abnormality identification and handling, and regularly evaluate training effects.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-03-29 00:30 (approximately): Three night shift personnel arrived at the 1277 material transport lane to head on. After completing the first row of coal cutting and roof bolt and anchor net support, no cable bolts were constructed.
- 2024-03-29 00:30 (later): After continuing to cut the second row of coal, the roof debris pressed down on the anchor net; the squad leader arranged to use logs with the cutting part of the tunnel boring machine to withstand the anchor net as temporary support.
- 2024-03-29 04:00 (approximately): The roof fell when two people were supporting the roof at the heading. Two people were buried by falling waste rock, and the other person jumped out of the falling area.
- 2024-03-29 04:30 (approximately): The roof fell again when on-site personnel searched successively, so they reported to the workers on duty in the work area and requested rescue.
- 2024-03-29 04:42: The Dongjing dispatching station received the report, arranged for underground rescue and notified the mine leaders and the Gequan mine dispatching station.
- 2024-03-29 05:10: The dispatch station notified the person in charge of Dongjing about the accident.
- 2024-03-29 05:54: The East Shaft of Gequan Mine reported the accident to the Xingtai Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-03-29 06:03: Gequan Mine reported the accident to the Hebei Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-03-30 18:50 (approximately): The two trapped persons were lifted out of the well and sent to the hospital; the hospital confirmed that both died before the hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the night shift 1277 material transport lane passed through the broken roof of the fault, the cable bolts and airborne temporary supports were not constructed according to the regulations. The squad leader arranged to continue the excavation and used logs and the cutting part of the tunnel boring machine to support the anchor net. When the workers were supporting the workers with an empty roof, the roof fell off, and two people were buried by falling waste rock. They were later rescued and lifted underground. The hospital confirmed that both of them died before the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The 1277 material transport lane failed to strengthen the support when the fault broke the roof. The illegal roofing operation caused the roof to fall, burying two workers and causing them to suffocate to death.
2. key contributing factors: The cable bolts and airborne temporary supports were not constructed according to the regulations, and no dedicated personnel were arranged to observe the mountain; risk identification, technical measures, on-site supervision, hidden danger investigation and training in the fault fracture zone were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Incorporate the risk of roof collapse of broken fault zones into operating procedures and dynamic risk identification.
2. Strictly use airborne temporary support, construct cable bolts according to regulations and arrange for dedicated personnel to observe the mountain.
3. Strengthen the supervision and inspection of the implementation of top-level measures by leaders, followers and superior companies.
4. If the roof is found to be broken, blind footage must be stopped and targeted strengthening of support must be implemented.
5. When passing through the broken roof of a fault, take measures to reduce the spacing between roof bolts, strengthen cable bolts and provide necessary shed-type reinforcement support.
6. Strengthen roof broken identification, temporary support, dedicated mountain observation and procedures implementation training to ensure supplementary training for those who have not participated in the training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-07-04 07:00 (approximately): The morning shift monitor led three excavation workers to the 201 transport frame joint tunnel working face.
- 2024-07-04 09:30 (approximately): The squad leader arranged to drill the blast holes, and four people were divided into two groups to help drill the side holes with a pneumatic drill on the left and right.
- 2024-07-04 09:30 (later): After the right crew completed the fifth blast hole, two rocks fell off in the middle and lower parts of the blast hole; drilling was stopped on site, the rocks were removed and broken, and the scum was cleaned up.
- 2024-07-04 11:00 (approximately): The middle and upper part of the right gang fell off again, hitting the excavation worker who was handling the waste rock. The rock crushed his body and buried his lower limbs.
- 2024-07-04 11:00 (later): On-site personnel called for help, moved rocks with bare hands, rescued the casualty, and transported them out via mining trucks.
- 2024-07-04 11:05: After receiving the report of injuries, the person in charge of the excavation area reported to the person in charge of the mine, and arranged for a team of mine leaders to go to the site to organise rescue.
- 2024-07-04 11:19 (approximately): The mine leader in charge went to the working face after receiving the dispatch call. On the way, he encountered someone who was transporting the casualty in a mine truck.
- 2024-07-04 11:26: The mine leader reported the injury to the company’s dispatch room; the dispatch room activated the emergency plan and contacted the hospital.
- 2024-07-04 12:34: The casualty was sent to Chengde County Hospital for rescue after coming out of the well.
- 2024-07-04 13:02: The casualty arrived at Chengde County Hospital.
- 2024-07-04 14:43: The casualty was death was confirmed after unsuccessful resuscitation.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the morning shift, rock fragments occurred at the heading when drilling side holes. After they were removed on site, they continued to process the waste rock at the heading. Later, the mudstone in the upper part of the right gang fell again, hitting the excavation worker who was working with his back to the support and burying him; on-site personnel rescued and transferred him to the hospital, but the casualty died after ineffective rescue.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The upper mudstone and the lower siltstone were not tightly bonded, and a large piece of upper mudstone fell and hit the operator, causing death.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to identify the risk of re-fracture after the first fragmentation and continuing to work at the heading; incomplete questioning, insufficient targeted measures, on-site management and training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement roof risk source identification, dynamic analysis and process control on-site.
2. Strictly carry out knock-on and ask questions, thoroughly eliminate risks after the first installation and confirm safety before construction.
3. Improve targeted technical measures for uphill excavation to prevent fragmentation at the heading.
4. Strengthen special training for team leaders and implementation assessment of procedures and measures.
5. During uphill excavation, improve measures to prevent chipping, sound the roof and ribs, and dynamic analysis and judgment of roof risks.
6. Carry out roof risk identification, procedural measures, self-protection and mutual protection training for team leaders and operators.

- 2024-08-10 00:42: The driver of the scraper conveyor arrived at work and started the sixth scraper conveyor.

- 2024-08-10 02:27 (approximately): The driver fell into the equipment while inching the sixth scraper conveyor on the reducer to deal with stuck waste rock, and his left leg and waist were squeezed by the machine head.
- 2024-08-10 02:27 (later): A nearby maintenance worker heard the cry and found that the casualty was trapped, and reported to the district team duty officer and squad leader; the on-site personnel used two 5T guide chains to lift the nose of the aircraft to rescue the casualty.
- 2024-08-10 05:17 (approximately): The casualty was raised to the ground via the mine car and the east inclined shaft. After preliminary diagnosis, he was transferred to the hospital for rescue.

- 2024-08-10 10:14: Pit No. 1 of Guoerzhuang Mine reported the accident to the Handan Emergency Management Bureau over the phone.
- 2024-08-10 10:21: The first pit of Guoerzhuang Mine reported the accident to the Hebei Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau over the phone.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver of the night shift scraper conveyor inched the sixth scraper conveyor to process the waste under the chain without locking the power. He fell into the equipment without operating it in a safe place outside the machine head, and his left leg and waist were squeezed under the machine head. On-site personnel used guide chains to rescue and transfer him to the hospital, where he was eventually confirmed dead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the scraper conveyor handled the waste rock stuck under the chain without locking the power and fell into the conveyor, and was crushed to death by the machine head.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to operate in a safe place outside the nose, insufficient single-post equipment inspections and on-site supervision; inadequate safety education, emergency rescue and information reporting management.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the inspection and supervision of single posts and problem-prone equipment, and urge the strict implementation of operating procedures.
2. Strengthen workers’ self-protection and mutual protection, power outage lockout and safe station management.
3. Improve accident emergency rescue, on-site protection and timely information reporting management.
4. The superior company shall strengthen supervision over the implementation of safety training and procedures and measures.
5. Before dealing with conveyor failure or waste rock, the power must be cut off and locked, and the operation must be carried out in a specified safe location.
6. Strengthen training on job procedures, risk identification, equipment power outage and emergency information reporting.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-10-07 13:25 (approximately): The fourth excavation area held a two-o'clock pre-shift briefing to arrange the transportation of steel pipes and cables from the Jiucai Railway Mountain Vehicle Yard to the 2972W Transport Road.
- 2024-10-07 15:50 (approximately): The material transport team arrived at the slope of Jiucai Track Mountain and clarified the division of labor for winch operation, warning and interception, and material receiving in the middle.
- 2024-10-07 17:30 (approximately): The winch began to lower 4 forklifts; after running for about 10 minutes, it was found that the wire rope was loose. It was judged that the vehicle had fallen off the road midway and stopped to tighten the rope.
- 2024-10-07 17:40 (approximately): The warning and interception personnel entered the front of the forklift without contacting the winch driver, and the vehicle moving up the tight rope knocked it down and crushed it.
- 2024-10-07 17:46: On-site personnel reported the condition of the casualty to the dispatch room, and the mine activated an emergency plan and notified the rescue team and hospital.
- 2024-10-07 19:36: Qianjiaying Mine reported the accident to Kailuan Group and requested the hospital to open a green channel for rescue.
- 2024-10-07 20:18: The ambulance team reported that the casualty was seriously injured, breathing weakly and unconscious, and the dispatch room arranged to continue the rescue operation.
- 2024-10-07 21:28: The casualty was taken to Kailuan General Hospital by ambulance after being lifted underground.
- 2024-10-07 22:30: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the steel pipe and cable forklifts were lowered during the two o'clock shift, the winches were stopped after the vehicles were off the road. The interceptor entered the front of the vehicle without contacting the winch driver. The winch tightened the rope to move the forklift upward, knocking it down and crushing it continuously. After the rescue, he was lifted underground and sent to the hospital, where he was confirmed dead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The warning and interception personnel entered the transportation lane in violation of the traffic and pedestrian regulations, and were knocked down and crushed to death by a forklift truck that was tightening the rope.
2. key contributing factors: The winch driver and squad leader drove the truck without confirming that no one was in the transportation lane; insufficient inspections of the transportation range and inspection of hidden track hazards, and inadequate on-site supervision and safety education.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Conduct a comprehensive inspection of the transportation route before starting construction, and promptly rectify hidden dangers such as track height deviations.
2. Implement the transportation safety confirmation responsibilities of the team leader, winch driver and security personnel.
3. Strengthen on-site supervision and anti-violation management at transportation sites.
4. Carry out auxiliary transportation safety education to improve risk identification and self-protection capabilities.
5. Strictly enforce the prohibition of driving and pedestrians, tighten the rope or confirm that no one is within the transportation area before starting the vehicle.
6. Strengthen training on auxiliary transportation procedures, vigilance responsibilities, risk prediction and self-protection capabilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-10-22 22:00: The ten o'clock shift started, 447 people in the mine went down the mine, and 17 people worked on the 2972W transport road.
- 2024-10-22 23:30 (approximately): 8 excavation personnel arrived at the 2972W transport tunnel and started excavation.
- 2024-10-23 01:00 (approximately): Completed the first row of excavation and roof-bolt support.
- 2024-10-23 04:10 (approximately): After completing the second row of excavation, the bolter stopped and raised the airborne temporary support, and the workers were preparing to carry out tunnel support.
- 2024-10-23 04:20 (approximately): The head plate collapsed, 4 people were buried in waste rock, and 2 people were trapped under the temporary support front beam and climbed from the middle of the windlass to the tail.
- 2024-10-23 04:41: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to the main person in charge of the mine.
- 2024-10-23 05:10: Qianjiaying Mine reported the accident to Tangshan Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-10-23 05:29: Qianjiaying Mine reported the accident to the Hebei Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-10-24 09:10: Rescuers rescued the first trapped person through the tunnel, and his vital signs were stable.
- 2024-10-24 09:18: Rescuers rescued the second trapped person, and his vital signs were stable.
- 2024-10-29 04:45: Rescuers found the third trapped person with no vital signs.
- 2024-10-31 02:02: Rescuers found the fourth trapped person with no vital signs.
- 2024-10-31 05:00 (approximately): Rescuers found that the fifth trapped person had no vital signs.
- 2024-10-31 08:18: Rescuers found that the sixth trapped person had no vital signs; all four victims were found.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the ten o'clock shift excavation reached the second row, the head plate was broken and the cable bolt lagged behind. The operators prepared the support before the temporary support. Due to unidentified changes in geological conditions, insufficient support design and strength, and failure to implement measures, the roof was damaged beyond the length of the roof-bolt support and fell. Four people were buried under waste rock and died, and the other two people climbed out on their own and were rescued.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The geological anomalies of the roof were not identified, the support design and strength were insufficient, and safety technical measures were not implemented. The roof rock layer was damaged beyond the bolt support range and fell, burying the workers.
2. key contributing factors: The roof exploration was too far away from the head, the cable bolt did not follow the head and the broken roof was not densely supported; the on-site measures were not implemented according to the requirements when the roof was broken and the pressure was high.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the geological exploration of the roof to ensure that the exploration holes can reflect at the heading changes in a timely manner.
2. The cable bolts follow the at the heading direction closely. When the roof is broken or the pressure is high, the cable bolts are enlarged and the support is reinforced.
3. Strictly implement roof management design, operating procedures and on-site technical measures.
4. Strengthen the research and assessment of major roof risks, on-site supervision and emergency rescue preparations.
5. Use effective roof exploration methods to promptly grasp the geological changes in the at the heading and adjacent areas, and adjust the support design accordingly.
6. Strengthen training on procedures and measures such as roof abnormality identification, cable bolt follow-up and intensive support of broken roofs.
