【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-02-22 14:15 (approximately): Mid-shift workers enter the mine one after another.
- 2025-02-22 14:50: The operators arrived at the 8476 coal face; because the water at the lower end submerged the tail of the loader, the deputy squad leader arranged for three people to clear the silt and drain it.
- 2025-02-22 17:00 (approximately): The water level dropped and relevant personnel returned to their posts at the working face; the shearer cut through the coal wall of the lower head and then cut coal in reverse direction, and the lower end of the working face began to push the sliding frame.
- 2025-02-22 17:20: The deputy squad leader discovered that the base of the 5# support was drilled to the bottom and arranged to clean up the floating coal before leaving for inspection; he later heard a noise and returned and found that the operator was pressed by the descending top beam of the 5# support.
- 2025-02-22 17:20 (later): There was no response to the on-site personnel’s calls, chokeholds and cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and the aircraft’s frontline personnel were called for support.
- 2025-02-22 17:25 (approximately): The squad leader and attendants arrived at the scene and confirmed that the casualty was not breathing and had no pulse; the scene reported to the district team duty room.
- 2025-02-22 17:32: The squad leader and attendants reported the accident to the district team on-duty personnel through the working face phone.
- 2025-02-22 17:34: The district team duty officer reported the accident to the deputy mining director.
- 2025-02-22 17:45-20:00: The mine organised the transportation of the casualty from the working face to the track opening in the name of spare parts hoisting, and then transported the casualty to the bottom of the auxiliary shaft by mining car; during this period, the relevant video surveillance power supply was stopped and personnel from outside units were cleared.
- 2025-02-22 18:00: The deputy mining director reported the accident to the mine director.
- 2025-02-22 19:00: After listening to the accident report, the mine manager decided not to report it to relevant government departments and higher-level enterprises.
- 2025-02-22 20:00 (approximately): The casualty was taken to the Wu'an funeral home after being lifted underground.
- 2025-04-28: The Handan City Work Safety Committee Office submitted an accident verification report; the accident had not been reported to relevant government departments and superior enterprises before.

【Accident Mechanism】
After coal mining resumed in the middle shift, the operator used a road log instead of a single powered support to lift the support base at the bottom of the drill at the 5# powered support at the 8476 coal face. After the track timber slipped, the support fell, and the roof beam pressed against his head and body. After being discovered, on-site personnel carried out rescue operations, but the operator eventually died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A single operator used a road block instead of a single hydraulic prop to lift the base of the 5# powered support. The road block slipped, the support fell, and the top beam squeezed his head and body, causing him to die.
2. key contributing factors: Measures such as long-distance operation, prohibition of using wooden rails to adjust racks, and two-person collaborative work are not implemented; on-site hidden danger investigation, key link control, and relevant training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen on-site operation safety management, fully confirm environmental risks before operation, and strictly implement measures when adjusting brackets.
2. Strengthen the investigation of hidden dangers and the management of single-post operations, improve the safety precautions for adjusting brackets, and stop illegal operations.
3. Strengthen training on electromechanical equipment such as bracket operation and evaluation of training effects.
4. Report production safety accidents promptly and truthfully in accordance with the law, and prevent late reporting, omissions, false reports and concealment of reports.
5. Comprehensively confirm the on-site environment and equipment status before operation, and strictly implement the regulations and safety technical measures when adjusting the bracket.
6. Strengthen support operation and abnormal handling training to enable operators to master equipment performance, operating procedures and correct positions, and regularly evaluate training effects.

- 2025-03-22 00:00 (approximately): 7 excavation personnel arrived at the 2122E air duct and started excavation.
- 2025-03-22 01:00 (approximately): After digging a row, on-site personnel found and used airborne temporary support to lift the steel strips and steel mesh, and began to construct the top anchors.
- 2025-03-22 01:47 (approximately): When 5 top roof bolts were being constructed, a large piece of waste rock hit the middle part of the first half and hit the bolter driver and pressed his legs.
- 2025-03-22 01:47 (later): On-site personnel used shovels to dig out the casualty and carried them on stretchers to the Sicaiping Shimen yard, and reported to the mine dispatch room at the same time.
- 2025-03-22 02:40 (approximately): The mine rescue team arrived at the fourth mining yard to check the casualty.
- 2025-03-22 03:33: The casualty was raised to the well and sent to Kailuan General Hospital for rescue.
- 2025-03-22 04:43: The hospital declared the casualty person dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the 10 o'clock shift had dug a row, the front-facing personnel failed to remove the broken rock mass with sliding surfaces when supporting it with anchor nets. After the tunnel boring machine, rock bolting machine and other operations were disturbed, a large piece of rock above the head was unstable and fell, knocking down the bolt machine driver and pinning his legs. He was rescued on site, raised to the well and sent to the hospital, and was confirmed dead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A large piece of broken rock with a native sliding surface was disturbed by the operation of the tunnel boring machine and bolter and became unstable and fell, hitting the driver of the bolter and killing him.
2. key contributing factors: No net protection was hung on the head, the roof was not carefully knocked and the rocks on the sliding surface were not found; roof risks were not fully identified and controlled, and relevant training was insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out risk identification and assessment of mining conditions, and inform operators of risks and targeted measures.
2. List roof management, especially coal and rock wall management at the head of tunneling, as a key task.
3. Improve the gang risk points and control measures in the operating procedures.
4. Strengthen on-site risk education and training on preventing gangs, knocking gangs and asking for support, and roofing.
5. Implement measures to hang the net at the heading, prevent the roof from collapsing, and knock the roof off, and remove loose rocks with sliding surfaces in a timely manner.
6. Strengthen training on roof risks, on-site protection and correct handling of large-section semi-coal and rock tunnels.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-05-12 13:30 (approximately): After arriving at the 19204 working face pumping station, the squad leader found that the emulsification pump was damaged and arranged for personnel to replace the spare pump while the remaining personnel prepared for production.
- 2025-05-12 18:30 (approximately): The replacement of the spare emulsification pump was completed, and personnel transport the broken pumps and enter the working face for work.
- 2025-05-12 18:40 (approximately): The shearer begins to move upward to cut coal, and the support worker moves the 33-35# support at the tail of the machine.
- 2025-05-12 21:25 (approximately): The inspection personnel found that the head of the bracket worker was squeezed by the lower column of the 35# bracket and the scraper conveyor reducer, and immediately organised rescue and carried him to the side alley.
- 2025-05-12 21:45: The district leader reported the accident to the mine dispatching room by phone.
- 2025-05-12 22:10: The casualty person went up underground and was sent to Wu'an First People's Hospital for rescue after being examined by the mine hospital.
- 2025-05-13 03:02: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2025-05-13 03:10 (approximately): The mine decided to deal with the accident privately with the family and conceal the accident.
- 2025-05-21: Yunjialing Mine and Jizhong Energy Co., Ltd. reported the accident to the Handan Emergency Management Bureau and the Hebei Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau respectively.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the emulsification pump was replaced during the middle shift, the support worker operated the pushing device alone in front of the 35# support and mistakenly pulled the operating handle to move the scraper conveyor toward the support. His head was squeezed by the conveyor reducer and support column, and he died after being rescued in a well and hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The support worker illegally operated the pushing device in front of the powered support column and mistook the wrench. The scraper conveyor moved towards the support, squeezing it between the reducer and the support column and causing death.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to implement the requirement of collaboration between at least two people for operation and rack movement in the stent operation box; insufficient single-person operation inspection, stent adjustment hidden danger investigation, risk management and training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the management and control of key aspects of single-person operation safety inspection and bracket adjustment.
2. Comprehensively investigate the risks and hazards of adjusting brackets and other operations to prevent reckless risks.
3. Implement the bracket operating procedures, two-person collaboration and safe positioning requirements.
4. Report accidents promptly and truthfully, and concealing reports is strictly prohibited.
5. Strictly operate within the stand operation box, and implement the two-person collaboration and prohibition of standing people in dangerous areas when moving and adjusting the stand.
6. Strengthen training on bracket operation, mechanical injury risks and abnormal handling, and carry out accident warning education.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-06-08 06:30: The transportation area held a pre-shift briefing and arranged the maintenance squad leader to deal with the problem of the rope falling of the overhead manned device in the inclined lane of the 11th mining area.
- 2025-06-08 07:50: The maintenance squad leader and others arrived at the slope of the material transport lane in the 11 mining area; the maintenance squad leader took the overhead crew device to the bottom of the slope to check.

- 2025-06-08 10:13 (approximately): The installation of the new wheel system was completed, and follow-up personnel are on site to help pack away the tools.
- 2025-06-08 10:30: The overhead passenger device started trial operation; the maintenance squad leader got off the car after the 31st beam, hung the chair without adjusting the direction of the cable holder to the downward wire rope and rode on it.
- 2025-06-08 10:31 (approximately): The lifting chair was stuck and tilted by the supporting rope wheel shaft under the 32 beams. The maintenance squad leader was squeezed between the lifting chair and the wire rope. The device triggered the anti-rope falling protection and stopped.
- 2025-06-08 10:43 (approximately): On-site personnel reported the accident to the transportation area duty room.
- 2025-06-08 10:54: The transportation area duty room reports to the mine dispatch room.
- 2025-06-08 11:51: On-site personnel used ladders and manual hoists to rescue the casualty. After cardiopulmonary resuscitation, they used stretchers and people and vehicles to transport the casualty to the well, and sent them to the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-06-09 16:35: The casualty was declared dead after rescue efforts by the hospital's ICU failed.
- 2025-06-09 17:10: Dongpang Mine reported death information to Xingtai Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2025-06-09 17:13: Dongpang Mine reported death information to the Hebei Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the maintenance team completed the gear train replacement and trial operation, the maintenance team leader hung the chairlift that had not correctly adjusted the direction of the cable holder to the descending wire rope for a test ride. The chairlift was caught and tilted by the supporting rope wheel shaft under the beam. The squad leader was squeezed between the wire rope and the chairlift and was injured. He died after the hospital failed to rescue him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: During the test ride, the maintenance squad leader hung the lifting chair that had not correctly adjusted the direction of the cable holder on the downward wire rope. The lifting chair got stuck on the supporting rope wheel shaft and tilted up, squeezing it between the lifting chair and the steel wire rope and causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The maintenance and trial operation process and the cable adjustment requirements are unclear, and there is no lifting chair distribution personnel; on-site supervision, risk identification, violation suppression and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Ensure that all protective devices of the overhead passenger equipment are complete and effective, and inspect and test as required.
2. Improve maintenance and trial operation measures and chairlift management, and prohibit illegal entry and exit midway.
3. Carry out inspection of the electromechanical transportation system to eliminate safety hazards such as the need to adjust the direction of the cable gripper.
4. Implement on-site supervision, risk identification and anti-violation management.
5. Revise the specific operation methods for maintenance and trial operation, clarify the direction of the cable grip and the requirements for getting on and off, and strengthen on-site supervision.
6. Carry out maintenance of overhead passenger equipment, riding and hazard avoidance training, examinations and emergency drills.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-10-21 05:00: The morning shift started. The 16 people at the 11216 transport lane development heading were divided into two groups: Production and maintenance; the maintenance team was responsible for replacing the connecting pin between the shovel plate of the mechanized excavator and the first transport slide and extending the belt.
- 2025-10-21 05:00 (later): The fully mechanised excavator retreats to a position 9.5m away from the head end. The production team performs anchor net support, and the maintenance team simultaneously inspects the fully mechanised excavator.
- 2025-10-21 08:34: The maintenance personnel were still unable to align the connecting pins after padding the shovel plate with ballast blocks and track wood supports. When the maintenance workers entered the space behind the shovel board to check, the ballast block shifted, the track wood was cracked, and the shovel board sank and squeezed it.
- 2025-10-21 08:45: On-site personnel dug out live ballast under the casualty person and re-padded the shovel board before rescuing him; the casualty person was breathing and had a pulse but was unconscious, and was subsequently transported on a simple stretcher.
- 2025-10-21 08:54: The on-site person in charge reported to the development zone duty room at the bottom of the slope of 216 Transport Lane; the duty leader immediately reported to the dispatch command center.
- 2025-10-21 08:54 (later): The mine arranged for relevant units to assist in the transfer, first aid station doctors to enter the mine, and to follow the mine leaders to organise rescue on site, and contact the hospital for first aid.
- 2025-10-21 09:54: The casualty was lifted underground.
- 2025-10-21 10:25: The mine ambulance sent the casualty to the hospital for further treatment.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the mechanized excavator was inspected in the morning shift, the maintenance personnel used irregular ballast blocks and track wood to support only one side of the shovel plate, and when the connecting pins could not be aligned, they entered the space under the shovel plate to check. The ballast blocks were unevenly displaced due to stress, the track timbers were cracked due to pressure, and the shovel plate sank, squeezing the maintenance worker. He later died after rescue and hospital treatment.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When irregular ballast blocks and rail supports were used to cushion the shovel board of the mechanized excavator, the ballast blocks shifted and the shovel board sank, squeezing the maintenance worker who illegally entered the space under the shovel board to death.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to implement double fixation and prohibiting the use of irregular and fragile materials; inadequate access control to dangerous areas, on-site supervision, risk investigation and safety training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the management red lines of on-site safety responsibilities, mutual protection and joint protection, and prohibiting venturing into dangerous areas.
2. Comprehensively confirm risks such as mechanical injuries and geological changes before operation, strengthen inspections during operation and correct violations in a timely manner.
3. Carry out practical training on the maintenance of large electromechanical equipment; entrust qualified units to carry out the maintenance if the maintenance capabilities are not available.
4. organise accident warning education and reflection, and deepen anti-violation management.
5. According to regulations, use top lifting and double fixing of standard square logs at the bottom at no less than three places. Personnel are prohibited from entering the limited space of the lifting support pad.
6. Strengthen the practical maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment, correct positioning, abnormal handling and anti-violation warning education.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the morning shift cuts coal to the intersection of the working face tunnel and the coal wall, in order to lift the double-wedge roof beam that affects the shearer's downward movement, the operator enters the machine tunnel to raise fluid to the hydraulic monomer pillar. The unstable false roof on the upper part of the coal wall suddenly fell off, crushing his head and back. He was rescued at the scene, raised to the shaft and sent to the hospital. He died after the rescue failed.

1. Direct cause: The unstable false roof at the upper part of the coal wall suddenly collapsed under the action of mine pressure and disturbance, crushing the operator who was close to the coal wall lifting hydraulic single pillar and killing him.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to carry out inspections, special personnel observation and safe positioning requirements; risk management and control of broken false roofs, hidden danger investigation, on-site surveillance and training are not in place.

2. Strengthen risk confirmation, mutual protection and on-site inspections before operations.
3. Strictly implement roof management regulations and safe positioning requirements.
4. Strengthen accident warning education to stop taking risks and reckless actions.
5. In front of the coal wall side lifting hydraulic single pillar, implement the requirements for sound the roof and ribs, special personnel observation, and operating in a location where the roof is intact.
6. Strengthen roof risk, operating procedures and anti-violation training to learn lessons from similar accidents.

- 2026-03-22 19:18: The ground centralized control personnel found smoke coming from the drive roller bearing seat of the head of the upper warehouse belt conveyor through video, and immediately stopped the machine and notified the on-site belt conveyor driver to check.
- 2026-03-22 19:20: The on-site belt conveyor driver called and reported that there was no smoke and asked to restart the belt conveyor for observation.
- 2026-03-22 19:21: Smoke still appeared after the belt conveyor was restarted; the on-site belt conveyor driver reported that there might be a problem with the bearing seat and entered the inside of the machine head guardrail to check.
- 2026-03-22 19:22: The on-site belt conveyor driver was caught by the rotating coupling when he approached the drum to check. The ground centralized control personnel made an emergency stop and found that his clothes were caught and suspended under the coupling.
- 2026-03-22 19:34: Three nearby personnel arrived at the nose of the aircraft and found the casualty person unconscious.
- 2026-03-22 19:51: Follow-up rescuers cut open the wrapped clothes and carried the casualty to the electromechanical chamber next to the nose of the aircraft.

- 2026-03-22 21:55: After the casualty reached the ground, he was taken to the hospital by ambulance for rescue.
- 2026-03-23 ​​04:24: The hospital declared the casualty person dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
The ground centralized control personnel discovered that the bearing seat of the head of the upper warehouse belt conveyor was smoking and stopped the machine and notified the site for inspection. After the belt conveyor was restarted, the driver of the belt conveyor entered the inside of the protective fence of the running equipment for inspection. When he was close to the rotating coupling, he was caught in clothing and suspended. He later died after rescue and hospital efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the belt conveyor illegally entered the inside of the protective fence of the head of the running upper warehouse belt conveyor and was strangled to death by the rotating coupling.
2. key contributing factors: The electronic fence is in maintenance mode and the sensor is faulty or insensitive, failing to automatically shut down; hidden danger investigation, mutual protection and safety education and training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the regulations on keeping a safe distance from the rotating parts of the belt conveyor during operation, and it is prohibited to enter the protective fence for inspection.
2. Inspect, maintain and use the electronic fence correctly to ensure that its alarm and automatic shutdown functions are effective.
3. Strengthen daily inspections of safety equipment and rectification of hidden dangers.
4. Optimize mutual insurance and joint insurance arrangements and strengthen on-site supervision and risk education.
5. Ensure that safety facilities such as protection for the rotating parts of the belt conveyor and electronic fences are in effective condition. If any abnormalities are found, stop the machine for inspection according to regulations.
6. Strengthen training and education on belt conveyor inspections, warning signs, protective distances and prohibited entry into dangerous areas.

After Zhang Jianguo arranged the work and explained clearly the safety precautions to XX, he followed the deputy captain Ma Zhensheng to carry out the specific division of labor and arranged for the team leader Zhang XX to lead a total of 6 people including Zhao XX, Geng XX, Zhao XX, Zhang XX and Jia Wenxin to turn over a shed in the return air channel.

After the roofing and opening were in place, the roof beams and left legs of the 13th ladder-shaped shed were installed, and Jin and Huang were laid. 【Accident Mechanism】
The staff on duty are turning over the shed in the return air channel. The retractable leg clamps on the right side of the 12th ladder-shaped shed were not tightened, and the shed beams were not firmly supported. The pressure from the coal and waste rock on the broken roof caused the shed to become unstable and sink. The falling coal and waste rock buried the tunnel construction worker to death.

1. Direct causes: The leg clamps of the trapezoidal shed were not tightened, the shed beams were not backed firmly, and the pressure from the coal and waste rock on the broken roof caused the shed to become unstable and fall, burying the operator to death.

2. Carry out special inspection and management of hidden dangers in roof management, and arrange special personnel to supervise key projects.
3. Strengthen the investigation of hidden dangers in key areas and the implementation of procedures and measures.
4. Improve the pertinence and effectiveness of safety education before class, and strictly prohibit illegal operations.
5. Strictly organise the operation in accordance with the safety technical measures for advance shed replacement. Before turning over the shed, sound the roof and ribs and ask for help. After the completion, a designated person will inspect and accept the shed.
6. Carry out roof accident case warning education and job risk identification training to strengthen self-protection and mutual protection.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the construction of the Auxiliary Shaft Ten Yokogawa anchor bolt, an operator left the working site and entered the operating range of the mine car. The descending hook truck collided and squeezed it, causing fatal injuries.

【Cause Analysis】

- 2023-03-06 19:18: The mine dispatcher received the accident report, and the mine launched an emergency plan to organise rescue.
- 2023-03-06 19:20: The first trapped person was rescued.
- 2023-03-06 19:32: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to Fu Kuang Group.
- 2023-03-06 20:05: Fu Kuang Group reported the accident to the provincial coal mine safety supervision department and the Liaoning Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2023-03-06 20:20: The second trapped person was rescued.
- 2023-03-06 21:04: The third trapped person was rescued and the on-site rescue ended.
- 2023-03-06 22:30: An injured person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2023-03-07 00:32: Another injured person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the workers on duty found that part of the roof and coal gangs of the working face were broken, they replaced the guard facilities and fixed the logs in front of the 61# to 64# supports. The workers entered the empty roof area and removed the flying pillars, which caused the protection to fail. The coal wall fragments caused the roof to leak. Two people were buried to death and one was injured due to falling coal and waste rock.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The protective facilities in the broken coal seam area failed. Workers entered the empty roof area to replace the protective facilities. The coal wall fragments caused roof leakage and buried people.
2. key contributing factors: The broken roof area was not moved forward in time, the single-layer metal mesh protection capability was insufficient, and on-site management, risk control and safety confirmation were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. For high-risk nursing operations, designated personnel are assigned to operate and supervise the operations, and the entire process is supervised.
2. Strengthen roof mine pressure observation, support working resistance analysis and network introduction management.
3. Add metal mesh in areas with severely broken roofs to improve coal wall protection capabilities.
4. Establish a safety inspection review mechanism to supervise the closed loop of rectification of major hidden dangers.
5. Refine the guarding operation process and safety measures, strictly control the overhead distance and move the rack in a timely manner.
6. Carry out targeted roof safety education, pre-shift risk warning and accident warning training.

the workers on duty are digging and supporting the N4306 return air channel. 1. Direct cause: Illegal ultra-deep cross-border mining to outburst dangerous coal seams, inadequate outburst prevention measures, coal cutting by mechanized excavators disturbed coal mass instability, causing coal and gas outbursts.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the pantograph beside the electric locomotive failed to rise, the driver failed to report and cut off the power according to the regulations, and opened the high-voltage load chamber without authorization to deal with the fault. He mistakenly touched the door lock switch, causing the nearby pantograph to connect to high-voltage wiring. His head came into contact with a live overcurrent relay, causing him to be electrocuted.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver handled the fault illegally when the safety protection device failed. Without cutting off the power, he mistakenly connected the pantograph on the side to the high-voltage wiring, touching the live overcurrent relay and died.
2. key contributing factors: The quality of maintenance and repair of electric locomotives is low, the door lock switch failure has not been rectified; fault handling procedures, risk identification, on-site supervision and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】

2. Carry out special risk identification and supervision inspections for high-risk operations such as walking platforms.
3. Improve the division of responsibilities, operating procedures and safety monitoring measures for electric locomotive maintenance and troubleshooting.
4. Improve the pertinence of safety education before work, and strengthen workers’ risk identification and mutual protection awareness.
5. Investigate and rectify defects in the high-voltage load chamber, door lock switch and safety protection device of the electric locomotive, and clarify the maintenance and troubleshooting procedures.
6. Strengthen electric locomotive fault handling, power outage confirmation and on-site monitoring training.

The shaft maintenance personnel mistakenly hung the safety belt on the relatively movable main skip and started the hoist without confirming the safety of the shaft operation. - 2025-12-06 23:20: Personnel on duty arrived at the 1316 fully mechanised mining face for work.
- 2025-12-07 00:00: Three operators began to clean the coal and waste rock between the hydraulic supports in the advance support section of the return air duct and tried to move the No. 1 support.
- 2025-12-07 01:30: It was discussed on site to use a back column winch to drag the No. 1 powered support, and to connect the wire rope and the support with a scraper conveyor chain.
- 2025-12-07 01:50: The return column winch pulls the No. 1 bracket forward by about 200 mm.
- 2025-12-07 02:01: When the traction bracket did not move again, the operator operated the push-pull cylinder at the No. 2 bracket; the chain broke, and the ejected link hit his left leg.
- 2025-12-07 02:03: On-site personnel reported the accident to the dispatch room and requested the arrangement of underground vehicles and ambulances.
- 2025-12-07 02:11: On-site personnel used the air door panel as a stretcher to transport the casualty away from the scene.
- 2025-12-07 02:38: The casualty arrived at the head of the auxiliary shaft. A preliminary examination by the mine doctor found a fracture in the left thigh and massive blood loss.
- 2025-12-07 03:10: The ambulance arrived at the hospital. Emergency examination showed that the casualty had no spontaneous breathing and no heart rate. He died after resuscitation failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The operator on duty moved the stuck No. 1 powered support, illegally used the back-column winch and scraper conveyor chain to pull the support, and operated the push-pull cylinder in the wire rope running area. The chain broke under the combined force of the winch and the push-pull cylinder, and the ejected chain link hit an operator in the leg, causing him to die of hemorrhagic shock.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally used the back column winch and the non-standard scraper conveyor chain to drag the powered support, and operated in the dangerous area of ​​the wire rope. The chain broke and rebounded, causing death from blood loss.
2. key contributing factors: The powered support was poorly maintained, illegal towing was not stopped at the scene; the operators did not implement the driving and pedestrian regulations, video surveillance management and safety training were ineffective, and the accident was deliberately concealed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the responsibility to report accident information timely and truthfully, and prohibit the forgery or destruction of telephone recordings and video materials.
2. Implement no operation without video and strengthen on-site video and power supply management.
3. Carry out special risk identification and formulate control measures for inclined tunnel transportation and large equipment handling operations.
4. Standardize reporting procedures for abnormal deaths by medical and funeral institutions.
5. Strictly implement the four-person chain and no-passenger system for winch transportation, establish maintenance files for hydraulic supports and winches, and conduct regular inspections.
6. Carry out training on mine management in accordance with the law, accident reporting, winch transportation safety, emergency self-rescue and mutual rescue training, and accident warning education.

- 2026-02-13 09:15: Wind measuring workers entered the uphill contact lane of the belt in the North No. 1 mining area.
- 2026-02-13 11:20: When the inspection personnel passed the entrance of the tape uphill contact lane in the North No. 1 mining area, they found the wind measuring worker passed out in the lane.

- 2026-02-13 12:19: The casualties were transported to the ground and sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2026-02-13 15:25: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The low-oxygen gas in the sealed uphill connection tunnel of the Bei No. 1 mining area leaked out under the influence of air pressure changes, and diffused through the ventilation of the original ore hole, reducing the oxygen concentration in the tunnel. The wind measuring worker failed to detect the gas according to the regulations and confirm that the environment was safe before entering the tunnel to measure the wind. He fell into a coma due to lack of oxygen and died after resuscitation failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Hypoxic gas in the airtight chamber leaked into the communication alley. The wind measuring workers did not detect the gas and entered the work without confirming that the environment was safe. They died of hypoxia and coma.
2. key contributing factors: cracks in the airtight walls and surrounding rock spray materials were not dealt with in time, air leakage analysis and gas observation were insufficient, ventilation air volume configuration and on-site risk identification were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Optimize the ventilation system. Air distribution in closed tunnels should consider the risk of gas leakage and conduct air leakage analysis regularly.
2. Hang a methane sensor in front of the seal, and add an oxygen sensor for nitrogen injection and carbon dioxide sealing, and deal with abnormalities in a timely manner.
3. Improve the containment management system and technical parameter standards, and carry out special spot inspections.
4. Supervise the effective implementation of the mine safety responsibility system at each position and strictly investigate illegal operations.
5. Use concrete walls and other methods to improve the sealing strength and sealing effect, seal the cracks in the sealing wall and surrounding rock, and improve the automatic drainage system.
6. Carry out safety thought and operational skills training based on the characteristics of single-person operations such as wind surveyors and methane examiners, and strengthen accident warning education.

The initial support strength of the single pillar in the nose section of the 205 sub-surface machine has not reached the standard for a long time, and the beam moving operation did not include a third person to observe the roof and pillars according to the regulations. - 2014-06-15 20:50: After the pumping work was completed, Wu Moumou and Wu Fayong went up to the well. Kong Moumou, the mine entrance inspector, found that three people had gone down the well and only two came up, so he told Wu Faxiang and Min Shilin that Min Shilin had not yet gone up the well. Wu Moumou and Wu Fayong immediately went down to the well to look for people.
- 2014-06-15 21:05: A gas suffocation accident occurred in No. 1 Shaft 31021 of the Yajing Coal Mine of Guangxi Huanjiang Yajing Mining Co., Ltd., leading to the death of one person and direct economic losses of about 1.2 million yuan. - 2014-06-15 21:05: Wu Moumou and Wu Moumou were going up the mountain to cut the hole in 31021. About 8 metres away from the cut hole entrance, they found Min Moumou. They called the emergency management department but there was no response. Wu Faxiang opened the air duct that ventilated the back alley of 3102 and directed the wind towards Min Shilin. The two people immediately entered the cut hole to rescue people. After taking Min Shilin to a distance of about 2 metres from the eye-cut opening, two people put Min down due to lack of physical strength. 4. Cut off the power supply, set up fences and warning signs at the site where work and wind are suspended; if gas or carbon dioxide exceeds the limit and cannot be dealt with immediately, seal it within 24 hours.
5. Truthfully inform the workplace of hazards, prevention and emergency measures, and carry out safety and emergency response training for all employees.

- 2020-12-23 19:00: The casualty was sent out of the mine entrance. After on-site treatment by doctors, he died due to excessive injuries and failed rescue efforts.

【Accident Mechanism】
The replacement hooker on the upper platform attached 3 more mine cars without re-closing the car arrester and barrier, and the connecting bolts, safety ropes and fishtail devices were not used as required, causing the first 7 mine cars to slip past the slope change point. The chief of the electromechanical section entered the winch lane to repair the signal light without contacting the winch driver and hooker, and was hit by a sports car and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The top shift hooker's illegal operation caused 7 mine car sports cars to hit the electromechanical section chief who did not enter the winch maintenance line according to the procedure, causing his death.
2. key contributing factors: illegally commanding ground transport workers who are not familiar with the business to work alone; the anti-car device failed, there were insufficient people to remove hooks, troubleshooting was not stopped and relevant positions were not notified, and training and on-site supervision were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to take over jobs, skip jobs, mix jobs, and adjust positions without training and without replacing the old with the new.
2. Strengthen daily inspections of upper and lower platforms, car barriers, car arresters and anti-car devices.
3. Implement the leadership of mine leaders and inspections of key positions to promptly discover and eliminate transportation hazards.
4. Clean up and revise the company and mine responsibilities, systems and mine safety responsibility systems, and strictly prohibit illegal command and operations.
5. Comprehensively investigate and improve the "one slope and three blocks" facilities in the inclined lanes; stop transportation when the facilities are incomplete, and provide sufficient hoist drivers and hooking personnel as required.
6. The training for job changes and new mining personnel shall be no less than 72 hours, and standardized personal and corporate training files shall be established.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-12 08:00: The mine dispatch assigned for the electromechanical team to deal with the bearing failure of the No. 2 emulsion pump on the 14I05 mining preparation working face.
- 2023-06-12 14:50: Three maintenance personnel found that the oil seal and bearing of the No. 2 emulsion pump were damaged and there were no accessories underground. After that, they all went up the well to search for accessories.
- 2023-06-12 15:30: In order to adjust the powered support, the pump station driver started the No. 1 emulsion pump; found that the fresh water pump was leaking and stopped the pump. According to the instructions of the shift leader, he removed the No. 2 fresh water pump and replaced it with the No. 1 pump.
- 2023-06-12 15:40: Fresh water pump replacement completed. The driver of the pumping station reminded the maintenance personnel to stay away from the No. 1 emulsion pump, and then went to the switch chamber to start the pump.
- 2023-06-12 15:45: After the No. 1 emulsion pump ran for about 5 minutes, the high-pressure hose joint fell off; a cleaner was hit by the high-pressure emulsion and fell to the ground and was injured. The pump was immediately stopped on site and rescue was carried out.
- 2023-06-12 16:58: Mine rescuers transported the casualty to the head of the No. 2 main shaft, and hospital medical staff on standby sent him to hospital for treatment.
- 2023-06-13 01:10: Hospital medical staff confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed, and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the No. 2 emulsion pump failed, its fresh water pump was removed and installed on the No. 1 emulsion pump on site. About 5 minutes after the pump station was started, the joint of the hydraulic high-pressure hose of the No. 1 pump suddenly fell off, and the 25MPa high-pressure emulsion directly hit the cleaner who was still next to the motor, causing serious injuries and later died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The hydraulic high-pressure hose joint of the No. 1 emulsion pump in operation fell off, and the high-pressure emulsion directly impacted the person next to the pump motor, causing serious injury and death.
2. key contributing factors: Purchasing and using counterfeit and withheld high-pressure hoses that did not meet the requirements; operating the pump without acceptance after adjusting the pump pressure from 18MPa to 25MPa; failing to effectively clear the site and provide warning before maintenance and startup; and failing to train personnel to participate in maintenance.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. organise warning education for all employees and use the accident date as the warning education day.
2. Strictly implement the management system for the procurement, entry and use of coal mine products.
3. Formulate and implement special rectification measures against "three violations" for all employees, and deal with typical violations in a timely manner.
4. Strictly implement the maintenance, acceptance and safety operating procedures of the emulsion pump station.
5. Strictly review mining equipment procurement qualifications and product safety qualifications, strictly control quality before use, and prohibit equipment and materials that do not meet coal mine requirements from being used in wells.
6. Strengthen safety training and assessment for key positions and key personnel, and improve their ability to comply with regulations and protect themselves and each other.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-11-26 16:00: Five operators arrived at the 2106 coal mining working face and began to repair and strengthen the skewed scaffolding from bottom to top.
- 2023-11-26 20:40: The captain of the coal mining team arrived at the scene and found that the roofing material had been used up and the pillar base sank into the floor. Three people were arranged to lower the single hydraulic prop to the ground; the remaining two people continued to repair the scaffolding.
- 2023-11-26 21:46: When the seventh scaffold was not connected to the roof, two support workers continued to repair the eighth scaffold; the roof suddenly collapsed, and the two were buried under the rubble and the scaffold.
- 2023-11-26 21:59: The safety inspector reported the accident to the mine leader on duty, who organised the workers on duty to rush to the scene for rescue.
- 2023-11-26 23:10: A buried person was rescued with minor injuries.
- 2023-11-26 23:19: The mine leader reported the accident to the dispatch room and requested reinforcements.
- 2023-11-26 23:27: The chief engineer of the mine reported to the superior company; the superior company reported to the County Emergency Management Bureau and requested rescue from the rescue squadron and 120 emergency center.
- 2023-11-27 01:12: 9 members of the rescue squadron arrived at Beiya Coal Mine.
- 2023-11-27 02:56: Rescuers rescued another person who was buried.
- 2023-11-27 04:48: The casualty was carried out of the well.
- 2023-11-27 04:52: The hospital doctor waiting at the mine entrance pronounced him dead after resuscitation efforts failed, and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the fault-affected area was broken, and the continuous scaffolding on the site was skewed. The seventh scaffold had not been connected to the roof because the roofing materials had been used up. The workers still moved forward to repair the eighth scaffold and erect the pillars, resulting in an empty roof operation. The roof collapsed immediately, burying two support workers, causing one death and one injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The seventh auxiliary scaffold in the roof broken area was moved forward to repair the eighth auxiliary scaffold when the roof was not connected. The empty roof operation caused the roof to collapse, causing one death and one injury.
2. key contributing factors: The banned tunnel-type coal mining technology was adopted, special measures lacked operability and mining procedures were not compiled; roof grading, mine pressure observation, pillar wearing, material equipment and on-site surveillance were not implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Stop mining and production before closing, and retain daily security activities such as ventilation, drainage, gas inspection, and safety monitoring.
2. The demolition work shall not be outsourced or subcontracted, and mine leaders shall strictly control the work and on-site supervision.
3. Ensure the operation of the monitoring and personnel location system during shutdown and exit, and implement permanent sealing of the main ventilator before shutting down.
4. Relevant government departments are stationed at the mine to guard the mine and prohibit irrelevant personnel from entering the mine, mining activities and the use of pyrotechnics.
5. Stop mining activities except for daily security according to the closure and exit plan, and strictly implement mine leadership leadership, on-site safety control and safety technical measures when dismantling operations.
6. Rectify formal safety education and training, and improve workers’ awareness of roof risk identification, self-protection and mutual protection, and prohibition of empty roof operations.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-05-14 22:30: A pre-shift briefing was held in the first excavation work area to arrange for operators to transport shotcrete materials and clean the westward wind downhill tunnel and ditches.
- 2024-05-15 05:52: The shift manager led an operator into the 4203 track channel and contact lane for inspection; when they arrived at the intersection of the contact lane and the track channel, a piece of coal on the right side crushed the operator.
- 2024-05-15 06:01: The mine director reported the accident to the Heshan Emergency Management Bureau.

- 2024-05-15 06:50: The Heshan Squadron of the Guangxi Mine Rescue Brigade and the Heshan People's Hospital arrived at the mine to participate in the rescue.
- 2024-05-15 08:10: The casualty was transported to the ground. After on-site diagnosis by 120 emergency doctors, it was confirmed that there were no vital signs, and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the shutdown of the 4203 track channel connection lane, the coal gang at the intersection of the contact lane and the track channel was not supported as required. When the operator entered the area for inspection, the loose coal wall on the right side suddenly broke apart, and the coal fell and crushed him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal gang at the intersection of the suspended roadway was not supported. When the operator entered the area for inspection, he was crushed to death by a sudden gang of coal.
2. key contributing factors: The construction was not carried out in accordance with the requirements of "one cycle, one support" and strengthened support in special areas; hidden dangers were not eliminated and there were no effective control measures. The contact lane operation procedures and special support measures for intersections were not prepared, and training was not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Convene a special meeting on roof management analysis and judgment at least once a month to improve roof management measures.
2. Complete the support and inspection of the shut-down tunnels and intersections according to technical measures, and report and handle any hidden dangers in a timely manner.
3. Establish risk-level management and control, hidden danger investigation and management, and accountability mechanisms.
4. Set up an accident warning education day and carry out warning education for all employees on a regular basis.
5. Establish and strictly implement systems such as support design, construction quality inspection, special roof management, tunnel inspection and maintenance, and support and inquiry; clarify the warranty responsibilities of each tunnel in use and deal with hidden dangers in a timely manner.
6. Carry out precise training focusing on on-site risks and operational difficulties; new workers must undergo no less than 72 hours of training and pass the assessment before taking up their posts, and the authenticity of the certificates must be verified.

- 2026-05-22 23:30: After the operators completed the top anchor net support, an excavation worker operated a bolt machine in the dangerous area of ​​the right side of the empty gang to drill the roof cable bolt; the waste rock on the right side suddenly slipped and injured him.
- 2026-05-22 23:33: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to the mine director.
- 2026-05-23 00:17: The mine reported the accident to Baise City Emergency Management Bureau.

- 2026-05-23 01:50: Baise City rescue team and underground rescue personnel transported the casualty to the mine entrance; 120 emergency personnel confirmed that he had no vital signs after on-site inspection and rescue, and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The excavation team on duty continued to dig 2 metres when the right side of the right side of the tunnel was 1.3 metres long and the empty side of the tunnel was not supported, so that the empty side of the tunnel expanded to 3.3 metres. When the operator was drilling for roof cable bolts in this dangerous area, the right side of the rock mass cracked, and the waste rock fell and hit his back, neck and left arm, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator drilled cable bolts in the dangerous area of ​​the right side of the sky that exceeded the limit of the operating procedures, and the rock mass cracked and hit the workers.
2. key contributing factors: Excavation continued on site when there was an unsupported hollow, forming a 3.3-meter hollow; operating procedures were inconsistent with on-site construction, joint review and training were mere formalities, and on-site roof management and supervision were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the roof management responsibilities of the mine director, chief engineer, person in charge of safety, district captain, team leader and position personnel, and conduct regular inspections.
2. Strictly review operating procedures in a centralized manner to improve the pertinence, guidance and operability of procedures and safety technical measures.
3. Strictly implement face-to-face shift handover at the underground site, and remote handover via telephone or communication equipment is prohibited.
4. Implement closed-loop management of roof management, anti-"three violations", education and training before going underground, and hidden danger investigation and management.
5. Revise and implement the mine safety responsibility system and roof management responsibility of all employees; clarify support measures such as laying nets and constructing temporary anchors in complex geological areas, and prohibit operations in dangerous areas with empty roofs.
6. Centrally publicize and implement operating procedures, and short pre-shift meetings shall not be used to replace systematic training; targeted training and refresher training shall be carried out according to majors and types of work, and employees shall not be employed without passing the training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-06-22 20:30: The Second Artillery and Excavation Team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange coal mining in No. 3 silo, and uphill excavation and transportation tasks in No. 1.
- 2020-06-22 21:00: 8 operators entered the mine from the auxiliary shaft and went to work at various operating locations.
- 2020-06-23 01:00 (around): The team leader inspected the excavation operation of No. 1 up the mountain after shooting up the mountain on No. 3, and the scene was normal.
- 2020-06-23 03:00 (around): After firing the second shot, the excavation operator complained of feeling unwell and left the working face.
- 2020-06-23 04:00 (around): The companion did not see him returning, so he went to +950 metres to return to the wind alley to search without success and continued the operation.
- 2020-06-23 04:30 (around): The team leader learned that the person had not returned and started searching.
- 2020-06-23 05:00 (around): The worker was found unconscious and not breathing in the No. 2 uphill contact lane.
- 2020-06-23 06:00 (around): Organise people who have ascended the well to go underground for rescue.
- 2020-06-23 06:32: Relevant personnel from the mine decided to conceal the accident after discussion.
- 2020-06-23 08:00 (approximately): Rescuers transported the victims from the inclined wind shaft to the ground and sent them to the hospital. The doctor confirmed their death.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine organizes operations in the mining area of the No. 8 coal seam in the south wing. The ventilation system is disordered, resulting in a breeze and no wind in the No. 2 uphill tunnel. The excavation operator left the working face and entered a windless tunnel, lost consciousness and died; the mine subsequently decided to conceal the accident.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The ventilation system in the south wing warehouse mining area was disordered, resulting in a windless tunnel. The operator died after entering the windless area on the No. 2 mountain.
2. key contributing factors: illegally organised production without a license, inadequate ventilation facilities and systems, failure of safety monitoring and personnel positioning systems or deletion of data; deliberate concealment of reports after the accident.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to organise mining operations without complete procedures and safe production conditions.
2. Improve ventilation systems, facilities and safety monitoring, and strictly prohibit the use of obsolete equipment and processes.
3. Allocate safety supervision forces to investigate and deal with unlicensed production, ventilation failure and concealment of reports in accordance with the law.
4. Strict accident reporting system.
5. Stop mining until the procedures are complete and safe production conditions are met, and ventilation systems, facilities and monitoring coverage should be improved.
6. Recruit qualified personnel according to regulations and conduct training on ventilation safety, risk identification and accident reporting.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-02-11 16:00: The comprehensive mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the movement of hydraulic supports along the return air channel and other operations.
- 2022-02-11 17:30 (around): The workers on duty entered the mine and arrived at their posts, and began to move the first support and maintain other support consoles.

- 2022-02-11 21:35: The operator was lifting the tool box and lowering the support column. The triangular inclined beam slipped and injured a support worker.
- 2022-02-11 21:46: The scene reported to the dispatch information command center that a person's leg was hit.
- 2022-02-11 22:25: The casualty was transported to the ground through the wind shaft.
- 2022-02-11 23:30: Toksun County People's Hospital confirmed the death of the casualty and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The operator used a powered support to lift the tool box and lower the column in the return air channel, causing the top beam of the support to tilt forward. The triangular inclined beam that was welded and fixed fell due to gravity after desoldering, hitting the worker in front of the rack and killing him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The powered support lifted the tool box and lowered the column, causing the roof beam to tilt forward. The desoldered triangular inclined beam slipped and injured the worker in front of the support, causing death.
2. key contributing factors: Illegal welding and modification of the triangular inclined beam at the top of the support, failure to test and accept, and failure to be detachable and fixed as designed; insufficient risk analysis, technical measures, on-site prevention and job transfer training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Install and use support equipment in strict accordance with the design, operating procedures and operating procedures.
2. Comprehensively study and judge the risks in equipment installation, use and each operation link, and implement control measures.
3. Strengthen on-site violation control and safety technology approval, and strictly prohibit illegal underground fires.
4. Improve the management of coal mine safety supervision agencies and mine personnel.
5. Re-install the supporting equipment according to the design, prohibit illegal welding modifications, and improve the safety measures for the use of brackets and tool lifting.
6. Strengthen onboarding, job transfer, scaffolding operation and evidence collection training for management personnel to improve self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

- 2022-09-18 21:15: The vehicle arrived at the air door of the return air contact lane of 11701 Return Air Lane; the driver stopped and turned off the engine and got out of the car to open the door. The vehicle slid down and squeezed it on the air door.

- 2022-09-22 08:57: Hami City Emergency Management Bureau received the accident report.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver of the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle on duty was transporting gravel to the slope door. He illegally parked the vehicle and got off the vehicle to open the door on his own without setting up a vehicle backstop. The vehicle slid down and squeezed him against the air door. He died after being sent to the hospital but failed to save him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver got out of the car at the 9° slope door and opened the door illegally without setting up a vehicle backstop. He was crushed to death by the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle that slid down.
2. key contributing factors: No targeted measures have been formulated for temporary transportation routes and damper risks, no automatic dampers or dedicated management have been set up; safety systems, on-site supervision and training are insufficiently implemented, and accidents are reported late.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate risks in temporary projects, facilities and transportation links and make closed-loop rectifications.
2. Install automatic dampers in the inclined transport lane or assign dedicated personnel to manage them, and implement measures to prevent collisions between vehicles and dampers.
3. Strict leadership and follow-up supervision and on-site violation management.
4. Report accidents promptly and accurately, and late reporting is strictly prohibited.
5. Formulate special measures for temporary transportation routes and dampers, install automatic dampers or assign dedicated personnel to manage them, and configure vehicle stop and on-site communication facilities.
6. Carry out warning education on trackless rubber-tyred vehicles driving in inclined lanes, wind gates and accident cases to improve compliance and emergency response capabilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-10-29 23:00: The transportation team held a pre-night shift meeting and arranged to clean up the transfer point and sprinkle coal before operating the belt conveyor.
- 2022-10-29 23:35: Night shift personnel arrive at work to take over the shift, and divide their duties to guard the conveyor and clean and unload the coal.
- 2022-10-30 00:25: Start the loading belt.
- 2022-10-30 00:27: Remotely release the brake brake of the belt conveyor for transportation up the mountain, and the belt will stop after sliding down for a while.
- 2022-10-30 00:31: On-site personnel found that the waste rock was stuck between the unloading drum and the belt, and began to process it.
- 2022-10-30 00:44: The operator returns to the unloading drum with a short-handled tool.
- 2022-10-30 00:49: The uphill belt slid down, and the operator's right arm and shoulder were caught between the belt and the roller.
- 2022-10-30 00:52: The scene reported to the dispatch room that the person was stuck by the roller and rescue was carried out.
- 2022-10-30 01:15: The mine director reported the accident to the superior company, local departments and the Xinjiang Bureau of the State Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2022-10-30 02:25: Rescuers cut off the roller base bolts and rescued the casualty and transported them to the ground.
- 2022-10-30 02:38: The casualties were sent to Hutubi County People's Hospital.
- 2022-10-30 04:06: The hospital failed to rescue and confirmed death, and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
Night shift workers clean up coal spills at transfer points and deal with waste rock stuck between the unloading drum and belt. When the brake brake was released, the waste rock shattered, and the belt slid down under the action of the pretension force and the weight of the coal. An operator was caught between the drum and the belt, and he died after the rescue failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the brake was released, the operator put his arm between the unloading drum and the belt to handle the waste rock. The belt slid down and was involved in the waste rock death.
2. key contributing factors: Belt conveyor job responsibility system and braking operating procedures are not perfect; corrective measures for coal sprinkling and waste rock jamming are not implemented, and on-site inspections, violations are stopped, and training is insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. When dealing with stuck waste rock, the machine must be shut down and long tools must be used. It is strictly forbidden to enter the dangerous area with the body.
2. Improve belt conveyor communication, emergency broadcast, braking and operation management.
3. Implement hidden danger rectification and team on-site supervision, and carry out anti-violation rectification on a regular basis.
4. Improve the quality of conveyor job safety training and risk identification.
5. Rectify the problems of coal spilling and jamming at the unloading point, and improve the operating procedures and protection of the centralized control, tensioning and braking devices of the conveyor.
6. Carry out conveyor shutdown and blocking, jamming handling, risk identification and anti-violation training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-11-24 15:00: The project department held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the disassembly and transportation of the return air channel advance powered support.
- 2022-11-24 15:30 (around): The workers on duty entered the mine from the auxiliary inclined shaft and went to the W1103 return air channel to start dismantling the downed bracket.
- 2022-11-24 17:25 (around): The shift leader went to the return air channel to inspect the bracket disassembly work and left.
- 2022-11-24 19:30 (around): Four workers went to the intersection and began to dismantle half a set of advanced hydraulic supports. They first removed the anti-backup chain, relieved the pressure and removed some pins.
- 2022-11-24 21:50 (around): One operator left to assist with other disassembly tasks, and the remaining three people continued to impact the four-link pin.
- 2022-11-24 22:08: When the pin rushed out, the powered support fell to the south, and an operator was knocked down before he could escape.
- 2022-11-24 22:08 (later): On-site personnel used a hoist to lift the roof beam to rescue the casualty, and transported him to the ground on a simple stretcher for medical treatment.
- 2022-11-25 00:40: Toksun County People's Hospital confirmed death after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the outsourced retrieval team dismantled half a set of advanced hydraulic supports, the top beam was not suspended and fixed according to the measures and a person stood on the inside of the support to impact the pin shaft. After the pin rushed out, the bracket became unstable and fell over, injuring an operator who died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: illegal command when dismantling the advanced powered support, failure to suspend and fix the top beam according to measures, and personnel working inside the support. The support tipped over and injured the operator to death.
2. key contributing factors: The special stent was disassembled without risk identification and on-site prevention; the qualifications, staffing, training and contracting party management of the outsourcing team did not meet the requirements.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Incorporate outsourced projects into unified mine safety management and review team qualifications, performance and personnel capabilities.
2. Strengthen hazard identification, risk assessment and hidden danger rectification in special operating areas.
3. Strengthen on-site inspections of key links by supervisors, followers and safety officers and stop violations.
4. Strictly outsource project bidding, personnel training and on-site safety management.
5. Strictly implement operating procedures and safety technical measures for the disassembly of the retraction bracket, and implement suspension and fixation of the bracket and control of personnel positions.
6. Carry out training on retrieval operations, job operating procedures and practical assessments to prevent formality in training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-03-03 10:00 (around): Operators pull cables along the belt trough and repair hydraulic supports at the mining surface.
- 2024-03-03 11:00 (approximately): On-site personnel went to the belt trough to disassemble the bottom connecting device of the No. 9 and No. 10 unit brackets, and lowered the No. 10 unit bracket.
- 2024-03-03 12:12: The roof collapsed after falling slag, sinking, and two workers were buried; the dispatch platform also displayed related video interruptions.
- 2024-03-03 12:14: The on-site security inspector reported to the dispatch room that two people were buried.
- 2024-03-03 13:09: The mine dispatch room reported the accident to the Barkol County Emergency Bureau.
- 2024-03-03 13:10: A second roof collapse occurred during the rescue.
- 2024-03-03 13:11: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to the Xinjiang Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-03-03 17:50: Due to another rockfall and the risk of a third roof collapse, the rescue headquarters suspended underground support operations and evacuated rescue personnel.
- 2024-03-03 22:53: Rescue experts and life detectors are in place, and it is determined that the collision wedge scaffolding method will be used for rescue.
- 2024-03-04 00:43: Life detection found no life signal.
- 2024-03-05 04:40: Rescue workers found a missing person.
- 2024-03-05 07:50: Rescue workers find another missing person.
- 2024-03-05 09:31: The two buried persons were transported to the surface, and doctors confirmed that both had no vital signs.
- 2024-03-05 10:10: The rescue command announced the end of the rescue operation.

【Accident Mechanism】
The workers on duty lowered the belt along the trough where the roof was broken and the local stress was highly concentrated and disassembled the unit bracket connecting device without implementing reinforcing support. The high stress in the surrounding rock was instantly released, causing the roof to collapse, and two workers were buried and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof collapsed during lowering operations in an area with high stress concentration and the roof collapsed, crushing two workers to death.
2. key contributing factors: advance support was shortened without authorization, support changes lacked special measures and on-site monitoring; roof risk assessment, hidden danger rectification, equipment and monitoring management, and operational training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Advance support is not allowed to be shortened or changed without authorization; changes must undergo technical demonstration and formulate special measures.
2. Strengthen the monitoring of roof separation layer and surrounding rock displacement in areas affected by mining to ensure real early warning of the system.
3. Incorporate high-risk operations such as rack moving into on-site monitoring and risk management.
4. Investigate and rectify hidden dangers in the roof and strengthen acceptance of resumption of work and production.
5. Formulate and implement reliable support measures based on geological and stress conditions, and implement special technical management and on-site monitoring for advance support and unit bracket relocation.
6. Strengthen training on roof risk identification, unit support operation, and safety technical measures for high-risk operations.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-04-25 16:00: The second comprehensive mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange work and safety precautions for the shift.
- 2024-04-25 17:30 (approximately): Relevant personnel studied the advancement plan near the No. 7 bracket, and then went to the end of the working face to handle the end frame and the No. 1 bracket.
- 2024-04-25 17:49 (approximately): The mud mortar in the goaf collapsed from the gap between the end frame and the tail beam of the No. 1 support. One operator was buried and the other was trapped.
- 2024-04-25 17:50: The dispatch room notified the mine leaders and the mine rescue team and initiated emergency response.
- 2024-04-25 18:31: The mine dispatch room reported the accident to the Hami Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-04-25 18:42: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to the Xinjiang Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-04-25 19:29 (approximately): The trapped people were rescued.
- 2024-04-25 20:07 (approximately): Hami City, Yizhou District Government and emergency management department personnel arrived at the mine to take over the on-site rescue command.
- 2024-04-25 22:06: The life detection results show that no life signs were found in the area where the buried person was located.
- 2024-04-26 03:11: Rescue workers found buried people.
- 2024-04-26 05:29: The buried people were cleared out and put on stretchers.
- 2024-04-26 06:05: The buried person was lifted out of the well and transferred to the hospital. The doctor on board confirmed that there were no vital signs.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the workers on duty were handling the end frame and the No. 1 support frame and recovering the single pillar at the end of the 11702 fully mechanised caving working face, the mud mortar in the goaf collapsed from the gap between the end frame and the No. 1 support tail beam. One operator was buried and another was rescued after being trapped, resulting in one death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Effective measures were not taken to prevent mud and sand from collapsing and personnel were not prevented from entering the dangerous area of the lower end. The roof collapsed and squeezed mud and mortar into the end bracket, burying the operator to death.
2. key contributing factors: Risky advancement after mud and sand collapse and top coal caving in periodic pressure areas; insufficient water damage risk identification, hidden danger investigation, technical measures for sag-passing structures, and professional water prevention and control capabilities, as well as lax supervision by superiors.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the water damage prevention and control system and timely supplement exploration when hydrogeological conditions change.
2. Strictly implement the requirements for water exploration and flood area management, and delineate areas where mining is prohibited, delayed, and permitted.
3. Strengthen the investigation of hidden water hazards and hidden disaster factors, and no production will be allowed until abnormalities are identified.
4. Equip professionals for water prevention and control and strengthen technical approval and on-site supervision.
5. Identify hydrogeological changes and formulate and implement special technical measures to prevent mud, sand and structural areas from collapsing. Stop relevant operations until hidden dangers are eliminated.
6. Improve the quality of training on water damage forecasting, risk identification, water exploration and release, and abnormal situation handling.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-10-04 16:00 (approximately): The second excavation area held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the excavation of the 72101 material tunnel, bottom sweeping of the drilling rig chamber and replacement of roof bolts (cable bolts).
- 2024-10-04 19:50 (approximately): 10 operators arrived at the 72101 material tunnel development heading and started working.
- 2024-10-04 23:00 (approximately): The team completed the tunnel excavation and support, and the digging and anchoring machine retreated and began to sweep the bottom of the drilling rig chamber.
- 2024-10-04 23:20: Operators use a handheld pneumatic bolter to add anchors to the blind area of ​​the airborne support and connect the anchor net.
- 2024-10-04 23:55 (approximately): The cutting drum was accidentally started during equipment adjustment, and the operator standing on the guard board fell and was involved.
- 2024-10-04 23:57: On-site workers reported the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2024-10-05 00:05: The mine doctor dialed 120 emergency number.
- 2024-10-05 00:35: The rescue team arrived at the scene, initially determined that the casualty had no vital signs and organised an elevating operation.
- 2024-10-05 00:45: The company reported the accident to the Kuqa City Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-10-05 00:52: The company reported the accident to the Xinjiang Bureau of the State Administration of Mine Safety Supervision.
- 2024-10-05 01:24: The casualties were sent to Kuqa People's Hospital by a mine ambulance.
- 2024-10-05 01:40: The casualty was transferred to 120 ambulance.
- 2024-10-05 03:05: 120 ambulance arrived at Kuqa People's Hospital.
- 2024-10-05 03:27: The hospital failed to rescue and confirmed death.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the excavation team completed the tunnel excavation, they drilled additional roof bolts in the drilling rig chamber. The driver of the tunnel boring machine failed to cut off the power and lock the cutting drum, and accidentally started the drum when operating the remote control to adjust the equipment. The operator who was standing on the drum guard and connected to the Internet fell and was involved, and eventually died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the tunnel boring machine illegally operated the anchor digging machine without powering off and locking it without confirming safety, causing the person standing on the guard plate of the cutting drum to fall and be strangled to death by the drum.
2. key contributing factors: illegal use of integrated anchor digging machines to construct special-shaped caves and lack of measures to support blind areas; insufficient on-site safety supervision and violation management, and new equipment and job transfer training did not cover all operators.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen team risk identification, on-site monitoring and management of illegal operations.
2. Strict technical approval and prepare executable construction and support measures for special-shaped tunnels.
3. Strengthen equipment operation, power outage lockout, electronic fence and emergency response training.
4. Improve the mine safety responsibility system, hidden danger investigation and dual prevention system.
5. Improve the drilling rig chamber construction technology and operable support measures, and strictly implement equipment shutdown, power-off and lockout, technical approval and on-site inspection.
6. Carry out safety training on new equipment, new processes and job transfers for all relevant personnel.
