【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-02-10 08:00: The project department held a pre-shift briefing, and 7 people on duty were assigned to transfer and assemble hydraulic supports and other operations.
- 2025-02-10 09:30: 6 workers arrived at the 2801 transportation lane assembly chamber, and the night shift has completed the assembly of the 24th powered support.
- 2025-02-10 11:36: The operator transferred the powered support to the forklift and fixed it with a lifting arm traction chain.
- 2025-02-10 12:05: The forklift transported the No. 24 powered support to the installation location; some personnel returned to the assembly chamber, and the remaining personnel cooperated with the installation.
- 2025-02-10 12:20: The forklift driver operated the control valve to adjust the bracket between the forklift and the rail truck, and arranged for personnel to remove the left lifting arm hook.
- 2025-02-10 12:27: On-site personnel reported that the right lifting arm was too tight; when the forklift moved the bracket, the rear of the truck tilted up and swung to the right, and the rear wheel derailed and slid down, squeezing the operator next to the control valve.
- 2025-02-10 12:28: Rescue organised on site.
- 2025-02-10 12:31: Rescuers arrived, operated the rail truck to retreat about 40 centimeters and rescued the casualty.
- 2025-02-10 13:32: The casualty was lifted to the ground and sent to Kuqa People's Hospital by ambulance.
- 2025-02-10 14:45: The casualty arrived at Kuqa People’s Hospital.
- 2025-02-10 14:58: The hospital failed to rescue and declared the casualty dead.
- 2025-02-10 15:10: Kuqa City Emergency Management Department reported the accident to the Xinjiang Bureau of the State Administration of Mine Safety Supervision by phone and in writing.

【Accident Mechanism】
The forklift driver illegally removed the traction chain of the left lifting arm when lowering the powered support, and failed to loosen the traction chain of the right lifting arm in time during the move, causing the powered support to become unbalanced. When the forklift moved backwards, the rear wheels derailed and slid down, causing the operator who was standing between the forklift and the rail truck to operate the control valve to be crushed against the control valve group and killed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The forklift driver illegally removed the traction chain of the left boom and failed to loosen the traction chain of the right boom in time, causing the powered support to become unbalanced, causing the rear wheel of the forklift to derail and slide, squeezing the operator next to the control valve and killing him.
2. key contributing factors: The connection and control methods of forklifts and rail trucks are unreasonable, and parking stabilization devices are not installed; on-site safety performance, technical measures review, risk identification, hidden danger management and training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate risks such as the connection and control methods of new process equipment during installation operations, and promptly address hidden dangers.
2. Improve the on-site performance of duties and the ability to stop violations of mine leaders, full-time safety officers and inspectors.
3. Improve the quality of preparation, joint review and implementation of procedures and measures to ensure consistency with on-site processes.
4. Strictly carry out training and assessment to improve workers’ ability to identify hazard sources and protect themselves and each other.
5. Improve the powered support installation process, adopt safe connection and remote control methods, and set up forklift stabilization devices; operating procedures and special measures must be subject to on-site investigation, joint review and implementation.
6. Carry out training on operating procedures and operating procedures, practical assessment and job ability inspection for project department personnel.

- 2025-05-19 08:30: The comprehensive mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange for the removal of the remaining hydraulic supports on the working face and complete the withdrawal and finishing.
- 2025-05-19 09:27: The deputy production manager and safety inspector arrived at the 1W202 withdrawal working face and handed over to the night shift.
- 2025-05-19 09:43: The operators transported the No. 3 shielding bracket to the entrance of the upper trough transportation contact lane and unloaded the truck, and then prepared to ship the No. 4 shielding bracket.
- 2025-05-19 10:56: When lifting the rear part of the bracket, it was found that the left rear side was not lifted; personnel inspection found that the left rear lifting hook was decoupled, and the lathe entered the truck and hooked it between the U-shaped frame and the bracket guard.
- 2025-05-19 11:08: After the lathe operator heard the command to lift, he operated the left rear lifting handle, and the powered support suddenly swung.
- 2025-05-19 11:09: The driver was found lying on the ground at the scene. Rescue was immediately organised and reported to the dispatch room. The emergency plan was activated and 120 was dialed.
- 2025-05-19 11:20: The casualties were lifted underground in a rescue vehicle and sent to Hutubi County People's Hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
The follower sent a lifting signal without evacuating to a safe location after lifting the hook on the powered support. During the lifting process, the powered support received uneven force and swayed out of balance, causing it to be squeezed between the truck and the support, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After hooking up with the lathe, a lifting signal was issued before evacuating to a safe place. The powered support was unevenly stressed and swayed during lifting, squeezing it to death.
2. key contributing factors: operating procedures and special safety measures for retrieval of truck drivers and truck drivers were not formulated; lifting hooks were cut and processed, models were mixed, and on-site supervision, risk identification, and video surveillance were lacking.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strict acceptance of mechanical and electrical equipment before entry, and it is prohibited to use cut or unqualified lifting hooks.
2. Unify the management of stent truck drivers and on-site operations, and clarify reliable lifting signals and personnel positions.
3. Restore and effectively use video surveillance for retraction operations, and provide on-site command and safety monitoring.
4. Identify risks one by one for lifting operations and implement control measures.
5. Develop special safety measures and operating procedures for retraction and lifting, and clarify the lifting steps, signals, stations and loading positions; personnel are strictly prohibited from staying in the lifting danger area.
6. Carry out procedures, risk identification and safe operation training for personnel handling and lifting brackets, and verify their mastery.

- 2025-06-04 13:30: The construction of the first two hanging anchors was completed, the main engine is lifted and fixed on the platform; the operators remove the safety bolts and front baffle of the main engine in advance.
- 2025-06-04 14:15: It was found that the shock wave receiver was missing the fixing nut, and personnel were arranged to remove the first push rod and reinstall it.
- 2025-06-04 14:20: When loading the anchoring agent for the fourth hanging roof bolt, the explosion-proof medium was sprayed out. The reaction force of the main machine hit the operator and he fell to the belt conveyor belt.
- 2025-06-04 14:20 (later): Brake the belt conveyor on site and report to the dispatch room to initiate emergency rescue.

In order to reduce the number of handling operations of the operating platform, the installation personnel removed the safety bolts and front baffle of the main machine of the automatic explosion-proof device in advance. When loading the anchoring agent for the fourth hanging roof bolt, the explosion-proof medium suddenly spurted out. The main engine was hit by the reaction force and the operator fell from the platform onto the belt conveyor belt and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The installer illegally removed the safety bolts of the main engine of the automatic explosion-proof device in advance. When loading the anchoring agent, the explosion-proof medium spurted out. The reaction force of the main engine hit the operator, causing him to fall and die.
2. key contributing factors: There are no operating procedures, special technical measures and technical explanations for installation operations; there is no unified command and on-site supervision for collaborative operations, and there is insufficient risk identification, hidden danger investigation and training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the unified command, on-site supervision and sub-management responsibilities of collaborative operations.
2. Comprehensively study and judge the installation risks of new equipment, and improve sporadic project management and safety technical measures.
3. Strengthen on-site front-line supervision, lead teams to perform duties, and investigate and rectify hidden dangers.
4. Improve education and training, team building and anti-violation assessment.
5. Develop operating procedures, special safety technical measures and technical briefings for sporadic projects and new equipment installations. No operations will be allowed without implementing key requirements such as safety bolts.
6. organise special training and practical assessment on new processes, new technologies, and new equipment, and conduct anti-violation education on a regular basis.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-08-04 07:50: The transportation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged personnel to install the diaphragm pump in the water pit at the bottom of the main inclined shaft +1437 metres.
- 2025-08-04 08:42: The leader of the mine found that the upper entrance of the main coal bunker at +1480 metres was submerged in water and reported it to the dispatching room.

- 2025-08-06 19:10: The second trapped person died after the hospital failed to rescue him.

【Accident Mechanism】
The main coal bunker was full and there was a lot of water, and the management staff still organised the bunker to be released in violation of regulations. After the bunker was placed, black water and coal slurry suddenly burst out of the coal bunker, overwhelming the coal feeder and maintenance platform, and burying two workers to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The management personnel illegally ordered the bunker to be released when the main coal bunker was full and there was a lot of water. The coal bunker suddenly collapsed and destroyed the maintenance platform, burying two workers and killing them.
2. key contributing factors: The coal bunker management system, daily inspections, waterproofing and monitoring measures are imperfect; mechanization transformation and remote control have not been implemented, and risk identification, technical explanations, on-site monitoring and supervision are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Storage of coal bunkers shall not be organised until hidden dangers such as water accumulation in coal bunkers have been eliminated.
2. On-site leadership, safety supervision, personnel evacuation and vigilance must be implemented during warehousing operations.
3. Improve coal bunker waterproofing, water drainage, drainage, monitoring and mechanized transformation.
4. Strictly review the rectification plan for hidden dangers and strengthen supervision at the mine.
5. Improve coal bunker inspection, inspection and maintenance, hidden danger investigation, bunker collapse prevention and decommissioning and reuse management, clarify the loading capacity and empty bunker volume, and complete waterproofing, monitoring, remote control and mechanized transformation measures.
6. Carry out targeted training and technical explanations on the risks of water accumulation in coal bunkers, empty bunkers and full coal slurry bunkers.

- 2025-08-31 17:42: The operator extended the four fixed columns of the drilling rig in sequence and slowly raised the drilling rig.
- 2025-08-31 17:44: It was discovered at the scene that the drilling rig was tilted and a call was made to stop the drilling rig. The drilling rig then dumped towards the west side of the tunnel, squeezing the operator next to the operating handle.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the track of the crawler drilling rig came out of grooves, the operator used wooden boards to cushion the four fixed columns to lift the drilling rig, but the columns were not firmly padded and the workers's positions were improper. The drilling rig became unstable and fell toward the west side of the tunnel, squeezing the operator next to the operating handle to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the operator raised the drilling rig, he failed to pad the fixed columns firmly and stood in an improper position. The drilling rig became unstable and fell over, crushing him to death.
2. key contributing factors: The fixed columns of the drilling rig are missing and maintenance and repairs are not in place; there are no job operating procedures and sporadic engineering measures, and risk identification, on-site supervision, and safety training are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out special risk identification of the crawler drilling rig’s integrity, operating environment, operating procedures and fault handling.
2. For sporadic projects, the positions of on-site personnel must be clearly defined and safety technical measures and joint review opinions must be implemented.
3. Strengthen equipment charter, daily inspection and maintenance records.
4. Supervisors and safety management personnel should promptly stop risky operations.
5. Repair the fixed columns of the drilling rig in a timely manner and perform maintenance and overhaul according to the instruction manual; formulate operating procedures for crawler drilling rigs and safety technical measures such as troubleshooting and maintenance.
6. Carry out warning education and operational training around the status of drilling rig equipment, personnel positions and risks of instability and toppling.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the retraction operation, the winch pressure column was not supported on the tunnel roof according to regulations. Without clearing away the people near the rehydration danger area, the operator held a liquid injection gun and directly replenished the monomer. The pressure column popped out instantly, hitting the head of the nearby operator and killing him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The winch pressure column was not supported on the tunnel roof according to regulations, and the operator manually replenished fluid in violation of regulations. The pressure column instantly popped up and hit a nearby person on the head, causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The withdrawal procedures and measures did not clarify the installation of the winch pressure column, fluid replenishment precautions and station positions; the construction organisation was chaotic, on-site monitoring and safety management were absent, and risk control and training were ineffective.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Incorporate the project department into unified safety management and provide qualified project leaders and on-site safety management personnel.
2. Full surveillance must be implemented during the retraction operation, and any violation will be stopped immediately and personnel in the dangerous area must be evacuated.
3. Improve the withdrawal plan and channel design to meet the layout requirements of vehicles, winches and supports.
4. Develop and implement special control measures for the risk of injury due to single-body rehydration.
5. Revise the retraction procedures and safety measures, clarify the installation sequence of winch pressure columns, liquid replenishment methods, personnel positions and requirements for clearing people in dangerous areas; adopt a long-distance single liquid injection method.
6. Strictly carry out recall operation procedures and accident warning training, and correct false training such as giving answers first and taking exams later.

4. Develop and implement effective safety measures for shearers’ coal cutting, waste rock flying and front-shelf operations, and strengthen on-site supervision of key links.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-11-26 19:00: 23 people from the coal mining team entered the mine and worked at the 412 coal face, including 11 people from the 412-1 mining face and 12 people from the 412-2 mining face.
- 2022-11-26 20:00: Two mining personnel arrived at the working face and started cutting coal.

- 2022-11-27 03:22: The mine manager reported to the owner of the company that an accident occurred underground and someone was injured.
- 2022-11-27 03:54: All people underground were evacuated to the mine entrance; the casualty who had been rescued were sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2022-11-27 05:00: The mine organised four part-time rescue teams to search and rescue in the well, and found and rescued a shearer driver who had no vital signs.
- 2022-11-27 08:00: Personnel involved in the search and rescue came out of the well.
- 2022-11-27 10:40: The business owner verbally reported the accident to the county emergency management department personnel who came to the mine to verify the gas over-limit alarm.
- 2022-11-27 11:18: The county comprehensive emergency rescue team entered the mine for rescue.
- 2022-11-27 13:00: Rescuers found the second shearer driver who was buried in coal and had no vital signs.
- 2022-11-27 14:01: The second victim was taken out.
- 2022-11-27 14:37: Two victims were transported out of the well.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal seam in the 412-1 coal mining working face is buried deep and encounters geological structures locally. The in-situ stress and tectonic stress are superimposed. The coal seam thickens and softens and there are signs of outburst, but no effective outburst prevention measures have been taken. When two shearer drivers were trial-running the shearer, coal cutting disturbance induced an outburst of extruded coal and gas. Coal and gas poured into the working face, killing two people and injuring one.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal seam on the working face showed signs of outburst under the conditions of geological structure and stress superposition, and no effective preventive measures were taken. The coal cutting disturbance of the shearer induced coal and gas outbursts.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient research and judgment on signs such as increased gas outflow, thickening and softening of coal seams, and stuck drill; targeted outburst prevention and gas control measures have not been implemented; there are serious violations of laws and regulations in labor organisation, safety training, monitoring management, and emergency reporting.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Illegal contracting, illegal command, super-capacity production, and concealment, false reporting and late reporting of accidents are strictly prohibited.
2. Strengthen geological data analysis, prediction and forecasting, risk analysis and hidden danger investigation and management.
3. Improve the gas drainage compliance system and strictly manage drilling design, construction, acceptance and drainage measurement.
4. Strengthen equipment maintenance, training and emergency duty of part-time rescue teams, and scientifically organise accident rescue.
5. Upgrade to an outburst mine, complete the design and system transformation in accordance with outburst prevention regulations, and implement regional and local comprehensive outburst prevention measures.
6. Strictly carry out safety training for employees, license management for special operations, and emergency escape and rescue drills.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty used manpower to push the flatbed truck loaded with the main engine of the drilling rig to the 13138 bottom extraction lane. The wooden sleepers at the accident site were corroded by water for a long time, the track spikes became loose, and the track gauge increased. The two wheels on the left side of the flatbed truck fell into the track core and tilted to the left. The main engine of the drilling rig tilted with the truck and hit the operator who was standing on the side of the truck to push the truck in violation of regulations.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Corrosion, loose sleepers and spikes caused the track gauge to increase, and the flatbed truck loading the main rig fell off the road and tilted and hit the person pushing the truck on the side of the truck.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient track maintenance and hidden danger investigation; operators pushing carts on both sides of the vehicle in violation of regulations; insufficient identification and training of special risks in transportation operations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a responsibility and inspection system for infrequently used transportation tracks and implement closed-loop management of hidden dangers.
2. Develop targeted transportation safety technical measures based on the tunnel section and transportation route.
3. It is strictly prohibited to push the cart on both sides of the flatbed truck, and strengthen on-site efforts to stop illegal operations.
4. Maintain and inspect transportation tracks in accordance with regulations, replace corroded wooden sleepers in a timely manner and rectify track gauge abnormalities.
5. Carry out special safety technical training for manual transportation and operations of over-height, over-wide, over-length, and over-heavy materials.
6. Eliminate hidden dangers on transportation tracks and strictly implement the requirements for manned trolley stations and on-site monitoring.

The temporary pillars in the transportation lane were erected unstablely. When workers were taking sand for shipment, they collided with the pillars, causing them to topple over. The roof beam fell and injured people.

2. key contributing factors: Insufficient risk identification and hidden danger investigation for temporary support, and lack of supervision of individual operators.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Check the stable status of temporary pillars and roof beams before operation.
2. Operations near temporary supports should be monitored and dangerous areas should be avoided.
3. Standardize the temporary support erection and check its stability.

5. Prevent temporary support from becoming unstable and causing injuries.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2024-08-21 09:51: The company reported the accident to the Wutongqiao District Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-08-21 10:35: Wutongqiao District Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident to the Sichuan Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-08-21 10:50: The Leshan City Mine Rescue Detachment arrived at the scene and found 5 victims and 3 people still missing.
- 2024-08-21 11:17: The casualties were sent to Wutongqiao District People's Hospital for treatment.
- 2024-08-21 12:30: The first batch of rescue teams went underground to investigate and found two victims, collapse of the tunnel at the slope change point, and high concentrations of harmful gases.
- 2024-08-21 15:16: The second batch of rescue teams entered the mine to investigate, but did not find the last missing person.
- 2024-08-21 17:12: The third batch of rescue teams transported the two victims out of the well.
- 2024-08-21 18:00: The fourth batch of rescue teams went underground to investigate and found the last victim under the collapse at the slope change point.
- 2024-08-21 18:40: The last victim was transported out of the well and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the sealing period of the wellbore, the air supply from the return air shaft was insufficient, and gas accumulated to an explosive concentration in the unblocked section at the top was ignited by the fire source of the gas welded and cut steel pipe, causing casualties on site.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Insufficient air supply in the return air shaft caused gas accumulation, and gas welding and cutting steel pipes ignited gas.
2. key contributing factors: Ventilation facilities did not supply air properly and effectively, and fires were illegally carried out during closed shaft operations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Verify that the local ventilation system is operating effectively before closing the shaft.
2. Gas welding and cutting are strictly prohibited in areas where gas may accumulate.
3. Stop illegal hot work and restore and ensure effective ventilation of the wellbore.
4. Strengthen training on risks of gas accumulation and hot work.
5. Prevent gas accumulation from being ignited by fire sources.

- 2024-09-18 12:20: Personnel on duty entered the mine one after another; safety supervisors and methane examiners first arrived at the maintenance operation point to inspect.
- 2024-09-18 13:00: The dangerous rock on the roof was processed on site, a wooden point pillar was set up as temporary support, and drilling began.
- 2024-09-18 13:20: When the hole drilling was about 20 centimeters, there was a sudden explosion on the right side of the tunnel, and coal and waste rock fell, burying the workers on the right rear side.
- 2024-09-18 13:25: The methane examiner reported the accident to the dispatch room, and initial rescue was organised on site.

- 2024-09-18 15:05: The mine reported the accident to the Supervision and Law Enforcement Division Three of the Sichuan Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
On duty, the top roof was processed and drilled at the return air uphill maintenance operation point located along the Y5 coal seam with serious deformation of the two gangs. The roof and floor of the tunnel were soft, the mine pressure was concentrated, and many of the original roof bolts failed. During the operation, only one temporary wooden pillar was installed and the two gangs were not effectively supported. After the blasting, the surrounding rock on the right side became unstable and the coal and waste rock fell and buried the workers working on the right rear side.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The roof and floor of the Y5 coal seam are soft, the mine pressure is concentrated, the tunnel support is not in place and the roof-and-rib sounding is not strictly carried out. The coal and waste rock on the right side falls and the workers are buried.
2. key contributing factors: Special maintenance measures did not carry out risk identification and support strength calculation; failed anchors were not replaced and temporary support was insufficient; there were parallel operations and rush to work on site, and safety training and supervision were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement hierarchical security risk management and control and hidden danger investigation and management, and implement rectification of hidden dangers in five steps.
2. Arrange professional and technical personnel to strengthen technical review and front-line on-site supervision.
3. Parallel operations, rushing to complete work plans and operations without adequate support are strictly prohibited.
4. Carry out demonstrations on roof disasters and guide the exit in accordance with the law when technical conditions cannot effectively prevent and control them.
5. Carry out special risk assessments for maintenance projects and formulate, review and dynamically revise support technical measures based on on-site geological conditions.
6. Strengthen training on roof-and-rib sounding, roof support and job operation skills, and enhance awareness of self-protection and mutual protection.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-02-12 13:00: The second excavation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for the 13319 upper machine tunnel to be supported first and the gas discharge hole to be constructed after the excavation was in place.
- 2025-02-12 15:21: It was found on site that 0.8 metres of the floor rock on the right side of the morning shift was not yet dug in place. Instead, the excavation of this section was completed first and then the drainage hole was constructed.
- 2025-02-12 15:31: The methane examiner removed the methane sensor on the working face and hung it on the belt bracket on the inlet side of the return air outlet.
- 2025-02-12 15:38: The driver of the fully mechanised excavator moved another methane sensor under the air duct at the rear of the mechanized excavator in preparation for excavation.
- 2025-02-12 15:50: The mechanized excavator starts and cuts the bottom rock on the right side.
- 2025-02-12 16:06: After completing the bottom rock cutting, start cutting the right side coal seam.
- 2025-02-12 16:15: The coal seam near the cutting head suddenly protruded, and the protruding coal (waste) buried the driver of the fully mechanised excavator, and the equipment was powered off.
- 2025-02-12 16:17: The dispatching room received a methane warning and ordered to stop operations and evacuate the entire mine.
- 2025-02-12 16:18: The dispatching room received an underground report and confirmed that the driver of the fully mechanised excavator was buried in coal (waste rock).
- 2025-02-12 16:27: The first group of 8 people from the mine rescue team entered the mine.
- 2025-02-12 16:54: The mine reported the accident to the relevant regulatory and supervisory authorities.
- 2025-02-12 17:28: Rescue workers arrived at the scene and began rescue operations.
- 2025-02-12 17:45: The buried persons were rescued, and cardiopulmonary resuscitation was immediately implemented at the scene.
- 2025-02-12 19:06: The casualty was transported to the main cave entrance, and waiting hospital doctors continued treatment.
- 2025-02-12 19:13: Died after rescue failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The shift continued to cut the top coal seam on the right side after completing the support in the 13319 upper machine roadway. The working face encountered geological structures, and the outburst prevention measures in the stress concentration area failed to effectively eliminate the threat of outburst, and the operators moved the methane sensor without authorization, causing monitoring distortion; cutting induced coal and gas outbursts, and the outburst coal (waste) buried the operators who were operating the fully mechanised excavator.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The working face encountered geological structures and stress concentration areas. Outburst prevention measures failed to eliminate the threat of coal and gas outbursts. Cutting coal seams induced outbursts and buried the driver of the mechanized excavator.
2. key contributing factors: The operator moved the methane sensor without authorization, causing monitoring distortion; the excavation continued without completing the support as required, and the geological structure risk assessment and on-site safety management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to manually move the safety monitoring sensors to ensure that the early warning, alarm and power outage functions are normal.
2. Strengthen collaborative analysis of geology and traffic control, and promptly identify structural zones and stress concentration areas.
3. Strictly implement the excavation support and outburst prevention operating procedures, and strengthen on-site supervision and anti-three-violation management.
4. Take effective pressure relief and comprehensive outburst prevention measures in structures and stress concentration areas, and organise construction in strict accordance with the approved technical measures.
5. Carry out special training on the identification of emergency signs, standardized use of methane sensors and risks of illegal operations.
6. Ensure that monitoring and control are real and effective, and support and outburst prevention measures are implemented before organizing excavation.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine arranged an development heading concealed in a non-construction area. The coal seam thickened and softened, the roof and floor plates were broken, and the inclination angle increased. 【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Broken coal seams with increased inclination angles and roof and floor slabs slipped due to insufficient support.
2. key contributing factors: illegal excavation in non-construction areas, no operating procedures and support design, and risky production.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to arrange and organise operations in unapproved construction areas.
2. When geological conditions change, stop work promptly and revise support design and measures.
3. Stop illegal concealment operations and implement support according to design and procedures.
4. Strengthen training on geological changes, roof risks and illegal operation hazards.
5. Prevent the broken roof and bottom plates from slipping into the buried personnel.

【Accident Mechanism】
The temporary track laying was unqualified, and the bucket of the rake loader was not moved out of the discharge chute, making the center of gravity unstable; after the rear wheel of the equipment was stuck by the deformed road splint, the operator still used a crowbar to move forward, and the rake loader fell off the road and turned to the left, with the bucket pressing down on the person standing on the left side.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The temporary track was unqualified, the center of gravity of the rake installation machine was unstable, and the equipment was stuck and then forcibly moved forward, causing it to fall off the road and roll over, crushing people.
2. key contributing factors: imperfect technical measures for track laying and equipment movement, improper positioning of personnel, and insufficient on-site safety management and hidden danger investigation.

2. It is strictly forbidden for people to stand on the sides, front and rear of the equipment and under the discharge chute.
3. Comprehensively renovate the temporary track, use reliable traction equipment when moving the rake loader, and clarify the safe distance.
4. Strengthen training on moving and fixing large equipment and prohibiting entry into hazardous areas.
5. Prevent the rake installation machine from moving, falling off the road, and rolling over to injure people.

After the support leg lost pressure, the tunnel boring machine sank and squeezed its head.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the water pump fell into disrepair and leaked, the pump worker illegally used a woven bag containing iron wire to plug the leak; the woven bag was caught in the rotating part of the water pump, and the iron wire in the bag scratched his right calf, causing severe blood loss and eventual death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The water pump worker illegally used a woven bag to block the leakage of the water pump. The woven bag was caught in the rotating part, and the iron wire in the bag scratched his right calf.
2. key contributing factors: The water pump has been in disrepair for a long time, inspection and maintenance are not in place, and water leaks exist; safety education and on-the-job training for pumping workers are insufficient, and emergency self-rescue and mutual rescue are improperly handled.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. If the water pump leaks, it should be shut down and handled according to maintenance measures. It is strictly prohibited to use woven bags and other items to plug leaks next to operating equipment.
2. Establish a system for regular inspection, maintenance and fault rectification of water pumps.
3. Strengthen job training, on-site monitoring and safety protection of rotating parts for pump workers.
4. After an injury occurs, provide first aid immediately, send the patient to the hospital quickly, and report in a timely manner as required.
5. Inspect, maintain and test drainage equipment to eliminate equipment defects such as water pump leakage; formulate and implement safe leakage plugging and maintenance measures.
6. Carry out job safety, protection of rotating parts of equipment and emergency first aid training for water pumping workers.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine failed to maintain the protective support as required, and used a slow-speed winch and a guide wheel to pull back the No. 73 support. The guide wheel was hung on the supporting cable bolt. After the winch tightened the wire rope, the cable bolt broke. The guide wheel and the wire rope rebounded instantly, hitting three people who were standing in the ropeway in violation of regulations.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When retracting Support No. 73, the cable bolt suspended from the guide wheel broke, and the wire rope and guide wheel rebounded, hitting the workers in the ropeway.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to set up cover supports and monorail crane retrieval according to measures; failure to clarify guide wheel suspension, personnel positions and signaling methods; failure to identify the risk of breakage of cable bolts, guide wheels and wire ropes, and on-site management and supervision did not stop operations in the ropeway.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Guide wheels, cable bolts, connecting devices and wire ropes must be used after risk assessment and reliable verification.
2. When the winch is in operation, personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the dangerous area of ​​the ropeway or support operation.
3. Keep the protective supports and implement roof support according to the approved support withdrawal sequence.
4. Strengthen on-site supervision and handling of habitual violations, and follow-up and rectification.
5. Prepare complete support retraction measures, clarify guide wheel fixation, ropeway warning, personnel positions and signaling methods, and it is strictly prohibited to pull or pull.
6. Strengthen risk training on support retraction, winch and ropeway, and improve the safety awareness and self-protection and mutual protection capabilities of operators.

4. Mine supervision and enterprise safety inspections should cover the actual mining operation area.

2. Supplementary safety technical measures must be taken when the geological conditions of the mining face change.
3. Strictly implement the system of knocking for help and asking for help, and it is strictly forbidden to work without a job.
4. Strengthen supervision and law enforcement and closed-loop management of hidden dangers, and strictly investigate and punish illegal contracting and subcontracting.

- 2024-08-07 09:00: Lead the shift mine leaders and follow-up mine leaders to the working face to inspect and understand the tasks on duty.
- 2024-08-07 09:10: The operator moved forward the front single pillar of No. 18 support and the top appeared, and began to support the roof.
- 2024-08-07 09:46: The operator pried off the stuck stone in front of the guard plate of the No. 18 bracket. The guard plate bounced up and squeezed his head, and the accident occurred.
- 2024-08-07 09:54: The mine leader reported the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2024-08-07 09:55: The dispatch room reported the accident to the mine manager and other management personnel.
- 2024-08-07 10:07: Rescuers met underground with mine management personnel who came to the rescue.
- 2024-08-07 10:39: The casualties were transported to the ground and sent to the hospital after emergency rescue by the health center.
- 2024-08-07 10:45: The coal mine reported the accident to Qujing Energy Bureau.
- 2024-08-07 12:35: The casualty died after the hospital failed to rescue him.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the adjustment of the 1910 working face, the roof was broken and the bracket was drilled and fell down. The operator illegally used a pickaxe to pry off the stuck stone within the angle formed by the guard plate of the No. 18 bracket and the front single pillar. After the stuck stone fell, the guard plate automatically bounced forward, squeezing his head and injuring him. He died after the rescue failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator stood between the guard plate and the single pillar and illegally handled the stuck stone. After the stuck stone fell, the guard plate automatically bounced up, squeezing the head and causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The risk identification of the rack adjustment did not cover the extrusion of the guard plate, and the hidden dangers of roof breakage and rack collapse were not effectively controlled; the rack adjustment plan was not comprehensive, and the on-site anti-"three violations", practical training and in-mine supervision were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out comprehensive risk identification and implement “one policy per side” before adjustment.
2. Strengthen on-site technical guidance when the fully mechanised mining working face passes through faults and geological structural zones.
3. The deputy chief engineer shall not concurrently serve as the head of the department, and the mine safety supervisor shall not concurrently be held by employees of the mine.
4. Strengthen the anti-"three violations", investigation of hidden dangers and local supervision and law enforcement.
5. Improve the technical measures for frame adjustment, clarify the methods of drilling the bottom of the frame, inverting the frame and handling waste, and strictly prohibit personnel from entering the dangerous area where the guard plate is squeezed.
6. Strengthen practical training on new equipment and safety education on rack-mounting operations, and improve on-the-job operation, self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-08-17 21:00: The comprehensive mining team organised a pre-night shift meeting and arranged for 14 personnel to enter the mine and work at the 1153 coal face.
- 2024-08-17 22:10: The operators arrived at the 1153 coal face and completed preparations for the operation.

- 2024-08-18 04:30: After the shearer is repaired, it continues to cut coal from bottom to top.
- 2024-08-18 05:35: The shearer moved to the No. 90 powered support. Sound, shock waves and coal dust appeared on the side of the coal wall, and a coal and gas outburst accident occurred.
- 2024-08-18 05:36: The dispatch monitoring room found that the wind flow on the working face was reversed and the gas exceeded the limit alarm, and reported it to the emergency personnel on duty.
- 2024-08-18 05:37: The emergency personnel on duty reported the accident to the mine director.
- 2024-08-18 05:41: The mine manager reported a suspected coal and gas outburst accident underground to the duty center of Zhaotong Energy Bureau.
- 2024-08-18 05:42: The emergency personnel on duty reported the accident to the general manager.
- 2024-08-18 05:48: The mine manager reported the accident to the Weixin County Energy Bureau Dispatch Command Center.
- 2024-08-18 07:25: Multiple professional mine rescue teams arrived at the mine to carry out rescue operations.
- 2024-08-18 09:05: The coal mine’s early rescue personnel evacuated to the ground.
- 2024-08-18 10:22: Rescue workers find the fourth victim.
- 2024-08-19 23:15: Rescue workers found the fifth victim.
- 2024-08-22 18:31: Rescuers found the sixth victim and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine failed to implement the order to suspend production for rectification, and organised mining at the 1153 coal face without eliminating the danger of coal seam outbursts and failing to strictly implement regional and local outburst prevention measures. The shearer cut coal and disturbed the outburst of dangerous coal seams, inducing coal and gas outbursts near the No. 90 powered support. The shock wave and the outflow of coal, rock and gas caused casualties on site.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct causes: The coal mine organised production in violation of laws and regulations, failed to eliminate the danger of coal seam outbursts and failed to strictly implement outburst prevention measures. The coal cutting machine disturbed coal and gas outbursts.
2. key contributing factors: During the period of shutdown and rectification, the coal mine stopped operating day and night and avoided monitoring; the drainage boreholes were not constructed according to the design and were not effectively inspected; operations continued even after signs of outburst occurred, and safety management, outburst prevention capabilities, and education and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Coal mines without gas prevention and control capabilities must suspend production for rectification.
2. Improve the process supervision of gas extraction and outburst prevention effect inspection, and strictly prohibit false drilling, false data, false reports, and false standards.
3. Standardize the management of the security monitoring system and strictly prohibit illegal movement or wrapping of sensors or deletion or blocking of monitoring data.
4. Strengthen surveillance at mines, jointly crack down on illegal activities, and supervise coal mines that suspend production for rectification.
5. Carry out gas prevention and control capability assessment; strictly implement regional and local outburst prevention measures, effect inspection and full-process traceability management.
6. organise education on production safety laws and regulations, emergency prevention knowledge, and accident warnings to improve employees’ risk identification, operation, and self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the working face is broken, floating waste accumulates between the brackets, and brackets 23 to 27 cannot be moved normally. The operator failed to clean up the floating waste rock and did not operate adjacent racks in accordance with regulations. He used a single hydraulic prop to forcibly support the top beam of the No. 26 bracket. When the operator was lying on his side in a small space under the bracket to operate the manual valve, the pillar became unstable and fell, causing the bracket to fall, causing death due to crushing.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally used a single hydraulic prop to forcibly move the frame. After the prop became unstable, the suspended powered support fell, squeezing the operator below and causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The floating waste rock between the racks was not cleared, and the adjacent racks were not operated; no supplementary measures were taken in the roof crushing zone; hidden dangers were not checked before work was resumed; only theoretical training in intelligent fully mechanised mining was performed; on-site management and on-site supervision were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Before moving the rack, clean up the floating coal and waste in front of the rack and between the racks.
2. When abnormality such as broken roof occurs on the working face, safety technical measures shall be promptly added.
3. Follow-up safety officers should be managed uniformly by the safety management department to ensure independent supervision.
4. Strengthen on-site inspections and closed-loop management of anti-"three violations".
5. Supplementary measures should be formulated for the construction of the roof crushing zone to remove floating waste and operate adjacent racks in strict accordance with the regulations. Forced removal of racks is prohibited.
6. Carry out practical operation and risk training for intelligent fully mechanised mining equipment, and strengthen education on roofing, moving racks, self-protection and mutual protection.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-12-20 07:53: The belt team entered the mine and used I-beam impact and sledgehammer knocking on the outside of the funnel to deal with the blockage at the lower entrance of the No. 2 coal bunker.
- 2024-12-20 10:29: The electric locomotive carries two passenger carriages and a cargo flatbed to carry people underground.
- 2024-12-20 10:41: The electric locomotive approached the lower entrance of the No. 2 coal bunker. The driver discovered the work ahead and sounded a warning; the on-site personnel stopped working and asked for help to avoid it.
- 2024-12-20 10:42: When the electric locomotive passed through the lower entrance of the No. 2 coal bunker, the coal bunker funnel fell and the coal and waste rock mud burst out, burying the second passenger compartment, and the accident occurred.
- 2024-12-20 10:43: The warehouse collapse accident was reported to the dispatch room on site.
- 2024-12-20 11:50: The coal mine called the mine rescue team to participate in the rescue.
- 2024-12-20 12:15: The mine rescue team arrives at the coal mine.
- 2024-12-20 12:50: The first trapped person was rescued.
- 2024-12-20 13:47: The second trapped person was rescued.
- 2024-12-20 13:53: The third trapped person was rescued; all three people had no vital signs.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal and waste rock sludge in the coal bunker was blocked and formed a bunker. The operators used impact and knock methods to deal with the blocked bunker. The coal and waste rock sludge became unstable and collapsed. The corroded coal bunker funnel with insufficient connections was impacted and fell, and the collapsed coal and waste rock sludge buried the passing second passenger carriage.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal and waste rock sludge blocked the warehouse and formed a silo. The illegal handling of the silo blocked the warehouse, causing the coal and waste rock sludge to become unstable and collapse and wash down the funnel, burying the passenger compartment.
2. key contributing factors: coal and waste rock mud is easy to harden when exposed to water; the I-shaped steel beams and connecting bolts of the coal bunker funnel are corroded, and 12 of the 30 connecting holes are not fixed; the coal mine has not included the disposal of blocked bunkers into hazardous operation management and control, and has not formulated safety technical measures.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Risk identification, measures must be formulated and on-site monitoring must be carried out to deal with coal bunker blockage and collapse.
2. It is prohibited to use unmeasured methods such as knocking and impact to deal with blocked positions.
3. Regularly check the coal bunker funnel, I-beam and connecting bolts, and rectify them immediately if they are found to be rusty or missing.
4. Before vehicles and personnel pass through the lower entrance of the coal bunker, they should confirm that there is no risk of blockage or collapse of the bunker above.
5. Carry out comprehensive inspection, reinforcement and maintenance of the coal bunker and funnel connection structure, and establish specialized safety technical measures and warning systems for risk management of blocked bunkers and unopened bunkers.
6. Training on the use and maintenance of coal bunkers, identification of bunker risk, and prohibition of illegal knocking, impact, poking and other disposal requirements.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine illegally used openings on both sides of the penetration point and the airtight opening to discharge gas, and failed to restore normal ventilation in the 121101 return air lane. After the seal was removed, two managers entered the windless tunnel wearing self-rescuers. After the self-rescuers ran out of oxygen, they died of poisoning and suffocation.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The workers illegally opened and closed the tunnel and entered the windless tunnel illegally, resulting in death from poisoning and suffocation.
2. key contributing factors: dangerous operations were not reported for approval, compliance measures were not formulated or a full-time rescue team was arranged; special risk identification was not carried out, ventilation was restored and gas was discharged before entering the tunnel, and technology and training management were weak.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Hazardous operations must be approved by the local regulatory authorities and must be performed by professionals.
2. Standardize the installation, use and management of videos, and promote AI videos to combat the "three violations".

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-04-24 07:00: The mine leader held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for the excavation team to work in the 116a1 transport lane.
- 2025-04-24 08:20: Seven people from the excavation team arrived at the working face one after another and divided the work.
- 2025-04-24 09:00: The mine leaders and safety officers arrived at the working face and found that the heading was not supported in time, and required temporary support before constructing the cable bolt.
- 2025-04-24 09:30: The mechanized excavator dug about 2 metres and then retreated and stopped.
- 2025-04-24 09:57: The squad leader was constructing cable bolt drilling in the empty roof area without temporary support, and the roof suddenly fell off, and the accident occurred.
- 2025-04-24 10:10: Leading the mine leaders to report the accident from underground to the chief engineer.
- 2025-04-24 11:00: The coal mine arranged vehicles to take the casualty to the hospital.
- 2025-04-24 12:00: The chief engineer reported the accident to the actual controller.
- 2025-04-24 14:10: The chief engineer reported the accident to the local regulatory authority.
- 2025-04-24 17:10: The casualty died after the hospital failed to rescue him.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 116a1 transport tunnel was excavated to the C5b coal seam goaf, and the roof structure was broken. After the mechanized excavator was shut down, the squad leader knocked on the roof but did not implement temporary support and drilled in the empty roof area on the right side of the head. When the second drill rod was being constructed, the roof suddenly fell and he was injured. He was later sent to the hospital and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The development heading was in the goaf area, the roof was broken, and the workers were working without a roof, causing the roof to fall and cause death.
2. key contributing factors: The general survey of the goaf area is unclear, temporary support and hypercycle excavation control have not been implemented; on-site monitoring, safety inspector deployment, hidden danger rectification and training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement roof-and-rib sounding and temporary support, and empty roof operations are strictly prohibited.
2. Mining is not allowed in areas where hidden disaster-causing factors have not been identified or treated.
3. Before digging to expose old empty areas, it is necessary to explore and take targeted treatment measures.
4. Strengthen supervision at the mine and dynamically supervise the implementation of operating procedures and safety measures.
5. Identify hidden disaster factors, formulate measures and use reliable temporary supports before excavation in goaf and other special areas.
6. Make procedures, roof abnormality signs, support procedures and special area control the focus of training, and carry out roof warning education.

During support recovery, the fully mechanised mining team installed only one single hydraulic prop between the base of the shield support and the coal face, without effective anti-slip measures. - 2025-05-25 02:35: The coal mine reported the accident to the relevant authorities.
- 2025-05-25 04:10: The casualty died after ineffective rescue efforts on the way to the hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
The surrounding rock at the opening of the winch chamber has poor stability and is located at the joint surface between the coal seam and the floor. No temporary support was implemented at the site, and umbrella rocks were left on the top; the roof fell when workers were expanding brushing and loading waste in the empty ceiling area, causing it to be buried.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The surrounding rock stability at the opening of the winch room was poor, and the operators were operating in the empty roof area in violation of regulations, causing the roof to fall.
2. key contributing factors: The construction did not follow safety technical measures to complete the entire tunnel at one time and provide temporary support in a timely manner; the on-site safety management personnel did not discover and stop illegal operations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Targeted support measures must be formulated and implemented based on the surrounding rock conditions for the winch room opening and brush expansion.
2. It is strictly prohibited to operate in unsafe areas such as empty ceilings and umbrella rocks.
3. Strengthen the team's on-site safety confirmation and lead patrol inspections, and stop risky operations immediately if any risky operations are discovered.
4. Supervisors stationed at the mine should perform their duties independently and effectively supervise high-risk construction.
5. Strictly implement the winch room construction measures, promptly adopt temporary supports such as front beams and capped pillars, and only operate after confirming that the support is reliable.
6. Strengthen roof management, asking for help and risk education for empty roof operations.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-10-11 07:40: The project civil engineering team arrived at the 35kV substation to prepare for construction.
- 2025-10-11 08:07: The contractor's representative arrived for inspection and was verbally reminded not to touch the high-voltage switch cabinet when removing the partition wall.

- 2025-10-11 08:58: The operation and maintenance personnel discovered that the project management personnel were not on site and required the construction and supervision personnel to be present for supervision.
- 2025-10-11 10:30: The supervisor found that the scaffolding was too close to the distribution cabinet, and left after verbally reminding people to pay attention to safety when working near live parts.
- 2025-10-11 10:33: Construction workers boarded the escalator on the north side of the No. 3 incoming line cabinet and hung colorful strips of cloth.
- 2025-10-11 10:35: The construction workers climbed from the ladder to the top of the No. 3 incoming cabinet and delivered the colored strips.
- 2025-10-11 10:36: The construction worker stepped on the pressure relief cover. After the cover fell off, it fell into the busbar room and received an electric shock. The accident occurred.
- 2025-10-11 10:40: Operation and maintenance personnel arrived at the scene to disconnect the power supply, and on-site personnel rescued the casualty and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
- 2025-10-11 11:06: The coal mine reported the accident to relevant units.
- 2025-10-11 11:15: The medical staff of the health center announced that the casualty person died after resuscitation failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The construction unit did not implement special safety technical measures in the operating substation, and the on-site safety management personnel were not on duty. The construction workers climbed up the escalator to the top of the live No. 3 incoming line cabinet to deliver colored strips of cloth. When they returned to the ladder, they stepped on the pressure relief cover and fell into the busbar room. They came into contact with the A-phase busbar and received an electric shock. He died after resuscitation failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The construction workers violated regulations and stepped on the pressure relief cover on the top of the No. 3 incoming line cabinet during live operation. After the cover fell off, it fell into the busbar room and was electrocuted.
2. key contributing factors: The construction unit did not have a full-time safety inspector and did not formulate special safety technical measures; project management personnel left their posts without authorization, supervision was not available, and the coal mine did not cooperate with the construction supervision of the operating substation.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Projects with incomplete information and unapproved special measures shall not be started.
2. During construction in operating substations, risks should be clarified and on-site monitoring implemented.
3. Strictly review construction qualifications and safety personnel allocation, and eliminate the use of contract management.
4. Supervise supervision units to stand by their posts and record supervision information factually.
5. Special safety technical measures must be prepared, approved and implemented for operations near live electricity. Special personnel should be arranged for on-site supervision and cooperation during the construction of operating substations.
6. Carry out training on electric shock risks, correct operations and emergency response for outsourced construction personnel, as well as accident warning education.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the operation of the main No. 1 belt conveyor, the inspection workers went under the head frame to clean the coal and waste rock, and the protective fence had been removed. His right arm was caught between the bottom roller and the tape, and his chest was squeezed and injured. After rescuers rescued him and sent him to the hospital, the hospital confirmed his death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally entered the cleaning operation under the head frame of the running belt conveyor, and was entangled in the bottom roller and the tape and squeezed to death.
2. key contributing factors: the cleaning operation was not stopped and fault lockout was carried out; the protective fence was removed; the mechanical and electrical transportation system and inspection management were not in place, and risk management and control and hidden danger inspection were not implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the belt conveyor cleaning, maintenance, shutdown, locking and tagging system.
2. Regularly inspect and maintain the belt conveyor to ensure that safety facilities such as guardrails are in good condition.
3. Strengthen inspections of single-person work stations and stop illegal operations in a timely manner.
4. Investigate blind spots in video surveillance and promote the AI ​​video anti-"three violations" system.
5. Cleaning and maintenance operations must be carried out after the equipment has completely stopped and centralized control fault lockout has been completed; protective facilities and operating procedures must be completed.
6. Strengthen job procedures, cleaning and maintenance shutdown systems and anti-habitual violation training to improve the ability to know dangers, avoid dangers and standardize operations.

- 2026-03-22 23:05: The captain of the general mining team held a pre-night shift meeting to arrange personnel to maintain the 110301 high-end general mining working face.

- 2026-03-23 ​​04:00: The shearer stopped near the middle lane and the deputy captain went to the upper part of the working face to provide support.
- 2026-03-23 ​​06:00: The deputy captain returned to the shearer and arranged to continue cutting coal and clean up the debris dropped from the roof.
- 2026-03-23 ​​06:55: The π-shaped beam and single pillar of the coal mining machine deformed and sank. The deputy captain entered the machine tunnel without stopping the cutting drum and conveyor.
- 2026-03-23 ​​06:58: The safety inspector discovered that the deputy captain was involved in the left cutting drum of the shearer, and immediately notified the shearer to stop.
- 2026-03-23 ​​07:06: An injury was reported to the dispatch room at the scene.
- 2026-03-23 ​​07:16: Lead the mine leaders to the working face to organise rescue.
- 2026-03-23 ​​08:21: The mine director reported the accident to Qujing Energy Bureau.
- 2026-03-23 ​​09:04: Rescuers rescued the casualty from under the cutting drum.
- 2026-03-23 ​​09:30: The casualties were transported to the ground.
- 2026-03-23 ​​09:51: Doctors at the health center confirmed on site that the casualty person had no vital signs.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the shearer encountered deformed and sunken π-shaped beams and pillars near the middle lane, the deputy captain who was on duty to operate the shearer only stopped towing, but did not stop the cutting drum and scraper conveyor. He entered the machine roadway with a liquid injection gun to protect the roof, and was caught by the running left cutting drum and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator entered the shearer tunnel to maintain the roof without shutting down the machine and was caught by the running left cutting drum and died.
2. key contributing factors: On-site safety officers failed to stop violations; risk management and control of resumption of work, closed-loop mechanical and electrical measures and safety training were not in place; coal shearer operators did not have special operation certificates.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. When the shearer is cutting coal, personnel are not allowed to enter the dangerous area near the cutting drum.
2. Allocate special operators who meet the needs of the operation and prevent those who work without certificates.
3. Carry out full-process risk management and control and follow-up of risk measures for resumption of work.
4. Strengthen the assessment of resident mine supervisors and on-site supervision of coal mines.
5. Strictly implement shearer shutdown, lockout and hazardous area control measures, and establish closed-loop management of the implementation of mechanical and electrical measures.
6. Strengthen training on the safe use of electromechanical equipment, key precautions and certification for special operations, and carry out warning education.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2026-05-08 15:30: The coal mining team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 22 people to work at the 11401 coal face.
- 2026-05-08 16:10: The operators arrived at the working face, prepared materials and prepared to cut coal.
- 2026-05-08 18:40: Start cutting coal from top to bottom at a position about 135 metres away from the machine head.
- 2026-05-08 20:30: After cutting through a piece of coal, the shearer stopped about 20 metres away from the machine head.
- 2026-05-08 20:45: When three people were moving beams and columns about 45 metres away from the nose of the aircraft, a large area of ​​the roof collapsed, and two support workers were buried.
- 2026-05-08 21:57: The coal mine reported the accident to the Ninglang County Industry and Information Technology Bureau and other departments.
- 2026-05-09 00:29: The first trapped person was found with no vital signs.
- 2026-05-09 10:23: The second trapped person was found with no vital signs.

【Accident Mechanism】
The accident site is located in the coal seam change zone, and the roof stability is poor. The workers failed to manage the roof in accordance with regulations. There was a serious shortage of dense columns, split columns and temporary supports on the working face, and the initial support strength of some individual hydraulic props did not meet the standard. The pressure from the roof pushed down the individual hydraulic props, causing a large-scale collapse and burying the workers.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the coal seam change zone has poor stability, and the on-site roof support strength is insufficient. After the pressure is applied, the single hydraulic prop is pushed down and causes collapse.
2. key contributing factors: the dense columns, split columns, temporary supports, wooden stacks and signal columns were not prepared according to the regulations; the pressure of the pillars was not tested one by one before going underground, and some initial support forces were insufficient; special safety technical measures were not formulated for inclination adjustment, and rectification after hidden dangers were not thoroughly rectified.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the roof management, roof asking and mine pressure observation systems to ensure that the pillars are complete, intact and stable.
2. After the shearer cuts the coal, temporary support for the shearer shall be implemented in a timely manner; special measures must be prepared for tilt adjustment and construction under special geological conditions.
3. The construction project department shall be equipped with safety, technical and special operations personnel, and the supervision unit shall be stationed at the mine to review the procedures and measures and conduct on-site inspections.
4. Strengthen video surveillance, on-site anti-"three violations" and closed-loop management of hidden dangers, and promptly stop illegal operations such as insufficient support strength.
5. Implement roof support and mine pressure observation in strict accordance with operating procedures; prepare special measures and strengthen support when the working face passes through geological structural zones, stress concentration areas and during periods of pressure.
6. Implement no less than 72 hours of pre-job training for employees, and strengthen roof risk identification, operation according to regulations, and self-rescue and mutual rescue training.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-04-29 23:30: The mine leader on duty on the ground presided over the night shift (00:00 to 08:00) dispatch meeting on April 30, arranging a preparation team to clean up the coal (gas) accumulation on the 6th scraper conveyor to solve the problem of poor pedestrian access.
- 2022-04-29 23:56: The preparation team leader held a pre-shift briefing, arranged cleaning and undercover operations, designated the operators of the 5th and 6th scraper conveyor, and made safety instructions.
- 2022-04-30 00:20: 5 operators entered the mine.
- 2022-04-30 01:20: The workers arrived at the 6th scraper conveyor; after the shift leader checked the coal (gang) accumulation, he arranged for 3 people to clean it and 2 people to operate the 5th and 6th scraper conveyors respectively.
- 2022-04-30 01:30: Operators began to clean up the coal (gang) from the tail of the sixth scraper conveyor; on-site personnel used tools to crush it and load it into the chute, and the conveyor operator started and stopped the equipment according to the signal.
- 2022-04-30 02:30: The safety inspector went to the site to inspect and left after finding no abnormalities.
- 2022-04-30 07:00: The safety inspector came to the scene again and saw that the conveyor had stopped and the cleaning operation was close to the head of the sixth conveyor. He left without any instructions.
- 2022-04-30 08:00: Three cleaning personnel worked to about 6.5 metres away from the head of the sixth scraper conveyor, and started the fifth and sixth scraper conveyors on site; the operator of the fifth conveyor rested on the edge of the modified chute at the rear of the machine.
- 2022-04-30 08:02: After hearing the shouting, on-site personnel found that the operator of the fifth conveyor fell into the modified chute at the tail of the fifth scraper conveyor.
- After 2022-04-30 08:02: The shift leader immediately stopped the 6th conveyor and signaled to stop the 5th conveyor. When the equipment came to a stop, the casualty person had been dragged into the bottom of the fifth chute, about 10 metres from the tail of the aircraft, and his clothes were entangled; three on-site personnel rescued him about 8 minutes later and transferred him to the upper refuge chamber.
- 2022-04-30 08:10: The shift leader reported the accident to the dispatch room and requested rescue.
- 2022-04-30 08:11: The mine rescue team went down the mine with rescue equipment after receiving the dispatch order.
- After 08:11 on 2022-04-30: The ambulance crew arrived at the refuge chamber and checked, confirming that the casualty had no heartbeat and no breathing.
- 2022-04-30 09:10: The casualty was transported to the shaft.
- After 09:10 on 2022-04-30: The accident unit failed to report the accident to relevant government departments and mine safety supervision and inspection departments as required.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the night shift to clean up the coal (gas) accumulation on the 6th scraper conveyor, the 5th and 6th conveyors started and stopped according to on-site signals. The operator of the fifth conveyor lost his footing and fell into the running chute while resting on the edge of the unprotected modified chute without a cover plate at the rear of the machine. He was dragged by the conveyor to the overlap between the fifth and sixth conveyors and was squeezed and dragged. He died after ineffective rescue efforts.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The modified chute at the rear of the fifth scraper conveyor was not equipped with a cover plate and protective device. When the operator leaned on the edge of the chute, he fell into the running conveyor and was dragged and squeezed.
2. key contributing factors: illegal use of modified conveyors that do not meet the requirements for mining product safety labels; inadequate daily maintenance of equipment, hidden danger investigation and risk identification; inadequate on-site safety management, education and training, and safety inspection supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to use electromechanical transportation equipment without mining product safety signs or without unauthorized modification or acceptance.
2. Install firm covers and protective devices on dangerous parts such as chutes and overlaps of the scraper conveyor, and carry out special inspections.
3. For operations such as clearing coal deposits (gane), start and stop signals, personnel positions and on-site monitoring requirements should be clearly defined.
4. Safety inspectors should strengthen inspections and problem handling of key links in transportation operations.
5. After an accident occurs, it should be reported promptly and truthfully in accordance with regulations, and no concealment of reports is allowed.
6. Stop using modified equipment that does not meet regulations, conduct a comprehensive inspection of transportation equipment, and make up for chute covers, protective devices and other safety facilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- After 08:00 on 2023-04-10: After the ditch construction team held a pre-shift briefing, four workers loaded materials underground together.
- 2023-04-10 08:40: 4 people arrived at the ditch construction site in the -240-meter North Transportation Lane, installed the pressure air duct and air pick and started the operation; no safety risk investigation was conducted before the operation.
- 2023-04-10 09:30: The deputy mine director for safety went to the construction site to inspect and left after finding no abnormalities.
- 2023-04-10 10:10: The deputy mine director for safety went to the construction site to inspect again and left after finding no abnormalities.
- 2023-04-10 10:30: A construction worker placed the third formwork and left to check the transportation situation of cement and river sand; the remaining three people continued to work, and one of them used a pneumatic pick to break the rock along the original blast hole.
- 2023-04-10 10:40: The remains of blind cannon in the bottom rock of the pickaxe caused an explosion. All three workers on site were blown down.
- After 10:40 on 2023-04-10: An injured person crawled out to search for rescue and met construction workers leaving the site; after the two returned, they found that one person had a head injury and the other had an injury to his left foot, and then called for help.
- 2023-04-10 10:50: The methane examiner reported the accident to the dispatching room by phone at the uphill and downhill parking lot on Track 12; the dispatching room reported the on-duty mine leader, chief engineer and deputy production director.
- 2023-04-10 10:56: The deputy mine manager dialed 120 emergency number to summon an ambulance.
- After 2023-04-10 10:56: On-site personnel used mine trucks to transport the two injured people to the underground car yard; the deputy mine director of safety returned to the accident site after arriving at the bottom of the mine to organise rescue, and transported the persons with no vital signs to the bottom of the mine using mine trucks.
- 2023-04-10 11:00: The mine personnel reported the accident and the medical treatment of the casualty to the chairman.
- 2023-04-10 11:14: 2 injured people were transported to the ground.
- 2023-04-10 11:26: The ambulance arrived at the main mine entrance and sent the two injured people to Leiyang People's Hospital, and then transferred them to separate hospitals for treatment.
- 2023-04-10 12:20: Persons without vital signs were transported to the ground, but on-site rescue by emergency doctors was ineffective.
- 2023-04-10 13:25: The emergency doctor declared the casualty dead and the on-site rescue ended.
- 2023-04-10 20:14: The mine just reported the accident to the Xiatang Town Coal Pipe Station, which constituted a late report.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the excavation of the accident site in 2019, there were supplementary shots and missing shots that were not inspected and processed, and were later covered by waste rock. The technical measures for digging ditches in 2023 did not identify the risk of remaining blind blasts in the old alley, and the site was not inspected before the operation; the operators hit the blind blast when they used pneumatic picks to break through the rock along the original blast holes, causing an explosion and injuring three people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The remaining blind cannons in the old alley were not discovered and dealt with, and the risks were not checked before the operation. The operator used a pneumatic pick to hit the blind cannon and detonated it.
2. key contributing factors: The inspection and treatment system for rejecting explosions and residual explosions after blasting has not been implemented; the risk of blind blasting has not been identified in the use of old lanes and ditch construction measures; the failure of on-site management, training, personnel positioning and hidden danger management.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Underground blasting is carried out by full-time blasters, and one shot, three inspections and three-person chain blasting are strictly implemented.
2. After blasting, blasters, methane examiners and team leaders must check and deal with rejected explosions and residual explosions in accordance with regulations.
3. Carry out a comprehensive hidden danger investigation in front of the old alley, and formulate special measures for the locations where blind cannons may remain.
4. Construction technical measures should be implemented after identifying risks on site and organizing learning for all employees.
5. Standardize the use of location identification cards for personnel going underground. It is strictly prohibited to go underground without a card or borrowing someone else's identification card.
6. Report accidents in a timely and accurate manner, and seriously investigate and deal with late or concealed reports.
