【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-04 07:40: Team 102 held a pre-shift briefing at the 2553 working face and arranged for the electric locomotive driver to work at the main stone gate at 25-130 metres, while other personnel carried out mining operations.
- 2023-05-04 07:45: Team 112 held a pre-shift briefing, arranged for workers to clean the 25-130-meter main stone gate water pipes and ditches, and explained the safety of locomotives entering and exiting.
- 2023-05-04 08:20: The workers on duty from the two teams went down the well one after another.
- 2023-05-04 09:00: The two teams of personnel arrived at the working site respectively; the 7 mine cars under the coal hopper have been connected and braked with 7-shaped card locks, and the electric locomotive driver is waiting at the dump site.
- 2023-05-04 09:20: Ditch cleaning crews started cleaning the ditch about 70 metres behind the coal hopper.
- 2023-05-04 10:00: The electric locomotive driver roofed three empty mine cars into the main stone gate. Due to the obstruction of the ditch and debris, they could not continue to pass. After parking, they walked to the coal hopper to wait for the coal to be discharged.
- 2023-05-04 10:30: After the blasting at the 2553 working face, the operators entered the working face to carry out roofing, supporting, coal removal and tunneling operations.
- 2023-05-04 11:13: The driver of the electric locomotive filled half of the car with coal directly under the coal hopper, pulled out the 7-shaped latch of the mine car, only inserted wooden wedges into the wheels to brake and left; the wooden wedge then loosened and fell, and the 7 mine cars slid out of the main stone gate due to their own weight.
- 2023-05-04 11:15: The ditch cleaning crew discovered that the mine car was sliding down quickly and hid in Dongbang and shouted; the sliding mine car hit his chest, and then hit three empty mine cars and caused them to fall off the road. The empty car fell off the road and knocked down the driver of a nearby electric locomotive and pinned him under the car.
- After 2023-05-04 11:15: The casualty ditch cleaner moved about 40 metres to the dump site and then stopped due to pain and was unable to wait for rescue; the captain of another team discovered that the electric locomotive driver was injured and found the casualty person at the telephone at the same time, and reported to the dispatch room.
- 2023-05-04 11:20: After receiving the report, the dispatching room reported to the mine leader on duty, organised the hospital rescue team to rescue and called the mine leader on duty underground.
- 2023-05-04 11:25: After receiving the order, the captain of the rescue team organised the rescue team to rush to Yipingdong Coal Mine with equipment.
- 2023-05-04 11:43: After the underground mine leader learned of the accident, he asked the dispatching room to send a rescue team and doctors down the mine, and rushed to the 25 mining area to organise rescue.
- 2023-05-04 12:02: The rescue team arrived at the main stone gate at 25-130 metres. They first helped the casualty ditch cleaner out of the well, and then went to the electric locomotive driver to carry out rescue; the casualty did not respond to his cry.
- 2023-05-04 13:10: Rescue workers escorted the driver of the electric locomotive to the bottom of the -50-meter-long man and vehicle. Doctors at the hospital who arrived confirmed that he had no vital signs.
- 2023-05-04 13:30: The victims were carried to the ground and sent to Lengjiang Funeral Home by mining ambulance.
- After 13:30 on 2023-05-04: The main person in charge of the coal mine and the company failed to report the accident to the local government and safety supervision department as required.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the electric locomotive driver filled the mine car under the coal hopper, he removed the 7-character latch and braked with only a single wooden wedge. After the wooden wedges became loose and fell, 7 mine cars slid down on their own in the tunnel with an excessive slope, no reliable stopping facilities and no warning lights. They first hit the ditch cleaning personnel and then hit 3 empty mine cars, causing them to fall off the road. The empty cars fell off the road and knocked down the driver of the electric locomotive passing here and squeezed him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator removed the brake latch of the mine car and used only a single wooden wedge to brake. After the wooden wedge fell, the mine car slid down on its own and hit the empty car that fell off the track, squeezing the electric locomotive driver and killing him.
2. key contributing factors: the slope exceeds the limit after the tunnel bottom drum is deformed, the parking lot and reliable vehicle blocking facilities are missing; the transportation personnel are insufficient, on-site management and anti-violation are ineffective; safety training, mine supervision and accident reporting systems are not implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate and improve the transportation system, focusing on controlling the risks of excessive gradients, irregular parking lots, and vehicle brake failure.
2. Follow the drivers, blocking facilities and vehicle parking warning devices in strict accordance with regulations.
3. It is prohibited to use unreliable means such as a single wooden wedge to replace braking and blocking devices.
4. Strengthen underground supervision, on-site inspections and anti-violation management.
5. After an accident occurs, a timely, accurate and complete report should be made, and late reporting, omissions and concealment of reports are strictly prohibited.
6. Standardize the design of parking lots and rail transportation in mining areas, eliminate unreliable braking methods such as brake sticks and wooden wedges, and install reliable braking and blocking facilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-07 07:00: The mine manager organised a morning shift dispatch meeting and made it clear that the 21-pedestrian shaft overhead manned vehicle was dangerous and was not allowed to be used. People were moved up and down the shaft instead.
- 2023-05-07 07:40: The maintenance team held a pre-shift briefing. The team leader once again explained that people and vehicles cannot ride overhead, and personnel can only go from the vertical shaft to the -40 meter level.

- 2023-05-07 08:20: Two fitters entered the mine and removed the overhead man-car lift chair on the upper platform of the 21st pedestrian shaft.
- 2023-05-07 09:30: Two fitters took the last undisassembled lifting chair to the -40-meter disembarking platform, dismantled the lifting chair, and then left the maintenance cradle; the overhead manned vehicle remained powered.
- 2023-05-07 12:51: The new operator of the maintenance team arrived at the 21 pedestrian well platform with a masonry knife, installed a lifting chair by himself, tightened the fastening bolts of the cable holder with bare hands, and then descended by car.
- 2023-05-07 13:10: The unfastened cable grip slid down after being vibrated by the supporting wheel. The chairlift collided with the supporting wheel and joists and decoupled, and the passengers were thrown into the tunnel.
- 2023-05-07 14:20: Two fitters found a mine cap in the lower yard when they were on duty. They then took an overhead manned vehicle up and found the casualty lying prone on the ground at the No. 23 steel beam.
- 2023-05-07 14:33: On-site personnel reported to the dispatching room on the 21-person underground platform; the mine leader on duty immediately reported to the mine director.

- 2023-05-07 16:38: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the period of maintenance and deactivation of the overhead manned vehicle, the power was not cut off, the start switch was not locked, and no warning was set. The operator installed a lifting chair without fastening the cable holder and took the risk to ride on it; the lifting chair slid down and swung along the wire rope after being vibrated by the supporting wheel. It collided with the supporting wheel and the joist and decoupled. The person was thrown off and died from a head impact.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The overhead manned vehicle was not powered off and locked during maintenance and deactivation. The operator illegally installed and rode on a lifting chair without tightening the cable holder. The lifting chair decoupled and threw him off.
2. key contributing factors: Maintenance measures did not clarify and implement control measures to prevent unauthorized power transmission and rides; new employees went down the mine alone before completing the apprenticeship internship, and there was a lack of on-site inspection of key maintenance links.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen power outages, lockouts and on-site inspections during maintenance of electromechanical transportation equipment.
2. Strictly review and implement safety technical measures to ensure that control measures are set against risks such as unauthorized starting and riding.
3. Equip electromechanical transportation technical management personnel and clarify management responsibilities.
4. Install monitoring facilities in key maintenance areas and implement risk identification and hidden danger management.
5. During the maintenance period, the system of power outage, lockout, tagging and special supervision shall be strictly implemented, and personnel shall not enter or ride on disabled overhead manned vehicles.
6. Implement new employee training, teacher-training internships, and overhead manned vehicle operation and maintenance training, and carry out warning education on illegal riding and maintenance shutdowns.

【Accident Timeline】

- After 2023-07-10 01:00: Maintenance personnel strengthened the gantou supports, installed chute plates and cleaned up the remaining coal, and then began tunnel maintenance; during the maintenance, only two single pillars were used to support each forward beam, and measures were not taken to reinforce the four supports to lift the double-sided buildings.
- 2023-07-10 05:08: When the deputy captain of the shift was dealing with the broken chain of the scraper conveyor 16 metres away, he heard the sound of collapse; the maintenance work that was digging the pillar nest in the East Gang was buried by the sudden collapse of coal and waste rock.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the return air lane 2454 is loose and detached seriously. The maintenance work did not follow the measures to reinforce the four-sided shed near the head. The metal shed did not have support tubes, the legs were not interlocked, and the number of front beam columns was insufficient. When Dagong was digging the pillar nest alone on the east side, the top coal and waste rock with insufficient support strength and stability suddenly collapsed, burying it and causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance tunnel failed to implement the support requirements for double-sided buildings, support tubes, shed leg interlocks, and sufficient forward beam columns. The roof collapsed when the workers worked alone on the east side of the tunnel with insufficient support.
2. key contributing factors: The risk of roof looseness and delamination is high and it is not monitored closely; maintenance measures for scaffold interlocking and operating procedures are incomplete, on-site inspections and hidden danger rectification are ineffective, and operators habitually violate regulations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. List roadway maintenance, single pillars and scaffolding support locations as the key points of roof management, and conduct a comprehensive investigation.
2. Improve the pertinence of operating procedures and safety technical measures, and strictly countersign, review and implement them.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-07-27 06:50: The leader of the previous shift organised a morning shift scheduling meeting to arrange production tasks and safety precautions.
- 2023-07-27 07:11: The squad leader of the previous transport team reported to the dispatcher that the flatbed truck loading the powered support on the 303 track up the mountain fell off the track; the dispatcher failed to report to the shift leader as required.
- 2023-07-27 07:30: The transportation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged three operators to deal with the flatbed truck falling off the track and re-railing, and arranged additional personnel for follow-up assistance.
- 2023-07-27 08:30: Three operators arrived at the scene and found that all four wheels of the flatbed truck had fallen off the track. They began to transport rerailing materials and used jacks and side wood to pad the truck.
- 2023-07-27 12:30: The safety inspector was required to be on guard at the parking lot -200 metres away. The nearby people left and did not go to the accident site to supervise.
- 2023-07-27 13:30: Five workers restarted the derailment, one of whom used a jack, and the other workers delivered materials and pad cars.
- 2023-07-27 14:42: Three wheels of the flatbed truck have been lifted up; after the operator discovered that there was insufficient padding, he and other personnel moved the materials, leaving one operator to rest on site.
- 2023-07-27 14:45: When the operator who stayed on site used a jack alone to lift the panel above the fourth wheel, the flatbed truck rolled over and the powered support squeezed it between the tunnel walls.
- 2023-07-27 14:58: On-site personnel used a jack to open the rollover support to rescue the casualty, and reported to the dispatch command center in the parking lot waiting room -200 metres away.
- 2023-07-27 15:38: The general manager led the rescue team to the scene to perform first aid.
- 2023-07-27 15:50: The rescue team found that the casualty person had no vital signs.
- 2023-07-27 16:20: Rescue workers transported the casualty to the mine entrance.
- 2023-07-27 16:30: Doctors from Lengshuijiang People's Hospital confirmed the death of the casualty at the mouth of the well.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the four wheels of the self-made flatbed truck loaded with hydraulic supports fell off the road, on-site personnel used materials such as side logs and rails that did not meet the requirements of the measures to pad the truck to keep the vehicle in a metastable state. When the operator used a jack alone to lift the panel above the fourth wheel, the flatbed truck rolled over and the powered support squeezed it between the roof guard and the tunnel wall, resulting in death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When handling the loaded flatbed truck in a metastable state, the operator illegally padded the truck and lifted it alone, causing the flatbed truck to roll over and the powered support to squeeze the workers.
2. key contributing factors: the use of self-made flatbed cars that do not meet national standards and the use of padding materials that do not meet the requirements of measures; the lack of anti-rollover and anti-skid measures in the track fall disposal measures, and the on-site safety supervision and track hazard management are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. List the transportation of over-wide, over-weight, and over-large objects as a major source of danger and implement control.
2. Regularly maintain the track and track bed, and promptly eliminate hidden dangers such as excessive track bed and poor track quality.
3. Strictly review and implement safety technical measures to ensure that the treatment measures for channel drop are on-site targeted.
4. Implement the monitoring and inspection of key transportation operations by shift leaders and safety officers.
5. Stop using transportation equipment that does not meet standards; take reliable anti-rollover, anti-skid, and anti-tipping fixation measures when dealing with large items falling out of inclined lanes.
6. Strengthen training on large cargo transportation, off-track re-railing and anti-"three violations" to improve the self-protection and mutual protection capabilities of operators.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-08-17 12:30: The second mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the maintenance, support repair and equipment recovery tasks of the 12610 working face and make safety instructions.
- 2023-08-17 12:45: Five operators went down to the 12610 working face one after another; the squad leader divided the work and arranged for personnel to drive the scraper conveyor, clean coal and load the truck, maintain support and observe the roof.
- After 2023-08-17 12:45: On-site personnel transported the materials to the operation site and cleaned up the accumulated coal and waste rock. Then 2 maintenance personnel started working, and the squad leader observed the roof on the air inlet side.
- 2023-08-17 19:31: A maintenance worker directly relieved the pressure on a single pillar on the Laotang side without following the outside-in principle and without reinforcing the support at the working site; the roof suddenly fell, and two maintenance workers were buried in coal and waste rock. Another person's legs were stuck between loose coal and waste rock and π beams during rescue operations.
- After 2023-08-17 19:31: After seeing that the two people were buried, the squad leader notified the workers to report to the dispatch room by phone, and went to the return air lane to assist the trapped personnel.
- 2023-08-17 19:34: After receiving the report, the dispatcher reported to the leader on duty on the ground and notified the production, deputy mine director and safety deputy mine director.
- 2023-08-17 19:40: The deputy mine manager for production, the deputy mine manager for outburst prevention, and the deputy mine manager for safety went down to organise the rescue.
- 2023-08-17 19:50: The leader on duty on the ground reported the accident to the mine director.
- 2023-08-17 21:03: The mine notified the company’s deputy general manager of safety.
- 2023-08-17 21:10: The rescue team went down to the well to rescue.
- 2023-08-17 21:30: The rescue team arrived at the accident site, and worked with underground personnel to set up support at the fall, add floating tips, and clean up the coal and waste rock for search and rescue.
- After 23:00 on 2023-08-17: The casualty person whose legs were stuck was rescued and lifted underground, and was sent to the hospital for treatment by ambulance.
- After 2023-08-18 01:00: The first buried person was rescued from the well and was confirmed dead by doctors when he was sent to Leiyang People's Hospital.
- 2023-08-18 04:59: The second buried person was rescued and sent to Hengyang Third People's Hospital. The doctor confirmed his death and the on-site rescue ended.
- 2023-08-18 10:40: The Hunan Provincial Emergency Management Department received reports from the public that an accident occurred in Wujiachong Coal Mine.
- 2023-08-18 12:12: Xiangmei Coal Co., Ltd. reported the accident to the Hunan Provincial Emergency Management Department.
- After 2023-08-18 12:14: Company personnel reported the accident to the emergency management departments of Leiyang City, Hunan Province and Hengyang City.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 12610 working face has not been completed or maintained for a long time after the mining was completed. The roof is broken, the roof is partially empty, and the support is severely deformed. The maintenance personnel did not follow the outside-in principle and did not reinforce the support at the working site. They directly relieved the pressure on the single pillar on the old pond side. The roof immediately fell and buried two maintenance personnel. During the rescue, one on-site personnel had his legs stuck by loose coal and waste rock and π beams.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The repair site with broken, empty roof and deformed support was not reinforced. The workers illegally relieved the pressure of the single pillar on the Laotang side, causing the roof to fall and bury two people.
2. key contributing factors: The working face has not been completed, sealed, and maintained for a long time after mining; insufficient risk identification and training in maintenance measures; failure of on-site leadership, safety inspections, roof management, and internal supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. After the mining area was completed, the equipment should be closed, withdrawn and sealed in a timely manner according to regulations, and written approval should be obtained in case of delay.
2. Maintenance operations must follow the principles of working from outside to inside, near first and then far, first supporting and then supporting. Reinforce first and then replace the support.
3. Strengthen the pressure detection, maintenance and scrap management of single hydraulic props.
4. Equipped with team leaders and full-time safety officers, mine leaders should inspect maintenance operations as a key link.
5. Accident information must be reported truthfully within the specified time limit. Blocking the scene or concealing the report is strictly prohibited.
6. Formulate special measures for the closing of the mining area, equipment withdrawal and disrepaired tunnels, inspect and reinforce the supports before repairing them one by one, and eliminate failed single pillars.

【Accident Mechanism】

The operators violated regulations and manually lowered three heavy vehicles in a tunnel with a slope of more than 7‰. In order to prevent the moving vehicle from going around in front of the vehicle, it fell on the track, and its neck was crushed by the moving heavy vehicle and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The lower parking lot was not equipped with brakes or vehicle arresters. The operator released the vehicle in a roadway with a slope of more than 7‰ and fell when blocking in front of the vehicle. He was crushed to death by a heavy vehicle.
2. key contributing factors: Transportation risk identification and technical measures violate regulations; long-term violations such as man-powered carts and flying cars with slopes exceeding 7‰ have not been eliminated; mechanical and electrical transportation management, on-site supervision and safety training are not in place.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-10-18 07:00: The chief engineer in charge organised a morning shift dispatch meeting and arranged for the return air from the 24 mining area to go down the mountain to stop excavation, clean the tunnel and repair the ditch.
- 2023-10-18 07:40: The excavation and repair team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for three workers to clean the return air coming down the mountain and build ditches from top to bottom.
- 2023-10-18 08:30: The excavation and repair team members arrived at the upper yard of the return air mountain and began cleaning preparations.
- 2023-10-18 09:00: The methane examiner went to the work area to check the gas and left.
- 2023-10-18 09:20: The safety inspector went to the operation area; because no excavation was arranged on duty, neither the captain on duty nor the safety inspector went to the excavation head to check the drainage equipment or conduct safety confirmation.
- 2023-10-18 09:30: After lowering the empty truck, the operators cleaned the tunnel from bottom to top and loaded the waste rock into the truck.
- 2023-10-18 11:00: The roadway cleaning was completed, and a total of 3 trucks of waste rock and dirt were cleared; 4 people were resting in the upper yard and waiting for materials.
- 2023-10-18 12:00: The materials are delivered to the upper yard. The captain on duty arranges for one operator to go to the excavation head to turn on the submersible pump for drainage, while the remaining personnel carry the materials.
- 2023-10-18 12:05: The workers left the upper yard, first went to the 185-meter avoidance tunnel, habitually turned on the submersible pump control switch, and then headed to the cave.
- 2023-10-18 12:15: When moving the submersible pump cable, the operator grabbed the damaged insulation and was electrocuted and fell to the ground.
- 2023-10-18 12:20: When the methane examiner went to Gaotou for inspection for the second time, he found that the casualty person had fallen to the ground. After cutting off the power to the water pump, he called for rescue from the upper yard personnel.
- 2023-10-18 12:50: On-site personnel took turns to carry the casualty to the upper yard and reported to the dispatch room, and then used empty mine trucks to transport them.
- 2023-10-18 13:30: The casualty was transported out of the well and sent to Zixing First People's Hospital by ambulance 120 for rescue.
- 2023-10-18 21:30: Hospital doctors announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The insulation of the submersible pump cable was damaged and leaked, the grounding wire of the start switch fell off and the leakage protection failed. After turning on the water pump, the operator violated the regulations and moved the equipment with electricity. He held the damaged insulation of the cable and touched the leaking core wire. He was electrocuted and fell to the ground and eventually died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The insulation of the submersible pump cable was damaged and leaked electricity, and the grounding protection and leakage protection of the start switch failed; the operator illegally moved the water pump while charging and came into contact with the damaged cable core wire.
2. key contributing factors: The installation, inspection and maintenance of water pumps and switches are not in place, hidden dangers such as loose grounding wires and missing test buttons are not discovered; the safety of drainage equipment is not confirmed on site, and mechanical and electrical training and full-time electricians are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the dual prevention system and carry out risk identification and closed-loop management of hidden dangers for underground drainage and electrical equipment.
2. Strictly review and implement technical measures for power supply and drainage safety, and clarify equipment protection requirements during blasting.
3. Implement pre-operation safety confirmation and on-site monitoring of key operations such as drainage and maintenance by mine leaders, safety officers and team members.
4. Increase the intensity of anti-"three violations" and inspections of electrical equipment to prevent equipment from operating with disease.
5. Establish an installation, use, and maintenance ledger for underground electrical equipment and conduct regular inspections and maintenance. If any leakage protection, grounding, or cable damage is found to be unqualified, stop using it immediately.
6. Carry out special training on the safe operation of electrical equipment, power outage relocation, and electromechanical training, and strengthen on-site education on the prohibition of live mobile equipment.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-10-27 15:00: The mid-shift dispatch meeting assigned for the third mining team to go up the 4521 ventilation mountain for repairs, and require on-site surveillance. After the meeting, the deputy general manager of production assigned for three excavation team personnel to identify and deal with the scraper conveyor failure.
- 2023-10-27 15:30: The excavation team held a pre-shift briefing, and 7 people were originally arranged to go to the 4522 wind tunnel to dig the bottom; 3 of them were subsequently temporarily adjusted to the 4521 ventilation uphill to handle the scraper conveyor.
- After 15:50 on 2023-10-27: 3 operators went down the well one after another.
- After 16:40 on 2023-10-27: 3 people arrived at the 4521 ventilation uphill machine head, and the deputy chief engineer of coal mining has arrived at the scene; the startup inspection found that the conveyor was stuck, the transition trough and the bottom of the middle trough of the last three sections were suspended, and the on-site decision was made to remove the chain and trough plate and lift the machine head to reinstall it.
- 2023-10-27 18:00: The deputy chief engineer of coal mining arranged for the workers of the third mining team to assist in lifting the bottom, moving the tail of the machine backward and installing the groove plate, and then transferred to the repair location.
- 2023-10-27 19:00: The captain of the third mining team went to the repair site. The deputy chief engineer of coal mining explained the precautions and returned to the conveyor installation place to continue installation and cleaning.
- 2023-10-27 21:30: The conveyor has been re-layed, but it still cannot operate after starting; the fault continues to be found on site.
- 2023-10-27 22:20: It was found on site that the old and new 8th trough plate did not match and had a height difference; the problems of the machine head being uneven, the transition trough and the rear middle trough being suspended, and the support beam base not being installed were not required to be rectified.
- 2023-10-27 23:00: The deputy chief engineer of coal mining reported the installation situation to the dispatching room and returned to the site. He found that there was only one wooden pressure post directly punched on the machine head reduction box; he asked to use a chain to fix it to prevent it from sliding and then leave the column retrieval device. The problem of non-compliance with the setting of the pressure post was not corrected.
- 2023-10-27 23:05: The operator squatted on the side of the machine head and directly turned on the switch on the ground. The conveyor ran continuously for about 5 metres and then the chain got stuck. The machine head rolled over from the wooden frame, and the reduction box and motor pressed down on the operator.
- After 2023-10-27 23:05: On-site personnel used a column return device to lift the nose of the aircraft to rescue the casualty, and found that he had difficulty breathing and was unresponsive.
- 2023-10-27 23:10: The deputy chief engineer of coal mining reported the accident to the dispatch room; the dispatcher reported the duty leader and notified the underground mine leader to rush to the scene.
- 2023-10-27 23:15: The company’s rescue team went down to the well with equipment to rescue.
- 2023-10-27 23:17: The dispatcher reported the accident to the general manager, who went to the dispatch room to direct the rescue.
- 2023-10-27 23:20: The dispatcher notified the work injury management staff to arrange for ambulance vehicles and doctors to wait at the mine entrance.
- 2023-10-27 23:40: Leading the mine leaders underground to the accident site, they found that the casualty person's heartbeat and pulse were weak.
- 2023-10-28 00:02: The rescue team arrived at the accident site and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation and other rescue operations on the casualty for more than ten minutes and found that he had no vital signs.
- 2023-10-28 01:40: The casualties were transported to the ground and sent to Lengshuijiang People's Hospital by ambulance.
- 2023-10-28 02:30: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died due to traumatic pericardial rupture.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the scraper conveyor was re-laid, the bottom of the machine head, transition trough and rear trough plate was suspended in the air. The equipment was uneven and unstable, and effective pressure columns and bases were not set up as required. The operator squatted on the side of the machine head and started it directly without starting the test machine or confirming the safety distance. After the equipment chain got stuck, the machine head became unstable and rolled over from the wooden frame. The reduction gearbox and motor held it down.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The installation of the scraper conveyor was uneven and unstable, and the pressure column was not in compliance with regulations. The operator started the machine at close range without testing the machine, and the stuck chain caused the machine head to roll over and squeeze the workers.
2. key contributing factors: Failure in the installation acceptance and on-site supervision of mechanical and electrical equipment; unlicensed personnel engaged in installation and commissioning, and the team was not equipped with transportation management personnel; safety training and accident prevention measures were not implemented in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Assemble mechanical and electrical transportation management and professional technical personnel, and clarify equipment charter responsibilities.
2. The scraper conveyor must be flat, straight, stable and chain-linked, with sufficient and effective pressure columns, protection and bases installed at the head and tail.
3. Equipment installation, modification, debugging and maintenance should be carried out after passing the inspection. Before starting, the machine should be tested and evacuated from the dangerous area.
4. Unlicensed personnel are strictly prohibited from handling underground electrical and electromechanical equipment.
5. Strengthen special rectification of electromechanical transportation systems, on-site inspections and accident warning education.
6. After the scraper conveyor is installed, set up the base, pressure column and protection as required. It can be operated only after passing the acceptance inspection. When dealing with faults, shutdown, test run and safety distance requirements must be implemented.

- 2024-01-14 06:27: After the methane examiner and the squad leader relieved the pressure and removed the three single pillars of Zhongshan, the roof fell off in a large area, three log beams were crushed, and two people were buried in coal and waste rock.
- 2024-01-14 06:32: On-site personnel reported that the roof of the tunnel expansion area in the control room collapsed, the working face was blocked, and 2 people were buried. They requested that the mine leader be brought to the scene.
- After 2024-01-14 06:32: The mine manager, deputy mine manager for safety and part-time rescue team organised the rescue; the rescue team was divided into two groups to open the ventilation duct from the lower exit control roof, add points to lift the shed from the return air side to remove the floating peak and clear the lane.
- 2024-01-14 08:30: The legal representative went to the dispatch room to understand the situation and then went down the well to participate in the rescue.
- 2024-01-14 09:20: The first buried person was rescued. After cardiopulmonary resuscitation failed, he was transported out of the well at 09:53 and sent to the hospital. The doctor confirmed his death.
- 2024-01-14 11:30: The second buried person was rescued and had no vital signs.
- 2024-01-14 14:26: The second victim was transported out of the well and sent to the hospital, and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The work point for tunnel cutting and tunnel expansion is located in the stress concentration area, and the on-site reinforced support is only a single beam and three columns, and no auxiliary beams are raised. After the workers demolished the shed, there was an empty roof of about 1 meter, but they failed to replace the roof with supporting materials in time. The methane examiner and the workers removed the roof without authorization, and the roof fell off in a large area, burying two people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The empty roof of the shed during the expansion of the tunnel in the stress concentration area was not connected in time, and the workers illegally removed the non-compliant reinforced support, causing the roof to fall and bury two people.
2. key contributing factors: The support was not set up with double beams and eight columns according to the regulations; no hidden dangers were found in the team leadership and safety inspections; the operating procedures lacked measures to deal with empty roofs, and major risk management and control, guarantee inspections and training were mere formalities.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clear support measures must be formulated for safety exits and tunnel expansion sheds in stress concentration areas and maintained by dedicated personnel.
2. The replacement shed should be strictly supported first and then dismantled. If there is an empty roof, it should be replaced with qualified materials immediately. It is forbidden to risk dismantling and strengthening the support.
3. To strengthen the support, sub-beams and sufficient single pillars should be installed according to regulations, and the quality should be checked regularly.
4. Mine leaders, safety officers and security personnel should monitor the key links of key projects on-site.
5. Improve work procedure training, examinations and on-site implementation of risk management and control measures.
6. Improve the support design of the tunnel expansion shed for safety exits in stress concentration areas, strictly support before dismantling, timely roof connection and double-beam reinforcement.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-03-11 23:20: The mine leaders on duty held a pre-shift briefing, requiring each operating location to ask questions and arrange for three maintenance personnel to maintain the 2231 machine roadway.
- 2024-03-11 23:52: Lead the mine leaders and safety officers into the mine.

He decided to reinforce it with some columns first and then deal with the broken shed beam; the two people left to unload the materials.
- 2024-03-12 03:14: When the safety inspector arrived to contact Shimen, a maintenance worker squatted alone on the empty roof in the middle of the building and shook the chopped shed beam; a large amount of coal and waste rock collapsed from the roof, burying it.
- 2024-03-12 03:15: When the on-site personnel tried to drag out the buried person, there was another abnormal noise from the roof of the tunnel, and they immediately evacuated to the opening of the machine tunnel; then a large amount of loose coal collapsed again, completely burying the person.
- After 2024-03-12 03:15: After 3 people scraped coal for a short time, they stopped rescue due to continuous coal falling from above. Two people were arranged to search for roof control materials. The safety inspector went to the telephone about 12 metres away from the accident site to report to the dispatch room.
- 2024-03-12 03:18: After receiving the report, the dispatching room reported to the mine leader on duty and notified the mine leader and chief engineer.
- 2024-03-12 03:20: The safety inspector returned to the accident site to wait for rescue.
- 2024-03-12 03:30: After the roof control materials arrived, the rescue was reorganized on site, with one person controlling the roof, one person pulling coal, and one person observing and commanding.
- 2024-03-12 03:50: The mine management personnel arrived at the accident site; after clearing out two trucks of coal, the casualty man's head was exposed, and the coal and waste rock in his mouth was removed to continue to control the roof and clear the coal. Finally, he was rescued and artificially resuscitated for about 10 minutes. He had no vital signs.
- 2024-03-12 05:10: The casualties were transported out of the well, and doctors from the emergency vehicle at the mine entrance performed rescue operations and sent them to the hospital.
- 2024-03-12 05:31: The doctor confirmed that the casualty person was dead and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
Affected by mining and the old upper roadway, the 2231 machine roadway maintenance point is located in the triangular stress concentration area of the steeply inclined coal seam. The coal seam is soft, the original shed beam is broken, and the roof is in danger of falling. The operator did not follow the measures to do the stringing or lift the floating peak to control the roof. He stood alone in the empty roof area and shook the broken beam. The loose roof collapsed twice and buried it under the coal and waste rock.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the maintenance point is in danger of falling. The operators handled the broken beams alone in the empty roof area without first controlling the roof. The roof was loose and coal and waste rock collapsed, burying it.
2. key contributing factors: The maintenance team leader did not follow the instructions to control the roof first and then repair according to the measures; there was no mine leader, safety inspector and methane examiner to follow on site; risk identification, warranty management, training and emergency drills were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Before repairing a broken shed beam, the roof must be controlled by string brazing, floating tips or other effective measures. Empty roof operations are strictly prohibited.
2. Equip mine leaders, safety officers, methane examiners, squad leaders and operating personnel according to measures to implement on-site follow-up.
3. Carry out special risk identification for steeply inclined coal seams, triangular stress concentration areas and upper old roadway affected areas.
4. The maintenance site should be equipped with sufficient roof control and rescue materials. In case of danger, the roof should be controlled first and then rescue can be organised.
5. Improve the authenticity and operability of roof accident emergency drills.
6. Revise the roadway maintenance measures. Before maintenance, check, control the roof and reinforce the support. If there are signs of roof collapse, evacuate immediately.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-04-05 15:20: The mine manager presided over the shift meeting and required the fourth excavation team to go up the mountain on the ±0-meter track to clean up debris and go up the mountain to replace the bracket at 21510. It was made clear that excavation operations were not allowed.
- 2024-04-05 15:40: The squad leader of the fourth excavation team held a pre-shift briefing, arranged for 2 people to clean the ±0-meter track and go up the mountain, and arranged for 4 people to go up the mountain to replace the bracket at 21510.
- 2024-04-05 16:30: The mine director and 4 workers arrived at 21510 at the same time and headed up the mountain. After inspection, they asked to replace the bracket and continue to clean up the floating coal, and then left to guard the 21512 coal face.
- 2024-04-05 17:00: The methane examiner went to 21510 and went up the mountain to check. The gas concentration was 0.24%, and the on-site personnel were transporting the bracket.
- 2024-04-05 19:10: The methane examiner went to 21510 Qianyan to check up the mountain again. The gas concentration was 0.24%, and 4 people on site were digging coal at the heading.
- 2024-04-05 20:20: A coal and gas outburst occurred in the uphill development heading of 21510.
- 2024-04-05 20:27: The dispatch room found through the safety monitoring system that the T2 methane sensor in the 21512 coal face had an over-limit alarm, with a maximum value of 1.89%.
- 2024-04-05 20:33: The methane sensor in the main return air lane of the 21 mining area alarmed over the limit, with a maximum value of 2.56%; the dispatcher reported to the mine leader on duty and notified the 21512 working face to evacuate people and search for a methane examiner to find out the cause.
- 2024-04-05 20:40: The mine leader on duty reported to the dispatch room of Jinzhushan Mining Company that the gas in mining area 21 exceeded the limit.
- 2024-04-05 20:48: The methane examiner went to the T2 sensor of the 21512 return air lane and measured the gas concentration at 3.6%, but did not go further.
- 2024-04-05 20:50: The mine leader on duty notified the mine rescue team leader to go down to the mine for reconnaissance.
- 2024-04-05 21:24: The company's dispatching room reported the gas exceeding the limit to the company's general manager.
- 2024-04-05 21:45: The methane examiner reported that the gas concentration in the upper mountain of 21510 is 3%, confirming that a gas accident occurred in the development heading.
- 2024-04-05 21:51: After learning the accident information, the general manager of the company notified the company's rescue squadron to dispatch rescue.
- 2024-04-05 21:58: Rescuers went to machine roadway 21510 and measured the highest gas concentration of 11% in the upper mountain. One victim was found at about 70 metres and 80 metres respectively; due to high gas, scattered pillars and narrow lane, they evacuated to machine roadway.
- 2024-04-05 22:52: The general manager of the company reported the accident to the Lengshuijiang Emergency Management Bureau, reporting that 2 people were killed and 2 people were missing.
- 2024-04-05 23:30: The company's rescue squadron arrived at the accident site. After removing the gas, they continued to investigate and rescue, and found two other victims about 85 metres up the mountain.
- 2024-04-06 00:05: The rescue squadron reported the survey and rescue situation to the coal mine dispatch room.
- 2024-04-06 04:00: 4 victims ascended to the well and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
21510 cuts uphill and tunnels uphill along the edge of the fault in the coal seam 5 with coal seam outburst. Coal and gas outbursts occur due to the superposition of concentrated stress of the coal pillar at the boundary of the goaf area of the overlying coal seam 3, fault tectonic stress and self-gravity stress. The working face did not implement the prediction and excavation permitting system. Even though there were signs of outburst and the face was required to stop, workers were still arranged to dig coal at the heading. Four people were killed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal and gas outburst occurred due to the superposition of concentrated stress, fault structure stress and self-weight stress on the working face of the outburst coal seam. The mine illegally organised personnel to continue working after the outburst warning.
2. key contributing factors: Outbreak prevention design and operation procedures were not effectively approved, forecasting, regional verification and excavation permission systems were not implemented; the working face was not reported, sensor data was not uploaded, and gas prevention and control, technical management, hidden danger investigation and internal supervision failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Excavation of outburst coal seams must strictly implement forecasting, regional verification, effect inspection and excavation permitting systems.
2. When there are signs of outbursts such as coal cannons, stuck drills, and blowholes, immediately stop work and evacuate personnel, re-take outburst prevention measures, and conduct operations only after passing the inspection.
3. All working locations should be reported, marked and safety monitoring data should be connected to the system in accordance with regulations.
4. Strictly review and approve the special design and operating procedures for outburst prevention, and prohibit unauthorized construction without obtaining the commencement procedures.
5. Promote intelligent transformation of monitoring, personnel positioning and video of important workplaces.
6. Stop operations on outburst coal seams that do not meet safety conditions, strictly review and approve outburst prevention designs and operating procedures, and implement regional and local comprehensive outburst prevention measures and excavation permitting systems.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-05-04 15:10: The deputy mine manager for safety organised a 4 o'clock pre-shift briefing to arrange the shift tasks and make safety instructions.
- 2024-05-04 15:40: The operators began to go down the mine. The deputy mine director of safety and the methane examiner went down from the auxiliary shaft on an overhead manned vehicle.
- 2024-05-04 15:50: The deputy mine director of safety and the methane examiner went to the -150 meter level to inspect the power distribution room, water pump room and other locations.
- 2024-05-04 15:55: The methane examiner went to the 1253 return air Shimen intersection, opened the fence and entered for inspection. He found that about 1 meter long roof was sprayed with water 17 to 19 metres back. After no other abnormalities were found, he moved to other locations and reported to the dispatch room.
- After 16:00 on 2024-05-04: Another methane examiner inspected in the +25-meter operating area, and the deputy mine director of safety went to other operating locations to inspect.
- 2024-05-04 21:04: The deputy mine director of safety went to the 1252 machine roadway to inspect and stayed for more than an hour.
- 2024-05-04 22:10: The deputy mine director of safety and the methane examiner met at the intersection of the +50-meter return air tunnel; the deputy mine manager of safety decided to go to the 1253 return air stone gate alone to check.
- 2024-05-04 22:15: The deputy mine manager for safety called Shimen from 1253 to report that the stone gate had collapsed and water was about to come. The call was interrupted after about 57 seconds, and a rumble came from the phone.
- 2024-05-04 22:16: The water accumulated in the originally closed old kiln penetrated the anti-water-isolating coal and rock pillars, and water leakage occurred in the 1253 return air stone door.
- After 2024-05-04 22:16: The dispatcher notified all personnel underground through the broadcast and communication system to evacuate along the flood evacuation route, and notified the mine leaders, relevant departments and rescue team members to gather in the dispatch room.
- 2024-05-04 22:20: Most communications and video signals underground are interrupted.
- 2024-05-04 22:23: Mine leaders arrived at the dispatch room one after another, activated the emergency plan, established a rescue headquarters, and arranged well entrance and exit registration and martial law.
- 2024-05-04 22:35: The chief engineer, deputy mine director of production and auxiliary rescue personnel went down to the mine for rescue.
- 2024-05-04 23:00: Mine personnel reported the accident to the Xinhua County Emergency Management Bureau and requested rescue.
- 2024-05-05 00:34: Through self-rescue and mutual rescue, 31 underground personnel were safely lifted out of the well.
- 2024-05-05 02:00: Xinhua County launched the Level IV emergency response plan for coal mine disasters, established a rescue headquarters and formulated a rescue plan.
- After 2024-05-05 02:00: The professional mine rescue team continues to carry out underground mud cleaning, drainage and search and rescue.
- 2024-05-20 06:50: Rescuers found the missing team leader in the -150-meter South Alley, about 9 metres up the mountain from the return air of mining area 12. He had no vital signs.
- 2024-05-20 11:18: The bodies of the victims were transported out of the mine entrance, and the search and rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The original Xinghua Coal Mine cross-border tunnel formed a large amount of old empty water accumulation, adjacent to the 1253 return air stone gate. The design and construction of the mine's water exploration and release could not effectively detect the water body, and the geophysical low-resistance anomaly area was not drilled and verified; the water-isolating coal and rock pillars between the Shimen and the old kiln were eroded by blasting, ground pressure, and confined water to form through-going cracks, which were eventually penetrated by high-pressure water. The team leader lost contact and died when water penetrated while checking for danger at Shimen.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The water accumulated in the cross-border tunnel of the closed old kiln penetrated the anti-waterproof coal and rock pillars whose strength was reduced due to erosion by blasting, ground pressure and confined water, causing water penetration and death of the shift leader.
2. key contributing factors: Laokong water accumulation investigation, geophysical drilling verification and water exploration and drainage design and construction were not in place; all operations threatened by water damage were not stopped after abnormal water discharge; water prevention and control institutions, basic data and census of hidden disaster factors were weak.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Re-examine the mining and water accumulation conditions of the old kiln within 200 metres around the mine and plot them on the drawing ledger.
2. The low-resistance anomaly area discovered by geophysical exploration must be verified by drilling, and the water exploration and discharge design should cover the horizontal and vertical directions in front of the tunnel.
3. When the water source, empty space or water-proof coal pillars are unclear, construction in areas threatened by water damage is strictly prohibited.
4. Establish an underground water dynamic observation system and a water outlet observation ledger to promptly analyse and deal with water leakage anomalies.
5. When signs of water penetration or danger of water intrusion occur, the threatened personnel must be evacuated immediately, and work shall not resume until the threat is eliminated.
6. Re-investigate the surrounding old kilns and water accumulation areas, manage them according to higher hydrogeological types, and improve the water exploration and drainage design that combines water-proof coal pillars with geophysical prospecting and drilling.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-08-08 07:20: The underground shift leader organised a pre-shift briefing to arrange the maintenance shift tasks and safety precautions; 3 of them were assigned to the 22142 return air lane for maintenance.
- 2024-08-08 08:03: The morning shift underground shift leader and safety inspector entered the mine.
- 2024-08-08 11:00: The morning shift underground shift leader and safety inspector arrived at the 22142 return air tunnel maintenance operation point for inspection. They found coal and waste rock falling at the head and left without taking effective preventive measures.
- 2024-08-08 11:57: Five people from the maintenance team went down the well together; on the way, the team leader agreed to transfer one of the original return air lane maintenance personnel to the transportation lane, without reporting it to the leader or the dispatch room. Only two people were actually working on the return air lane maintenance.
- 2024-08-08 13:00: Two maintenance personnel arrived at the 22142 return air lane and found that coal and waste rock was falling from the top. They installed support tubes and closed brackets near Shed No. 1 and cleaned up two trucks of coal and waste rock; only two anchor points were partially installed, and the required comprehensive roof control was not completed.
- 2024-08-08 16:10: After one maintenance staff left with the cart, another maintenance staff continued to clean up the coal and waste rock under the No. 0 support; the coal and waste rock suddenly fell from the top of the No. 0 support, burying it, and only the head was exposed.
- 2024-08-08 16:15: The maintenance personnel on the way back heard the call for help and rushed to the scene. They tried to rescue but failed, and then ran to the -150-meter parking lot to call the dispatching room.
- 2024-08-08 16:20: After receiving the report, the dispatcher reported to the mine leader and mine manager on duty; the mine manager commanded to start the emergency broadcast, dispatch rescue personnel and lead the team down the mine, and the mine leader on duty stayed in the dispatch room to command and summon the ambulance.
- 2024-08-08 16:25: On-site rescuers arrived at the accident site. They first built the anchor point control roof and then excavated coal and waste rock to carry out rescue.
- 2024-08-08 16:55: The mine manager and other personnel arrived at the scene and continued to organise the setting of anchor tips and cleaning up coal and waste rock.
- 2024-08-08 17:20: Rescuers rescued the trapped person after adding 6 anchor points and cleaning up the coal and waste rock. He was still breathing at the time.
- 2024-08-08 18:10: The casualty was transported out of the well. Medical staff at the mine entrance confirmed his death after first aid and preliminary diagnosis. The on-site rescue was completed.
- 2024-08-09 03:34: Company personnel reported the accident to the People's Government of Huangfengqiao Town, which was then reported step by step; the report determined that the accident was reported late.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the maintenance personnel on duty were dealing with the coal and waste rock falling above No. 1 Shed in the 22142 return air lane, they only added local support and two anchor points, and failed to control all the broken roofs according to measures; after one maintenance personnel left the cart, another operator was still cleaning the coal and waste rock under the No. 0 support. coal and waste rock fell from the top of the empty roof area again, burying him on the left side of the tunnel. He was confirmed dead after being rescued.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the long-term disrepair of the tunnel partially collapsed and formed an empty roof, the operators continued repairs in the dangerous area without fully controlling the roof first, and the roof collapsed again, burying the workers.
2. key contributing factors: The maintenance site was not equipped with safety officers and observers as required, and the number of workers was reduced without approval; special training on hidden danger handling, shift inspections, warranty responsibilities, and roof maintenance were not implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out special inspections on roof management and strengthen broken roof support and on-site management in strict accordance with regulations.
2. Improve the well entry and exit identification, video surveillance and communication systems to enhance real-time monitoring and early warning capabilities.
3. Strictly implement accident reporting regulations and report accidents promptly, accurately and completely after discovery.
4. Improve the job responsibility system for all employees and the roof maintenance system, standardize labor organisation, and implement on-site supervision for shift leaders, safety officers and operators.
5. Carry out special safety education and assessment for roof maintenance to enable operators to understand risk identification, roof control requirements and compliance operation requirements.
6. Focus on support design, on-site roof management, team building and regular inspections to prevent roof falling accidents.

- 2024-08-24 01:10: Two operators started drilling downwards from the 114th rig to arrange blast holes. One person operated the drill rig in the middle channel of the powered support, and the other person stood on the scraper machine slot plate and supported the positioning of the drill pipe against the coal wall.
- 2024-08-24 01:35: Two people were preparing to drill the 12th drill hole in front of the 109th aircraft. After discovering that there was an empty roof and umbrella rock in front of the support, they still thought they had knocked the roof and drilled directly under the umbrella rock.

- After 2024-08-24 01:37: The companion stopped drilling and went to the 106th aircraft to call for help through the working face broadcast; the team leader, squad leader and safety inspector arrived and carried the casualty to the pedestrian passage of the 110th aircraft. the casualty was unconscious but still breathing.
- 2024-08-24 01:40: The safety inspector reported the accident to the dispatch room by phone at the upper exit; the dispatcher reported the ground duty leader and notified the rescue team, and the duty leader reported the mine director and summoned an ambulance.
- 2024-08-24 01:45: The mine manager went to the dispatch room to direct the rescue.
- 2024-08-24 01:50: The deputy mine director of safety and the company’s rescue team members went down to the mine with equipment.
- 2024-08-24 02:34: Rescuers arrived at the accident site and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation and other rescue operations, and found that the casualty had no obvious vital signs.
- 2024-08-24 02:36: The rescue captain reported the condition of the casualty to the mine dispatch room; the mine director immediately reported to the emergency command center of Lengshuijiang Emergency Management Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The hard roof of the working face was partially detached after loosening and blasting. There is about 500 mm of empty roof between the front of the 109 support and the coal wall and there is umbrella rock. The operator failed to cooperate with two people to sound the roof and ribs, remove the loose umbrella rock, or provide temporary support as required, that is, he held the drill rod under the umbrella rock to drill the 12th hole. When the drilling was about 0.1 metres away, the umbrella rock suddenly fell and hit his head.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The separated layer of umbrella rock after loosening and blasting is in danger of falling. The operator drilled under the empty roof umbrella rock without sound the roof and ribs in accordance with regulations, removing dangerous rocks or providing support, and the umbrella rock fell and hit his head.
2. key contributing factors: The empty roof in front of the 109th aircraft was not supported; on-site safety confirmation, guard duty and warranty responsibilities were not in place; hidden dangers on the roof repeatedly occurred but were not cured; and safety inspectors and special training were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. After blasting, areas where the roof is broken or separated from the layer must first be cleared of loose rocks and dangerous rocks, and measures to control and protect the roof must be taken.
2. Strictly carry out knocking and asking questions, with one person operating and one person supervising, and it must be carried out in a safe location with complete support.
3. Incorporate repeated hidden dangers such as empty roofs, umbrella rocks and insufficient supports into key rectifications and close the loop for cancellation.
4. Implement the on-site supervision of mine leaders, guarantees and safety officers, and have dedicated personnel to monitor key operations.
5. Equipped with full-time safety inspection personnel, safety officers and gas inspectors shall not serve as concurrently with each other.
6. Deal with empty roofs, umbrella rocks and separated roofs in a timely manner, and implement effective temporary support before drilling, blasting and other operations.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-06-17 15:30: The deputy captain of Team 206 organised a pre-class meeting, with 11 people participating.
- 2025-06-17 16:02: The operators went down the well and were divided into upper and lower groups after arriving at the 2139 coal face; one operator was responsible for starting the second scraper conveyor.
- 2025-06-17 23:00: The upper section of the working face is mined to the tail of the second scraper conveyor, and partial support and coal discharging operations were completed; the lower section continues to operate in the middle of the first conveyor.
- 2025-06-17 23:08: The second scraper conveyor has serious coal and waste rock accumulation, the lower trough is blocked, the equipment is stalled, and the load pin is sheared.
- 2025-06-17 23:10: The operator of the second scraper conveyor dealt with the load pin failure. Due to the narrow machine head, he removed the machine head pressure column and entered the machine head side to replace the load pin without shutting down the machine. When the load pin was installed while the equipment was running, the machine head instantly tilted up and hit his forehead.
- 2025-06-17 23:13: The deputy captain went to the nose of the aircraft and found the casualty lying on the edge of the reducer, with no response to calls. He immediately organised nearby personnel to assist and went to the aircraft alley to call the dispatch room and request the rescue team to go underground.
- After 2025-06-17 23:13: On-site personnel found that the casualty person’s left foot was pressed by the connection between the motor and the reducer. They used the hand-cranked column returner on the top of the machine head to lift the equipment, rescued him and transferred him to the lower safety exit to wait for rescue.
- 2025-06-17 23:17: The mine dispatcher reported the accident to the mine manager and shift leader.
- 2025-06-17 23:26: The mine manager reported the accident to Jinzhushan Company.
- 2025-06-17 23:32: The leader on duty and four rescue team members went down to the well to rescue.
- 2025-06-17 23:52: Company personnel reported the accident to the Loudi Emergency Management Bureau and the Supervision and Law Enforcement Division of the Hunan Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2025-06-18 00:10: Rescuers arrived at the scene of the accident and reported to the dispatch room after unsuccessful rescue efforts; then the casualties were carried to the 21-220 parking lot and transported to the ground by mining trucks.
- 2025-06-18 01:05: The coal mine ambulance delivered the casualty to Lengshuijiang People's Hospital. The doctor confirmed his death and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
Due to the accumulation of coal and waste rock, the lower trough of the second scraper conveyor was blocked and the load pin was sheared. In order to deal with the fault, the operator removed the pressure column of the machine head, and entered the machine head side to replace the load pin without cutting off the power, stopping the machine, and clearing the coal and waste rock in the lower trough. When the conveyor was running, the load pin was installed, the chain tension increased suddenly, and the machine head, which had lost the restraint of the pressure column, instantly tilted up and hit his forehead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally removed the head pressure column of the scraper conveyor, stopped the machine without cutting off the power to deal with the broken pin, and replaced the load pin while the equipment was running, causing the machine head to tilt up and hit the head.
2. key contributing factors: The installation, use and maintenance of conveyors do not comply with regulations for a long time, and hidden dangers are poorly investigated and rectified; risks in mechanical and electrical transportation are not effectively controlled, and special training and accident warning education are just a formality.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The scraper conveyor is equipped with pressure columns, overlaps and safety protection in strict accordance with regulations. If it is found that it does not meet the requirements, it will be immediately deactivated and rectified.
2. To deal with conveyor faults, the power must be cut off, locked, tagged, and coal residue must be removed. Operations while the equipment is running are prohibited.
3. Implement pre-shift and on-site safety confirmation, daily cycle inspection of equipment and warranty inspection system.
4. Recruit professional management and technical personnel for mechanical and electrical transportation to carry out special rectification of the mechanical and electrical transportation system.
5. Carry out targeted warning education using the mine and similar accidents as cases.
6. Install, use and maintain the scraper conveyor in accordance with regulations, set up firm pressure columns and implement the maintenance system after power outage, tag-out and power inspection.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-09-21 18:40: Mid-shift operators and gas inspectors go underground.
- 2025-09-21 19:30: The two people arrived at the +300-meter dark main shaft extension working face, connected the air duct, cleaned up track debris, and notified the squad leader and workers to go underground and remove waste.
- 2025-09-21 19:53: The squad leader and the workers went down the mine.
- 2025-09-21 20:20: The squad leader arrived at the working face and started the waste rake machine to load waste. The workers were responsible for hooking, signaling and pushing the cart.
- 2025-09-21 21:00: The blaster on duty went down the mine with the detonator.
- 2025-09-21 21:34: The blasters arrived at the working face to assist in the removal of waste rock.
- 2025-09-22 00:30: The zero-hour safety inspector went to the working face to inspect and explain safety matters before leaving.
- 2025-09-22 01:00: The operators began to drill holes; the squad leader returned the waste rake to a position about 60 metres away from the working face and fixed it, and left the shift early at 03:07.
- 2025-09-22 06:30: The safety inspector inspected again. He left after the blasthole construction was almost completed and did not monitor the blasting on site.
- 2025-09-22 06:40: A total of 60 blastholes were drilled in the at the heading and left side avoidance tunnels, with a depth of about 1.8 metres; the blasters began to charge and assisted the workers in connecting the detonator legs and the blast bus.
- 2025-09-22 07:20: After the charging was completed, the four people agreed that the blasters would wait at Sanchakou. After the remaining three people drained the water and cleaned up the facilities, they used the miner's lamp to shake up and down as a signal to detonate.
- 2025-09-22 07:30: The drainage was completed, and the three people began to evacuate upwards along the tunnel; the miner's lamp of the person in the front was blocked by the air duct, and the miner's lamp of the two people in the rear was blocked by the rake.
- 2025-09-22 07:36: The blasters misjudged that the only signal from the miner's lamp they saw was that everyone should evacuate, and used an electronic detonator to detonate without counting the number of people; the shock wave knocked down three people who were still near the waste rake.
- After 2025-09-22 07:36: The slightly injured person called for help and waited in the shelter; another person called the blaster to go down to the mine for rescue, and found that the seriously injured person was still breathing and heartbeating.
- 2025-09-22 07:48: On-site personnel reported the accident to the dispatch room via phone; the dispatch room notified the mine leaders and requested help from the health department and 120 emergency center.
- 2025-09-22 08:20: The person in charge of excavation and the deputy mine director of safety arrived at the accident scene.
- 2025-09-22 08:25: Other management personnel arrived one after another and used iron frames to make simple stretchers to transport seriously injured people.
- 2025-09-22 09:30: The two injured were transported out of the well via the main tunnel in a mining truck. After preliminary examination by the mine entrance doctor, they were sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2025-09-22 10:30: The seriously injured person was transferred to Xinhua County People's Hospital for surgery, and then transferred to a provincial hospital for continued treatment.
- 2025-09-24 12:27: The mine manager reported the accident to the Xinhua County Emergency Command Center by phone and reported it in writing at 13:01, which constituted a late report.
- 2025-09-30 07:18: The seriously injured person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The operators increased the depth of the blastholes and the amount of charge without authorization. The squad leader left work early and failed to perform three-person chain blasting, evacuation warning, and head count. After seeing the miner's lamp signal at the detonation point, the blasters mistakenly believed that the workers had evacuated to a safe area. In fact, three people were still in the tunnel near the waste rake, and then the blast detonated; the explosion shock wave knocked down three people, and one of them died after being seriously injured.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The blasters failed to count the number of people, misjudged the evacuation signal, and detonated before the workers had evacuated to a safe area. The explosion shock wave caused injuries and deaths.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to implement one shot, three inspections and three-person chain blasting; unauthorized increase in blasthole depth, charge amount, and change of detonation alert; team management, on-site surveillance, technical measures, and blasting training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the system of one shot, three inspections, three-person chain blasting, and squad leader head count.
2. The location and scope of evacuation, warning, and detonation should comply with regulations, and unauthorized verbal changes are prohibited.
3. The charge amount and blast hole depth must be carried out in accordance with the blasting instructions. Excessive amount and depth are strictly prohibited.
4. Blasting operations should be operated by certified personnel, and safety officers and mine leaders should monitor key links on site.
5. After an accident occurs, it should be reported immediately according to regulations, and late reporting is strictly prohibited.
6. Strictly implement the system for obtaining blasting materials, approval of explosive charge, evacuation warning, video inventory and request for instructions for detonation. No detonation will occur until all personnel have evacuated.
