【Accident Mechanism】
The deputy captain ordered the use of a tunnel boring machine to sweep coal in violation of regulations. The cutting head of the tunnel boring machine strangled the air duct of the pneumatic pick that was buried in cinders. When the operator was dragging the air duct within the operating range, he slipped and fell into the lower right part of the cutting head, and was strangled to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The deputy captain of the shift ordered the use of a tunnel boring machine to sweep coal in violation of regulations; the operator dragged the air duct within the operating range of the cutting head, slipped and was caught in the cutting head and suffered fatal injuries.
2. key contributing factors: No on-site safety confirmation was carried out, the operators did not have the corresponding qualifications; the tunnel boring machine was used instead of manual coal scraping without authorization, the operators did not evacuate the dangerous area, and the on-site safety officers did not follow up.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the system for tunnel boring machine operation, power outage and personnel evacuation.
2. Correct violations such as replacing prescribed manual processes with machinery.
3. Strengthen on-site safety confirmation and safety inspector supervision.

- 2023-09-03 15:26: Two exploration and drainage workers arrived at the entrance of 2136 wind inlet lane.
- 2023-09-03 15:56: Two people arrived near the tunnel drilling site; after being informed that the mechanized excavator was running and not allowed to enter, they continued to work forward.
- 2023-09-03 16:25: After transporting the drill pipe, the two people began to connect and hang the pressure air ducts from both sides of the mechanized excavator.
- 2023-09-03 16:27: An operator climbed onto the platform of a running mechanized excavator to hang the air duct; the excavator driver did not shut down the machine in an emergency after his dissuasion failed.
- 2023-09-03 16:29: Another exploration and drainage worker was crushed by a running mechanized excavator and fell to the ground.
- 2023-09-03 16:39: On-site personnel reported the injury to the deputy leader of the drilling team.
- 2023-09-03 17:10: The drilling team and the excavation team made simple stretchers and organised the transportation.
- 2023-09-03 17:49: After the casualty was found not breathing, he reported to the mine dispatching room on site; the mine started an emergency plan and reported it step by step.
- 2023-09-03 19:47: The casualty was transported to the ambulance for rescue, and the medical staff initially diagnosed him as dead before diagnosis.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the operation of the mechanized excavator, the exploration and drainage hydraulic workers enter its working range to connect and hang the pressure air pipe. After the on-site dissuasion failed, the equipment did not stop and lock in an emergency, and the operator was squeezed and injured by the running mechanized excavator.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: An exploration and drainage worker illegally entered the working area of a running mechanized excavator to connect to the air duct, and was crushed by the equipment and died.
2. key contributing factors: On-site vigilance and equipment shutdown and lockout are not strictly implemented; cross-operations are not coordinated in advance; operators have insufficient risk identification and training; video anti-violation and on-site management are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly set up warnings around the operating equipment, and the machine must be shut down and locked before entering the dangerous area.
2. Establish a multi-team cross-operation reporting, coordination and on-site monitoring system.
3. Strengthen on-site anti-violation, video inspections and inspection of equipment operating procedures.
4. Strengthen job risk identification, mutual protection and emergency reporting training.
5. Stop relevant operations, activate emergency plans, organise rescue, stop production, evacuate personnel, and report accidents.
6. Carry out training on restricted areas for mechanized excavator operations, cross-operation coordination and emergency shutdown and lockout.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-06-12 23:10: The installation company's transportation team held a pre-night shift meeting to arrange transportation and withdrawal work.
- 2024-06-12 23:30: The installation company leaders and operators took command vehicles No. 6 and No. 9 to enter the mine respectively.

- 2024-06-12 23:50: The No. 9 command vehicle arrived at the bypass, some personnel entered the retreat working face, and the forklift driver checked the No. 1 forklift.
- 2024-06-12 23:55: The forklift driver drove the No. 6 command vehicle to the centralized control console of 39204 Auxiliary Transport Lane, stopped the vehicle and turned off the engine.
- 2024-06-13 00:04: Command Vehicle No. 6 rolled away in the inclined roadway, and the left front wheel fell into the drainage ditch before stopping; the driver was squeezed between the deformed door and the B-pillar of the vehicle.
- 2024-06-13 00:10: No. 9 directed vehicle-borne rescue personnel to enter the mine.
- 2024-06-13 00:11: The security inspector reported the accident to the mine dispatching room, which activated the emergency plan, dialed 120, and arranged for an ambulance to wait at the auxiliary mine entrance.
- 2024-06-13 00:15: The No. 1 shovel truck moved the rear of the No. 6 command vehicle about 50 centimeters, and the on-site personnel lifted the casualty onto the No. 9 command vehicle and lifted it underground.
- 2024-06-13 00:34: The casualty was hoisted and transferred to a waiting ambulance.
- 2024-06-13 00:56: The casualties were sent to Pinglu District People’s Hospital for rescue.
- 2024-06-13 01:38: The wounded person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-06-13 02:03: Pingshuo Company reported the accident to the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver of the forklift truck illegally drove the command vehicle, parked the vehicle in a 12-degree incline roadway and then turned off the engine without applying the parking brake. When he got off the vehicle, the vehicle rolled and hit the side of the alley, causing him to be crushed to death by the door.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver illegally drove the command vehicle and failed to apply the parking brake after parking in the sloping roadway. The vehicle rolled away when he got off, and the door squeezed him to death.
2. key contributing factors: The installation company’s vehicle management is chaotic, outsourced transportation vehicles are not connected to the mine vehicle location monitoring system; on-site surveillance is insufficient, violations are not discovered and stopped in a timely manner, and job responsibility systems and safety training are incomplete.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Driving a vehicle without a license or without a driver is strictly prohibited.
2. Parking brakes and vehicle blocking measures must be adopted when parking on a sloping roadway.
3. Incorporate outsourced transportation vehicles into mine vehicle location monitoring and unified management.
4. Strengthen on-site surveillance, job responsibilities and transportation safety training.
5. Strictly limit vehicle driving qualifications and parking requirements in inclined lanes, implement parking brakes, car arresters and door lock protection; connect outsourced vehicles to the location monitoring system.
6. Strengthen the safety training on trackless rubber-tyred vehicle driving, parking prevention, disembarkation and retraction tunnel transportation safety training.

- 2024-07-06 14:30: Du Wenmin held a pre-shift briefing. - 2024-07-06 19:00: Excavation started. Li Moumou was responsible for operating the comprehensive excavator. After digging about 1.8m, Zhang Moumou arranged for workers to provide permanent support. After the permanent support was completed, the next cycle of excavation is ready. At this time, the tail of the belt conveyor fails.
- 2024-07-06 22:30: After troubleshooting, the second cycle of excavation operations was started. The excavation was about 0.6m. When the cutting head was cut to the front of the right side, Zhang Wen was observing the tunnel formation on the mechanized excavator. Li Wen was operating the remote control on the mechanized excavator to cut. Support workers Song and Gao Guijun were respectively watching the tail of the belt conveyor and cleaning the coal on the left side and right side of the tunnel about 20m from the rear of the mechanized excavator.
- 2024-07-06 23:38: Zhang Wenlong suddenly heard a "bang" and was immediately overturned by air waves and coal. He fell from the mechanized excavator to the left floor of the tunnel. He got up and shouted to run and began to escape. The self-rescuer was thrown off during the escape. Zhang Wen went to the No. 2 contact lane of 1207 Gas Control Lane and reported the water leakage of the working face to the duty room of the second mechanized excavation team (7898) and the mine dispatching command center (7777) using the phone number at the belt machine head (7693).
- 2024-07-06 23:45: The dispatch command center of Qingxu Branch received a call from Zhang Wenlong from underground, reporting a water leakage accident at the excavation face of 1207 Gas Control Lane
- 2024-07-06 23:48: Dispatcher Li Zhiming notified people to evacuate underground and reported to mine director Dong Moumou, but the call was not connected. He then reported to Hao Moumou, deputy mine director of production, Lei Moumou, director of dispatch command center, Sun Moumou, deputy mine director of ventilation, and Liu Moumou, deputy mine director of safety. Some mine leaders Lu Moumou went to the dispatch command center.
- 2024-07-07 01:00: Lei Moumou arranged for the Minister of Mechanical and Electrical Department Guo Moumou and the hydropower team and electromechanical transportation team to load water pumps and other materials from the ground emergency material reserve underground, and arranged for the development team to load emergency materials from the underground firefighting material warehouse. At the same time, Deputy Mine Manager Hao Caijun and Deputy Chief Engineer of Water Prevention and Control Wang Rangrang went down the well. When they arrived at the 1207 gas control lane, they found that the water level had reached the first low-lying point (about 1400m), about 1m away from the roof. They immediately arranged to use a water pump (flow rate 30m³/h) for drainage. During the drainage process, the water level rose, the water pump was gradually submerged, and the drainage work was forced to stop.
- 2024-07-07 01:50: Liu Junwang, the deputy mine manager for safety of Qingxu Branch, got through to the mine manager Dong Hongcheng and reported that a water leakage accident occurred at the development heading of the 1207 gas control lane and 3 people were trapped.
- 2024-07-07 01:50: Liu Junwang got through to Dong Hongcheng, the mine manager, and reported the accident.
- 2024-07-07 02:00: Arrange personnel to carry a nearby water pump (flow rate 30m³/h) to the second low-lying area (about 920m) of 1207 Gas Control Lane for drainage, and then someone was flooded
- 2024-07-07 02:50: Shi Moumou and Dong Moumou activated the accident emergency plan after arriving at the mine, established a temporary emergency rescue headquarters with the mine director as the general commander, organised and arranged for the electromechanical department to launch the water pump, and arranged for the safety department minister Liu Wei to report the accident to the regulatory authorities. After Zhao Moumou, chairman of Lijialou Coal Industry (the client), arrived at the mine, the ground was handed over to Zhao Moumou for command, and Dong Hongcheng organised the rescue.
- 2024-07-07 03:29: Qingxu Branch reported the accident to the Qingxu County Emergency Management Bureau Dispatch Command Center
- 2024-07-07 03:57: Qingxu Branch reported the accident to the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau over the phone. After the accident, Qingxu Branch failed to report to the production safety supervision and management department of the people's government at or above the county level and the relevant departments responsible for mine safety supervision and management within one hour after the accident in accordance with the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Regulations on Reporting, Investigation and Handling of Production Safety Accidents, which constituted a late report.
- 2024-07-07 04:00: Li Moumou, general manager of Lekuang Mining West Company, went to the mine to participate in accident rescue,19 reported the accident to Cai Moumou, general manager of Lekuang Mining Group, and Cai Moumou, chairman of the board of directors.
- 2024-07-07 04:13: Xiang Moumou, the leader of the Qingxu County People’s Government and relevant departments, arrived at the mine
- 2024-07-07 04:30: An emergency rescue headquarters headed by the county magistrate was established. It consists of a comprehensive coordination group, an emergency rescue group, a security guard, a medical rescue group, a logistics support group, a aftermath working group, a news announcement, and a technical expert group to organise accident rescue. Dongmei Group's temporary rescue headquarters was incorporated into the Qingxu County rescue headquarters- 2024-07-07 04:55: Xiang XX, leader of the Taiyuan Municipal People’s Government and relevant departments, arrived at the mine
- 2024-07-07 05:20: An on-site rescue headquarters with Executive Deputy Mayor Yang Moumou as the commander was established. It consists of a comprehensive coordination group, an emergency rescue group, a technical guidance group, a medical rescue group, a publicity and reporting group, a social stability group, a aftermath working group, an emergency support group, and an expert guidance group to organise accident rescue. The rescue headquarters successively mobilized a total of 6 rescue teams, including the National Mine Emergency Rescue Fenxi Team, Huayang New Materials Mine Rescue Team, National Mine Emergency Rescue Shanxi Special Exploration Team, Taiyuan City Mine Rescue Team, Taiyuan City Comprehensive Rescue Team, and Xishan Coal and Electricity Mine Rescue Team, with more than 230 people involved in the rescue. It lasted 186 hours and worked hard to rescue someone.
- 2024-20-14 18:15: Three trapped people were searched and rescued in 1207 Gas Control Lane. The rescuers confirmed on site that all of them had no vital signs.
- 2024-20-14 23:55: The victims were transported out of the well, and the rescue work ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The mine did not identify the water accumulation situation in the old empty tunnels in the working face and adjacent areas, and did not strictly implement the exploration first and then excavation. High-pressure water in Laokong broke into the development heading, causing three workers to be trapped and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Failure to identify the water in the old void and excessive excavation in violation of regulations, causing the water in the old void to burst into the working face.
2. key contributing factors: Invalid technical management of water prevention and control, geophysical drilling and on-site supervision, and insufficient emergency response in the early stages of the accident.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the system of exploring before digging and preventing and controlling water.
2. Strengthen water survey, drilling acceptance and on-site supervision in goaf areas.
3. Improve water damage emergency preparedness and accident reporting mechanisms.
4. Identify water accumulation in the goaf area and strictly implement water exploration and lead management.
5. Strengthen professional training on water prevention and control, supervision of water exploration and release operations, and emergency response training.
6. Prevent the recurrence of water damage accidents in Laokong.

- 2024-07-28 07:39: Two people lifted a 6-meter, approximately 180-kilogram steel rail to the 190.7-meter unloading point. When unloading, the rear-end personnel released the rails first, and the front-end squad leader was brought down and crushed by the rails.

- 2024-07-28 11:00: The casualties were transferred to a higher-level hospital to continue rescue operations.

【Accident Mechanism】
Two operators carried a rail of about 180 kilograms on their shoulders to transport it uphill. There was an imbalance in coordination during unloading. The back-end personnel lowered the rails first. The front-end squad leader was knocked down by the rails and crushed. He later died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The squad leader violated operating procedures and safety technical measures and organised two people to carry heavy rails on their shoulders. When unloading, the back-end personnel released the rails first, causing the front-end personnel to be knocked down and crushed by the rails.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient identification of manual transportation risks; undulating slopes of transportation routes, floating coal and waste rock on the floor, and insufficient lighting and on-site remediation; on-site safety inspections and outsourced construction management are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The construction unit should improve the safety management system, equip safety management personnel and implement on-site control.
2. Risk identification should be carried out before operation, and transportation routes, lighting and material stacking conditions should be improved.
3. Coal mines should strengthen the management of outsourcing teams and supervision units to ensure that key operations are supervised in place.
4. Improve manual transportation operation measures and on-site safety confirmation, equip safety management personnel, and strengthen outsourcing team management.
5. Strengthen training and control of high-risk operations such as rail transportation and violations.
6. Prevent similar manual handling accidents from happening again.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2024-09-14 14:00: On-site arrangements were made to lower the mine car loaded with materials, the winch driver operated the JD-2.5 winch, and the signal worker went to the unloading yard to clear people and send signals.
- 2024-09-14 14:04: The mine car begins to be lowered.
- 2024-09-14 14:06: The mine car braked urgently when it approached about 100 metres from the slope section, and the damaged wire rope broke; the mine car sports car hit the car arrester and then rolled over, and the thrown metal plate hit the signal worker.
- 2024-09-14 14:21: The winch driver reported the accident to the team duty room, and on-site personnel cleaned up the materials and made a simple stretcher.

- 2024-09-14 16:00: After examination, medical staff confirmed that the casualty person had no vital signs.
- 2024-09-14 20:00: The victims were transported out of the well.

【Accident Mechanism】
The transport wire rope was caught by bolts and damaged, but was not stopped on site. Emergency braking caused the wire rope to break when lowering the mine car. The mine car hit the car arrester and rolled over. Metal materials in the car were thrown out and hit the signal worker at the parking lot.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After it was found on site that the transport wire rope was hooked, blocked and damaged, it was not stopped in use or disposed of; the wire rope broke when the mine car was lowered for emergency braking, causing the sports car to roll over, and the thrown materials caused the death of the signal worker.
2. key contributing factors: wire rope detection and transportation operation control are not in place; there is no protective device for sports cars on the slope section and no signal room in the parking lot; video surveillance cannot cover the entire transportation process; accident warning education and corporate supervision and inspection are not solid.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Detect, replace and manage transportation wire ropes in accordance with regulations, and stop using them immediately if any damage is found.
2. Improve the video surveillance of the slope sports car protection, signal chamber and the entire transportation process.
3. Strictly implement the no-vehicle and on-site warning system.
4. Strengthen auxiliary transportation training, violation investigation and accident warning education.
5. Immediately stop relevant transportation operations, organise rescue and on-site disposal, and conduct an investigation into the accident.
6. Strengthen training on auxiliary transportation operating procedures, wire rope inspections and the "vehicles and pedestrians" system.

- 2024-10-16 14:45: The foreman once again arranged for personnel to move the machine and remove the ground anchor of the rock rake; two electricians unlocked the electronic fence without authorization and moved it.
- 2024-10-16 15:20: After the rock rake was moved about 5 metres, the left sliding shoe fell into floating waste rock, the body tilted and the machine was stopped to loosen the rope.
- 2024-10-16 15:45: The follow-up team found that the equipment was tilted and could not be moved, and asked to stop the move.
- 2024-10-16 15:50: The foreman entered the inclined side and tried to use square wood to right the rock rake. The equipment tipped over twice and squeezed it.
- 2024-10-16 15:52: On-site personnel found the casualty and organised rescue, using a side loader to drag a rock rake to rescue the casualty.
- 2024-10-16 16:16: The follow-up team leader reported the accident to the mine control room.
- 2024-10-16 18:09: The casualty went up to the well, received expert rescue in the ambulance and was transferred to the hospital.
- 2024-10-16 19:23: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the rock rake was moved, the left sliding shoe was blocked and sank into floating waste, causing the equipment to tilt. The foreman illegally entered the tilted side and used square wood to straighten it. After destroying the balance of the equipment, it fell over again and squeezed it.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The foreman on duty illegally entered the side of the inclined rock rake and used a square log to straighten it. After destroying the balance of the equipment, he was crushed and injured by the sudden overturning of the rock rake and died.
2. key contributing factors: the temporary relocation project was not reported and implemented as required; the electronic fence was moved without authorization; on-site supervision and video surveillance were missing; risk identification, training and mutual protection were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Temporary relocation projects must be reported and measures prepared, and can only be implemented after ground anchors and safety conditions are met.
2. Electronic fences and equipment locks must not be lifted or moved without authorization.
3. When the equipment is tilted or blocked, evacuate immediately and stop the machine. It is forbidden to enter the tilted side to straighten it.
4. Strengthen video coverage, on-site monitoring, risk identification and warning education.
5. Use a side loader to drag a rock rake on site to rescue the casualty, and then securely transport, report and send him to the hospital for rescue.
6. Strengthen rock rake machine relocation, electronic fence locking, tilting equipment handling and hazardous area station training.

【Accident Mechanism】
Coal and gas outburst occurred when the tunnel boring machine was cutting the 15303 bottom tunnel. After the coal and gas gushed out, the working face equipment and two operators were buried.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Coal and gas outburst occurred when the tunnel boring machine was cutting the 15303 bottom tunnel. The outburst coal and gas trapped two operators.
2. key contributing factors: The accident site entered the influence range of the collapse column structure, and regional prediction and verification failed to effectively identify outburst hazards; there were problems with sampling, drilling construction, and implementation of outburst prevention measures; monitoring uploads were interrupted, and the accident process was not fully recorded.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement outburst prevention area prediction, verification and outburst elimination measures in areas affected by structures and collapse pillars.
2. Standardize drilling construction, sampling and testing. If the results are abnormal or unreliable, they must be reviewed.
3. Ensure that methane monitoring, video and communication are continuous and effective, and stop work and evacuate personnel in a timely manner when abnormalities occur.
4. Improve emergency response plans, rescue response and on-site evacuation management for outstanding accidents.
5. The mine initiated an emergency plan, organised evacuation, rescue team reconnaissance, clearing of coal outbursts and rescue of trapped personnel.
6. Strengthen outburst prevention prediction, borehole sampling, regional verification, monitoring and emergency evacuation training in structural coal areas.

- 2024-11-20 15:08: The scene was reported to the mine dispatch center, and the mine initiated an emergency rescue response.
- 2024-11-20 15:24: The casualty was carried on a simple stretcher to the entrance of the return air alley and transported out of the well through an overhead manned device.
- 2024-11-20 16:06: The casualty was sent to the hospital for rescue after rising from the well.
- 2024-11-20 16:52: The hospital confirmed the death of the casualty.

【Accident Mechanism】
The squad leader illegally used the back column winch and push jack to move the No. 85 transition bracket. When the push jack retracted, the front-end 40T ring chain broke, and the winch wire rope rebounded, hitting the head of the transport worker who was staying in the towing danger zone.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The squad leader violated the regulations and used a back-column winch to connect a push jack to move the powered support; after the circular chain was disconnected, the wire rope rebounded and hit the head of the operator who violated the regulations and entered the traction danger zone, causing death.
2. key contributing factors: On-site safety inspections failed to stop illegal commanders and people stationed in dangerous areas; shift leaders failed to conduct on-site inspections; video surveillance failed; lack of procedural training, warning education, and superior supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The bracket must be moved using processes and connection methods approved by the agency.
2. Before towing operations, clear the dangerous area of ​​wire rope rebound and set up reliable warnings.
3. Strengthen safety confirmation, shift inspections and video surveillance maintenance at temporary work sites.
4. Strengthen winch transportation warning education and timely reporting of accidents.
5. Initiate emergency rescue response, use stretchers to remove the casualty from the well and transfer them to the hospital.
6. Strengthen training on bracket moving, winch pulling, ring chain connection, dangerous area positioning and accident reporting.

- 2024-12-04 14:10: Rescuers arrived at the bottom of the well and found that the casualty man had a head injury and was unconscious. They immediately moved him into a bucket and prepared to lift the well.

- 2024-12-10 09:10: The coal mine reported the accident to the Gaoping Emergency Management Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
Without wearing a safety belt, the operator fell into the hole while confirming safety near the unprotected ash pipe hole on the lower deck of the hanging plate. He fell to the bottom of the well and was injured. He later died after being rescued.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator did not wear a safety belt, worked near the ash pipe opening of the lower deck of the hanging plate without protective facilities and fell, which was the direct cause of the accident.
2. key contributing factors: lack of protection at the opening of the hanging plate; on-site management personnel did not stop operations without safety belts; risk identification and on-site inspection after blasting were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the protection of hanging plate holes and safety facilities for wellbore operations.
2. Strictly implement the safety belt wearing, safety confirmation before operation and on-site monitoring system.
3. Strengthen safety management of outsourced projects and report accidents in a timely manner as required.
4. Set up reliable protection for the hanging plate holes, and strictly implement safety belts and on-site monitoring systems for working at heights.
5. Strengthen training on shaft hoisting operations, risk of falling from heights, and safety belt use.
6. Prevent the recurrence of falling accidents of well workers.

- 2024-12-29 19:45: The advanced support section of the transportation channel collapsed, and three people were buried under waste rock.
- 2024-12-29 19:48: The accident was reported to the mine dispatch room on site, and rescuers carried out rescue operations from both sides of the tunnel.

- 2024-12-30 11:20: One injured person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-12-30 11:50: Another injured person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The advance support and shed replacement operation did not follow the requirements of "support first and then withdraw" to support the wooden shed, that is, the U-shaped steel beam shed legs on the mining side were removed, which reduced the roof support strength. After being disturbed by the movement of the end frame and other disturbances, the roof fell down, burying three support workers.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The shed replacement operation violated the "support first and then withdraw" regulations. The supporting components were removed without erecting the wooden shed, causing the roof support to become unstable; the roof fell off after being disturbed by the end frame movement, and three people were buried.
2. key contributing factors: The roof of the isolated island working face is broken and the pressure is high, and hidden dangers are not checked before resuming operations; the on-site sheds are not repaired and supervised and supported in a timely manner; safety inspections, training and video surveillance are not effective.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the operating procedures for support first, then withdrawal and roof support, and complete the advance support before operation.
2. Carry out special risk identification and hidden danger investigation on broken roofs and island working surfaces.
3. On-site supervision and safety inspections must be arranged for support operations to ensure effective video coverage.
4. Strengthen mentoring, top management and emergency reporting training for new employees.
5. Initiate first-level emergency response, organise rescue on both sides, transport the wounded out of the well, and report accidents.
6. Strengthen the training of "first support and then retreat" for shed replacement operations, roof risk identification and on-site monitoring.

2. Establish a system for mine inspection, repair and maintenance and regular pressure testing of single hydraulic props.
3. Improve the anti-tipping measures and on-site risk inspection of winch compression columns.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The reducing joint of the high-pressure liquid supply pipeline between No. 1 and No. 2 hydraulic supports broke. The joint and hose bounced up under the action of high-pressure fluid, injuring and killing the operator.
2. key contributing factors: long-term use of self-welded non-standard joints without timely deactivation, replacement or protection; mechanical and electrical maintenance, material procurement and high-pressure liquid pipe risk management and control were not in place, there was no on-site deputy captain, and the risk of high-pressure hose collapse was not identified and eliminated.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Stop using non-standard high-pressure liquid pipe joints and implement pressure resistance tests.
2. Standardize material procurement, use, maintenance and replacement management.
3. Strengthen risk identification, on-site inspection and follow-up management of high-pressure liquid pipes.
4. Improve industrial video surveillance and “no operation without surveillance” management.
5. Disable the use of non-standard high-pressure liquid pipe joints, establish pressure test, replacement and anti-falling standards; standardize the procurement, use and equipment maintenance processes.
6. Strengthen training on high-pressure liquid pipe connection, pressure testing, protection, maintenance and risk of pipe collapse injury.

- 2025-02-22 04:03: The second powered support began to be transported, and multiple personnel followed the vehicle for inspection.
- 2025-02-22 04:35: The shuttle arrives at the 11-degree slope change point of the South Wing Transport Avenue, and the driver adjusts the tractor to low speed.
- 2025-02-22 04:40: The counterweight wire rope of the tensioning device broke, and the bracket car and shuttle car jumped forward; the rear wheel of the shuttle car fell off the road, hitting the person following the car on the side of the vehicle.
- 2025-02-22 04:45: The scene was reported to the dispatch room, and the mine started an emergency plan.
- 2025-02-22 05:24: The casualties were transported out of the well and transferred to the hospital.
- 2025-02-22 06:20: The casualties were sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2025-02-22 08:00: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the endless rope continuous tractor was transporting the powered support, the counterweight wire rope of the tensioning device broke, and the support vehicle and shuttle vehicle jumped forward. The person following the car violated the regulations of not pedestrians while driving and followed the shuttle car on the side. He was hit by the rear wheel of the shuttle car that fell off the road and was injured.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The counterweight wire rope of the tensioning device of the endless rope continuous tractor broke. The support vehicle and shuttle vehicle jumped forward, and the rear wheels of the shuttle vehicle fell off the road. The person following the vehicle who violated the no-pedestrian regulations was hit and killed.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient inspection and maintenance of tensioning devices and inspection of hidden dangers; failure to effectively implement transportation measures; failure to arrange safety officers to monitor the entire process on site; infractions of regulations by shift leaders; and inadequate training and superior supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Inspect and maintain the infinite rope tensioning device and counterweight wire rope as required. If any hidden dangers are found, immediately stop using them and make rectifications.
2. During the transportation of the bracket, the dangerous area must be strictly closed and traffic must be kept away from pedestrians.
3. For key transportation projects, safety officers should be arranged to monitor the site throughout the entire process.
4. Strengthen the implementation of transportation measures, on-the-job training and timely accident reporting management.
5. organise the on-site transportation of the casualty, and the mine will activate an emergency plan and arrange medical rescue and transfer out of the mine.
6. Strengthen the training on endless rope transportation, tensioning device maintenance, driving and on-site monitoring.

2. Strengthen the whole-process supervision of key links by safety officers and follow-up managers.

【Accident Mechanism】
The project department violated regulations by arranging unlicensed support workers to drive rubber-tired trucks that failed to pass the inspection to transport materials. The vehicle rolled away without braking when passing the air door on a slippery sloping roadway, and the auxiliary worker who was closing the air door was squeezed between the rear of the carriage and the air door and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: An unlicensed person drove a rubber-tired truck that failed to pass the inspection without braking when it passed the damper in the slippery inclined tunnel, squeezing the person who opened and closed the damper to death.
2. key contributing factors: chaotic labor organisation, inconsistent certificates and positions, vehicles operating with diseases and no effective inspections; no special measures have been formulated for the transportation risks of dampers and inclined tunnels, flaws in the design and management of dampers, and insufficient on-site safety supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Driving without a license and operating the vehicle while sick are strictly prohibited.
2. Improve measures for damper passage in inclined tunnels and measures to prevent vehicles from rolling away.
3. Strengthen vehicle inspection, maintenance and auxiliary transportation risk management.
4. Report accidents in a timely manner in accordance with the law, and concealing reports is strictly prohibited.
5. Unlicensed driving and the operation of unqualified vehicles are prohibited; inspection, maintenance and anti-rolling management of auxiliary transport vehicles are carried out, and automatic or reliable protection facilities are installed at the dampers.
6. Strengthen training on rubber-tired vehicle driving qualifications, driving on inclined roadways, air gate passage and anti-rolling.

- 2025-03-26 09:00: The ambulance arrived at the scene, and medical staff confirmed that the casualty had no vital signs.

【Accident Mechanism】
Five empty mine carts fell off the road and tilted to the left while running. The operator did not release the tension on the wire rope, so he stood in front of the right side of the vehicle and used a hand hoist to re-rail. The mine car became unstable and swung to the right, squeezing it.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the mine car tilted down the track, the operator stood in front of the vehicle and used a hand hoist to re-rail without releasing the tension of the wire rope; the mine car became unstable and swung, squeezing it to death.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient staffing and on-site inspection of endless rope transportation; failure to report according to the change management system after falling off the road; video surveillance is turned off and anti-violation is weak; transportation training and emergency reporting are not solid.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Before re-tracking, vehicles that have fallen off the track must be stopped, tension released, and approved disposal measures must be formulated.
2. Personnel are strictly prohibited from standing in areas dangerous to vehicle swinging, pulling and squeezing.
3. Strengthen personnel allocation, on-site confirmation and video surveillance management for endless rope transportation.
4. Strictly implement change management, anti-violation, emergency rescue and accident reporting systems.
5. On-site personnel organised derailment rescue, cardiopulmonary resuscitation and transportation of the casualty; the mine subsequently arranged special rescue electric locomotives and medical assistance.
6. Strengthen training on falling track re-railing, wire rope pressure relief, endless rope transportation, dangerous stations and emergency reporting.

- 2025-04-10 17:23: The bracket worker mistakenly operated the adjacent rack control as group control. Guard plates No. 2 to No. 6 opened at the same time, squeezing the scraper conveyor driver under the No. 2 bracket against the cable trough guard.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the support worker controlled the guard plate of the No. 6 powered support on the adjacent frame of the No. 7 powered support, he mistakenly operated it as a group control. The guard plates of the No. 2 to No. 6 supports were opened at the same time, squeezing the scraper conveyor driver working under the guard plate of the No. 2 support to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The scaffolding worker mistakenly operated the adjacent rack control into group control, causing the guard panels of multiple racks to open at the same time, squeezing the scraper conveyor driver who had not evacuated the dangerous area to death.
2. key contributing factors: When the driver entered the front of the support to work, he did not close the liquid inlet shut-off valve of the stand and lock the adjacent stand; the safety inspector failed to stop it in time. The operating procedures did not provide sufficient provisions for group control risks, and the support operation training and risk identification were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the locking and evacuation system for operations in front of the support.
2. Improve group control operating procedures and risk prevention measures.
3. Strengthen on-site inspections by security officers and stop violations.
4. Strengthen training on electro-hydraulic control operation of hydraulic supports.
5. Improve the operating procedures for electro-hydraulic control of hydraulic supports, clarify group control prohibitions and locking requirements for nose and tail operations; implement personnel evacuation and lockout confirmation before operation.
6. Strengthen training on electro-hydraulic control of hydraulic supports, operation of guard panels, evacuation of hazardous areas and risk identification.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-05-11 22:30: The second excavation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 8 people to work on the development heading of the water tank at the bottom of the well, with a planned footage of 1.6 metres.
- 2025-05-11 23:00: Operators enter the mine on trackless rubber-tyred vehicles.
- 2025-05-11 23:40: The workers arrived at the working face of the well bottom water silo. After the team leader and safety inspector confirmed the scene, they arranged for the tunnel boring machine to remove slag, the forklift to shovel slag and the warning.
- 2025-05-12 02:30: After the slag discharging was completed, the tunnel boring machine continues to advance about 1.9 metres and exits at the heading; the driver enters the working face alone to check the tunnel formation situation, and there is an unsupported area on the right side.
- 2025-05-12 03:45: When the driver walked 2.2 metres away from the head end, stones fell in the unsupported area of ​​​​the spandrel on the right side of the roadway, knocking him down.
- 2025-05-12 03:52: The safety inspector reported the accident to the dispatch room. On-site personnel used steel pipes and drill pipes to pry open the rocks and lift the casualty to the auxiliary inclined shaft.
- 2025-05-12 04:14: The mine called 120 emergency number.
- 2025-05-12 04:33: The emergency vehicle of Xiangning County People's Hospital arrived at the entrance of the secondary inclined well.
- 2025-05-12 04:35: The casualties were transported to the entrance of the auxiliary inclined shaft, and emergency personnel began inspection.
- 2025-05-12 04:58: Medical staff confirmed that the casualty had no vital signs.
- 2025-05-12 06:01: The mine director reported the accident to the group, Xiangning County and Linfen City emergency management departments.
- 2025-05-12 07:30: The Xiangning County Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident to the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the slag was discharged from the water tank at the bottom of the well, there was an unsupported area on the right side of the tunnel. After the tunnel boring machine driver continued to dig 1.9 metres, he entered alone to check the formation of the tunnel. He was crushed to death by falling rocks in the unsupported area of ​​the right spandrel.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The unsupported area on the right side of the tunnel collapsed after excavation. The driver of the tunnel boring machine was crushed to death by rocks when he entered alone to check head on.
2. key contributing factors: On-site operations with no ceiling, team leaders, safety officers and drivers failed to fulfill their job responsibilities; insufficient learning of procedures, on-site follow-up and risk identification, and deficiencies in the staffing and performance of project management personnel.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the regulations on excavation support and no entry into the void area.
2. Arrange on-site management personnel and implement follow-up and safety inspection responsibilities.
3. Strengthen the study of construction regulations, risk identification and anti-violation management.
4. Report accidents promptly and truthfully and activate emergency plans.
5. Strictly control the overhead distance, and do not enter the at the heading area before the support was completed; implement the responsibilities of the team leader, safety inspector, and follow-up management personnel for on-site confirmation, supervision, and rectification of hidden dangers.
6. Strengthen training on temporary support during excavation work, prohibition of entry into the void area, risk identification and accident reporting time limits.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the flatbed truck carrying the mechanized excavator parts fell off the track, the on-site failure to report and handle it in accordance with regulations was used without authorization to use the JSDB-6 winch and guide pulley to pull the track back. During the towing process, the fixed shaft of the guide pulley broke, and the pulley part was bounced off by the wire rope, hitting the head of the person on site.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The site violated the management regulations for off-track operations and used a winch and guide pulley without authorization to pull the off-track flatbed truck back onto the rails. The fixed shaft of the guide pulley broke, and the flying parts hit the operator's head and killed him.
2. key contributing factors: failure to report after being dropped off the road, non-routine transportation operations organised in violation of regulations on site; insufficient transportation management, video anti-violation and on-site command; failure to report ultra-high and overweight transportation according to procedures; inadequate training and risk prevention and control.

1. Vehicles that fall off the track must be reported in accordance with procedures and re-tracking measures must be formulated. They must not be disposed of without approval.
2. Unconventional, ultra-high and overweight transportation should be reported and directed by management personnel on site.
3. Strictly inspect load-bearing components such as winches, wire ropes, and guide pulleys.
4. Strengthen transportation site management, video anti-violation and job risk training.
5. Activate the emergency plan, organise the evacuation of the casualty to the hospital, and report the accident step by step.
6. Strengthen training on off-track disposal, unconventional transportation, winch traction and guide pulley use.

- 2025-06-01 09:20: The dispatch room of China Coal Huajin Company reported the accident to the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The team leader illegally removed the temporary support and failed to implement the "one-anchor-one" measure during the permanent support process; when constructing the 13th anchor hole, falling stones from the unsupported area on the wall facing the chamber crushed him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The team leader illegally removed the temporary support and failed to implement the "one anchor, one anchor" measure; during the construction of the 13th anchor hole, he was crushed to death by falling rocks from the upper wall of the wall.
2. key contributing factors: Construction projects are not included in unified and coordinated management; construction units have insufficient implementation of technical measures and on-site supervision, personnel in key positions have not performed their duties, and safety education and anti-violation management are not solid.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The construction unit shall coordinate the safety management of the construction unit in a unified manner.
2. Strictly implement temporary support and "anchor one" measures.
3. Strengthen the performance of key positions, on-site supervision and video surveillance.
4. Report accidents promptly and truthfully.
5. Restore and strictly implement temporary support and "anchor one" measures; the construction unit coordinates construction safety management and implements safety confirmation and video monitoring before operation.
6. Strengthen training on cave support, temporary support removal, anchor construction and roof risk identification.

- 2025-06-03 15:00: The district chief arranged for three maintenance workers to collect hydraulic hoses and put them underground to replace the damaged hydraulic hoses on the cage safety door.
- 2025-06-03 15:14: 4 personnel entered the cage and prepared to go underground.
- 2025-06-03 15:18: The workers arrived at the bottom of the auxiliary well, the cage switched to maintenance mode, and began to replace the hydraulic hoses in the trench and around the cage.
- 2025-06-03 15:46: Two tank waiting personnel arrived at the signal room at the bottom of the well to wait for the lift.
- 2025-06-03 16:00: The signal worker opened the safety door of the east tank and let two people waiting to board the tank.
- 2025-06-03 16:01: The cage starts, the east tank rises and the west tank drops.
- 2025-06-03 16:03: The district chief opened the safety door of the western tank without authorization and leaned over the door to check the maintenance status in the ditch.
- 2025-06-03 16:04: The Western can fell to the bottom of the can, squeezing the district chief.
- 2025-06-03 16:06: On-site personnel reported the injury to the duty room in the operation area.
- 2025-06-03 16:07: The operation area reported to the mine dispatching room and asked to contact 120.
- 2025-06-03 16:21: The mine director initiated the emergency rescue plan.
- 2025-06-03 16:27: The ambulance arrived at the south gate of the auxiliary well and the casualty was transferred to the hospital.
- 2025-06-03 18:03: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the cage was in maintenance mode, the district chief opened the safety door of the western tank without authorization and leaned over to check the maintenance status in the trench. The western tank dropped to the bottom of the tank, and its head and chest were squeezed between the western tank and the north wall of the shaft.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the district chief ordered the tank cage to operate in maintenance mode in violation of regulations, he opened the safety door of the western tank without authorization, leaned over to check the ditch, and was crushed to death by the running tank cage.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to formulate cage maintenance operating procedures and safety technical measures; failure to rectify oil leakage hazards in the cage safety door hydraulic system; insufficient on-site management, shift handover and violation control; maintenance personnel did not participate in pre-shift meetings.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Develop and strictly implement cage maintenance procedures and special safety technical measures.
2. During the maintenance period, locking, vigilance and special supervision shall be implemented. It is strictly prohibited to open the door or operate the cage without authorization.
3. Promptly rectify hidden dangers in lifting equipment such as oil leakage in the hydraulic system.
4. Strengthen pre-shift meetings, shift handovers, risk identification of dangerous operations and anti-violation management.
5. After removing the casualty from the scene, perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation and report to the dispatch room. The mine will activate the plan and arrange for 120 to be transferred to the hospital.
6. Strengthen cage maintenance, maintenance mode operation, safety door management, limited space and hazardous area training.

- 2025-06-13 00:50: When the squad leader was cleaning the wall groove scum under the plain concrete supported by the old I-beam beam, the upper plain concrete block fell off and knocked it down on the platform.

- 2025-06-13 02:08: The mine director arranged to report the accident to the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau, the Changzhi Emergency Bureau and the group dispatch headquarters.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the wind bridge maintenance operation, after the workers demolished three I-beam beams at a time, the squad leader stood in the unsupported ceiling area to clean up the scum in the wall grooves; a plain concrete block fell from above and injured him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The workers illegally demolished three I-beam beams at once. The squad leader was standing in the unsupported ceiling area while working, and a plain concrete block fell, injuring him to death.
2. key contributing factors: lack of on-site safety confirmation and supervision, failure to stop illegal beam demolition and empty roof operations; inaccurate risk assessment of the wind bridge structure, with three columns replacing three beams failing to achieve equivalent support; loopholes in the preparation, review and video surveillance management of technical measures.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement wind bridge maintenance safety technical measures and on-site safety confirmation.
2. Implement full-process supervision by safety officers for critical and abnormal operations.
3. Improve the review of technical measures, video surveillance maintenance and hidden danger investigation.
4. Strengthen roof management and illegal operations.
5. Reorganize and strictly review the safety technical measures for wind bridge maintenance; restore effective support and video surveillance, and arrange for safety officers to supervise the entire process of key operations.
6. Strengthen roof management, wind bridge maintenance, roof-and-rib sounding and no-entry training in empty roof areas.

【Accident Mechanism】
The trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, fully loaded with materials, skidded when going up a 13-degree slippery slope. The vehicle failed to brake, hit and squeezed the operator on the inside of the first air door, and then collapsed the wall of the air door.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The trackless rubber-tired vehicle skidded on an uphill section where the slope exceeded the regulations and the road surface was slippery. It hit and killed the installation team leader who was illegally staying at the bottom of the slope.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient identification of roadway slope and anti-rolling risks; failure to implement transportation closure and no-personnel ban systems at the bottom of slopes; failure to monitor the site in accordance with regulations; inadequate transportation training, anti-violation and corporate supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Renovate slopes that do not meet the requirements and control slippery roads to ensure operating conditions for rubber-tired vehicles.
2. Strictly implement the closed management of people and transportation at the bottom of the slope during vehicle climbing.
3. Strengthen on-site monitoring, risk identification and hidden danger investigation of rubber-tyred vehicle transportation.
4. Carry out targeted warning education and anti-violation training.
5. Activate the emergency plan, organise on-site rescue, transport the casualty out of the well and report the accident.
6. Strengthen training on trackless rubber-tyred vehicle ramp transportation, damper access, closure management and vehicle slip risk.

When the two workers dismantled the bridge trough of the transfer machine, they failed to install wooden stack pads as required and violated the disassembly sequence. 【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When two workers dismantled the bridge trough of the loader, they failed to set up wooden stacks as required. After the lifting chain connecting bolt broke, the bridge trough became unstable and fell, crushing the two people to death.
2. key contributing factors: Violation of equipment withdrawal and bolt removal sequence; lack of on-site team, follow-up and safety inspection; risk identification did not clarify the position of personnel during disassembly; video surveillance coverage and lighting were ineffective.

The operator uses a small unit to hold up the crusher on the side of the coal mining gang where the floor is downhill and the space is narrow. After the loader moved, the operator relieved the pressure on the small unit, and the crusher rebounded instantly, squeezing it between the motor protrusion and the hydraulic pillar of the steel shed unit, causing death.

1. When there are people working on the side of the coal mining gang in the trough, the machine must be stopped, and the hazards of the operation must be thoroughly identified and controlled.
2. Develop, approve and implement safety technical measures for special and non-routine operations.
3. Document hazard sources and preventive and control measures and inform frontline personnel.
4. Strengthen self-protection and mutual protection, hazard source identification and anti-violation education through pre-class meetings and centralized training.
5. Prevent mechanical crushing injuries caused by crusher alignment and narrow space operations, and eliminate concealment.

The blocked drain pipe of No. 1 coal bunker was blocked by silt, and water accumulated over a long period of time. After the fixing bolts rusted and slipped, the water and silt in the bunker suddenly burst out and flowed along the north main inclined shaft, knocking down the workers below, causing 2 deaths and 1 injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal bunker drain pipe was blocked, causing water accumulation. After the fixing bolts of the blocking steel plate failed, the accumulated water and sediment suddenly burst out and rushed into people.
2. key contributing factors: The coal bunker sealing was not constructed according to the plan, and measures were not re-formulated and accepted after changes were made; technical management and hazard source identification were insufficient, and the risk of bunker collapse was not effectively assessed and dealt with.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively identify hidden disaster factors and safety risks, and improve the hidden danger investigation and management system.
2. Standardize the formulation, approval, acceptance and execution of individual project measures.
3. Improve the technology and daily management of abandoned coal bunkers; take measures to seal and drain coal bunkers when there is water, and they must not be used without proper disposal.
4. Carry out accident warning education and strengthen risk training for key locations such as abandoned coal bunkers, abandoned tunnels and seals.

【Accident Mechanism】
The communication alley has poor ventilation, and the wedge-shaped area accumulates gases such as carbon dioxide and lacks oxygen. The inspection and maintenance worker entered the fenced communication alley without authorization and suffocated due to lack of oxygen; the search and rescue personnel found out and put on self-rescuers to rescue him. He was confirmed dead after going up the well.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The worker entered the communication alley with poor ventilation and insufficient oxygen without authorization, and died of suffocation due to lack of oxygen.
2. key contributing factors: insufficient effective air volume and hypoxic hazards in contact lanes were not discovered and dealt with in a timely manner; dangerous area management, loss of contact monitoring, on-site management and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the investigation and management of hidden dangers and the identification and control of on-site risks in key links.
2. Strictly enforce accident reporting time limits.
3. Transform underground ventilation facilities, close useless tunnels, optimize the ventilation system and strengthen daily inspections.
4. Strengthen key position training and safety warning education, and improve risk identification and self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.
5. Prevent people from entering dangerous tunnels that are hypoxic and poorly ventilated.

- 2020-01-12 10:40: Rescuers carried Tian Dong on a simple stretcher to the belt conveyor in the transport chute. They escorted Tian Dong to the Sanlian Lane of the 2201 fully mechanised mining working face through the belt, and were transported to the underground parking lot by the explosion-proof rubber wheel truck waiting here.

Without observing the people in front of the support or making any announcements, the powered support workers used the linkage function to open the guard panels in groups and squeezed the workers in front of the No. 4 transition support into the cable trough of the scraper conveyor. 【Accident Timeline】

- 2020-06-30: The watchdog received a report about the accident.

【Accident Mechanism】
Before resuming operations after the rain, the umbrella rocks and pumice on the 1120 flat steps were not completely cleaned. The dump truck crossed over a retaining wall that did not meet the requirements and stopped at the bottom of the steps to wait for loading. A stone slipped from the steps and hit the cab, killing the driver.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The dump truck entered the bottom of the steps where the umbrella rock and pumice had not been thoroughly cleaned, and was hit by falling rocks from the steps.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient cleaning of umbrella rocks and pumice before resumption of work after rain.
3. key contributing factors: The safety barrier setting does not meet the requirements and fails to effectively block traffic.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Thoroughly clean the umbrella rocks and pumice on the steps before resuming work after rain, set up safety retaining walls as required, and inspect and accept them.
2. Strengthen the inspection of hidden dangers, on-site inspections and the implementation of technical measures by the outsourcing team.
3. Strengthen training on the risk of rockfall on open steps, self-protection and mutual protection, and prohibition of entry into dangerous areas.
4. Prevent vehicles and people from entering unmanaged rockfall hazard areas and prevent concealment of reports.

When retracting the fully mechanised excavator, the operator illegally sat in the tail chute of the traveling mechanized excavator and coiled cables. As the mechanized excavator drove over the uneven floor, its nose fell and its tail lifted, squeezing the operator to death.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2021-07-21 18:00: The mining and stripping team held a pre-shift briefing and temporarily arranged 7 dump trucks to transport slag to the widened road to the west of the 1290-meter earth dumping platform.
- 2021-07-21 18:30: The operation vehicle arrives at the designated location and starts dumping soil.
- 2021-07-22: Three excavators were called to the scene to support and secure the accident vehicle, and rescuers unfastened the seat belt and rescued the driver.

- 2021-07-22 01:30: Dump truck No. Z03 fell to the 1270-meter earth dumping platform while reversing straight on the edge to unload slag.

- 2021-07-22 04:09: The mine reported the accident to the Yijinhuoluo Banner Energy Bureau.
- 2021-07-22 06:53: The mine reported the accident to the supervisory agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver reversed the truck to unload slag at night on a widened road where special safety technical measures for slope dumping were not formulated. The truck was improperly reversed and fell to the 1,270-meter dumping platform below. Rescuers secured the vehicle and rescued the driver. He died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Improper operation of the dump truck when reversing straight on the edge to unload slag. The vehicle fell to the platform below, causing the driver's death.
2. key contributing factors: New drivers were not given pre-job training; no slope operation measures were formulated for temporary earth dumping; there was no lighting at night; the reverse slope of the earth dump site and the road slope did not meet the requirements; on-site command and risk investigation were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the job responsibility system for management personnel and clearly assign responsibilities to each person.
2. Conduct an in-depth analysis of the cause of the accident and implement the lessons learned to district teams and teams.
3. Formulate special safety technical measures for dumping operations on slope roads, and standardize night lighting, dump site slopes and on-site command.
4. Implement pre-job training and carry out professional ability and safety warning education for managers and drivers.
5. Prevent dump truck edge unloading and reversing falling accidents.

The project department repairs roads in locations where there are no specialized technical measures, insufficient platform width, and no safety retaining walls. When the excavator was clearing debris, a large rock from the south end suddenly fell, hitting the cab and causing the driver and the driver to fall down the north slope. the casualty was confirmed dead after on-site rescue.

4. Carry out safety education and skills training for all employees during the shutdown and rectification period.

【Accident Mechanism】
Workers assemble the trestle truss on the ground, and the two sets of single pieces are erected to prepare for welding of cross beams. When the first group of monoliths had been temporarily supported and fixed, the team leader still adjusted its welding position with a chain hoist. 4. Carry out precise training, technical briefings and practical drills by type of work and position to improve risk identification and self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

【Accident Mechanism】
The operator recycles the tape without using the tape extraction and tape storage device according to safety technical measures. The speed of the tape machine and the tape winding machine did not match. The tape accumulated between the driving rollers and was rolled into the rollers. The reverse tension was generated and the tape core fixing pin was broken. The tape core and the winding tape suddenly bounced towards the tape machine, hitting two workers who were adjusting the tape, causing one death and one injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The tape accumulated and rolled into the driving roller, causing reverse pulling force, which broke the tape core fixing pin, and the tape core and tape ejected and hit the operator.
2. key contributing factors: unauthorized changes to the tape recycling process and failure to implement safety technical measures.
3. key contributing factors: lack of on-site follow-up management and failure to stop illegal operations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement safety technical measures for equipment withdrawal and improve the tape recycling process, measures and operating procedures.
2. Allocate sufficient on-site safety management personnel to strengthen risk identification, hidden danger investigation and on-site supervision.
3. Increase safety investment and improve equipment withdrawal process.
4. Improve the quality of safety education and warning education, and strengthen formal operations, self-protection and mutual protection, and safe operation skills.
5. Put an end to unauthorized process changes and illegal operations, and prevent mechanical injury accidents during the tape recycling process.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the No. 91 powered support on the 12407E working face was removed during the shift, the operator installed a guide pulley on the support moving head and used a winch to pull the support. The wire rope broke due to concentrated lateral shearing at the No. 2 guide pulley. The broken rope rebounded to the rear of the winch and hit the electrical team operator who was recovering the cable. The person fell to the ground and was injured, and later died after ineffective treatment.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The wire rope of the traction bracket was broken by concentrated lateral shear at the guide pulley and rebounded, hitting the operator.
2. key contributing factors: After changing the process of using a winch to remove the powered support, no special safety measures were added to address the risk of rope breakage.
3. key contributing factors: Failure to fully identify the risk of rope breakage and rebound, and to delineate and control dangerous areas.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly review and approve technical safety measures. Risk assessments must be carried out and control measures must be formulated when process changes are made.
2. Carry out special hidden danger investigation and management for working face installation, withdrawal and other operations.
3. Incorporate contractors and professional service teams into unified mine safety management.
4. Strengthen the training of workers on the risks of mechanical injuries such as rope breakage and rebound, and on safe positions.
5. Strengthen risk identification, measure approval and on-site supervision throughout the entire process of high-risk operations to prevent similar mechanical and electrical injury accidents.

In order to retract the half-raised powered support, the operator entered the support and removed the hydraulic plug of the lowering column hole of the control valve group without remote operation according to regulations and without safety supervision. 【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally entered the powered support to remove the plug of the lowering column hole. After the support was forced to release the pressure, the top beam dropped rapidly, squeezing it to death.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the safety responsibility system for all employees and comprehensively investigate and manage potential accident hazards.
2. Arrange safety inspectors to monitor key projects and key links on-site and strictly implement technical measures.
3. Strengthen video surveillance at work sites and rectify violations.
4. Conduct targeted training around procedures, technical measures and emergency response to improve risk identification and accident prevention capabilities.
5. Prevent personnel from entering the dangerous space of the powered support and prevent illegal squeeze injuries during maintenance and shipment of large mechanical and electrical equipment.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-09-06 23:32: The winch driver entered the mine from the return air inclined shaft in the West No. 3 mining area and reached the winch chamber through the return air contact lane. He fell down due to lack of oxygen on the way.
- 2023-09-07 04:20: The winch driver felt chest tightness and headache, and reported physical discomfort to the ground duty monitor.
- 2023-09-07 04:23: The ground shift leader arranged for another winch driver to enter the mine to take over.
- 2023-09-07 05:12: The replacement winch driver entered the mine from the return air inclined shaft in the West No. 3 mining area and went to the winch chamber along the same route.
- 2023-09-07 05:28: The replacement winch driver fell to the ground due to lack of oxygen about 15 metres away from the return air connection alley to the return air side of the damper.
- 2023-09-07 05:40: The ground duty monitor arrived at the winch chamber and found that the winch driver who arrived first had difficulty breathing and gave initial treatment.
- 2023-09-07 05:50: The ground duty monitor reported that two people were feeling unwell and the replacement staff had lost contact. The shift leader arranged to wear a self-rescuer to evacuate.
- 2023-09-07 06:49: After analysis and judgment, the mine notified the mine rescue team to rescue and arranged for nearby personnel to cooperate.
- 2023-09-07 07:16: The rescue team put on rescue equipment and entered the mine to search and rescue.
- 2023-09-07 07:28: The rescue team found the person who fell on the ground in the return air communication lane, measured the oxygen concentration at the scene of 4.5%, and immediately implemented first aid.
- 2023-09-07 08:20: The person who fell to the ground was carried to the mine entrance on a stretcher, and medical staff performed first aid.
- 2023-09-07 08:25: Medical staff confirmed that the person had lost vital signs.
- 2023-09-07 08:51: The casualty winch driver went up the well and was sent to the hospital for treatment.

【Accident Mechanism】
The fireproof iron doors and wind windows in the return air contact lane of the winch chamber have been closed for a long time, blocking ventilation and forming an oxygen-deficient blind lane. The replacement winch driver fell to the ground due to hypoxia when he went to the chamber along the return air side communication lane. The winch driver who had previously entered the chamber also showed symptoms of hypoxia, resulting in one death and one injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The fireproof iron door and wind window in the return air contact lane of the winch chamber were closed for a long time, cutting off the air flow and causing the oxygen concentration to drop. People were deprived of oxygen and suffocated when passing through this area.
2. key contributing factors: Risk identification, assessment or management measures for ventilation changes were not carried out after the installation of fireproof iron doors.
3. key contributing factors: The management responsibilities of fireproof iron doors are unclear, and the hidden dangers of long-term closure have not been investigated and dealt with.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the management responsibilities of ventilation facilities, comprehensively investigate and rectify hidden risks in the ventilation system.
2. Strictly review and approve the preparation of safety technical measures, and carry out risk identification and control based on changes in facilities.
3. Strengthen on-site safety management and supervision and inspection of key links.
4. Incorporate job risk factors, preventive measures and hypoxia emergency response into targeted training to improve self-rescue and mutual rescue capabilities.
5. Prevent blind alleys and hypoxia caused by loss of ventilation facilities, and prevent people from venturing into abnormally ventilated areas.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the working face was connected to the net, the operator violated the regulations and tilted the pneumatic legs of the bolting machine to support the net on the overlap between the gear rail and the scraper baffle. The outrigger suddenly slid out and hit the deputy captain who was standing behind to direct the alert. The back of his head hit the powered support column, causing fatal injuries.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Illegal use of roof bolts to top the net, and the outriggers slid and popped out after tilting the support, hitting the people on site and causing them to hit the powered support column.
2. key contributing factors: On-site management personnel gave illegal instructions, and the working methods violated the prohibitive provisions of the regulations.

2. Strengthen the on-site supervision of teams, districts, security inspections and shift leaders, and implement the principle of no work without supervision and no work without monitoring.
3. Strengthen the rectification of violations and prevent the disconnect between institutional measures and on-site operations.
4. Conduct training on procedures, responsibilities and measures at different levels, majors and positions to strengthen the ability to reject illegal orders and protect themselves and each other.
5. Put an end to illegal operations and concealment of accidents in the working face support network to prevent mechanical rebound injuries.

- 2023-09-27 12:42: The escaping personnel reported the water damage accident to the mine dispatching room, and the mine director initiated the emergency plan.

- 2023-09-29 22:46: The third missing person was transported to the ground and sent to the hospital. He was diagnosed with no vital signs and the search and rescue was ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The construction of the waterproof sealing wall in the No. 7 contact lane built to store mud water on the working face was inconsistent with the design and measures and was not effectively accepted. After muddy water accumulated behind the wall, the bottom of the airtight wall was flushed open, and muddy water quickly poured into the water pump room and track alley at the bottom of the North District. Five people escaped during the evacuation of eight people, and three people lost contact and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The construction quality of the waterproof sealing wall in No. 7 Contact Lane was unqualified, the bottom was washed away, and the accumulated mud water poured into the work area.
2. key contributing factors: The thickness and material of the closed wall are inconsistent with the design and safety measures, and the tank is poured before the muddy water is drained.
3. key contributing factors: Failure to correct the discrepancies between construction and design after discovery, and the sealing wall being put into use without completing effective acceptance.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly carry out the design, construction and acceptance of water damage control projects such as waterproofing and sealing, and stop making corrections when found to not meet the requirements.
2. Improve water hazard management risk identification, monitoring and inspection, and hidden danger management to ensure smooth drainage and release facilities.
3. Strengthen engineering change approval and on-site quality management, and shall not be used without effective acceptance.
4. Strengthen water damage early warning, emergency evacuation and emergency rescue training to improve personnel's ability to deal with disasters.
5. Prevent the failure of water damage control projects and sudden surges of muddy water, and ensure the timely evacuation of people in threatened areas.
