【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-12-16 13:30: The second coal mining team held a four o'clock pre-shift briefing and arranged for 18 people to work. The main task was to drop the nose and tail of the transport trough and return air trough scraper conveyor to the bottom.
- 2024-12-16 About 14:10: The deputy captain led the workers on duty underground.
- 2024-12-16 About 15:00: The workers arrived at the working site and divided the work. One operator was responsible for loading coal at the lower entrance of the coal bunker along the transport channel of the 12302 fully mechanised caving working face.
- 2024-12-16 16:00: The shift monitor called and asked why the lower entrance belt of the coal bunker was not opened. The operator replied that the coal bunker was blocked and no assistance was needed.
- 2024-12-16 About 16:20: The operator put his upper body into the coal outlet of the coal feeder and used a high-pressure hose to flush water to deal with the blockage. coal and waste rock suddenly gushes out, impacting and burying it.
- 2024-12-16 16:30: Nearby workers arrived at the scene to rescue but were unable to rescue the casualty due to the large amount of coal, and then reported to the dispatch room.
- 2024-12-16 16:55: On-site rescuers rescued the casualty. After simple first aid, they carried him to the ground on a stretcher and transferred him to the shaft with a mining truck.
- 2024-12-16 17:29: The casualty went up the shaft and was taken to the hospital by a mine vehicle. On the way, he was transferred to the hospital by ambulance for rescue.
- 2024-12-16 18:19: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-12-16 21:05: The coal mine reported the accident to Hancheng City Emergency Management Bureau and Weinan City Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2024-12-17 01:02: The coal mine reported the accident in writing to the Shaanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
Workers on the four o'clock shift were arranged to load coal at the lower entrance of the coal bunker in the transportation trough of the 12302 fully mechanised caving working face. After the coal bunker was blocked, he failed to report and formulate special measures as required. He illegally inserted his upper body into the coal outlet of the coal feeder and used a high-pressure hose to clear it. coal and waste rock suddenly poured out, impacting and burying him. He died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally entered the coal outlet of the coal feeder and used a high-pressure hose to flush the blocked warehouse, and was hit and buried by the coal and waste rock that instantly poured out.
2. key contributing factors: After the coal bunker was blocked, it was not reported step by step according to the system, a clearance plan and special safety technical measures were not formulated, and no on-site safety monitoring was arranged.
3. key contributing factors: The mechanization transformation of the coal bunker has not been completed, the coal bunker has not been unmanned, and the coal bunker management responsibilities and systems have not been implemented in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Coal mines should strictly implement risk classification management and control and hidden danger investigation and management, ensure the deployment of security inspection personnel and carry out comprehensive inspections.
2. The hosting company and its superior company should clarify the safety management relationship, implement safety investment in a timely manner and track and rectify.
3. Local regulatory authorities should strengthen supervision and inspection of managed coal mines and urge all parties to implement mine safety responsibilities.
4. Promote the mechanized transformation of coal bunkers and the application of unmanned chemical exploration bunkers, warehouse clearance, and dredging technology and equipment, and ensure that there is no one under the coal bunker.
5. Clarify the responsible departments and persons in charge of coal bunker safety management, and establish and implement coal bunker management, bunker blockage handling and on-site monitoring systems.
6. Improve the accident emergency response and information reporting process, and report accidents promptly and accurately as required.

【Accident Mechanism】
In the morning shift, 5 hand chain hoists are used to lift the rear scraper conveyor chute in the 23301 fully mechanised working face machine roadway. When the chute was transferred from the nose of the machine to the tail of the reloading machine and moved towards the front scraper conveyor, the operator at the 1# hand chain hoist point illegally placed his head between the chute and the side of the top beam of the 1# end bracket. The chute swung sideways and squeezed his head, and he died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the chute was being lifted and transferred, the operator illegally placed his head between the chute and the side of the top beam of the end bracket. The chute swung sideways and squeezed his head.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient research and assessment of risks in equipment replacement operations, and failure to identify the risks of chute swing caused by unbalanced forces, narrow working space, and personnel positions.
3. key contributing factors: There was no unified command on the hoisting of multiple hand chain hoists on site, and full-time safety supervisors failed to detect and stop illegal positions in time.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The main person in charge of the coal mine should implement the main responsibility and play the on-site supervision role of key positions and key personnel.
2. Regulatory authorities should carry out inspections and law enforcement in a standardized manner, and promote the implementation of risk management and control and hidden danger management.
3. Mine safety supervisors should strictly perform their duties and keep abreast of coal mine production and high-risk operation arrangements in a timely manner.
4. Carry out risk identification and on-site control step by step for high-risk equipment lifting operations, and implement on-site safety management responsibilities at all levels.
5. Strictly review operating procedures and safety technical measures and supervise their implementation, and immediately carry out hidden danger investigation and special rectification of unsafe behaviors.
6. Strengthen daily law enforcement inspections in coal mines and assessments of resident mine safety supervisors, and investigate and deal with failure to fulfill responsibilities, ineffective risk management and control, and habitual violations.

- 2025-06-06 07:00-16:00: The well operators successfully dismantled and lifted two old water supply pipelines, and the working position was about 67.5 metres down from the mine entrance.

When the hanging basket rose to about 10 metres from the mine entrance, the wire rope broke, and the hanging basket and the two people fell underground.
- 2025-06-06 17:41: On-site personnel at the mine entrance heard abnormal noises and found that the hanging basket and personnel were missing. They called the relevant construction personnel respectively.

- 2025-06-06 21:40: The coal mine reported the accident to the Shaanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

- 2025-06-06 23:32: Two rescuers took protective measures and formally entered the mine along the ladder room for search and rescue.
- 2025-06-07 00:37: Rescuers found a person who fell underground 120 metres down from the mine entrance and was unresponsive.

- 2025-06-07 15:58: Two people were transported to the well, and medical staff on site confirmed that they were dead.
- 2025-06-07 16:10: Rescue work ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
Two well workers on duty removed the old water supply pipeline from the central air inlet shaft. Due to the loss of their tools, they did not continue to remove the third pipeline and instead used a self-made hanging basket to lift the well. When the gondola rose to about 10 metres from the mine entrance, the redundant lifting wire rope got caught in the gap between the drum and the casing of the electric winch and broke apart due to friction and tear. The gondola and the two people fell into the wellbore, killing two people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally rode a self-made hanging basket to lift underground. The lifting wire rope was entangled in the gap between the electric winch and then friction and tear broke, causing the hanging basket to fall.
2. key contributing factors: There are layers of subcontracting in outsourced projects, construction plans are not approved, safety technical measures are not formulated, safety agreements are not signed, and personnel start work without training.
3. key contributing factors: There are no safety technical managers and safety monitoring personnel at the construction site, and operators have not received well safety education and training and have not obtained necessary protective equipment.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Coal mining enterprises should improve the safety management system for the entire chain and cover all aspects, and clarify key areas and key link responsible departments.
2. The superior company should strengthen the supervision of the outsourcing management and high-risk operations of its coal mines, and establish a construction reporting system for outsourcing projects.
3. Local regulatory authorities should carry out special inspections and rectifications by outsourcing teams, and investigate and deal with illegal subcontracting and illegal high-altitude and hot work.
4. Comprehensively investigate outsourced projects and outsourced personnel, clarify that the dedicated department will continue to track contract performance, transfer and construction status, and eliminate qualification affiliation, illegal subcontracting and contract management.
5. Improve the management system for special operations such as heights, restricted spaces and fire, and refine management responsibilities and control measures.
6. Conduct on-site technical inspections, performance tests and safety assessments on key equipment such as lifting, establish maintenance files and implement maintenance responsibilities.

- 2025-08-25 10:16: The support worker started the vehicle to reverse without authorization, and the vehicle stalled and slid after about 10 metres.

- 2025-08-25 14:15: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver of the trackless rubber tire vehicle did not cut off the power, lock the vehicle or take away the keys after parking. In order to wipe the lens of the laser pointer, the support worker started the vehicle to reverse without authorization, causing the vehicle to lose control and accelerate and slide down. When he tried to use the water tank to stop the vehicle, the vehicle squeezed the operator in the inclined shaft who was replacing the air pressure self-rescue device on the right side. the casualty person died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The support worker illegally drove a trackless rubber-tyred material truck that was not locked, powered off, and the key was not removed. When reversing, the vehicle lost control and slid down, squeezing the worker to death.
2. key contributing factors: vehicle parking locks, power outages, and key management were not implemented; on-site follow-up and security inspections were ignored; cross-operation communication between teams was insufficient; auxiliary transportation risk control, training, and project safety management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Allocate enough construction project safety and engineering technology management personnel to implement leadership and team follow-up.
2. Strict management of trackless rubber-tired vehicles and special inspection of auxiliary transportation.
3. Communicate vehicle injury risk control measures to the front line of operations and check their implementation.
4. Strengthen cross-operation coordination, on-site monitoring and hidden danger investigation.
5. Construction, construction, and supervision units should jointly strengthen on-site safety supervision.
6. Strictly enforce the regulations on power-off, locking, key retrieval, and designated personnel for trackless rubber-tired vehicles when parking, and improve on-site inspections of auxiliary transportation, cross-operation coordination, and vehicle injury risk management and control.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-10-28 14:55 (approximately): The comprehensive mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange routine production and related inspection operations at the 51204 working face.
- 2025-10-28 16:03: The deputy captain led 10 workers underground in 013# manned vehicle.

- 2025-10-28 17:31: On-site personnel inspected the tape storage area and found that a section of the protective net had fallen to the ground.
- 2025-10-28 17:32 (approximately): On-site personnel found that the belt conveyor driver was squeezed between the running tensioning car and the large frame column and was unconscious.
- 2025-10-28 17:33: On-site personnel stopped the machine and called for help through the loudspeaker phone.
- 2025-10-28 17:47: The deputy captain and others arrived at the scene to organise rescue.
- 2025-10-28 17:50: After the belt was broken to release the pre-tightening force of the tensioning car, the casualty was rescued.

【Accident Mechanism】
The installation defect of the circular chain connecting the tape tensioning trolley and the belt supporting trolley caused abnormal noise. The driver of the belt conveyor illegally removed the protective net of the tape storage bin and put his body into the dangerous area of the operating equipment for inspection. The load of the belt conveyor suddenly increased, and the tensioning trolley moved suddenly, squeezing it between the trolley and the large frame column. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the belt conveyor illegally dismantled the protective net of the tape storage bin and entered the dangerous area of the operating equipment. The tensioning car suddenly moved and squeezed him to death.
2. key contributing factors: The installation, inspection and maintenance of the connecting parts of the tensioning and supporting trolleys are not standardized; protective facilities, single-post operation monitoring, on-site safety inspections, special risk identification and training and warning education are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Allocate safety and engineering technical personnel to implement leadership guidance and full-process monitoring of high-risk operations.
2. Implement special inspections and upgrades to the transport belt guardrails and key components.
3. Strengthen pre-shift risk disclosure for single positions, cross-post and temporary operations.
4. Communicate mechanical and electrical transportation risk control measures and establish a closed-loop ledger of hidden dangers.
5. Strictly report accident information and avoid late reporting.
6. Revise the belt transportation and equipment maintenance system, strictly implement power outage, lockout, tagging, and power inspection procedures; upgrade belt protection facilities and install safety interlocking devices.

- 2025-12-13 12:40: Another worker arrived at the scene, and 4 people continued to construct the airtight wall.
- 2025-12-13 14:54 (approximately): Two people entered a closed wall and broke open a temporary wall hole to install an observation tube and were in danger; one person also fell into the wall while rescuing, and the other person felt dizzy and had difficulty breathing and evacuated.

- 2025-12-13 19:02: Two people died after rescue efforts failed at Fugu County Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital.
- 2025-12-13 19:10: Another person died after rescue efforts failed at Fugu County People’s Hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
The oxygen concentration in the temporary sealing wall in the goaf area is only 3.7565%, and the mine has not yet taken any measures and organised the construction of a permanent sealing wall. The workers broke open a hole in the temporary sealed wall to install an observation tube in a blind alley without special safety measures, effective ventilation or gas detection. Low-oxygen gas gushed out from the goaf, causing two people to suffocate due to lack of oxygen. Another person also suffocated after blindly entering for rescue, resulting in three deaths.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: There were no measures to smash holes in the temporary closed wall of the isolated goaf area. Low-oxygen gas gushed out, causing hypoxia and suffocation for two people. The other person blindly rescued, which led to the expansion of the accident.
2. key contributing factors: gas anomaly alarms and hypoxic detection results in the goaf were not dealt with; airtight wall construction, blind tunnel ventilation, gas detection and on-site monitoring were missing; custody safety responsibilities, technical approvals, risk control and special training failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Standardize the overall custody, clarify the safety responsibilities of the entrusting party and the trustee, and strengthen the supervision of the whole process.
2. Establish a safety responsibility system covering all employees and the entire process, and staff it with professional safety management personnel.
3. Implement high-risk operation control and penetrating inspection for closed wall construction and goaf management.
4. Carry out regular emergency drills for suffocation accidents to ensure that personnel can use self-rescuers and provide timely and scientific rescue.
5. Strictly implement an accident information reporting system to prevent late reporting and omissions.
6. Formulate special technical measures for the construction, ventilation adjustment and unsealing of closed walls in goaf areas; strictly implement one project for one measure, construction acceptance and the setting of observation holes, measure holes and drainage holes.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-12-31 05:30: The project department held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the construction of the 5# drilling rig and safety risk management and control on duty.
- 2025-12-31 06:30: Shift personnel entered the mine.
- 2025-12-31 07:10: The workers arrived at the operating site of the 5# drilling rig, and after completing the safety confirmation for the start of construction, they continued to construct the pre-extraction drilling through the layer.
- 2025-12-31 10:48: When the drilling was withdrawn to the remaining 3 drill pipes, the drilling site planned a power outage for maintenance, and the drilling operation was terminated.
- 2025-12-31 11:55: The methane sensor of the 5# drilling rig began to alarm beyond the limit, and the positioning card immediately alarmed; the on-site personnel evacuated under the organisation of the security inspector and methane examiner.
- 2025-12-31 11:57: The dispatching room notified 31 personnel in the bottom tunnel to evacuate; the mine launched an emergency plan and organised the evacuation of the entire mine.
- 2025-12-31 12:04: 24 people on the downwind side of the 5# drilling rig evacuated to the gas extraction air inlet lane, and the remaining 3 people evacuated under the leadership of the security inspector.
- 2025-12-31 12:28: All 27 operators on the downwind side of the 5# drilling rig evacuated to the system tunnel.
- 2025-12-31 13:49: Except for the two personnel on duty, all the remaining 436 people underground came up.
- 2025-12-31 14:44: Two personnel on duty went up to the well, and all 438 people underground have been evacuated.

【Accident Mechanism】
Drilling rig No. 5 was drilling through layers for pre-extraction and outburst prevention measures. After drilling into the coal seam, there were abnormalities such as the water return volume becoming smaller and the drilling being withdrawn being blocked. The coal slag erupted when the drilling was performed under conditions such as high gas pressure, changes in coal seam thickness, and concentrated surface well fracturing stress. The blowout preventer fell off, and the coal slag flooded the drilling rig and released a large amount of gas. After the methane sensor exceeded the limit and alarmed, personnel were organised to evacuate.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Cinders erupted and gas gushed out under abnormal drilling and withdrawal conditions in the pre-extraction borehole, and the blowout prevention device fell off, causing gas to exceed the limit and personnel to be in danger.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient gas geological exploration and research and judgment of high stress and high gas areas; unreliable fixing, sealing and maintenance of blowout prevention devices, and deficiencies in refined management of drilling construction, on-site monitoring and emergency response.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the dynamic comparison of gas geological data and the evaluation of surface well drainage effects.
2. Strict on-site video supervision, technical explanation and acceptance of disaster management.
3. Improve the pipe diameter, sealing and fixing reliability of the blowout hole system.
4. Establish a unified access, training and responsibility tracing mechanism for disaster management teams.
5. Strengthen monitoring, early warning and maintenance, emergency drills and local mine supervision.
6. Strengthen the dynamic analysis of coal seam thickness, gas pressure and stress concentration areas, optimize drilling slag discharge and hydraulic punching processes; improve the sealing, fixation and maintenance standards of blowout prevention devices and slag discharge extraction pipelines.

The roof of the goaf in the No. 5 mountainous area collapsed, and a large amount of carbon monoxide gushed out through the sealed cracks in the goaf, causing poisoning of workers working in the return air tunnel.

Without mechanical ventilation and gas detection, people enter blind alleys formed by flooding with water. Mixed gases such as gas, carbon monoxide, and carbon dioxide in windless areas can cause suffocation and poisoning.

【Accident Mechanism】
The motor and reduction gearbox were illegally shipped in the same vehicle with an uneven load, and the binding and acceptance did not meet the requirements; after the reduction gearbox was removed, sleepers were not used to block the flatbed truck. When the motor was lifted, the flatbed truck tilted up and the motor flipped, pinching the operator between the motor and the brake truck.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When unloading the motor from the offset-loaded flatbed truck, the flatbed truck tilted and the motor flipped over, pinching and killing the operator who was illegally between the motor and the brake truck.
2. key contributing factors: The motor and reduction gearbox were transported in the same vehicle in violation of regulations and the binding did not meet the regulations, and the transportation acceptance was invalid.
3. key contributing factors: No sleepers were used to block the flatbed truck when unloading, and the operator's position was unsafe.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement safety operations and large-piece transportation management systems.
2. Strengthen on-site inspections, hidden danger management and anti-"three violations".
3. Improve the scientific nature and operability of mechanical and electrical transportation regulations and measures.
4. Optimize the way mine leaders lead teams, covering key positions and key links.
5. When large materials are shipped on a single vehicle, they must be tied with "eight" characters at the four corners as required and handover and acceptance must be implemented.
6. Before unloading the truck, use sleepers to set up "cross" blocks, and it is prohibited to use supporting anchors and cables to lift heavy objects.

Security inspector Wei Bangfa reported to the security station. Then the staff on duty drilled four 3m long penetration rods (made from 24kg/m scrap rails) 45o upward from the left shoulder of the shed to the center line of the lane to control the front roof.
- 2017-04-28 19:05: When preparing to do the lifting work, Huang Moumou suddenly surged out from the upper left corner of the working face and buried Wei Moumou and Ru Jianjun below the waist. On-site workers Zhou Moumou, Wang Moumou, Shi Moumou and others immediately dug up the yellow mud to save people. After more than ten seconds, Huang Moumou poured out of the rupture point. Squad leader Wang Chenghu shouted "Run", and other personnel quickly evacuated the accident site to the airport entrance. The rushing out Huang Moumou completely buried Zhou Zicheng, who was rescued by Ru Jianjun, Wei Moumou and Moumou.
- 2017-04-28 21:15: Three people who were buried in the water were rescued and sent to Jingmei General Hospital for rescue
- 2017-04-28 21:45: Died after rescue failed. The forensic autopsy report concluded that Ru Jianjun, Wei Moumou, and Zhou Zicheng all died due to suffocation during their lifetime.

【Accident Mechanism】
After signs of yellow mud dripping appeared, the site did not stop work and evacuate people, and the accumulated grouting situation was not identified. Disturbed by the excavation, yellow mud burst out from the upper left corner of the head and buried people twice.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The grout accumulation was not identified when passing through the damaged area of the old kiln. The grout was disturbed and the grout burst out and buried people.
2. key contributing factors: Measures to detect when in doubt, explore first before digging, and effectively explore and release water have not been implemented.
3. key contributing factors: Failure to safely assess slurry accumulation and formulate reliable anti-slurry measures before resuming excavation.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Construction shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the design and approval, and major changes shall be re-examined.
2. Improve the water prevention and control responsibility system and hidden danger reporting channels.
3. Carry out technical demonstration on the re-exploitation of damaged areas of old kilns.
4. Implement advanced water discharge, detection, water drainage and slurry prevention measures during excavation in the damaged area of ​​the old kiln.
5. Standardize grouting dehydration time, dehydration amount and water damage forecasting system.
6. Strengthen training on flood prevention and control, identification of signs of slurry collapse, emergency evacuation, and self-rescue and mutual rescue.

【Accident Mechanism】
After cutting coal, the distance between the end faces of the lower exit transition frame and the basic frame was too large to form an empty roof. 3. key contributing factors: No supplementary special safety technical measures have been formulated for crossing the broken zone, and the existing regulations are not targeted enough.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Optimize the working face layout and support design to avoid stress concentration and the influence of geological structural zones.
2. Carry out key investigation and closed-loop management of hidden problems in the roof.

4. The group company strengthens mining replacement, design and training management.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the maintenance personnel cleaned up the floating coal in the tension pit and removed the guardrails, they issued a start-up signal without restoring the guardrails and evacuating people; the tape operation caused the floating coal to slide into the pit, and the maintenance fitter who was standing on the floating coal slid in and was hit in the chest with the handle of a shovel and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The guardrail was not restored and the belt conveyor was started before people were evacuated. The maintenance fitter slipped into the tensioning pit with the floating coal and was hit in the chest with a shovel handle and died.
2. key contributing factors: personnel evacuation was not confirmed before starting the machine, and the conveyor starting procedure and emergency stop failure handling were not standardized.
3. key contributing factors: Daily maintenance did not eliminate the hidden dangers of the rollers in time, power was not cut off during maintenance, and on-site supervision was not arranged.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen dynamic safety supervision of production classes and inspections of remote transportation locations.
2. Tape maintenance must be supervised on-site by the shift leader.
3. Implement the investigation and management of hidden dangers in mechanical and electrical transportation and strictly investigate the "three violations".
4. Carry out accident warning education for all employees and investigate similar hidden dangers within the group.
5. After maintenance, restore the guardrail, cut off the power, and confirm that people have evacuated before starting the machine.
6. Strengthen daily inspection, maintenance and rectification of hidden dangers on belt rollers and other components.

After the powered support was adjusted and parked in the inclined tunnel, the winch wire rope was released illegally on site and personnel were allowed to enter the ropeway to get the pulley. - 2018-05-05 00:04: The supervisory agency received a telephone accident report from the company.
- 2018-05-05 01:04: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the retraction transportation, the tail of the aircraft was blocked by the flange of the alleyway pipeline, and the on-site personnel lifted it up in violation of regulations before evacuating to a safe place; the binding wire rope was pulled off, and the tail of the aircraft slipped from the flatbed truck and slid down the diagonal alley, injuring the squad leader who was running towards the bottom bend.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the tail of the aircraft was blocked by an alley pipe, it was lifted illegally without evacuating people from the scene. The binding wire rope broke, causing the tail of the aircraft to slide down, injuring the operator and causing death.
2. key contributing factors: The withdrawal transportation system has not been accepted by the mine and the company, and the transportation safety distance is insufficient.
3. key contributing factors: Transportation handover, vigilance and unified command were not implemented, and on-site labor organisation was chaotic.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the management of key projects, clarify responsibilities and arrange full-time security inspectors for patrol inspections.
2. Carry out transportation system risk pre-control and hidden danger investigation and management.
3. Strictly investigate illegal commands, illegal operations and late reporting.
4. The company carries out special self-inspections on equipment installation, retrieval and large-piece transportation.
5. Correct transportation safety distances and pipeline impacts, and strictly implement withdrawal transportation acceptance procedures.
6. Evacuate personnel before operating in dangerous areas, and provide unified command to deal with jams, slippage and tilting of large items.

During the lowering of materials, the excavation workers and their colleagues ignored the "driving, no pedestrians allowed" signal and entered the transportation mountain. When they were climbing the ladder around the coal feeder, they were hit, crushed and dragged by a string of trucks being lowered from above, causing fatal injuries.

4. The group company carries out special inspections on the lifting and transportation systems of each mine.

【Accident Mechanism】
The driver of the dump truck drove the vehicle to the edge of the unloading platform with no continuous retaining wall, no reverse slope and cracks to discharge earth. The vehicle became unstable, the front of the vehicle tilted up and then slid down a slope about 30m high. The driver was seriously injured and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the dump truck illegally discharged soil at the edge of the unsafe soil unloading platform. The vehicle became unstable and slid to the bottom of the slope, causing his death.
2. key contributing factors: The temporary road has no design and safety technical measures, and the soil is not discharged in layers.
3. key contributing factors: The unloading platform has no continuous safety retaining wall, reverse slope, lighting and warning signs, and there are landslide cracks.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out comprehensive investigation and management of potential safety hazards in dumpsites and slopes.
2. Implement the system of pre-class meetings, no homework until the rectification of hidden dangers and leadership guidance.
3. Improve operating procedures, operating procedures and safety technical measures.
4. It is strictly prohibited to reverse the dump truck at high speed and take risks.
5. Improve the safety retaining wall, reverse slope, lighting, communication and soil unloading warning facilities in the dump site.
6. Develop and implement designs and “one project, one measure” for temporary roads.

- 2019-04-01 07:38: The company's safety supervision department called to report the accident.
- 2019-04-01 08:15: The company's safety supervision department continued to report the accident via fax.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the main wash failure, the coal flow was diverted to the original coal bunker; when the 302 belt conveyor was running, the inspection workers illegally entered the coal chute at the head of the machine to deal with the jam, fell into the chute, and were suffocated by the buried pressure of coal that continued to enter.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The inspection worker violated regulations and blocked the coal chute when the conveyor was running. He fell into the chute and was suffocated by the coal pressure and died.
2. key contributing factors: The installation angle of the coal chute does not comply with the original design, and the problem of frequent jamming has not been fundamentally rectified.
3. key contributing factors: Safety facilities such as tail drum protection, video surveillance and coal chute operating platform are missing or ineffective.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. To deal with the jamming of the coal chute, the machine must be stopped, locked and tagged out.
2. Strengthen safety inspections and hidden danger management in washing plants and other ground places.
3. Implement the safety responsibilities of district team managers in following and leading the team.
4. Strictly investigate illegal operations and improve the production safety responsibility system.
5. Install the coal chute as designed, set up an operating platform at the coal hole, and improve the protection and video surveillance of the transmission parts.
6. Optimize the washing system and coal bunker management to reduce transfer links and frequent jams.

- 2019-05-08 21:20 (around): The division of work on the winch, warning, signaling and self-moving devices was completed on site, and the winch-assisted pulling was started.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the equipment train became difficult to move, no special measures were taken at the site, so a winch was used to assist the movement in violation of regulations, and the guide pulley was fixed on the permanent support anchor. The anchor broke due to shear force, and the guide pulley fell, hitting the security inspector who illegally entered the warning area.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the security inspector entered the warning area, the permanent support anchor carrying the guide pulley broke, and the pulley fell out, injuring him to death.
2. key contributing factors: Without formulating special safety technical measures, a winch was used illegally to assist in pulling the equipment train, and the pulley was fixed on the permanent support anchor.
3. key contributing factors: Safety management personnel and security personnel failed to effectively prevent illegal operations and personnel from entering dangerous areas.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out a major inspection of mechanical and electrical transportation safety and improve the system.
2. Temporary high-risk operations must be assigned special personnel for coordination, guidance and on-site supervision.
3. Stop and report immediately when operating conditions change and existing procedures are no longer applicable.
4. Implement the hidden danger investigation and management and anti-"three violations" systems.
5. Promote measures such as long-distance liquid supply and power supply to reduce the number of on-site workers.
6. Develop special safety technical measures for on-site conditions where it is difficult to move equipment trains by themselves.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-10-19 06:40: The 6 left-behind staff held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 1 methane examiner to check the gas and 4 people for drainage.
- 2019-10-19 07:00: 6 people entered the mine from the auxiliary well in a car.
- 2019-10-19 07:13: After arriving at the bend at the bottom of the auxiliary shaft, the workers went separately to the drainage point, substation and gas check point.
- 2019-10-19 12:39: The methane examiner left the 1060 substation and began to check the gas along the way.
- 2019-10-19 12:40: The methane examiner notified the workers working in the 801 water pump room to turn on the local ventilator in the return air lane of the 2525 fully mechanised caving working face.
- 2019-10-19 13:11: The methane examiner arrived at the 940 substation.
- 2019-10-19 14:14: The methane examiner left the 940 substation and went up the mountain via the return air to the return air lane of the 2525 fully mechanised caving working face.
- 2019-10-19 14:50 (approximately): The methane examiner entered the sealed area of ​​the return air lane alone to check the gas, and suffocated and fell to the ground in the windless and oxygen-free section.
- 2019-10-19 19:14: The leader of the mine discovered that the methane examiner had not gone up the well, and asked the dispatching room for his location and arranged for night shift personnel to search for him.
- 2019-10-19 20:00 (approximately): The night shift staff found a methane examiner lying on the ground in the return air alley; they felt difficulty breathing when approaching, and the detector alarm showed that the oxygen concentration was 14%, so they immediately retreated and connected the disconnected air duct.
- 2019-10-19 20:08: The night shift leader reported the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2019-10-19 20:54: Four rescuers entered the return air lane to check and confirmed that the gas returned to normal.
- 2019-10-19 21:15: The dispatch room ordered the rescuers to enter the return air alley and carry the casualty to the entrance of the alley on a simple stretcher.
- 2019-10-19 21:48: The dispatch room ordered the casualty to be escorted up the shaft, and the rescuers used mine trucks to transport them through the inclined shaft.
- 2019-10-20 00:00 (approximately): The casualties were rescued and lifted underground, and then sent to a medical institution.
- 2019-10-20 02:00: The medical institution diagnosed and confirmed that the casualty person died.
- 2019-10-20 07:00 (approximately): The mine manager reported the case to the police station, falsely claiming that the employee died of illness in the dormitory.
- 2019-10-20 08:31: The company’s deputy general manager reported to the Chongxin County Emergency Management Bureau, falsely claiming that an employee died of a sudden illness in the dormitory.
- 2019-10-20 20:25: Chongxin County Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident by fax to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the shutdown period, only drainage and gas inspections will be conducted at the mine. The local ventilator in the return air lane was not continuously managed, and the air duct was disconnected 35 metres away from the closed wall, forming an anoxic and windless section; the methane examiner did not enter the area alone according to the requirements of the double-post patrol inspection, and fell to the ground due to lack of oxygen and suffocation. He was later rescued and raised to the well and was confirmed dead.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The methane examiner violated regulations and entered the airless and oxygen-free return air alley caused by the disconnection of the local ventilation duct to inspect the gas alone, and died of suffocation.
2. key contributing factors: Local ventilators were not managed by dedicated personnel, detached air ducts were not dealt with promptly and were installed illegally; measures for double-post tours, ventilation and hidden danger investigation were not implemented during the production shutdown; on-site roof maintenance, education and training, and safety risk identification were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Follow the mine leaders to strictly perform on-site supervision and inspection responsibilities to ensure the implementation of safety measures for production shutdown.
2. Strengthen the investigation and management of safety hazards in coal mines that have been suspended for a long time, and implement the main responsibilities of enterprises.
3. Report dangers and accidents promptly and truthfully, and late reporting, concealment, and false reporting are strictly prohibited.
4. Regulatory authorities should strengthen on-site surveillance or safety inspections of coal mines that have been suspended for a long time.
5. During the long-term shutdown period, the two channels along the 2525 working face will be closed and fences will be installed, local ventilation will be cancelled, and personnel will not be allowed to enter the windless tunnel; during the shutdown period, inspections of potential safety hazards and inspections at the mine will be strengthened.
6. Carry out ventilation, tile inspection and emergency response training during production shutdowns to improve risk identification, self-rescue and mutual rescue and compliance operations.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-12-08 12:30: The selection team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange 13 personnel and positions at the head, middle section and tail of the 101 belt conveyor.
- 2019-12-08 13:00 (approximately): Shift personnel arrived at their posts one after another and start working.
- 2019-12-08 17:24: The driver of the belt conveyor opened the head guardrail of the 101 belt conveyor to clean up the falling coal.
- 2019-12-08 17:46: When the driver was using a rake to clean up fallen coal, he was caught between the bottom tape and the roller, and his head hit the roller.
- 2019-12-08 19:51: The workers at the middle section found that the casualty person was caught between the bottom belt and the roller, and immediately stopped the machine and reported; the mine started an emergency plan.
- 2019-12-08 19:51: The workers of the sports selection team cut the bottom tape, rescued the casualty and sent them to the hospital for rescue.
- 2019-12-08 20:05: The mine manager received the accident report.
- 2019-12-08 20:45: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2019-12-08 20:58: The mine director reported the casualties to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the middle shifter was working on the head of the 101 belt conveyor, the driver of the belt conveyor opened the unlocked head guardrail to clean up the falling coal. The equipment continued to run. When he was cleaning with a rake, he was caught between the bottom tape and the roller. His head was hit and he died after being rescued.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the belt conveyor illegally opened the head guardrail to clean up the falling coal during the operation of the 101 belt conveyor, and was caught between the bottom belt and the roller and died.
2. key contributing factors: The machine head guardrail was not fixed and locked, resulting in serious coal falling; the hidden dangers of single-post personnel cleaning up coal falling on operating equipment were not checked, and inspections and video monitoring were not in place; the shift handover sanitation and cleaning system did not specify shutdown requirements, and job risk training was insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate and control safety risks in each position, and improve the hidden danger investigation and management system.
2. Improve the transportation system and system, and strictly enforce the mine safety responsibility system and the requirements for mobile and human immobility.
3. Management personnel go deep into the site, absorb the opinions of workers, and scientifically determine risk points.
4. Strengthen targeted safety warning education and resolutely put an end to the three violations.
5. The group carried out safety inspections on the ground production system and ancillary sites.
6. Systematically check the protective devices of the transportation system, improve protection, video monitoring and remote centralized control, reduce coal falling and pile up, and implement dedicated monitoring and video alarms.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-01-11 07:30: The roadway maintenance team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 27 personnel to replace the 1405 wind inlet endless rope winch wire rope.
- 2020-01-11 08:30 (approximately): Personnel arrived at the work site one after another and were on standby at the bottom curve, upper parking lot and various working locations.
- 2020-01-11 08:40 (approximately): The transportation team transported the flatbed truck equipped with wire rope and rope coiling device to the damper.
- 2020-01-11 09:10: The dispatching winch was used on site to lift the flatbed truck with the rope coiling device to the upper yard, and then arranged for personnel to push it from behind the truck.
- 2020-01-11 09:10: The flatbed truck could not be pushed in the curve. High-pressure hoses were used on site to allow 4 people to pull the truck in front of the truck and 4 people to push the truck behind the truck.
- 2020-01-11 09:20: The flatbed truck suddenly moved forward about 500 mm, and the rear wheels tilted and turned to the left. The squad leader of the rear cart was caught between the rope coiling device and the alley gang.
- 2020-01-11 09:20: On-site personnel used anchor chains and hand hoists to move the overturned flatbed truck, rescued the casualty and sent them to the ground.
- 2020-01-11 09:30: The security inspector reported the accident to the dispatch room, the mine activated the emergency plan and arranged for an ambulance to wait at the mine entrance.
- 2020-01-11 09:50: The casualties were escorted out of the well.
- 2020-01-11 10:03: The mine dispatching room reported the accident to the dispatching room of Huating Coal Mining Group Co., Ltd.
- 2020-01-11 10:34: The casualties were sent to Huating Second People's Hospital for rescue.
- 2020-01-11 11:00: The Safety Supervision Department of Huating Coal Mining Group Co., Ltd. reported the accident to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.
- 2020-01-11 11:30: The casualty died due to ineffective rescue efforts.

【Accident Mechanism】
When replacing the wire rope of the endless rope winch in the morning shift, the approximately 10-ton rope coiled flatbed truck was lifted to the upper yard by the dispatching winch, but it could not continue to be pushed manually on the hard curved and uneven track. A high-pressure hose was used at the scene to allow people to pull in front of the vehicle and push it from behind. The vehicle suddenly moved forward and rolled over. The squad leader pushing the vehicle behind lost his point of strength and jumped forward. He was pinched by the rope coiling device and the alley gang and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Personnel illegally pulled and pushed a flatbed truck equipped with a wire rope in the upper parking lot. The vehicle suddenly rolled over and the tunnel maintenance worker pushing the truck behind was pinched and killed.
2. key contributing factors: Large items are transported by manpower, and the track is hard and uneven; risk identification and special measures were not carried out for manual transportation of large items; illegal pulling of trucks was not stopped on site, technical measures and training were insufficient, and security inspectors were on duty without certificates.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out risk identification and hidden danger investigation before construction. Construction is strictly prohibited when the risks are unclear or the hidden dangers have not been controlled.
2. Strictly abide by the operating procedures for human-powered carts. It is prohibited to pull carts in front of the vehicle and push carts on both sides.
3. Regularly inspect transportation lines to ensure that the track gauge, fasteners and curve quality meet standards.
4. Develop and implement special safety technical measures for large-scale transportation.
5. Carry out special inspections of transportation systems in affiliated mines.
6. Conduct a technical analysis of the transportation methods of large items, and switch to mechanical transportation when manual carts are not suitable; optimize the design of the transportation system, transfer links and track laying.

- 2020-01-15 19:30: The fully mechanised mining team held a pre-night shift meeting to arrange normal production of the 31503 fully mechanised mining face, find the coal wall, and lay down the protective panels to prepare for the production shutdown the next day.
- 2020-01-15 20:18: Night shift workers enter the mine in cages.

- 2020-01-15 20:35 (approximately): The deputy captain of the night shift went alone from the nose of the reloading aircraft to the safety exit under the working face.
- 2020-01-15 20:40 (approximately): When he passed the safety exit, he was injured by falling coal from the working face.
- 2020-01-15 20:40: The driver of the scraper conveyor made an emergency stop and reported it. On-site personnel arrived at the accident site to carry out rescue operations; the deputy captain of the middle shift reported to the deputy production manager and the dispatch room.
- 2020-01-15 21:14: On-site personnel used a simple stretcher to escort the casualty from the auxiliary shaft to the shaft.

- 2020-01-15 23:00: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2020-01-15 23:59: The mine manager reported the accident by phone to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the night shift takes over the shift at the 31503 fully mechanised caving working face, the working face equipment is still operating normally. The deputy captain of the night shift entered the working face through the safety exit alone. Coal pieces rolled down from the coal wall of the working face jumped out from the scraper conveyor area and injured him. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: During the operation of the equipment, the deputy captain illegally entered the lower safety exit and was injured to death by coal that rolled down and jumped out of the scraper conveyor area.
2. key contributing factors: No anti-coal and waste rock escape facilities are installed at the safety exit under the steeply inclined working face; no targeted risk identification has been carried out; personnel vigilance during coal and waste rock prevention and equipment operation is not in place; exit protection is not stipulated in the coal and waste rock prevention measures, and hidden danger investigation, shift management and training are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the main responsibilities of the enterprise and improve the allocation of safety management personnel and on-site management.
2. Strengthen risk identification and hidden danger investigation throughout the entire process, and promptly rectify hidden dangers in support, transportation and protective facilities.
3. Revise the job responsibility system and operating procedures, and strictly implement measures to formulate, review, approve, and study.
4. Strictly lead the mine leaders to lead the team, and keep watch on key links and key parts.
5. Strengthen safety education, training and strict assessment.
6. Set up safety exits under the fully mechanised mining working face to prevent coal and waste rock from escaping and injuring people, and improve measures to prevent coal and waste rock and restrict personnel access during equipment operation.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-04-10 21:00: The first comprehensive coal mining team held a pre-night shift meeting to report hidden dangers in the work area and arrange coal cutting tasks.
- 2020-04-10 21:00: The workers arrived at the transportation channel of the East 1103 working face and started working after learning the mechanical and electrical safety measures; the sections above the No. 65 bracket were first processed on site.

- 2020-04-11 06:00: A loud noise occurred when the scraper conveyor at the rear of the No. 19 powered support was being pulled on site, and the coal cleaner was found to be pressed between the No. 16 support column and the cable trough by waste rock.

【Accident Mechanism】
The night shift's East 1103 working face continued to deal with the roof leakage of the bracket sections 78 to 88. When the coal cleaner illegally stayed in front of the No. 16 support in the lower section, a large piece of waste rock that fell from the No. 78 to 80 support in the upper section slid down the large-slope cable trough, hit the shearer guard plate and flew out, injuring him to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A large piece of waste rock from the roof of No. 78 to No. 80 supports slid down along the cable trough and flew out, hitting the coal cleaner who was illegally staying in front of No. 16 support and between the scraper conveyor.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to move the machine and provide timely protection and support, and there are empty roofs and empty roofs on supports No. 78 to 80; failure to implement key follow-up and hidden danger rectification when the working area was severely damaged; insufficient inspection of safety technical measures, risk identification and targeted training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen on-site support management to ensure that the initial support force and control distance of the support meet the requirements.
2. Improve the safety management of leadership, follow-up and night shifts, optimize labor organisation and gradually reduce night shift production.
3. Carry out the three-in-one work of risk classification management and control, hidden danger investigation and management, and mine safety standardization.
4. Strict training before taking up the job and implementing the procedures and measures.
5. Carry out special inspections on roof management and accident warning education.
6. Pull out the bracket and connect the roof guard in time according to the regulations. If the roof is broken or the support fails, stop production immediately and eliminate the hidden dangers; strictly follow the five implementation requirements to rectify the hidden dangers of the roof.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-08-16 05:20: The second coal mining team held a pre-morning shift meeting, arranged for 16 personnel to work and emphasized safety precautions.
- 2020-08-16 05:40: Early shift workers enter the mine one after another.
- 2020-08-16 06:00: Personnel arrived at the working face and divided their labors to carry out work such as drilling holes, moving racks, cleaning coal and operating conveying equipment.
- 2020-08-16 11:40: After the third stage of blasting, there was an abnormal sound and large pieces of coal and waste rock fell above the support; on-site personnel used wood and single hydraulic props for reinforcement.
- 2020-08-16 12:10: The top beams of the No. 4 and 5 supports sank, and a large amount of mud instantly collapsed from the coal wall at the front end of the supports; personnel evacuated along both ends, but the coal cleanup workers failed to evacuate.
- 2020-08-16 12:20: The coal mine reported the accident to the Huating City Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2020-08-16 12:45: Huating City Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident by phone to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.
- 2020-08-16 13:10: The deputy mine director of electromechanical and other personnel arrived at the site to inspect and arranged for all workers on duty to go up the well.
- 2020-08-16 18:10: A second slurry failure occurred, and the scope of sedimentation on the working face and the wind inlet channel expanded.
- 2020-08-17 06:31: The third slurry collapse occurred, and the scope of siltation further expanded.
- 2020-08-23 04:35: Rescuers found trapped people in the slurry area.
- 2020-08-23 06:03: The trapped persons were escorted up the well.
- 2020-08-23 06:20: The emergency doctor confirmed that the trapped person had no vital signs and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After blasting the 1392 horizontal working face in the morning shift, there was an abnormal sound above the support and coal and waste rock fell. The softened mixture formed by grouting, water injection and long-term soaking of old hollow seepage water in the upper multi-layered goaf broke out from the front beams of No. 4 and 5 supports under the influence of blasting vibration and top coal fracturing, burying workers who were clearing coal.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal slime and gravel mixture formed by long-term soaking of grouting, water injection and old hollow seepage in the upper goaf broke out from the front ends of the No. 4 and 5 supports of the working face under the influence of blasting, burying the coal clearing workers.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to identify the accumulation of slurry in the grouting area and implement water exploration and drainage; grouting records and hydrophobic and dehydration measures were incorrect or not implemented, and no special measures for coal mining in the lower part of the grouting area were formulated; roof management, risk identification and training were insufficient, and people were not evacuated in time to deal with abnormal noise and pressure increase.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The person in charge shall be responsible for the management and control of major disaster risks and the rectification of hidden dangers.
2. Fully identify hidden disaster factors such as the roof, fire, water and harmful gases before resuming mining.
3. Strengthen inspections of goaf areas, subsidence areas, water accumulation areas and surrounding surface water systems, and suspend production and evacuate personnel in case of heavy rains.
4. Work out operational safety technical measures closely in conjunction with the actual conditions of the mine, and construction without measures is strictly prohibited.
5. Improve the support quality and roof management level, and strengthen support in the broken roof area.
6. Before excavation, explore the range and amount of water in the old empty space, and carry out complete inspection, exploration, drainage, and verification; drill holes under the grouting area to drain water before excavation, and implement measures to prevent grouting and water permeability after grouting.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-08-18 07:20: The coal mining team held a pre-morning shift meeting, arranged work for 17 personnel and emphasized safety precautions.
- 2020-08-18 07:20: All personnel entered the mine one after another.
- 2020-08-18 08:30 (approximately): 15 personnel arrived at the 2103 coal face and began normal mining; the operators carried out coal filing and support work according to sections.
- 2020-08-18 10:35: The shearer was cutting coal about 70 metres away from the lower exit of the working face. The waste rock from the separation layer slipped and toppled the temporary pillar, causing the broken roof to fall and hit the coal filing worker in the machine tunnel.
- 2020-08-18 10:35: On-site personnel stopped, called and carried out rescue, bandaged the head of the casualty and transported him on a temporary stretcher.
- 2020-08-18 10:47: The team leader reported the accident to the mine manager, and the mine launched an emergency plan and organised a rescue.
- 2020-08-18 11:20: The casualty person went up the well and was sent to Wuwei Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital for rescue after simple treatment by the mine doctor.
- 2020-08-18 15:00 (approximately): The casualty arrived at Wuwei Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2020-08-20 16:20: The mine director reported the accident to the Shandan County Emergency Management Bureau and the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.
- 2020-08-20 17:11: Shandan County Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident by fax to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the morning shift mining, coal cutters entered the machine tunnel to work during the normal operation of the shearer and scraper conveyor. When the coal shearer was cutting coal, the waste rock from the upper separation layer slipped and toppled the temporary pillar, causing the broken roof to fall. The coal-cutting worker was injured and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal cutter illegally entered the machine tunnel during operation of the shearer and scraper conveyor, and was injured to death by waste rock falling from the roof.
2. key contributing factors: The broken roof was not reinforced with support, and temporary columns were not prevented from falling over or wearing iron boots; the procedures and supplementary measures were not revised after the support method was changed; there was insufficient on-site hazard investigation, personnel restraint, and training, and there were gaps in the safety management system.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the safety organizational structure and responsibility system, and deepen the construction of a dual prevention system.
2. Strictly follow the lead and investigate and manage hidden dangers, strengthen on-site control and eliminate three violations.
3. Re-evaluate coal mining technology and equipment and promote the reduction of personnel and improvement of efficiency.
4. Carry out accident warning education and promptly and truthfully report production safety accidents.
5. Strengthen local supervision and urge coal mines to comply with production safety laws and regulations.
6. Optimize the support methods and parameters, and equip them with instruments for detecting the initial supporting force of pillars; timely revise operating procedures or supplement safety measures when the working face changes, and strictly implement pillar collapse prevention and roof management.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-08-20 06:20: The lane repair area held a pre-morning shift meeting to arrange work for 22 personnel and emphasize safety precautions.
- 2020-08-20 07:00 (approximately): The district chief received a report from the night shift electrician that a fault in the 55-kilowatt winch switch caused the primary feed switch to trip, and immediately arranged for a maintenance team to go down to the mine to deal with it.
- 2020-08-20 08:20: Three people from the maintenance team arrived at the lower section of the No. 3 coal return air tunnel, confirmed that the handle of the No. 2 feed switch was in the breaking position, removed the fuse and listed it, and began to replace the burned winch switch.
- 2020-08-20 08:20: After the original switch cable is removed and the wiring is prepared, in order not to affect the operation of the belt conveyor, the on-site division of labor consists of one person delivering the first-level feed switch power, one person guarding the winch chamber, and one person inspecting the equipment.
- 2020-08-20 08:40 (approximately): After the first-level feed switch sent power, the electric fitter was electrocuted and injured in the winch chamber.
- 2020-08-20 08:40: The deputy district chief organised cardiopulmonary resuscitation for nearby people and reported to the dispatch room; the mine launched an emergency plan and organised rescuers and doctors to go down the mine.
- 2020-08-20 08:50: The deputy district chief reported the accident to the mine dispatch room.
- 2020-08-20 09:24: The casualty was escorted out of the well, and the team doctors continued the rescue before being sent to the hospital by ambulance.
- 2020-08-20 09:50: The person in charge of the mine reported the accident to the Chongxin County Emergency Management Bureau.
- 2020-08-20 10:19: Chongxin County Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident over the phone to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.
- 2020-08-20 11:16: Chongxin County Emergency Management Bureau reported the accident by fax to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.
- 2020-08-20 14:56: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the morning maintenance shift replaced the 55-kilowatt winch switch, although the handle of the No. 2 feeder switch was in the breaking position, the power was not truly cut off due to contact adhesion. The electric fitter failed to take measures such as testing electricity, discharging, and hanging ground wires, and did not wear insulating protective equipment and connected cables without supervision. He was electrocuted due to direct contact with live core wires.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The load-side cable was still charged when the handle of the No. 2 feed switch was disconnected. The electric fitter connected the winch switch without taking measures such as testing, discharging, and grounding, and received an electric shock when touching the core wire of the live cable.
2. key contributing factors: The feed switch contacts are stuck, and the well inspection and acceptance are not in place; the power supply outage work ticket is not issued, and the person in charge of construction and safety is not designated; insulating protective equipment is not worn, and there is no one to monitor; there are loopholes in equipment listing charter, mechanical and electrical management, and safety training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate loopholes in the mechanical and electrical maintenance and equipment replacement system, and establish a management system that is consistent with the actual conditions of the mine.
2. Strictly implement the work ticket and operation ticket system for power outages, as well as the system of who will send power when there is a power outage.
3. Electrical maintenance must include power outage, lockout, power inspection, discharge, grounding and tag-out, and a guardian must be present.
4. Arrange mechanical and electrical equipment management personnel to regularly inspect and test electrical equipment and protective devices.
5. Strengthen training on safe technical operations and hazard identification to prevent illegal operations.
6. Stop using and conduct a comprehensive inspection of the feed switch of the same model, confirm that the power outage lockout is normal and the inspection is qualified before use; strictly implement the equipment acceptance underground and the entire process of inspection and maintenance.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-09-21 20:45: The deputy district chief held a pre-night shift meeting. 12 personnel attended the work and were briefed on safety precautions.
- 2020-09-21 20:45: The workers arrived at the 1423 three-layer fully mechanised caving working face one after another. The squad leader assigned tasks such as operating the front and rear and transport trough scraper conveyors, cleaning waste rock and coal accumulation, etc.
- 2020-09-22 03:00 (approximately): After the second cut of coal is cut on the working face, the top coal is placed.
- 2020-09-22 04:30: It was found that there were large pieces of waste rock on the scraper conveyor. The on-site personnel used lights to indicate that the relevant conveyor should be shut down and cleaned up.
- 2020-09-22 04:35: After seeing the waste rock cleaning, the conveyor driver started the transport trough scraper conveyor and brought down the coal filer who was standing on the chute to clean up the coal accumulation.
- 2020-09-22 04:35: On-site personnel called for a shutdown and participated in the rescue, and reported to the dispatch room with the district chief; the mine started an emergency plan.
- 2020-09-22 05:30: The casualty was transported out of the well on a simple stretcher after being simply bandaged, and was sent to the Second Hospital of Lanzhou University for treatment by the ambulance team.
- 2020-09-22 06:16: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the night shift when top coal is placed, a coal scraper stands on the chute of the transport trough scraper conveyor to clean up the coal accumulation at the end. The driver of the conveyor used a flashing light instead of a start-stop signal and started the conveyor without confirming that no one was on the equipment. He knocked down the coal scraper and caused head injuries. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The scraper conveyor along the transport chute suddenly started, knocking down the coal filer who was illegally standing on the chute to clean up the accumulated coal. He was hit on the head and died.
2. key contributing factors: The driver used a flashing light instead of the start/stop signal and did not confirm that no one was on the equipment; the end operation was not blocked due to power outage, and the bracket shifting and support settings did not meet the requirements; there was no start/stop signal device in the middle of the conveyor, the bridge handrails were missing, and the safety exit was not smooth and other hidden dangers were not rectified; safety training was not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish an anti-three-violation investigation and governance mechanism and carry out video surveillance and surprise inspections.
2. Improve the conveyor start and stop signaling devices, bridge handrails and working face video surveillance.
3. Carry out special inspections of mechanical and electrical transportation, rectify hidden dangers according to the five implementation requirements and conduct closed-loop management.
4. Improve the equipment matching and end support of the fully mechanised caving working face.
5. Implement the main responsibilities of the enterprise and strengthen on-site management and accident warning education at the working face.
6. Strictly implement the conveyor start and stop signal, confirmation and power outage locking system. When the conveyor is running, personnel are prohibited from cleaning up nearby coal accumulation; when moving the conveyor, the end bracket must be fully in place.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2020-10-10 05:00: The transportation team held a morning pre-shift briefing to arrange the maintenance of underground transportation equipment and the transfer of coal bunkers and belts on the ground.
- 2020-10-10 05:40: The morning shift personnel arrived at work, and the shift leader led the workers to inspect the ground belt and clean up nearby floating coal.
- 2020-10-10 12:00: There was an underground notification that the coal slime produced by cleaning the tunnel needs to be discharged; the coal feeding equipment at the bottom of the coal bunker failed to discharge coal.
- 2020-10-10 12:00: The squad leader led two people to the upper entrance of the coal bunker to check and decided to enter the coal bunker to clean the coal slime; a general worker wore a safety belt and lowered it to the bottom of the bunker with a brown rope.
- 2020-10-10 12:40: When general workers were dealing with coal accumulation on the funnel wall at the bottom of the coal bunker, the coal slime suddenly loosened and collapsed and buried it.
- 2020-10-10 12:40: The squad leader found that the brown rope was loose and called for help. On-site personnel organised rescue and opened the coal feeding equipment at the bottom of the coal bunker to remove coal.
- 2020-10-10 12:49: The deputy mine entrance inspector reported the accident to the dispatch room; the mine activated the emergency plan and called an ambulance.
- 2020-10-10 13:00: Rescuers cut the belt, removed the fixed parts of the coal feeding equipment, put coal in, and rescued the casualty with the coal flow.
- 2020-10-10 13:07: The ambulance arrived at the mine and sent the casualty to Huating People's Hospital; he died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2020-10-10 15:23: Gansu Huaxin Coal Co., Ltd. reported the accident to the Huating Emergency Management Bureau over the phone.
- 2020-10-10 15:31: Gansu Huaxin Coal Co., Ltd. reported the accident over the phone to the former Gansu Coal Mine Safety Supervision Agency.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the morning shift reported on the ground that the coal bunker was not being discharged smoothly, the squad leader led the staff into the coal bunker to deal with the coal accumulation on the funnel wall. When a general worker was lowering a brown rope to the bottom of the coal bunker to handle coal slime, the coal slime suddenly loosened and collapsed, burying it under pressure. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When a general worker illegally entered the ground transfer coal bunker to deal with the blockage, he was buried by the coal slime that suddenly loosened and collapsed in the bunker wall and suffocated to death.
2. key contributing factors: No special safety technical measures have been formulated to deal with coal bunker blockage; unsuitable and invalid safety belts are used, the coal bunker lacks anti-blocking facilities; labor organisation is unreasonable, and sporadic project management and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve sporadic project management regulations and standardize approval and on-site supervision.
2. Strengthen on-site inspections of ground production auxiliary systems, coal preparation buildings and coal bunkers to eliminate management blind spots.
3. Construct coal bunkers according to standards and take anti-blocking measures to reduce the risk of blockage in coal bunkers.
4. Strictly investigate and deal with illegal commands, illegal operations and violations of labor disciplines.
5. Strengthen the certification of personnel in the three positions and the safety training of operating personnel and team leaders.
6. Formulate special safety measures for coal bunker inspection, blockage treatment and sporadic projects, and improve the management of protective equipment; transform coal bunker anti-blocking facilities according to standards and strengthen on-site supervision.
