【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-02-18 14:00: The comprehensive mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange production at the 39113 fully mechanised mining face, with 20 people participating in the shift.
- 2019-02-18 15:00: 20 people arrived at the 39113 fully mechanised mining working face. The squad leader assigned tasks such as opening the belt, turning on the hydraulic pump, keeping watch, filing coal, supporting, mining the coal machine, cleaning the floating coal, cutting the foot wells, and watching the tail of the slide machine; the squad leader and the deputy captain of the squad patrolled.
- 2019-02-18 19:35: The shearer moved upward from the lower outlet to cut coal. The squad leader heard a noise when the No. 25 frame was about to push away, and found that the deputy squad leader fell near the No. 27 powered support.
- After 19:35 on 2019-02-18: On-site personnel organised rescue and reported to the dispatch room.
- 2019-02-18 19:38: After receiving the report, the dispatching room notified the mine leader; the mine director organised personnel to carry out the casualty, and notified the rescue team to enter the mine and the hospital ambulance to the mine entrance.
- 2019-02-18 20:30: The casualty was carried out of the mine entrance and put into an ambulance, and transferred to Guiyang Jinyang Hospital for rescue.
- 2019-02-18 21:25: The casualty person lost vital signs on the way to the hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the middle shifter was working on the 39113 fully mechanised mining face, the deputy team leader mistook the handle of the bottom-picking control valve for the operation of the pushing control valve. The bottom-picking jack pulled off the left connecting piece and then ejected, injuring himself. the casualty person died on the way to the hospital after being rescued from the well.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator mistakenly used the handle of the bottom-picking control valve as a push control valve, and the connecting piece on the left side of the bottom-picking jack broke and popped out, injuring himself.
2. key contributing factors: The mine safety responsibility system for support maintenance positions is not perfect, the maintenance regulations do not stipulate the inspection of the welding parts of structural parts, and no welding seams are found in daily maintenance.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the responsibility system and operating procedures for powered support maintenance positions.
2. Strengthen daily and weekly inspections of bracket structural parts, side protection and welds.
3. Timely investigate and manage equipment defects and hidden dangers.
4. Improve the risk identification capabilities of support operation and maintenance personnel.
5. Improve the powered support maintenance responsibility system and operating procedures, and clarify the inspection requirements for structural parts, side protection and welding parts.
6. Carry out targeted training around support operation, structural component inspection and risk identification.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-02-22 After the gas returned to normal: The leader of Daiban Mine led more than ten people to search and rescue along the return air inclined lane. Two workers were found about 3 metres away from the Sanping Lane. They were carried to Shishimen for a brief rescue and then sent out to the ground.
- 2019-02-22 06:00: The mine manager presided over the morning shift scheduling meeting to arrange the closing and withdrawal of the 5102-1 mining face and other work; 108 people actually entered the mine on the shift.
- 2019-02-22 07:10: Personnel on duty entered the mine one after another, and the 5102-1 mining face personnel carried out retracting supports, erecting flexible shielding supports, stacking sandbag walls, dropping coal and transporting according to the division of labor.
- 2019-02-22 16:05: The safety monitoring system issued a methane over-limit alarm at 5102-1 mining surface, with a maximum T1 value of 1.09%; the dispatch room notified personnel to evacuate. After the methane examiner detected that the methane dropped to 0.8%, the team leader organised the resumption of operations.
- 2019-02-22 16:59: The safety monitoring system alarmed again, with the maximum T1 value of 2.2%; the dispatching room notified people to evacuate and notified the mine leaders to come to the site for processing. After the workers evacuated to Shishimen, they were notified that the gas had returned to normal, and operations resumed one after another.
- 2019-02-22 17:56: The security monitoring system alarmed for the third time, with a maximum T1 value of 12.97%; the dispatch room notified the evacuation again.
- 2019-02-22 at approximately 18:10: After the workers evacuated to Shishimen, an inventory found that 2 people were missing.
- 2019-02-22 18:36: The captain and the methane examiner reported to the dispatch room that there were 2 missing people; when leading the mine leaders and others to search and rescue to the Sanping tunnel entrance, the methane concentration exceeded 10%, and the search and rescue could not continue for the time being.
- Approximately 20:00 on 2019-02-22: The mine sent two injured people to Tongzi County People’s Hospital for rescue.
- 2019-02-22 23:45: Two injured people died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the closing of the 5102-1 mining face, the roof of the goaf moved and abnormally high concentrations of methane and other harmful gases were released. After the gas exceeded the limit many times, two workers failed to evacuate according to the disaster evacuation route prescribed by the measures. They were suffocated by harmful gases in the return air alley and died after ineffective rescue.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the goaf moved abnormally and released high-concentration methane and other harmful gases. Two people did not evacuate according to the disaster evacuation route and suffocated.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient gas control measures during the closing period of the mining area, failure to conduct emergency training for underground personnel after resumption of work and production, and inadequate inspection of hidden dangers and inadequate management by superior companies.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen gas control in the goaf area, especially during the closing period of the mining face.
2. Strictly implement the regulations on evacuation and disaster evacuation routes for gas exceeding the limit.
3. organise safety education, emergency training and drills.
4. Timely investigate and manage production safety hazards.
5. The superior company urges coal mines to implement safety management responsibilities.
6. analyse the drainage effect of the goaf during the closing period of the mining face and take effective gas control measures.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-03-11 05:00: The second coal mining team in the comprehensive mining area held a pre-morning shift meeting, and 19 people were on duty.
- After 07:10 on March 11, 2019: The team leader arranged for the team leader to lead 3 workers at the tail of the aircraft to maintain the roof and clean up the floating coal (gang), while the rest of the staff handled the floating chain and prepared to cut the coal; the 4 people used logs and single columns to build support sheds.
- Around 07:10 on March 11, 2019: The team leader arrived at the exit of the 1081 fully mechanised mining working face and handed over to the night shift inspector. He learned that there were problems with the floating chain of the slide and the empty roofs at the ends of brackets 120 to 122 that needed support.
- Approximately 09:00 on March 11, 2019: The roof support was completed, and 4 people began to clean up the floating coal (gang).
- Around 09:30 on March 11, 2019: The team leader went to the return air tunnel of the mining face to get tools, and the remaining three people continued to clean up the floating coal (gang).
- Around 09:50 on March 11, 2019: The roof between the ends of brackets 120 to 122 and the coal wall suddenly collapsed, pinning three workers working on the side of the coal wall.
- 2019-03-11 10:27: Three trapped persons were rescued and sent to the Eagle Mountain Mining Hospital for rescue.
- 2019-03-11 15:05: All three injured died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2019-03-11 15:20: The coal mine reported the accident to the company's safety command center, Shuicheng County Emergency Management Bureau, Shuicheng County Safety Command Center and the local sub-district office.

【Accident Mechanism】
The morning shift workers were working on the empty roof area at the rear of the 1081 fully mechanised mining face where the roof was broken and the end face distance exceeded the limit. The support of the temporary single pillar and supporting shed was not reliable. When clearing floating coal (gang), the pillar became unstable and caused a roof collapse. Three workers working on the side of the coal wall were pinned down. All of them died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof is broken and the temporary pillars in the empty roof area where the end face distance exceeds the limit are not reliable. The pillars became unstable and popped up when the workers were cleaning the floating coal (gang).
2. key contributing factors: Failure to pull up the support in time, no on-site leader and safety inspector supervision; failure to use end brackets as required and insufficient hidden danger investigation, technical management and on-the-job training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The shearer should move the rack in time after cutting coal to avoid the roof hanging for a long time.
2. Special measures must be formulated and strictly implemented for the treatment of empty ceiling areas.
3. Strengthen the management of the end powered support and the roof of the mining working face.
4. Strengthen the investigation and management of hidden dangers and provide written inspections and rectification files by superior companies.
5. Report and handle accident information as required.
6. Prepare and implement special safety technical measures for operations where the end-to-face distance exceeds the limit and enters the coal wall side, and timely pulls up the frame and strengthens end support.

- 2019-03-16 at approximately 01:50: The trapped person was rescued and had no breathing and heartbeat.
- 2019-03-16 at approximately 02:40: The body was transported to the ground.

【Accident Mechanism】
Geological structures were encountered near the exit under the 11502 mining face, and the roof was broken but the support was not reinforced. When two workers were retracting the last single hydraulic prop in the fourth row, the roof fell. The waste rock pushed down three sets of supports and buried one of them. He was dead when rescued.

1. Direct cause: The broken structural belt of the roof was not reinforced with support. When returning to the column, the roof fell and pushed down the support, burying the operator.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The structural zone and roof fracture location must be strengthened with support.
2. Carry out back column and roof management operations in strict accordance with regulations.
3. Strengthen on-site safety management and leadership of mine leaders.
4. Improve the effectiveness of safety training and technical management.
5. Concealing accident reports is strictly prohibited.

1. Formulate and implement targeted support measures for the structural zone and roof broken section.
2. Timely investigate and rectify hidden dangers such as insufficient basic columns and beams.
3. The team leader shall not serve as a safety inspector to replace on-site safety supervision.
4. Strengthen leadership guidance and mine safety supervision inspections.
5. Improve the effectiveness of on-the-job safety training.
6. Improve the roof management system, supplement the pillars and beams in the structural zone and broken roof sections according to regulations, and strengthen support.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2019-07-28 23:30: The coal mine organised a pre-shift briefing to arrange night shift operations in Dongxiashan and other areas; a total of 83 people entered the mine on duty, 13 of whom were working at the Dongxiashan coal face.

- 2019-07-29 02:01: The total return airway methane concentration reached 3.99% of the sensor's maximum range.
- 2019-07-29 02:10: The dispatcher on duty received a report of an accident at the Dongxiashan coal face.

- 2019-07-29 02:50: The rescue team arrives at the coal mine.
- 2019-07-29 03:05: The rescue team entered the mine to carry out rescue.
- 2019-07-29 04:20: Rescuers began to find people in distress and victims at different locations on the mining surface.
- 2019-07-29 at approximately 06:00: After discovering the victims, the mine agreed to conceal the accident and arranged specific concealment matters.
- 2019-07-29 13:20: The Guiyang hotline received reports from the masses, and local inspectors went to the mine; the mine falsely reported that the excavation work was all gang-related and that no one died.
- 2019-07-30 at approximately 02:00: The bodies of the four victims were taken out of the well and transferred.
- 2019-07-30 14:00: The local government went to the mine for another inspection. The mine confessed that an accident occurred and said that 4 people were killed and 2 injured.
- 2019-07-31 at approximately 04:00: The rescue team focused on investigating the No. 17 seal, and found no suspicious traces.
- 2019-07-31 13:00: The rescue team opened No. 17 seal for reconnaissance, found the Dongxiashan coal face, and initially confirmed the accident location and the type of coal and gas outburst.

【Accident Mechanism】
Coal mines illegally organise coal mining in hidden areas beyond the mine boundary and the scope of outburst hazard assessment, without taking outburst prevention measures. The working face has no design, no operating procedures, and unreliable ventilation. When the shearer cut coal downward from the middle of the working face, coal and gas outbursts occurred in the soft coal mass under the superposition of fault tectonic stress and the initial compressive stress of the roof. The amount of coal outburst was 132 tons and the amount of gas was 7,067 cubic meters, resulting in 4 deaths and 2 minor injuries.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal mine cut coal in a hidden cross-border mining face without identifying the risk of outburst and taking no outburst prevention measures, which caused coal and gas outbursts.
2. key contributing factors: There is no design and operating procedures for concealed mining surfaces, failure of ventilation and gas management, failure to install monitoring and personnel positioning, failure to evacuate people when gas exceeds limits, loss of safety management and concealment of accidents.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out special operations to crack down on illegal activities and establish a multi-department joint law enforcement and mine surveillance mechanism.
2. Smooth reporting channels and establish a reward mechanism for reporting violations of laws and regulations.
3. The group company has deployed safety technical management personnel to review major technical plans and grasp production trends.
4. Strictly carry out gas grade identification and outburst hazard identification, and implement two four-in-one outburst prevention measures.
5. Improve the coal mine safety monitoring platform, early warning handling and duty maintenance mechanism.
6. Stop and investigate cross-border and concealed illegal production, carry out outstanding risk identification in accordance with the law, and strictly implement regional and local emergency prevention measures.

- 2019-08-13 18:00: The casualty person died on the way to the hospital.
- 2019-08-13 at approximately 23:00: After receiving the report clues, the Bijie Energy Bureau, together with the regulatory authorities, went to the mine for verification.
- 2019-08-14 at approximately 11:30: Mine personnel admitted that an accident occurred underground, confirming that one person was killed and two others were injured.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the coal wall at the mining surface was hard and the pneumatic pick could not operate, the blast was fired without authorization on site without formulating safety technical measures and without qualified blasting personnel. After the three people connected, they only retreated to about 20 metres away from the blasting point and then detonated. They were all injured, and one of them died on the way to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator took the risk to detonate the explosion in violation of regulations when the safety distance was insufficient, resulting in three people being injured.
2. key contributing factors: unauthorized consent to underground blasting in mines that have not resumed production; operations by personnel without blasting qualifications; failure to implement three-person interlock blasting and evacuation regulations; chaotic management of explosives and safety and concealment of accidents.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Underground blasting shall not be arranged without approval for resumption of production.
2. Strictly manage blasting personnel’s certification, charging, connection, vigilance and safe evacuation.
3. Standardize the collection, storage and use of explosives.
4. Strengthen the performance of safety management personnel’s duties and the investigation of hidden dangers.
5. Report accident information promptly and truthfully.
6. Strict approval for resumption of production and blasting, blasting operations shall be carried out by certified personnel and a three-person interlocking, alert and evacuation system shall be implemented.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2019-08-21 After the accident: The coal mine promptly reported the accident to the Jinsha County Industry and Information Technology Bureau and the Bijie Supervision Branch of the Guizhou Coal Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

- 2019-08-21 05:01: The first buried person was rescued, lifted underground and sent to Jinsha County Lindong Hospital.
- 2019-08-21 05:06: The second buried person was rescued, lifted underground and sent to the hospital.
- 2019-08-21 at approximately 06:00: Two injured people died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The crack zone in the roof of the fault section of the 5914 mining face leads to the overlying Changxing Formation aquifer. The roof has been soaked in water for a long time and the support strength is insufficient. When clearing floating waste rock and draining water during the zero hour shift, the roof of supports No. 11 and 12 fell off, and the coal slurry mixed with waste rock collapsed into the working face. Two people were buried and died during the evacuation.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The crack zone in the roof leads to the overlying strong aquifer, the roof is soaked in water and becomes unstable, the support strength is insufficient, and slurry collapse occurs.
2. key contributing factors: Targeted measures were not revised after changes in fault breakage and flooding conditions; reinforced support was not constructed as required, and water damage prevention, on-site management, and superior supervision were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement targeted roof measures when the geological structure, roof is broken and unstable due to exposure to water.
2. Establish a water damage prevention and control system and working mechanism, and revise the plan according to site conditions.
3. Strictly inspect the on-site implementation of support measures.
4. Strengthen monitoring of key processes and combat three violations.
5. The superior company strengthens disaster management technical support and on-site supervision.
6. Prove the hydrogeological conditions, formulate and revise water damage prevention and roof management measures as the site changes, and ensure reliable support.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2019-11-24 at approximately 23:20: The zero-hour shift safety inspector, methane examiner and electrician entered the mine. The 6 personnel from the previous shift and the zero-hour shift methane examiner continued to work in the 41601 transportation lane.
- 2019-11-25 at approximately 01:53: Personnel without emergency prevention qualifications went to the working face to measure sensitive indicators of outstanding hazards.
- 2019-11-25 at approximately 02:20: Leading the mine leaders to inspect the 41601 transportation lane, the working face is being reinforced with roof bolts.

- 2019-12-01 04:01: Rescuers found the last victim and the rescue work ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 41601 transport lane accident site has complex geological structures and coal seams with outburst risks. However, after gas dynamic phenomena such as blowholes and top drilling occurred in the coal mine, the coal seams were not managed as outburst coal seams. Neither gas drainage nor outburst risk verification truly reflected the risks. The coal mining operation of the fully mechanised excavator induced coal and gas outbursts, resulting in 7 deaths and 1 injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The coal and gas outbursts were induced by fully mechanised excavation operations in dangerous coal seams where gas extraction and outburst risk verification were untrue, and outburst prevention measures were not implemented.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to manage outburst coal seams after the occurrence of gas dynamic phenomena, fraud in the monitoring system, inaccurate evaluation of extraction drilling and compliance with standards, illegal mining of boundary safety coal pillars, and insufficient technical and safety management capabilities.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the main responsibilities of coal mining enterprises in accordance with the law and put an end to blocking safety monitoring and mining boundary safety coal pillars.
2. Strengthen geological prediction and basic parameter determination of coal seam gas, and timely fill in gas geological maps.
3. Strictly carry out outstanding hazard identification or identification, and implement regional and local comprehensive emergency prevention measures.
4. Arrange safety technical management personnel, improve the system and carry out hidden danger investigation and management.
5. Regulatory authorities should strengthen gas disaster prevention and control, monitoring systems and supervision and inspection of illegal mining.
6. After an outburst sign occurs, immediately identify it according to regulations or directly manage it according to the outburst coal seam, and truly carry out gas extraction, standard evaluation and outburst risk verification.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 21202 transportation lane is close to the fault. The coal seam has become thicker and softer, and there have been many outburst signs such as coal cannons, top drills, stuck drills and blowholes. A night shift mechanized excavator caused coal and gas outbursts when cutting coal. The amount of coal outburst was about 414 tons and the amount of gas was about 42,300 cubic meters, causing 16 deaths and 1 injury.

1. Direct cause: After obvious signs of outburst appeared in the coal seam of 21202 transportation lane, outburst prevention measures were not taken according to the outburst coal seam and the excavation continued, which induced coal and gas outburst.

【Preventative Recommendations】

2. Strengthen gas geological prediction and forecasting, and analyse the risks of thickening and softening of coal seams and fault structure.

4. Allocate professional technical and special operations personnel to improve gas disaster prevention and control capabilities.
5. Regulatory authorities will strengthen the implementation of production suspension orders, gas monitoring and law enforcement for production resumption acceptance.
6. If there are signs of outburst, immediately stop operations, evacuate personnel, manage the coal seam according to the outburst, and carry out gas monitoring, geological prediction and outburst prevention measures in a realistic manner.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2021-01-18 23:30: The deputy mine director for safety presided over the zero-hour pre-shift briefing and arranged for 47 people to enter the mine, including drilling construction and back-excavation operations in the return tunnel.
- Around 00:08 on 2021-01-19: Two drillers wore self-rescuers and arrived at the upper drilling site of 11204 hole.
- Around 2021-01-19 00:11: Drilling operations begin.
- Around 2021-01-19 02:28: Construction of borehole No. 6 started.
- Around 03:14 on 2021-01-19: When drilling about 22.5 metres, gas with a strong pungent smell gushed out of the borehole.
- 2021-01-19 03:15: The scene reported to the dispatch room that there was rotten egg smell gas gushing out from the borehole.
- 2021-01-19 03:19: A driller was fainted to the ground after being smoked, and another person was reported to have fainted at the scene; the dispatch room did not order the evacuation, but still arranged for personnel to check.
- Around 03:37 on 2021-01-19: 5 personnel evacuated to the wind gate of 11204 Transport Lane and went up the shaft; 4 personnel failed to evacuate and were trapped.
- Around 04:01 on 2021-01-19: The miner found a strong pungent smell at the entrance of the dedicated return air lane of the 11204 transportation lane, and requested to report to the Energy Bureau and request rescue by the rescue team.
- 2021-01-19 04:09: Dafang County Energy Bureau received a report that carbon monoxide exceeded the limit and four people were missing, and summoned the rescue team.
- 2021-01-19 05:15: The first team of Dafang County Zhongan Rescue Squadron arrived at the coal mine.
- 2021-01-19 07:41: The first team of Zhongan Rescue Squadron entered the mine for investigation.
- 2021-01-19 08:40: Xiaotun Coal Mine Rescue Team received a rescue call.
- 2021-01-19 12:00: The rescued injured were lifted to the ground and immediately sent to the hospital for treatment.
- 2021-01-19 12:43: The three victims were transported to the ground and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The drilling crew violated safety technical measures and used dry drilling. After the drilling was blocked, the drilling was carried out for a long time. The friction generated local high temperatures. The cracks around the drilling were oxidized and pyrolyzed, and a large amount of toxic and harmful gases were emitted. After a pungent smell appeared at the scene and people fainted, they did not evacuate immediately or wear self-rescuers. The dispatcher still arranged for personnel to enter the disaster area, resulting in 3 deaths and 1 injury.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driller violated the measures by performing dry drilling and empty drilling for a long time, which generated high temperatures that promoted oxidation and pyrolysis of the coal and caused a large amount of toxic and harmful gases to gush out, resulting in poisoning and casualties.
2. key contributing factors: abnormal smell and failure to evacuate immediately and wear self-rescuers after people fainted, errors in dispatching and command, insufficient emergency plan activation and rescue capabilities, and inadequate risk assessment and training in the drilling area.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Equip disaster prevention and control professionals and technical equipment to strictly perform job responsibilities.
2. Conduct technical research and judgment on hidden disaster-causing factors in the drilling area and take preventive measures.
3. Strengthen the maintenance of rescue equipment, emergency training and the presence of professional rescue teams in mines.
4. Standardize safety education and training to ensure that workers understand procedures and emergency response.
5. Regulatory authorities should streamline law enforcement mechanisms and report accident information in a timely manner.
6. Dry drilling and illegal parallel operations are strictly prohibited during drilling construction. Carbon monoxide sensors should be installed on the return air side of the drilling rig and monitored online.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2021-04-13 07:44: Rescuers began to find the remaining victims one after another at 373 metres.
- 2021-04-13 15:27: The last victim was transported to the ground and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 10901 cut hole encountered a structure, the coal seam thickened, and there were outburst signs such as blowholes and top drilling. However, the regional cross-bed drainage boreholes did not completely cover the excavation strip. The coal mine did not re-implement regional outburst prevention measures and continued to construct drainage boreholes. At 8:47, a coal and gas outburst occurred in the dangerous coal seam due to the superposition of tectonic stress and mining stress, killing 8 people and injuring 1 person.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The regional drainage boreholes did not cover the 10901 cut-out excavation strip, and the risk of structural coal seam outbursts was not eliminated; the drainage boreholes were still constructed even after signs of blowholes and top drilling appeared, inducing coal and gas outbursts.
2. key contributing factors: methane sensors were artificially caused to fail, outburst signs were concealed, gas geological prediction and outburst prevention technology reviews were insufficient, and construction, construction and supervision safety management was chaotic.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the safety responsibility system at all levels and equip management and engineering technicians.
2. Standardize construction project bidding and strictly prevent affiliation and fraudulent use of qualifications.
3. The construction unit shall clarify the safety responsibilities of all parties involved in construction and supervision and strengthen on-site supervision.
4. The supervision unit shall strictly review safety technical measures and special construction plans.
5. The design unit strengthens on-site technical services for construction projects.
6. Redesign and implement regional cross-layer drainage according to actual tunnel parameters to ensure coverage of the excavation strip; immediately stop work and evacuate personnel if there are signs of outburst, and re-implement regional outburst prevention measures.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2021-11-10 at approximately 16:30: The mine leaders on duty went to the 110702 return air contact inclined tunnel, and then left without making work arrangements.
- 2021-11-10 at approximately 16:40: 4 maintenance workers and 1 methane examiner entered the mine.

- 2021-11-10 18:30: Maintenance personnel transported the supporting logs to the site and began to erect wooden sheds. Two sheds have been erected but the top has not been connected.
- 2021-11-10 at approximately 20:40: The roof fell when the operators were erecting the third wooden shed, and 4 people were trapped; the escaped personnel reported to the mine control room.
- 2021-11-10 at approximately 21:00: After receiving the accident report, the mine director organised people to go underground to rescue themselves.
- 2021-11-11 00:08: The public security police station received a call from the masses saying that someone was trapped underground.
- 2021-11-11 00:30: The police station reported to the Guanzhai Town People's Government.
- 2021-11-11 01:12: The Guanzhai Town People's Government reported to the Liuzhi Special Economic Zone Energy Bureau and the Special Zone Government.
- 2021-11-11 02:20: Liuzhi Rescue Brigade received a call for accident rescue.
- 2021-11-11 03:36: Liuzhi Rescue Brigade arrived at the coal mine to carry out rescue.
- 2021-11-12 06:10: All 4 trapped persons were rescued, all had no vital signs, and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
110702 Return air contact inclined tunnel is located in the fault zone. The tunnel is in disrepair, the roof is incomplete, and the log shed has been broken. The coal mine opened and sealed without technical maintenance safety measures and arranged maintenance. During the operation, the wooden shed was not roofed and no advance control and temporary support were taken. When the third shed was erected, the roof suddenly fell, trapping three maintenance personnel and one methane examiner, and they all died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the disrepaired tunnel in the fault zone was incomplete. The roof was repaired without advance control and temporary support. The roof became unstable and resulted in the death of 4 people.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to prepare maintenance safety technical measures, illegal use of wooden supports and lack of roofing of the wooden shed, lack of safety personnel and effective roof observation on site, failure to report in time after the accident and risking self-rescue.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Before repair, strengthen nearby supports and adopt effective temporary supports. Empty-ceiling operations are strictly prohibited.
2. Maintenance of single-ended tunnels ensures ventilation and safe evacuation of people and is carried out one by one from the outside to the inside.
3. Disable outdated materials such as wooden supports, and strengthen support when encountering geological structures.
4. Establish a technical management system and individual project procedures and measures system that the chief engineer is responsible for.
5. Strengthen surveillance at mines and rectify hidden dangers before resuming work and production, and strictly crack down on illegal resumption of production.
6. Before repairing the tunnel, analyse the lithology of the top roof, formulate targeted technical measures, and scientifically determine support parameters, processes, and materials.

- 2022-02-25 at approximately 06:10: The inspectors went to the mining surface again and found fallen waste rock about 40 metres above the lower exit; after the scene was treated with open fire, the inspectors left.
- 2022-02-25 07:00: Two shearers went to the lower trough to rest and wait for the shaft to be lifted. On-site personnel continued to work on the mining face.
- 2022-02-25 07:37: The mining face collapsed. The transportation personnel misjudged that the lower outlet had collapsed and then ascended the well; on-site personnel found that the mining surface had collapsed extensively and confirmed that the workers were trapped.
- 2022-02-25 07:49: On-site personnel called to report the accident.
- 2022-02-25 08:41: The methane examiner arrived at the lower exit and found that the roof collapsed and reported to the coal mine control room.
- 2022-02-25 09:12: The mine leader reported the accident to the superior company over the phone.
- 2022-02-25 09:15: The mine called the Zhenfeng County Coal Mine Safety Supervision Department to report the accident.
- 2022-02-25 09:40: 13 commanders and fighters of the mine rescue squadron arrived at the coal mine to carry out rescue.
- 2022-02-25 11:15: A total of 30 rescue commanders and fighters from two mine rescue squadrons arrived at the coal mine for reinforcements.
- 2022-03-03 06:05: Rescuers found the first victim 62.8 metres away from the lower exit of the concealed mining surface.
- 2022-03-05 10:45: Rescuers found the 14th victim 86.6 metres away from the lower exit of the concealed mining surface.
- 2022-03-05 13:28: The last victim was transported out of the well, and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The hidden mining face was mined beyond the mine boundary without operating procedures and safety technical measures. After blasting, the inverted pillars and the broken roof along the coal wall were not treated and the support was not strengthened. The separation layer of the composite roof broke and the pillar stability was insufficient. The roof collapsed at 7:37, and 14 people working on the mining face were trapped and killed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: Insufficient support strength of the hidden mining surface beyond the ore boundary, fracture of the composite roof separation layer, and insufficient support stability, leading to roof collapse.
2. key contributing factors: illegal organisation of concealed coal mining, failure to prepare operating procedures and safety technical measures; hidden dangers such as pillar inversion and roof cutting after blasting were not dealt with, and roof management was out of control.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. The mining surface must be designed in accordance with the law, work procedures and safety technical measures must be prepared, and support strength verification must be carried out.
2. After blasting, promptly deal with hidden dangers such as inverted pillars and broken roofs, and strengthen support quality and roof inspections.
3. Improve safety monitoring, personnel positioning and well registration, and it is strictly prohibited to set up hidden operating points to avoid supervision.
4. Strictly investigate and deal with illegal contracting, subcontracting and concealing accident reports.
5. Crack down on cross-border illegal mining, illegal contracting and subcontracting, and evasion of supervision in accordance with the law, and suspend production and rectify mines that do not meet the conditions for safe production.
6. Strictly carry out pre-job and daily safety education and training, and strengthen roof risk identification, hidden danger handling and accident reporting training.

【Accident Timeline】
- Around 07:30 on March 19, 2022: 4 operators entered the mine and went down to the upper part of the mountain for expansion work on the track in the first mining area.
- 2022-03-19 11:50: After four people completed the construction of two I-beam sheds, they used a single hydraulic prop to move the legs of the second shed; the operator did not stop adding fluid in time, and the shed beam fell off, the roof fell, and hit his head and chest.
- 2022-03-19 12:10: The methane examiner reported the accident to the mine dispatch room.
- 2022-03-19 at approximately 18:00: The actual controller of the coal mine reported the accident to the Puding County Industry and Information Technology Bureau.
- 2022-03-19 18:10: The mine arranged for personnel to use an underground phone with a recording function to report the accident again, creating the illusion that the accident had just occurred.
- 2022-03-19 18:20: Puding County Bureau of Industry and Information Technology reported to the Puding County People's Government.
- 2022-03-19 19:46: Puding County Industry and Information Technology Bureau reported to Anshun City Industrial Information Technology Bureau.
- 2022-03-19 19:48: Puding County Bureau of Industry and Information Technology reported to Anshun City Emergency Bureau.
- 2022-03-19 19:51: Puding County Bureau of Industry and Information Technology reported to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2022-03-19 21:53: Puding County Bureau of Industry and Information Technology issued a written report on the accident.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the period of suspension of production and rectification, Tongxin Coal Mine illegally organised the expansion of the track down the mountain, without formulating safety technical measures, nor taking temporary support and cleaning up live waste. When the operator used a single hydraulic prop to push the legs of the second I-beam shed, he failed to stop adding fluid in time. After the legs were in place, the beam fell off, and the roof immediately fell, hitting the operator operating the hydraulic gun and killing him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The support of the I-beam shed failed, and the beams and roof of the shed fell and hit the expansion workers, killing them.
2. key contributing factors: illegal construction during the shutdown and rectification period, failure to formulate technical measures, failure to implement temporary support and clean up waste, no on-site supervision by safety inspectors, and insufficient technical and special operations personnel.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. analyse roof separation and fracture risks based on geological changes, and strengthen support in a timely manner.
2. Before replacing the supports, strengthen the adjacent supports, remove loose waste and erect permanent supports in a timely manner.
3. The main tunnels shall be supported in strict accordance with the design of safety facilities, and the support methods shall not be changed without authorization.
4. The enterprise is equipped with mine directors, professional and technical personnel and safety management agencies.
5. The regulatory authorities maintain a high-pressure posture of cracking down on illegal activities and supervise the mine safety supervisors to perform their duties.
6. Construction shall be suspended during the shutdown and rectification period; targeted operating procedures and safety technical measures shall be formulated, approved and implemented before expansion.

The roof beam had a large span and was only supported by wooden point columns. The tunnel had a roof leak before but the support was not strengthened. 【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-05-27 06:10: The coal mine held a morning shift dispatch meeting to arrange underground drainage, inspections, and ground cleaning of belt waste and silt.
- 2022-05-27 at approximately 12:27: Due to the blockage of the coal bunker in the 11th transportation Shimen section, on-site personnel used cable bolts to clear the coal bunker upwards from the coal discharge port; the silt waste rock collapsed and carried the cable bolts and fell to the main inclined shaft belt conveyor.
- 2022-05-27 at approximately 12:30: When the ground cleaning operators were cleaning the silt and waste rock at the coal drop barrel, the cable bolt that fell from the transfer point of the conveyor head pierced the right side of the abdomen.
- 2022-05-27 at approximately 12:31: On-site personnel found the casualty and reported it to the mine; rescuers cut off the abdominal cable bolt and sent him to the hospital.
- 2022-05-27 15:45: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2022-05-27 16:48: The coal mine reported the accident to the Zhijin County Coal Mine Safety Supervision Department.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the operator used the cable bolt to clear the coal bunker, the massive silt waste rock in the coal bunker collapsed and carried the cable bolt into the belt conveyor; the machine was not stopped at the site and the cable bolt was not taken out. The cable bolt fell at the nose transfer point and plunged into the abdomen of the operator who was cleaning below. the casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The cable bolt ran with the conveyor and fell from the transfer point of the machine head, injuring the workers below the transfer point.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to shut down the coal bunker in time and fail to remove the cable bolt after abnormal dredging of the coal bunker; there are no safety protection facilities and obvious warning signs at the transfer point, and hidden danger investigation and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Set up reliable protection facilities and warning signs at the conveyor transfer point and coal falling area.
2. Use special long-handled tools and remote operation to clear the coal bunker to prevent damage and collapse.
3. If an abnormality or malfunction occurs, the operation of the equipment must be stopped immediately, and the operation can only be resumed after the danger is eliminated.
4. Report accidents in strict accordance with regulations in a timely manner and avoid late reporting, omissions and concealment of reports.
5. Improve and enhance the safety protection facilities and devices of the transportation system, and implement full life cycle management of equipment.
6. Carry out practical and theoretical training based on job risks to improve hazard identification and self-protection capabilities.

The development heading was affected by the fault structure, and the roof support failed and roof seepage and roof spalling occurred. 【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-08-16 07:00: The mine held an 8 o'clock shift dispatch meeting to arrange the transfer of the fully mechanised excavator to the 12125 transport lane development heading.
- 2022-08-16 12:30: When the 8 o'clock shift workers dug the shed legs, the shed legs were suspended and the roof sank; the inspector asked to stop dismantling the shed legs and reinforce the lifting shed.
- 2022-08-16 13:11: The captain of the excavation team reported the sinking situation of the roof to the deputy mine director of excavation.
- 2022-08-16 15:00: The mine held a 4 o'clock shift dispatch meeting and still arranged to continue the transfer of the fully mechanised excavator.
- 2022-08-16 15:30: The excavation team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange for the dismantling of the U-shaped shed legs at the intersection and the restoration of the shed legs after transferring the comprehensive excavator.
- 2022-08-16 16:30: The workers on duty arrived at the operation point to take over the shift and continued undercover, dismantling shed legs, pulling the shovel plate of the mechanized excavator and reinforcing the work.
- 2022-08-16 18:23: The mine director called the site to pay attention to the reinforcement of intersections.
- 2022-08-16 19:54: When the shovel plate of the mechanized excavator was pulled on site and the cable stuck on one side of the last U-shaped shed was removed, the roof suddenly fell down about 9 metres away from the intersection, trapping 10 people.
- 2022-08-16 19:57: The dispatch room contacted the escapees and learned that the roof of the mine had collapsed and the condition of the remaining personnel was unknown.
- 2022-08-16 20:09: An on-site inventory found that 10 people were missing, and the mine organised underground personnel to rush to rescue.
- 2022-08-17 02:31: An injured and trapped person was rescued from the shaft, and search and rescue continued at the scene.
- 2022-08-18 04:46: The last victim was transported out of the well, and the rescue ended.
- 2022-08-19 12:50: The rescued injured died after rescue efforts failed, and the death toll in the accident increased to 9.
- 2022-08-26 17:02: After the national mine safety supervision agency found doubts about the operating time, the coal mine reported the accident to the relevant departments.

【Accident Mechanism】
The intersection of the 12125 transport lane is located in a geological structural zone and a stress concentration area, and cracks in the roof are developed; the coal mine has not strengthened support according to the review opinions, and the roof has sunk. After the shed legs were removed on site, a chain hoist was fixed on the U-shaped shed that had lost one of its legs and the shovel board of the mechanized excavator was pulled while continuing to remove the shed legs, causing the support to become unstable and the roof to fall, trapping many people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the support at the intersection was not in place and the roof of the shed was sinking, the commander violated regulations by dismantling the legs of the shed and fixing the hand chain hoist transfer equipment with an unstable U-shaped shed, causing the roof to fall.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to adopt cable bolts to strengthen support in accordance with review opinions, failure to formulate special measures for dismantling shed legs and transporting large equipment; failure in geological management, hidden danger management, on-site safety management and training, and deliberate concealment of reports after the accident.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Recruit geological and safety management professionals to accurately analyse surrounding rocks and structures and provide support recommendations.
2. Deepen the special improvement of roof management, optimize support parameters and strengthen inspections of key locations.
3. Implement hierarchical control of safety risks and closed-loop management of hidden dangers, and strictly control the acceptance of construction work.
4. Strictly verify the information reported on gas exceeding the limit and accidents, and hold responsible for late reporting, omissions, false reports, and concealment of reports in accordance with the law.
5. Establish a reward and whistleblower protection mechanism for reporting coal mine accidents.
6. Implement one-project-one-measures for key, partial and sporadic projects, and strictly prepare, approve, implement and implement them on-site; roof abnormalities and equipment transfers must first eliminate hidden dangers.

【Accident Mechanism】
The maintenance point did not implement temporary support as required. When the maintenance personnel removed the original support and cut the upper mesh on the right side, the tunnel roof collapsed and the coal and waste rock buried it. Rescuers rescued the casualty and sent him to the hospital, but he died on the way after resuscitation failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: Temporary support was not implemented at the gas drainage tunnel maintenance point, the roof of the tunnel collapsed during the support removal operation, and coal and waste rock buried the workers.
2. key contributing factors: Maintenance operations did not strictly implement shed-by-shed construction and temporary support requirements, and roof management and on-site safety management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Set up temporary support within the specified range ahead before repair.
2. Strictly implement the shed-by-shed maintenance and on-site safety confirmation system.
3. Strengthen roof hazard inspection and on-site management.
4. organise rescue operations in a timely manner and report accidents as required.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2022-09-16 02:00: - Report the accident situation to Guizhou Jinyongtai Mining Investment Co., Ltd. at 5-40 minutes
- 2022-09-16 02:19: Safety inspector Zhu Moumou reported to the dispatching room on the phone at the end of the 10501 conveyor belt-4-belt machine about the mine safety inspection of the 10501 cut-eye development heading. As soon as he hung up the phone, he heard a roar from the rear so-and-so (10501 transport chute from the outside to the inside), and then a large amount of dust spread from the transportation lane to the tail of the belt conveyor, making it difficult to see. safety inspector Zhu Moumou immediately shouted "Run" to the workers who were digging into the working face. Then squad leader Yu Ying called on the employees to evacuate quickly.
- 2022-09-16 02:32: Safety inspector Zhu Guicai withdrew outside the reverse damper and reported to so-and-so that the 10501 eye-cutting and transportation personnel had evacuated. At the same time, so-and-so went to dispatch to notify the entire mine of evacuation instructions. After Zhu Moumou and others withdrew to the ground,
- 2022-09-16 02:32: After receiving the accident call, the dispatching personnel on duty reported to the mine manager Lan Jiang, chief engineer Liu Moumou, and actual controller Cai Jingkai. The actual controller Cai Jingkai was separated from
- 2022-09-16 03:08: When counting people, it was found that Zhou Mei had not come out of the well. 37 people went down the well on duty, 36 people went up safely, and 1 person was missing. (2) Emergency response and rescue situations
- 2022-09-16 03:18: Report the accident to the competent authority, Renhuai City Industry and Commerce Bureau
- 2022-09-16 03:21: The Renhuai City Industry and Commerce Bureau began to report the accident in accordance with the prescribed procedures. The coal mine failed to report the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the State Administration of Mine Safety within 1 hour in accordance with the "Regulations on Reporting, Investigation and Handling of Production Safety Accidents" and the Announcement of the Guizhou Bureau of the State Administration of Mine Safety Supervision (2021 No. 1)
- 2022-09-18 13:28: The missing person Zhou Moumou was found and confirmed dead after a doctor’s diagnosis, and the rescue was completed. (3) Accident report status

【Accident Mechanism】
The support strength of this section of the 10501 transport chute was insufficient, and the roof fell first. On-site personnel blindly evacuated without waiting for the roof of the caving area to stabilize. During the evacuation, a second caving occurred, and the waste rock buried an excavation worker; he was confirmed dead after 56 hours and 16 minutes of rescue.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The roof of the 10501 transport chute failed to support and the roof fell. The workers evacuated through the caving area before the roof was stabilized and were buried by secondary falling waste.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient tunnel support strength, cable bolt anchoring quality and project acceptance do not meet requirements; risk analysis, geological forecast, roof hazard investigation and training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Construction shall be carried out in strict accordance with operating procedures and the quality of support shall be inspected.
2. Carry out geological prediction and forecasting, and adjust support in a timely manner when faults, thin coal seams, etc. are discovered.
3. If the roof collapses, demarcate the dangerous area and wait until the roof is stabilized and rescue measures are formulated before handling.
4. Carry out targeted safety training and roof accident emergency drills.
5. Rectify the design, construction and quality acceptance of roadway support, and implement anchoring strength testing of roof bolts and cables.
6. Carry out roof accident emergency drills and hazard avoidance, self-rescue and mutual rescue training.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-02-13 06:00: The mine held an early shift scheduling meeting to arrange the production of 1205 mining surface and the fault maintenance of the vacuum electromagnetic starter of the scraper conveyor.
- 2023-02-13 07:29: Electrical special operations personnel enter the mine.
- 2023-02-13 08:12: The electrical special operations personnel arrived at the +354 dump yard and pressed the opening button to stop the power supply at the 1205 mining area, but the zero lock and tag were not set.
- 2023-02-13 08:14: Special electrical operators entered the electromechanical chamber of 1205 Transport Lane and opened the upper cover of the vacuum electromagnetic starter for inspection.
- 2023-02-13 08:31: Because there was no lighting in the tunnel, the transportation worker pressed the closing button of the feed switch to send power without confirming the maintenance status; the maintenance personnel received an electric shock, and the switch immediately tripped and cut off the power.
- 2023-02-13 09:00: Mine management personnel arrived at the accident scene and organised rescue.
- 2023-02-13 10:40: The casualty was transported out of the well and onto an ambulance, but died on the way.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the electrical special workers were out of power to inspect the vacuum electromagnetic starter, they only pressed the opening button of the feed switch, but did not set the switch handle to zero to mechanically lock it, nor did they hang a sign prohibiting power transmission. After the transport worker discovered that there was no lighting, he pressed the closing button to restore power when there was no condition for power transmission. The maintenance workers suffered electric shocks.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Maintenance power outage was not locked or tagged out, and non-electrical personnel illegally transmitted power, resulting in the electrocution of maintenance workers.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient staffing for special electrical operations, non-full-time personnel operating electrical equipment in violation of regulations for a long time; failure of on-site management of power supply and consumption, education and training, and management of habitual violations.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Regularly check and adjust the grounding, overcurrent, and leakage protection devices of the power supply system.
2. Strictly check the insulation and explosion-proof performance of electrical equipment, and regularly measure the grounding resistance of the grounding network.
3. Carry out low-voltage leakage protection tripping tests every day to ensure that the protection device is sensitive and reliable.
4. Regulatory authorities should strengthen law enforcement and assistance, and urge coal mines to promptly eliminate hidden dangers of electromechanical accidents.
5. Equipped with full-time power supply and distribution personnel who meet the needs, prohibit non-full-time or non-duty electrical personnel from operating electrical equipment; strictly implement the system of power outage and electrical maintenance.
6. Conduct electricity supply and consumption safety education for all employees, and strengthen training on operating procedures, equipment principles and fault handling for special electrical workers.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-03-17 23:30: The mine held a pre-shift briefing at zero o'clock on March 18 to arrange the excavation of the 20503 return air contact lane and other working faces.
- 2023-03-18 01:30: The upper part of the 20503 return air contact lane was blasted; the I-beam shed was not reinforced before blasting.
- 2023-03-18 01:50: The upper blasting was completed. The operators stretched out two front beams without sound the roof and ribs, placed the shed beams and discharged slag without laying the back board.
- 2023-03-18 03:20: After the lower part of the tunnel was blasted, the first two permanent support shed legs were collapsed and the two shed beams on the front beam were shaken off.
- 2023-03-18 04:30: Before the temporary support was completed on site, the shed legs were straightened and the shed beams were lifted in the empty roof area, and the roof fell and buried two workers.
- 2023-03-18 04:32: On-site personnel rescued an injured person.
- 2023-03-18 04:36: On-site personnel rescued another injured person and reported to the mine dispatch room.
- 2023-03-18 05:32: The seriously injured were transported out of the well and sent to hospital for treatment.
- 2023-03-18 09:30: The seriously injured person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2023-03-18 10:20: The coal mine reported the accident to the Jinsha County Energy Bureau over the phone.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the 20503 return air contact lane was blasted, the shed beam on the front beam was knocked down and the permanent supporting shed legs were tilted. No roof-and-rib sounding was done on site. Only two front beams were used for temporary support and no backing board was laid. The person in charge on duty still organised people to support the legs and lift beams in the empty roof area. Coal waste from the roof fell down and buried two people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The person in charge on duty violated regulations and organised personnel to work in the empty roof area without sound the roof and ribs or providing effective temporary support. coal and waste rock fell from the roof and buried personnel.
2. key contributing factors: Temporary supports were not set up according to regulations, individual contracting of excavation projects caused management to go out of control; hidden danger investigation, shift inspection, implementation of regulations and training of new workers were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the dual prevention mechanism of hierarchical management and control of safety risks and the investigation and management of hidden dangers, and implement closed-loop rectification of hidden dangers in five steps.
2. Lead the mine leaders to promptly investigate hidden dangers, stop three violations, and clarify on-site risks before the shift.
3. The group company strengthens technical services, safety inspections and technical approvals, and promptly stops illegal activities.
4. It is strictly prohibited to illegally outsource mining face or tunnel maintenance to individuals as independent projects.
5. Demonstrate permanent and temporary support methods based on the roof and bottom plates and excavation technology, strictly inspect the project, and prevent insufficient support and empty roof operations.
6. Complete pre-job training, learning operating procedures and safety technical measures; new employees will be mentored and trained, and they can work independently only after they have the ability to identify risks.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-03-19 07:30: The construction project department held a pre-shift briefing to arrange for the construction of advanced pipe sheds, extension of belts and effectiveness inspection of outburst prevention measures for the main development heading of the 987 main leveling tunnel.
- 2023-03-19 07:50: Personnel on duty entered the mine one after another.
- 2023-03-19 08:10: 9 workers at the working face and supervisors arrived at the site and arranged to provide back-up help first and then construct the advanced pipe shed.
- 2023-03-19 08:40: The outburst prevention workers went to the working face to measure the K1 value, and were arranged to lift the well, but the K1 value measurement was not carried out.
- 2023-03-19 09:50: The deputy production manager of the project department left after inspecting the working face.
- 2023-03-19 10:20: The dispatching room informed that the back-up operation was over; the tunnel boring machine was subsequently started on site to clean up the back-up operation, and some personnel moved the pipe shed.
- 2023-03-19 10:46: Coal and gas outbursts occurred on the working face during the cutting operation of the tunnel boring machine. The on-site personnel evacuated and reported to the dispatching room.
- 2023-03-19 10:47: The monitor found an abnormality in the methane sensor on the working face; the dispatch room notified other underground personnel to stop operations and evacuate from the auxiliary well.
- 2023-03-19 12:15: The rescue team found the first trapped person in the 987 Main Huiping Lane, and died after the rescue failed.
- 2023-03-21 04:05: The rescue team found the sixth victim at the tail of the belt machine, and the accident rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
Before the M18 outburst coal seam was exposed in the 987 general return tunnel, there were gaps in the control scope of regional outburst prevention measures, the effect inspection and K1 value data were tampered with, and the danger of coal seam outburst was not eliminated. After the K1 value measurement was canceled on duty at the accident, the tunnel boring machine was started to clean the tunnel in violation of regulations. The mechanical disturbance induced coal and gas outbursts. The amount of coal outburst was about 350 tons and the amount of gas outburst was about 22,962 cubic meters, causing casualties.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the danger of the M18 coal seam outburst has not been eliminated, the tunnel boring machine was used illegally to disturb and expose the coal seam, causing coal and gas outbursts.
2. key contributing factors: There are blind spots in the regional outburst prevention measures, gas extraction, effect inspection and K1 value data are falsified; long-distance blasting is not fully implemented, and safety management, construction management and supervision fail.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. It is strictly prohibited to fake sampling, fake data, fake compliance with standards and fake elimination of emergencies, and falsification of emergency prevention measures will be strictly investigated and punished.
2. Establish a hierarchical management and control mechanism for safety risks and a closed-loop management mechanism for hidden dangers, and the superior company will strictly review major disaster management plans.
3. The construction unit shall be equipped with management agencies such as traffic control and ground surveying and special operations personnel.
4. The supervision unit shall recruit qualified professionals in accordance with the contract to carry out on-site supervision and log recording in a real manner.
5. Regulatory departments will strengthen gas control inspections and major hidden dangers handling, and improve the capabilities of the regulatory team.
6. Strictly implement two four-in-one comprehensive outburst prevention measures, accurately measure gas parameters and examine the extraction radius and time; carry out long-distance blasting during the entire process of uncovering coal and passing coal gates.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-07 14:20: The second work area of fully mechanised mining held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the coal extraction operation of the 11181 fully mechanised mining working face.
- 2023-05-07 14:21: The middle shift leads the mine leaders into the mine.
- 2023-05-07 16:20: The deputy district chief on duty led the workers to the 11181 fully mechanised mining face and began the coal cutting operation.
- 2023-05-07 21:45: The shearer stopped after cutting a cut of coal, and arrangements were made on site to clean up the floating coal; an operator cleaned up the sidewalk from the lower safety exit upwards.
- 2023-05-07 22:20: The roof of the guard plate of supports No. 26 to 27 leaked, and the waste rock broke through the protective net and hit the workers cleaning the floating coal at support No. 12.
- 2023-05-07 22:34: The mine dispatching room received the accident report, notified the rescue team and reported to the mine leader, who organised the rescue.
- 2023-05-07 23:30: The ambulance personnel confirmed that the casualty person was dead on the way to the hospital.
- 2023-05-08 00:05: The director of the second comprehensive mining area reported the death of the casualty and the opinions of the family members to the mine.
- 2023-05-08 04:00: The mine handed over the body to the family.
- 2023-05-08 08:00: The mine used a false illness death agreement to handle compensation and concealed the accident.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the No. 23 to No. 51 support section of the 11181 fully mechanised mining working face was broken and the coal wall was chipped. The support was not moved forward in time to strengthen the roof support. There was a gap between the No. 26 and No. 27 support plates. After the operator entered the machine tunnel to clean up the floating coal, the waste rock leaked from the top of the gap and rolled down the shearer. It broke through the protective net between No. 16 and No. 12 supports and hit his head, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The broken roof fell when the support was not in place, broke the protective net and hit the operator who entered the machine tunnel to clean the floating coal, killing him.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to pull up the frame in time to strengthen the roof support, illegally organizing personnel to enter the machine path, inadequate pre-shift briefing and on-site management, and deliberate concealment of reports after the accident.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out special roof management improvements and optimize support methods and parameters according to the conditions of large-angle coal seams.
2. Promote double-day cross-inspection and workplace video surveillance.
3. Improve the safety responsibility system, assessment mechanism and leadership system.
4. If an accident occurs, promptly initiate a rescue plan, report truthfully and protect the scene.
5. Establish a reward and verification mechanism for accident reporting, and seriously investigate those responsible for concealing reports.
6. Promptly pull up the frame and strengthen the support according to the conditions of the roof, improve the technical measures to prevent waste rock channeling, and prohibit entry into the machine tunnel when the support is not in place.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the coal eye was blocked, the squad leader did not report it to the dispatch room or wait for on-site confirmation from the shift leader. He removed the wooden pile above the tiger's mouth at the lower entrance and then entered the coal eye with others to clear the warehouse. During cleaning, the coal and waste rock from the edges and top of the coal hole slipped, burying the squad leader.

1. Direct cause: The squad leader illegally entered the blocked coal hole to clear the warehouse without reporting or confirming it, and was buried by falling coal and waste rock and died.

【Preventative Recommendations】

2. Provide safety officers to improve the quality of pre-shift meetings and shift inspections.
3. Strictly implement no video, no work, job description cards, and all employees to oppose three violations.
4. It is strictly prohibited to conceal reports, and report production safety accidents promptly and truthfully in accordance with regulations.

6. Implement training for new and veteran workers to ensure the true implementation of technical measures and improve self-protection, mutual protection and risk identification capabilities.

- 2023-05-15 04:57: The coal mine reported the accident to the Energy Bureau of Baili Dujuan Management Area, and the investigation determined that the accident was reported late.

【Accident Mechanism】
The No. 1 and No. 2 supports of the 31502 fully mechanised mining working face have hidden dangers of separation and tilt of the No. 1 support. There is also a large amount of waste rock accumulated nearby. The deputy squad leader failed to follow the safety technical measures of at least three people and used a single hydraulic prop to adjust the No. 1 support alone; the single column slipped and the suspended support became unstable, fell, slipped and hit his head.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator violated the requirement of at least three people working together and used a single hydraulic prop to adjust the unstable powered support alone. After the single column slipped, the support fell and slid, injuring someone.
2. key contributing factors: The hidden danger of separation of No. 1 and No. 2 supports on the working face and the narrow working space were not dealt with in a timely manner; on-site inspections, operator training and safety confirmation were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Combine comprehensive rectification and investigation of major hidden dangers to comprehensively eliminate on-site safety hazards.
2. Strengthen on-site environmental management, lead shifts to monitor guards and ensure safety, and stop violations in a timely manner.
3. Prepare and train special emergency plans for various types of accidents, and conduct regular drills.
4. Report accident information in strict accordance with the prescribed time limits and procedures to prevent late reporting, omissions and concealment of reports.
5. Implement the mechanical and electrical transportation responsibility system, operating procedures and safety technical measures to ensure that the equipment, safety facilities and protective devices are intact and reliable.
6. Strengthen the study of the three major regulations and improve employees' ability to predict risks, identify hazards, and protect themselves and each other.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-16 13:35: The rescue squadron received a notification that the main inclined shaft of Panxing Coal Mine was sealed.
- 2023-05-16 13:39: The rescue team received a dispatch notice.
- 2023-05-16 14:10: Six rescue team members arrived in front of the main inclined shaft seal with equipment.
- 2023-05-16 14:30: Coal mine technical personnel implemented safety technical measures for sealing and gas discharge on site.
- 2023-05-16 16:10: The chief engineer of the coal mine arrived at the scene to take command.
- 2023-05-16 16:20: Sealing and unsealing completed, only the gas concentration 1 meter away from the mine entrance was checked on site.
- 2023-05-16 16:30: Four rescue team members wore equipment and entered the tunnel for investigation.
- 2023-05-16 16:35: Two team members ran out of air ducts after laying a 30-meter air duct, and the other two team members continued to investigate downwards.
- 2023-05-16 17:10: The two team members who stayed at the mouth of the air blower found that the investigator fell in the tunnel, the respiratory mask fell off, and the oxygen bottle was closed. They immediately performed initial rescue and called for help.
- 2023-05-16 17:20: Reinforcement rescue team arrived and entered the roadway for rescue.
- 2023-05-16 17:40: Two injured people were rescued from the well and sent to hospital.
- 2023-05-16 20:30: Two injured people died after the hospital failed to rescue them.
- 2023-05-17 09:00: After the national mine safety supervision agency received the report and verified it, the company reported the accident; the investigation determined that the previous behavior was a cover-up.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the old well was unsealed and sealed, only a 30-meter air duct was laid on the 201.6-meter-long tunnel on site. Local ventilation was insufficient, and ambient gases were not detected and recorded as required. Two rescue team members continued to enter the area for investigation and took off their respirator masks without permission, suffocating and fainting in the low-oxygen environment.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the old well was unsealed, effective ventilation and gas inspection were not carried out. The rescue team members took off their respirator masks in the hypoxic environment, resulting in death from suffocation.
2. key contributing factors: Risk identification and technical measures were incomplete, the air duct was not extended on site as required; spare oxygen and detection emergency equipment were not provided, and rescue team training, on-site command and corporate safety management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Old wells and old alleys are not allowed to be sealed without authorization in the name of disaster control; applications for unsealing are strictly reviewed and approved.
2. The rescue team participates in the preparation and review of technical measures and inspects and implements them one by one.
3. The unsealing site is equipped with a rescue technician or commander above to serve as deputy commander-in-chief.
4. Rescue personnel entering the mine must strictly wear personal equipment, carry testing and emergency equipment, and implement mine rescue procedures.
5. Ensure the rescue team’s training venues, equipment maintenance and emergency supplies input.
6. Improve risk identification, technical measures and rescue action plans before opening and sealing; organise ventilation, gas detection, personnel grouping and on-site command as required.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-05-30 07:30: The transportation team held a pre-morning shift meeting and arranged three maintenance workers to deal with the coal feeder failure.
- 2023-05-30 08:00: 3 maintenance workers entered the mine one after another.
- 2023-05-30 at approximately 08:30: The maintenance workers arrived at the 1060 coal bunker coal feeder platform and found that the gate jumped and was in a half-open state, and began to deal with it.
- Around 12:47 on 2023-05-30: Two maintenance workers and managers brought the repaired driving cylinder and pad underground.
- Around 13:20 on 2023-05-30: The manager left after emphasizing safety precautions, and three maintenance workers began to install the coal feeder drive cylinder and pad.
- 2023-05-30 at approximately 13:46: A large amount of wet coal poured out of the coal bunker and collapsed. The coal feeder and maintenance platform were crushed; one maintenance worker fell with the equipment and was buried in coal slime, and the other two people were injured and escaped.
- 2023-05-30 13:53: The dispatch room received the accident report, notified the mine management personnel and summoned the rescue team.
- 2023-05-30 14:08: The coal mine and the mine-based rescue team entered the mine for rescue, and transported two injured people out of the well and sent them to the hospital.
- Around 2023-05-30 17:47: The coal mine reported the accident to the relevant regulatory and supervisory authorities.
- 2023-05-30 19:15: A total of 17 people from two teams of the rescue brigade arrived at the coal mine for reinforcements.
- 2023-05-30 21:21: Rescuers found a maintenance worker trapped at the entrance of the 1060 coal bunker.
- 2023-05-31 01:23: The trapped maintenance worker was rescued. He had no vital signs and the rescue was ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
When inspecting the coal feeder at the lower entrance of the coal bunker, the amount of coal stored was not checked, the coal bunker was not emptied, and no warning was issued at the upper entrance. After the gate was pulled out, a large amount of wet coal poured out and crushed the coal feeder and platform. A maintenance worker on the outside of the platform fell with the equipment and was buried in coal slime and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When inspecting the coal feeder, the coal bunker was not emptied and the gate was not pulled out. The wet coal burst out and crushed the platform, and the maintenance worker was buried in coal slime.
2. key contributing factors: The coal bunker management and maintenance system is lacking, and there is no warning during maintenance; risk analysis, hidden danger investigation, equipment maintenance and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the management department of the coal bunker, conduct unified dispatch during maintenance and set up warnings at the upper entrance of the coal bunker.
2. Check the coal storage amount and empty the coal bunker before maintenance.
3. Regularly check the fasteners and supports of the coal feeder and platform.
4. Report production safety incidents in a timely manner and in accordance with regulations.
5. Establish a management, inspection, maintenance and inspection and testing system for coal bunkers and coal feeders, and implement venting and warning measures before inspection and maintenance.
6. Strengthen safety training on job risk identification, self-protection and mutual protection, and coal bunker maintenance.

【Accident Timeline】
- Around 20:00 on 2023-05-31: The captain of the coal mining team arranged for the operators to go underground to inspect the 11402 coal face before the morning shift the next day, and provide feedback on the inspection situation before the pre-shift briefing.
