- Around 2023-06-01 10:05: The casualties were sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2023-06-01 11:14: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2023-06-01 11:36: The mine manager reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the suspension of mining, the 11402 coal mining working face had problems such as missing columns, pressure relief failure and unconnected roof beams, and was not permanently closed within the specified period. The coal mining team members violated the final safety technical measures and entered the working face for inspection. They were injured and buried by the collapsing roof waste rock. They were sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator violated the closing safety technical measures and ventured into the stopped mining working face for inspection where the support failed. He was injured and died by falling waste rock.
2. key contributing factors: After the working face stopped mining, the roof support inspection and maintenance were not in place, missing and failed pillars were not cured, and the working face was not permanently closed after the prescribed period; the safety responsibilities and on-site management of the trustee parties were not implemented well.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Continue to carry out special rectification of roof management, and strengthen roof management in special areas and key links such as initial mining and final withdrawal.
2. The coal face shall be permanently closed within 45 days after the mining was completed, and ventilation, roof and gas management shall be ensured during the final withdrawal.
3. Carry out in-depth system-wide hidden danger investigation and management and safety training for all employees to avoid going through the motions.
4. Clarify the rights and responsibilities of all parties to the custody, equip safety management and technical personnel, and strengthen on-site supervision and inspection and anti-"three violations" governance.
5. Incorporate the closing and withdrawal of the mining surface into the management and control of key projects, promptly inspect and maintain support after stopping mining, and permanently close it within the specified period.
6. Carry out roof management, closing retracement and risk identification training, and strengthen warning education on illegal operations.

When the transportation team was loading and unloading materials on the auxiliary road of the auxiliary inclined shaft ground yard, it violated the regulations and used the loader bucket as a working platform. The operator stood at the meeting point of the tail mine car to plug the leak, and the signal hooker lifted it without confirming safety. The string of mine cars was pulled and passed through the loader bucket, squeezing it to death.

1. Direct cause: The signal handler lifted the hook without confirming safety, and the mining truck was pulled by the train and squeezed to death the worker near the loader bucket.
2. key contributing factors: The illegal use of loader buckets as working platforms, ground lifting and transportation risk management and control, mine car maintenance management, operating technical measures and training were not in place.

6. It is prohibited to use the loader bucket as a working platform, and improve safety technical measures for ground loader transportation and mine car inspection and maintenance.

2. key contributing factors: No management personnel were arranged for supervision and command on site, personnel safety training and risk notification were insufficient, pre-shift briefing system and roof protection measures were not implemented; production continued after the accident and the site was rearranged.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Promote the investigation of hidden dangers and anti-violation work throughout the day, covering all aspects of production, safety and management.
2. Establish video surveillance at the workplace and strengthen safety training and education.
3. Strengthen the construction of emergency plans and rescue capabilities, initiate emergency plans in a timely manner and protect the accident site.
4. Carry out safety responsibility implementation and safety training for all employees, and clarify the list of rights and responsibilities.
5. The superior company should strengthen technical services, supervision and inspection and mine-based guidance, and promptly stop illegal operations.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-09 08:30: The second fully mechanised mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the production and support maintenance of the 11808 fully mechanised mining face.
- 2023-06-09 09:40: Followers and operators arrived at the 11808 fully mechanised mining working face one after another.
- 2023-06-09 10:10: Organise a pre-shift briefing on site to arrange operations such as bottom pulling of the upper outlet and inspection of brackets.
- 2023-06-09 10:20: The support maintenance personnel discovered that the control valve group of the No. 117 support was faulty, and arranged to close the spherical stop valve of the liquid supply main pipe at the No. 88 support for maintenance.
- 2023-06-09 10:40: The bracket worker discovered that the top beam of the No. 102 bracket was wrong, and mistakenly put the handle in the lowered state; because there was no fluid supply, the bracket did not move at that time, and the handle did not reset.
- 2023-06-09 10:42: Maintenance personnel resumed fluid supply, and the top beam of the No. 102 support fell; when the support workers returned for disposal, the roof fell and was buried by waste rock.
- 2023-06-09 10:51: On-site personnel found that the air volume had become smaller and the channels were blocked by waste rock. After inventory, they found that the support workers were lost and reported to the dispatch room.
- 2023-06-09 10:55: Mine management personnel rushed to the scene for rescue.
- 2023-06-09 11:06: The mine manager directed the rescue in the dispatch room and mobilized other operators for reinforcements.
- 2023-06-09 16:02: When the rescuers cleared the No. 102 bracket, they found that the bracket operating handle was in the lowered state.
- 2023-06-09 16:35: Rescuers searched and rescued the casualty on the pedestrian side of Support No. 101 to 102. There were no vital signs and the rescue was ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The stent worker mistakenly placed the lifting handle of the No. 102 stent in the lowered state when the liquid supply main pipe was not supplying liquid and did not reset it. After the maintenance personnel restored the fluid supply, the roof beam of the support fell. When the worker returned for disposal, the roof fell and he was buried in waste rock and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The bracket worker mistakenly placed the handle in the lowered state and did not reset it. After the fluid supply was restored, the bracket descended, causing the roof strata to fall and bury it.
2. key contributing factors: The switch fluid supply supervisor did not conduct safety confirmation and notification; the bracket fluid supply risk assessment, pipeline hidden danger investigation, on-site management and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Safety confirmation is carried out before each process. No operation is allowed without safety conditions.
2. Regularly carry out roof risk identification assessment and pre-shift hidden danger investigation.
3. Arrange on-site safety management personnel to strictly investigate illegal operations.
4. The superior company strengthens the supervision of the mine and the assessment of hidden dangers.
5. Standardize the fluid supply and operating procedures of the bracket, and rectify hidden equipment hazards such as the connection of the column's inlet and return fluid pipes.
6. Carry out equipment operating procedures, safety confirmation and practical training for new employees.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-16 22:30: The underground mine leader presided over the zero-hour pre-shift briefing and arranged water exploration drilling for the construction of 10803 transportation lane.
- 2023-06-16 23:05: Two exploration and drainage workers arrived at the drilling site of the 10803 transportation lane. After completing the No. 2 borehole, they moved to the No. 5 borehole.
- 2023-06-17 02:09: The drill stuck when drilling about 6.3 metres into the No. 5 borehole. Drilling did not stop at the site and continued drilling for about 3 minutes. The drill bit dry-grinded pulverized coal to produce high temperature and thick smoke.
- 2023-06-17 02:12: The carbon monoxide sensor at the drilling site alarmed, the dispatcher issued an evacuation order, and on-site personnel began to evacuate.
- 2023-06-17 02:13: On-site personnel moved the carbon monoxide sensor into the air duct and retreated to the stone gate of the II track.
- 2023-06-17 02:23: The mine director and chief engineer discovered through video that the No. 5 borehole was burning and igniting the left coal wall.
- 2023-06-17 02:50: The mine manager and other personnel entered the 10803 transportation lane and faced it. They used water injection and dry powder fire extinguishers to extinguish the open fire and seal the hole.
- 2023-06-17 03:30: On-site personnel reported that the concentration of toxic and harmful gases in the disaster area was too high and requested that a rescue team enter the mine.
- 2023-06-17 03:48: Six members of the part-time rescue team wore respirators and went underground to rescue. On the way, some people became ill and the rescue was blocked.
- 2023-06-17 04:04: The accident occurred when the safety inspector and technician on duty carried a self-rescuer and evacuated to about 280 metres away from the 10803 Transport Lane due to insufficient oxygen supply.
- 2023-06-17 04:40: The coal mine summoned the Jinsha County Emergency Rescue Brigade to implement professional rescue.
- 2023-06-17 04:41: Dagou Coal Mine reported the accident to Jinsha County Energy Bureau over the phone.
- 2023-06-17 05:10: Jinsha County emergency rescue team arrived at the mine to carry out rescue.
- 2023-06-17 06:30: The first injured person was transported out of the well and sent to Jinsha County People's Hospital for treatment.
- 2023-06-17 06:50: The safety inspector and technician on duty was transported out of the well and sent to Jinsha County People's Hospital for treatment.
- 2023-06-17 07:20: The remaining four trapped persons were rescued out of the well, and the rescue was completed.
- 2023-06-18 01:00: The safety inspector and technician on duty was pronounced dead after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty used wind and slag removal to explore the water drilling hole without access to water. The drilling hole continued to drill after it got stuck. The drill bit dry-grinded the pulverized coal to generate high temperatures and ignited the coal body. After the open fire was extinguished, the coal continued to burn incompletely and produced toxic and harmful gases. The mine did not take effective protective measures and still illegally entered the disaster area to put out the fire and rescue. As a result, the safety inspector and technician on duty died of poisoning due to inhalation of toxic and harmful gases.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Dry drilling without water and continuous dry drilling after the drill got stuck. The friction and high temperature ignited the coal mass; the miner illegally organised firefighting and rescue in a toxic and harmful gas environment, resulting in poisoning and death.
2. key contributing factors: illegal movement of carbon monoxide sensors; failure to publicize and implement water detection and release measures, unlicensed operations and ineffective on-site prevention; inadequate emergency training, drills, equipment maintenance and group safety control.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Equip the company with safety management and professional technical personnel, and strictly assess the mine safety position responsibility system of all employees.
2. Strengthen technical approval, safety inspection of affiliated mines and disaster prevention and control technical services, and promptly stop illegal activities.
3. Equip and maintain emergency rescue equipment, and conduct regular emergency rescue training and drills.
4. Implement the job responsibility system and dual prevention mechanism, investigate hidden dangers and ensure that rectifications are in place.
5. Carry out safety technical measures, risk emergency response and special rescue drill training to enable personnel to master operating procedures, disaster avoidance routes and self-rescue and mutual rescue requirements.
6. Put an end to illegal activities such as illegal dry drilling, moving or blinding sensors, and risky rescue, and improve disaster emergency response capabilities.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-20 15:00: The transportation team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange inspections of equipment in the ground belt machine room, but did not arrange maintenance of the main belt; the maintenance workers did not attend the pre-shift briefing.

- 2023-06-20 at approximately 20:00: The maintenance worker entered the No. 2 driving drum to install the over-temperature sprinkler device without stopping the machine. His arm was caught between the drum and the tape, and his body spun and fell.
- Around 20:18 on June 20, 2023: The leader on duty of the transportation team reported the accident to the deputy mine manager of mechanical and electrical mines, and immediately organised rescue.
- 2023-06-20 20:25: The coal mine rescue team rushed to the scene after receiving the call.
- Around 20:40, 2023-06-20: The casualties were sent to the hospital.
- 2023-06-20 22:06: The doctor confirmed that the casualty person was dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
The maintenance worker did not attend the pre-shift briefing and installed an over-temperature sprinkler device between the No. 2 driving drum and the reversing drum frame while the main inclined shaft belt conveyor was running. His right arm was caught in the roller and the tape, and his body rotated with the driving roller. His head hit the roller and fell, causing severe craniocerebral injury and death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance worker entered between the driving roller and the reversing roller when the belt conveyor was running. His arm was involved and he died from severe brain injury.
2. key contributing factors: Maintenance workers did not attend the pre-shift briefing, insufficient protection and warnings were provided for the rotating parts of the equipment, and on-site safety management, education and training, and hidden danger investigation were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Regularly investigate and improve the hidden dangers of transportation equipment protection devices and formulate corrective measures.
2. Improve the protective fences, protective nets and safety warnings for the rotating parts of the equipment.
3. Strengthen on-site safety management of teams, districts and important transportation links.
4. Carry out risk prevention and control and hidden danger investigation and management of the electromechanical transportation system, and make rectifications as required.
5. Report production safety accident information promptly and truthfully.
6. Improve the belt conveyor protection device, rotating part protection and maintenance management system. Maintenance must regulate shutdown and implement safety measures.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-06-27 23:00: The deputy director of mechanical and electrical mine organised a pre-shift briefing at zero o'clock on June 28 to arrange operations at the 31407 fully mechanised mining face and other locations.
- 2023-06-27 23:10: The first coal mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the work for the shift.
- 2023-06-27 23:20: A coal mining team of 10 people began to enter the mine.
- 2023-06-27 23:40: Personnel arrived at the 31407 fully mechanised mining working face and started operations after the shift handover.
- 2023-06-28 00:14: The shearer started cutting coal; when cutting to the No. 100 bracket, a squeeze occurred. The squad leader did not deal with the squeeze and forcibly moved the bracket into place.
- 2023-06-28 05:00: The shearer enters the next cycle of coal cutting.
- 2023-06-28 06:00: The shearer was cutting coal in the direction of the transportation lane, and the squad leader moved the shear without supervision.
- 2023-06-28 06:20: The squad leader repeatedly raised and lowered and forcibly pulled the No. 100 bracket that was squeezed by the adjacent bracket. The bracket suddenly fell, damaging and squeezing it.
- 2023-06-28 06:30: The safety inspector and the shearer driver reported the accident to the captain, stopped relevant equipment on site and organised rescue.
- 2023-06-28 08:15: The accident was reported to the dispatch room on site.
- 2023-06-28 08:25: The mine director reported the underground accident to the Jinsha County Energy Bureau.
- 2023-06-28 09:50: The casualty was lifted out of the mine entrance from the auxiliary inclined shaft and put into an ambulance. He died after rescue efforts failed on the way.

【Accident Mechanism】
Due to the fold structure, the No. 100 support of the 31407 fully mechanised mining working face formed a depression, limited the working space and caused a squeeze. The squad leader repeatedly raised and lowered the bracket without supervision and forcibly moved the No. 100 bracket without handling the squeeze. The suspended bracket suddenly fell and moved forward, causing damage and being squeezed between the top beam of the bracket and the cable trough of the scraper, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the No. 100 powered support was squeezed, the operator forcibly lifted and moved it repeatedly without supervision, and the suspended support suddenly fell and squeezed it to death.
2. key contributing factors: The requirements stipulated in the operating procedures that two people should move the frame and deal with the causes of excessive resistance first were not implemented; the procedures or supplementary measures were not revised after the working face conditions changed, and risk identification, hidden danger management and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish and implement job responsibility systems and operating procedures, and strengthen on-site supervision and control.
2. Improve risk management and control and hidden danger investigation and management, report and eliminate hidden dangers in a timely manner.
3. Strictly review and approve procedures and technical measures, and revise and review them as site conditions change.
4. Strengthen safety education and training for special key positions and all employees.
5. The group company strengthens technical services, technical approvals and safety inspections, and prohibits independent outsourcing of mining operations to individuals in violation of regulations.
6. Timely revise operating procedures and safety technical measures according to changes in operating conditions, and strictly implement the requirements for two-person rack moving, monitoring, and handling of crowded racks.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the drilling rig's tracks sank into the soft floor and could not be started, the maintenance personnel raised the support cylinder and padded the wood in a small space. - Approximately 2023-08-07 15:30: 5 operators entered the mine one after another, and after arriving at the working face, they inspected equipment and transported materials.
- Around 17:30 on 2023-08-07: The tunnel boring machine started and started excavation.
- Around 20:10 on 2023-08-07: Excavation stopped, and the working face footage was about 4 metres.
- Around 20:30 on 2023-08-07: The operators removed the previous row of anchor plates and began to overlap and hang the net without moving the front beam forward.

【Accident Mechanism】
The development heading was overexcavated by about 4 metres, and the front exploration beam was not moved forward. The previous row of anchor bolts and anchor plates was removed and the hanging net was connected on site under the condition of empty ceiling. The roof suddenly collapsed, burying an excavation worker and injuring another person. He died after being rescued by the buried worker and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The development heading was seriously overexcavated. The operators failed to set up temporary support as required and supported it in the empty roof area. The roof collapsed and injured people.

4. The superior company shall perform safety management, supervision and inspection responsibilities, and supervise the implementation of systems and measures.
5. Construct temporary supports in strict accordance with regulations, control footage, and prevent over-excavation and empty-top operations.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-08-07 16:00: The coal mining team held a pre-event shift meeting and arranged for 8 operators to transport and install the shearer drum.
- 2023-08-07 16:27: The deputy captain of the coal mining team reported the replacement of the drum to the deputy mine manager of electromechanical.
- 2023-08-07 19:32: The deputy captain of the coal mining team once again reported the replacement of the drum.
- 2023-08-07 19:39: The deputy captain of the coal mining team once again reported the replacement of the drum.
- 2023-08-07 19:57: The deputy captain of the coal mining team once again reported the replacement of the drum.
- 2023-08-08 01:49: When the squad leader used a single hydraulic prop to push the drum, the prop slipped and fell, and the drum rolled down and pressed on his chest and abdomen.
- 2023-08-08 01:49: The remaining workers called nearby personnel for support and reported the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2023-08-08 02:55: The casualty person died after being transported to the hospital after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal-mining team installed a shearer drum without safety technical measures, a safety inspector or a designated person in overall command. The team leader used two single hydraulic props to push the inadequately secured drum, without anti-slip measures between the props. During radial hydraulic jacking, the props became unstable and slipped; the drum fell and crushed his chest and abdomen, causing fatal injuries.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: While the shearer drum was being installed, a single hydraulic prop became unstable and slipped, allowing the inadequately secured drum to fall and crush the worker fatally.
2. Key contributing factors: No safety technical measures had been prepared; there was no safety inspector or unified on-site command; safety and technical management were disconnected; and workers had received insufficient safety training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Hold effective pre-shift briefings, coordinate work arrangements, and implement the requirement for the shift mine manager to travel underground with the shift.
2. Apply a specific safety measure to each project and promptly stop unsafe instructions, unsafe work and reckless conduct.
3. Deliver comprehensive safety training and prohibit work where safety technical measures are absent.
4. Require the parent company to review safety performance regularly and ensure that mines rectify identified management shortcomings.
5. Standardise the organisation, technical controls and on-site safety management of shearer-drum installation, in line with the project-specific safety-measure requirement.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2023-08-10 03:15: After the air duct extension was completed and the undercover was preparing to repair it, the separation layer shotcrete body suddenly collapsed and pressed the squad leader's upper body against the gas drainage pipe.
- 2023-08-10 03:25: On-site personnel reported to the mine dispatch room that the squad leader was injured by a shotcrete body, and rescue was being organised.
- 2023-08-10 03:27: The dispatcher notified the nearby district chief and safety inspector to go to the accident site to organise rescue.
- 2023-08-10 03:46: The safety inspector reported to the dispatch room that the casualty person was squeezed between the gunite body and the gas drainage pipe.
- 2023-08-10 04:31: The casualties were rescued and transferred to the main mine entrance.
- 2023-08-10 05:48: The casualty person died after being sent to the hospital after rescue efforts failed.
- 2023-08-10 06:25: The coal mine reported the accident to the relevant authorities.

【Accident Mechanism】
The support of the uphill roadway in mining area 11 was deformed due to return air, the shotcrete body was separated from the roadway rock, and protective measures such as temporary support were not taken. After the air duct extension was completed, the squad leader was standing on the side of the alley preparing for undercover repairs. The shotcrete body of the separation layer suddenly collapsed and pressed his upper body on the gas drainage pipe. He was sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The shotcrete body of the deformed tunnel detached from the deformation layer fell off and crushed the squad leader who entered the work site without taking protective measures to death.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to implement temporary support and ask for support during maintenance operations, and insufficient preparation of roof hazard investigation and management, on-site management, training and safety technical measures.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement the main responsibility for mine safety, carry out risk analysis and eliminate hidden dangers in a timely manner.
2. Provide timely support for tunnel maintenance and excavation to reduce the distance and time of empty roof.
3. Monitor the roof separation layer, surrounding rock displacement and anchor load in the anchor-supported tunnel.
4. Arrange on-site supervision by managers and safety officers for high-risk tunnel repair operations.
5. The group company conducts inspections on risks in subordinate mines and supervises prevention and rectification.
6. Standardize technical measures for restoration operations, including knocking on roofs, handling suspended live rock waste, and implementing temporary support and on-site supervision before operations.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine illegally used a back-column winch without protection devices to lower 15 equipment trains. No. 2 contact lane warning was not set up and there was a risk of fatigue damage to the equipment connection devices. The 5th equipment train at the rear ran over and knocked down the operator walking on the track in the lifting area, causing death.

5. Improve the mine safety responsibility system and operating procedures for all employees, and strengthen supervision and assessment.
6. Select qualified lifting equipment, wire ropes, connecting devices and sports car protective devices according to the design, establish an inspection ledger and strictly implement special measures.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-09-23 22:00: Mining District 1 held a zero-hour dispatch meeting to arrange coal mining, conveyor belt inspections, drilling construction and other work.
- 2023-09-24 07:48: A fire broke out near the belt conveyor in the second section of the 1200 transportation lane, and smoke appeared after the conveyor belt was stopped.
- 2023-09-24 08:11: Two underground personnel reported the occurrence of smoke to the dispatch room of Mining District 1, but the dispatcher did not immediately issue an evacuation order.
- 2023-09-24 08:24: The methane examiner on duty at 211016 asked about the cause of the smoke, and the dispatch room informed him to evacuate.
- 2023-09-24 08:28: Mining District No. 1 reported to the mine dispatching room that there was smoke in the transportation lane and had arranged to evacuate people. The mine dispatching required a power outage to evacuate people.
- 2023-09-24 08:38: The underground personnel clearly reported that the conveyor belt in the 1200 transport tunnel was on fire.
- 2023-09-24 08:40: The mine dispatching room reported the conveyor belt fire situation to the mine leader, who arranged for the entire mine to evacuate underground personnel.
- 2023-09-24 09:51: Two mine rescue teams arrived in the mining area to carry out fire reconnaissance, fire extinguishing and search and rescue respectively.
- 2023-09-24 13:25: The last trapped person was found; of the 17 trapped persons, 1 escaped and 16 showed no signs of life.
- 2023-09-24 18:34: The last victim was transported to the ground, and the on-site rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
Old powerful conveyor belts that have not been tested for flame retardancy and anti-static electricity are used in severely disrepaired and deformed tunnels. When the conveyor belt catches fire, a large amount of toxic smoke is produced. Some carbon monoxide and smoke sensors on the downwind side were not connected to the Internet or were damaged. The mine failed to identify the fire, evacuate people and initiate rescue operations in time. The smoke flowed along the transportation lane, and many personnel failed to evacuate safely.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: An old strong conveyor belt that had not been accepted and tested for flame retardant and antistatic properties caught fire at the second belt conveyor in the 1200 Transport Lane, producing toxic smoke and causing casualties.
2. key contributing factors: The roadway is in serious disrepair and has not been rectified; fire monitoring sensors are not effectively connected to the network and some have been vandalized; evacuation, accident reporting and rescue team call are not timely, and personnel emergency escape training is insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Consolidate safety responsibilities in all aspects of compaction equipment, site, and emergency response, and thoroughly rectify major hidden dangers.
2. Strengthen the management of safety monitoring and surveillance systems, and it is strictly forbidden to destroy sensors and not upload monitoring data.
3. Establish a timely and truthful accident information reporting system, and strictly prohibit late reporting, omissions and false reporting.
4. Deepen the Double Full Day, carry out investigation of cross-hazards between the group and the mine, and combat three violations by all employees.
5. Strengthen supervision and law enforcement, dig into the management issues behind hidden dangers of accidents, and seriously pursue accountability.
6. Check non-flame-retardant conveyor belts and facilities and equipment that do not meet safety requirements mine by mine, conduct flame-retardant and anti-static tests and accept acceptance before the conveyor belts are brought into the mine.

【Accident Timeline】
- Around 06:30 on 2023-10-09: Mining Area 11 held a production scheduling meeting to arrange for rectification of hidden dangers discovered during recent inspections.
- Around 08:50 on 2023-10-09: Two workers arrived at the power distribution point of the 110604 Transportation Lane Gas Control Lane and began to organise and hang cables.
- Around 11:00 on 2023-10-09: Certified electricians arrived at the distribution point to hang cables together.
- Around 11:30 on 2023-10-09: Monitoring and maintenance workers arrived at the scene to repair the monitoring lines and cooperate with hanging cables.
- Around 13:10 on 2023-10-09: The plumber opened and cut off the power on his own to sort out the cables, without locking, tagging or reporting to the dispatch room.
- 2023-10-09 13:45: After the scraper driver discovered that the feed switch was open, he pressed the closing button to send power without checking the on-site work conditions. The plumber who was holding the cable head was electrocuted.
- Around 13:49 on 2023-10-09: The mine dispatcher received a report, requested on-site first aid and arranged for a rescue team to enter the mine for rescue.
- 2023-10-09 14:35: The mine rescue team encountered the casualty at the three-way intersection of the underground car yard, confirmed that he was still breathing and pulsed, and administered first aid.
- 2023-10-09 15:05: The casualty arrived at the mine entrance and were taken to the hospital by ambulance.
- 2023-10-09 15:26: The casualty arrived at the hospital and began rescue operations.
- 2023-10-09 15:58: The hospital declared the casualty person dead.
- 2023-10-09 16:34: The mine director reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau, the Provincial Energy Bureau and the Provincial Emergency Management Department.

【Accident Mechanism】
In order to sort out the twisted cables, the plumber illegally operated the vacuum feed switch to cut off the power, without locking, tagging or reporting; he removed the lighting comprehensive protection power supply side cable and held the cable head to prepare for wiring. Because the equipment had no power, the driver of the scraper closed the switch and supplied power without checking whether anyone was working on site, without authorization and without reporting. The plumber was immediately electrocuted and injured, and he died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A worker failed to implement power outage lockout and tagout during cable work, and another worker illegally sent power without checking the on-site work conditions, resulting in the worker being electrocuted.
2. key contributing factors: non-electrical personnel stopped power supply in violation of regulations, lack of unified scheduling of cross-work operations, and insufficient power supply and consumption management, protection, hidden danger investigation and training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the power supply and distribution management system, and strengthen power outage and multi-type operation scheduling management.
2. Equipped with full-time power supply and distribution technicians who meet the needs of safe production.
3. Strengthen the investigation of potential risks in mechanical and electrical transportation and provide guidance on mechanical and electrical management in the 11 mining areas.
4. Carry out special inspections of mechanical and electrical hazards, and evacuate workers and stop work before major hazards are eliminated.
5. Regulatory authorities will strengthen law enforcement and assistance to promote coal mines to improve their safety management capabilities.
6. Strictly implement power supply lockout, tag-out, reporting and electrical maintenance procedures. Non-full-time or off-duty electrical personnel are not allowed to operate electrical equipment.

Then he accidentally slipped and was crushed and dragged by the frame truck. On-site personnel stopped the vehicle to rescue the casualty, and the casualty person died after being taken to a well and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally rode an electric locomotive and was run over by the trolley after falling off.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to formulate an electric locomotive safety management system and pedestrian operation requirements during peak periods, long-term ineffective investigation and punishment of vehicle violations, and insufficient risk analysis and pre-job training for new workers.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the inspection of personnel walking when the transportation system is in operation, and strictly investigate and punish violations such as car picking.
2. Apply human-machine environmental management analysis methods to identify transportation risks during peak periods for commuters and formulate control measures.
3. Sort out subsystem risks based on system hidden dangers, and implement targeted rectifications and risk reminders.
4. Establish an electric locomotive transportation safety management system to clarify vehicle operation and pedestrian management requirements during commuting and work.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2023-11-25 23:10: The head of the preparation area held a pre-night shift meeting and arranged 3 people to be responsible for the lifting, transportation, management and hook removal of the track inclined shaft.
- 2023-11-26 03:40: The operator received the dispatch notice and lowered the ground shipping belt to the track inclined shaft 1060 yard through the winch.
- 2023-11-26 04:43: Two operators loaded the belt with a rack truck and connected an empty mine car behind the truck to prepare for returning to the ground.
- 2023-11-26 05:24: The empty mine car was lifted to about 7 metres above the 1060 yard and fell off the track and was towed. The guide rope jammed it and the winch stopped running.
- 2023-11-26 06:00: When the handler used a hoist to pull the tail of the mine cart to the left, the stuck spot of the mine cart came loose and suddenly jumped out to the left front, knocking down and crushing the on-site observers, and the accident occurred.
- 2023-11-26 06:10: The winch driver notified the mine entrance hook worker to come to the scene to participate in the rescue.
- 2023-11-26 06:18: On-site personnel rescued the casualty from under the mine car and implemented a temporary hemostatic bandage.
- 2023-11-26 06:25: The ambulance team attendant received a call from the dispatch room and learned that a work-related injury occurred in the 1060 parking lot.
- 2023-11-26 07:00: The casualty was escorted out of the well and sent to the hospital. He fell unconscious on the way and was transferred to a nearby hospital.
- 2023-11-26 08:20: The casualty's vital signs were weak and he was urgently transferred to Shuigang Hospital for rescue.
- 2023-11-26 09:42: The casualty died after unsuccessful rescue efforts by Shuigang Hospital. The on-site rescue operation ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
The empty mine car fell off the track during the lifting of the track inclined shaft and was stuck by the guide pulley. The handler used a hoist to pull the tail of the mine car to reset it. Because the distance between the track and the belt conveyor was too small, the observers stood on the left and front of the mine car where the mine car might have drifted. After the front part of the mine car got loose, it suddenly jumped out to the left and front under the combined action of the traction force of the wire rope and the hoist, knocking it down and suppressing its lower limbs. He eventually died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When handling the off-track mine car, the operator illegally stood on the offset and tilted side of the mine car. He was hit by the suddenly shifted mine car and was crushed to death.
2. key contributing factors: The track laying is not standard and the safety distance between it and the belt conveyor is insufficient; transportation measures lack pertinence, and on-site management, hidden danger management, training, and supervision by superior companies are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Standardize the preparation and approval of safety technical measures, formulate corresponding prevention and control measures based on risks, and establish an implementation supervision mechanism.
2. Correct the identified hidden dangers in accordance with the "Five Implementations" requirements, and seriously hold accountable the hidden dangers that are not corrected within the time limit.
3. Strengthen anti-violation education and safety management activities involving all employees.
4. Carry out risk analysis and hidden danger investigation and management throughout the system, clarify grid-based mine safety responsibilities and rectify typical violations.
5. Use diversified training and strict assessment according to the characteristics of the work to enhance employees’ awareness of self-protection and mutual protection.
6. Match technical measures with on-site risks and implement them underground to eliminate systemic hidden dangers in rail transportation.

The removable protective net of the belt overpass of the main inclined shaft was removed, and the cleaners who were transferred to work went under the belt conveyor to clean the floating coal when it was running. 【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-01-04 00:10: The third excavation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 5 people to go to the opening point of the 1380 (II) transport stone gate return air contact lane to lay cable bolts, cut nets, brush and open the opening.
- Around 01:30 on 2024-01-04: 5 personnel arrived at the operation site. After strengthening the operation platform, 3 people worked on the platform and 2 people were responsible for removing slag.
- Around 03:30 on 2024-01-04: Due to the accumulation of waste rock, some personnel were adjusted to slag discharging, and the squad leader continued to work on the operating platform.
- 2024-01-04 06:50: The broken rock on top of the brush gang collapsed, hitting the chest and legs of the squad leader who was not tied with a safety rope, causing him to fall from the platform and hit his head against the waste rock.
- 2024-01-04 06:56: Report to the captain of the third excavation team on site, and then report to the deputy mine director of safety and the mine manager.
- Around 07:10 on 2024-01-04: The captain of the third excavation team arrived at the accident point to organise rescue.
- Around 07:30 on 2024-01-04: The mine director and others discussed not to call in the rescue team for the time being to rescue themselves, and arranged to shift or destroy the video cameras on the route for transporting the casualty.
- 2024-01-04 07:42: The casualty began to be transported out from the scene.
- Around 09:20 on 2024-01-04: The casualty was carried into a mine car and lifted out of the mine.
- 2024-01-04 09:39: The coal mine dispatching room summoned the mine rescue team to participate in the rescue.
- Around 09:40 on 2024-01-04: The casualties were transported to the mouth of the waste rock inclined shaft.
- 2024-01-04 10:35: The ambulance team sent the casualty to the hospital for rescue.
- 2024-01-04 10:49: The mine manager reported the accident to the government and relevant departments, but falsely reported that he was injured after falling from the platform, and also lied about the time, type and circumstances of the accident.
- 2024-01-04 11:05: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
At the opening point of the contact lane where the roof was broken, the workers violated the measures and brushed the platform on the platform without using the safety rope. The top rock collapsed and hit his chest and legs. He fell from the platform and hit his head on the waste rock. He died after being rescued but failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator did not use a safety rope to brush the broken roof, and was hit by falling waste rock and fell from the operating platform.
2. key contributing factors: The risk analysis and technical measures for opening operations are incomplete and not implemented, the requirements of two safety personnel, no operation without video and anti-three violations are not implemented, and the training, leadership and supervision of superior companies are insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Late reporting, false reporting of accidents and damage to safety monitoring equipment are strictly prohibited.
2. Install video surveillance at the work site before starting work.
3. Carry out roof risk analysis and improve technical measures for opening projects.
4. Strictly implement the requirements for roof-and-rib sounding, surrounding rock observation and platform safety ropes.
5. The superior company shall strengthen the performance of duties of the mine safety supervisors and the management and control of major hazard sources.
6. Conduct on-site inspection, consultation and improve safety technical measures before opening; adopt advanced management and reliable support for the broken roof section, and use safety ropes for platform operations.

【Accident Timeline】

- After about 08:00 on 2024-01-29: 18 workers arrived at the 11127 retraction working face and carried out the retraction of the bracket according to the division of labor.
- 2024-01-29 18:18: When the No. 105 support was being transported to the upper safety exit, a retrieval worker entered the sector area without authorization to recover the single hydraulic prop.
- 2024-01-29 18:19: On-site personnel found the retrieval worker lying on his back in the sector, with his helmet off and his head bleeding.
- 2024-01-29 18:23: The safety inspector reported the accident to the coal mine dispatch room.
- 2024-01-29 18:27: The dispatcher reported to the deputy mine manager of production, who then reported to the mine manager.
- 2024-01-29 18:30: The squad leader of the outsourcing project department reported the underground accident to his on-site safety manager.
- 2024-01-29 18:40: The mine director called the superior company to report the accident underground.
- 2024-01-29 18:57: The casualties were transported from the waste disposal shaft to the ground at the scene.
- 2024-01-29 19:30: The casualties were sent to Xishui County People’s Hospital for rescue.
- 2024-01-29 20:16: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty was confirmed dead.
- 2024-01-29 21:01: The mine manager made a telephone report to the Xishui County Industry and Energy Bureau, falsely reporting that the ground worker was injured while walking.
- 2024-01-29 22:35: The coal mine submitted a written report to the Xishui County Industry and Energy Bureau.
- 2024-01-29 23:48: The County Industry and Energy Bureau submitted a written report to the Zunyi City Industry and Energy Bureau.
- 2024-01-30: The Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau jointly verified with relevant departments and confirmed that the accident occurred at the underground 11127 retraction working face and resulted in the death of one person.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the retrieval workers entered the fan-shaped area without authorization to recover the single hydraulic prop, the wire rope fixed to the roof suddenly collapsed after being stressed and hit his head, causing death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the retrieval worker was recovering a single hydraulic prop in the sector area, he was hit in the head by the collapse and rebound of the roof wire rope.
2. key contributing factors: fan-shaped area support, column unloading and personnel evacuation were not implemented according to regulations, and the outsourcing project department did not arrange on-site follow-up; coal mine safety confirmation, hidden danger investigation, outsourcing management and double-day work were insufficient.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Report accidents strictly and truthfully.
2. Strengthen on-site, technical and safety management of outsourced construction teams.
3. The superior enterprise should improve the assessment mechanism and supervise the standardized technical management, training and full-time work of its affiliated coal mines.
4. Implement safety condition confirmation and process control before operation, and strengthen the on-site responsibilities of safety personnel, shift leaders and followers.
5. Carry out safety training, ideological rectification and accident warning education for all employees to improve self-protection, mutual protection and safe operation capabilities.
6. Incorporate outsourcing teams into integrated mine safety management, carry out system safety confirmation, grid-based responsibility management, and all-employee anti-violation.

- 2024-02-28 11:04: After completing the inspection, the inspection electrician prepared to go up the shaft and walked to the tail wheel of the overhead crew unit.
- 2024-02-28 11:05: The inspection electrician was pulling a lifting chair to walk in a non-pedestrian area. The lifting chair entered the inside of the anti-overswing device and was blocked by the forward lifting chair. The person was suspended and stuck.
- After 2024-02-28 11:17: The overhead passenger device restarted, and people fell from the device to the tunnel floor.

- 2024-02-28 12:55: The casualties were transported out of the well, and medical staff at the mine entrance performed rescue operations.
- 2024-02-28 13:06: Doctors declared the casualty dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
The inspection electrician did not get on the bus on the ride platform, but walked in the non-pedestrian area of the overhead passenger device using a lifting chair. The lifting chair tilted under the force and entered the inside of the anti-overswing device. It was blocked by the forward lifting chair and then lifted up, causing it to be stuck in the air. After the device was activated, the person fell and died after the rescue failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The inspection electrician illegally pulled a lifting chair to walk in the non-pedestrian area of the overhead passenger device. He was caught by the lifting chair and the anti-swing device and fell.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient risk identification, on-site control, warning education, equipment maintenance management and violation control in riding and pedestrian areas.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly ride on the aerial passenger device on the designated riding platform, and it is prohibited to walk with a lifting chair.
2. Improve the inspection and maintenance, alarm prompts and prohibited area management of the anti-overswing device.
3. Strengthen employee safety training and three violations.
4. Carry out risk identification and hidden danger investigation in the transportation system.
5. Improve the riding, maintenance and non-pedestrian area management systems for overhead passenger devices, and set up effective warning and control measures.
6. Strengthen warnings and education on safe riding of overhead passenger devices, prohibited areas and violations.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-03-03 06:50: The mine held a dispatch meeting to arrange the maintenance of the inclined transport tunnel in a section.
- 2024-03-03 07:30: The lane repair team assigned 8 personnel to repair a section of the transportation inclined lane before the shift.
- 2024-03-03 08:35: The lane maintenance team arrived at the maintenance operation point, and the squad leader arranged for brushing, waste rock removal, material transportation and other operations; the safety inspector did not go to the maintenance point for inspection.
- 2024-03-03 09:40: The gunite body on the left side suddenly collapsed and fell over on the right side, hitting two road construction workers who were working.
- 2024-03-03 10:15: An injured person was rescued from the well and sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2024-03-03 12:10: The casualty died after the hospital failed to rescue him.

【Accident Mechanism】
The maintenance point of the transportation inclined lane in Section 1 has not used the prescribed temporary support since the start of construction, and there is no support material on site. The shift leader did not rectify the problem after discovering it. While the road construction workers were working on the road expansion without support, a large piece of concrete shotcrete in the upper left road suddenly collapsed and tipped over to the right road, hitting two people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance work failed to set up temporary supports according to the measures, and the original tunnel shotcrete body collapsed and injured people.
2. key contributing factors: The mine leaders, squad leaders and safety officers in charge failed to implement temporary support, on-site inspection and video requirements; production shutdown and rectification and resumption of production procedures were not completed but still organised operations in violation of regulations, and the superior company and the mine supervision did not perform their duties adequately.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the double-day safety confirmation, grid guarantee and assessment mechanism.
2. Strictly implement no work without video, and monitor the work location.
3. The superior company strictly controls the resumption of work and production, and strengthens the supervision and assessment of personnel stationed in the mine.
4. Coal mines that have stopped production for rectification must complete acceptance inspection before production can be resumed.
5. Mine safety supervisors should strengthen on-site inspections and promptly stop and report any refusal to execute instructions.
6. Temporary support measures must be prepared and implemented for maintenance and condition change operations, and the status of the roof, support and video must be comprehensively checked before operation.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2024-04-06 08:02: The squad leader and other 6 people took a car underground from the auxiliary tunnel.
- 2024-04-06 09:52: The workers arrived at the head of the second belt conveyor in the 210604 transportation lane and prepared to perform the tape nailing and buckling work.
- 2024-04-06 10:10: When the workers were tightening the buckles, the mining area management personnel and safety officers went to the site to inspect, but did not stop the work.
- 2024-04-06 11:18: A maintenance worker jogged the reverse belt conveyor, and the maintenance worker squatting above the double drive rollers to connect the buckles was caught between the two rollers together with the tape.
- 2024-04-06 11:22: The squad leader reported the accident to the Caisan District dispatch room and notified nearby personnel for rescue.
- 2024-04-06 12:17: The mine rescue squadron arrived at the scene and rescued the maintenance worker who was wrapped in tape.
- 2024-04-06 13:25: The casualties were transported to the ground and sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2024-04-06 14:05: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty nailed the buckles above the double drive rollers at the head of the belt conveyor without implementing the safety technical measures for tape nailing and buckling and without the on-site safety command of the team leader. In order to connect two snap joints that could not be aligned, one maintenance worker squatted on top of the roller, and another maintenance worker jogged the reverse conveyor. The worker and the tape were caught between the two driving rollers. He died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance worker reversed the overlapping buckle of the equipment above the double drive rollers at the head of the belt conveyor and was caught between the double drive rollers.
2. key contributing factors: "One project, one measure" was not implemented in the tape nailing and buckling operation, training for transferred personnel, on-site stoppage of violations and management of shift management were not in place, and long-term illegal operations were not corrected.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement "one project, one measure" and carry out tape repair and fastening operations only after learning and implementing safety technical measures.
2. Strictly implement the equipment maintenance operating procedures, and prohibit illegal nailing of buckles and overlapping buckles of the reverse roller on the transmission part of the belt conveyor head.
3. Improve safety responsibility and shift management, promptly investigate and stop illegal operations on site.
4. Supervise superior companies to follow up on the implementation of safety management systems, training, inspections and rectifications, and seriously handle discovered problems in accordance with regulations.
5. Special safety technical measures must be prepared and implemented for tape repair and fastening operations. It is prohibited to use the reverse roller method to overlap buckles in the transmission part of the machine head.
6. Strict training for job transfer personnel, and those who have not completed the training are not allowed to enter new positions; carry out belt conveyor operating procedures and illegal operation warning education.

- 2024-05-05 14:23: The mine rescue team went to the mine to rescue the two injured people and lifted them out of the well and sent them to the hospital.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 2078 coal bunker was blocked many times but no management system or special measures were formulated, and the site was not equipped with safety belts, safety ropes, or supervision. Many people entered the coal bunker along the hemp ropes and used air ducts and rakes to clean the coal. The waste rock attached to the bunker wall slipped, knocking two people into the coal mud at the bottom of the bunker, causing them to suffocate to death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator entered the blocked coal bunker to clean up the coal bunker without wearing a safety belt or safety rope. He was hit by falling coal and waste rock and suffocated by the coal slime.
2. key contributing factors: The coal bunker has no design plan, management system, warnings and videos, and long-term violations of regulations and blockages have not been rectified; no safety technical measures have been formulated, no supervision and warning are set up, and the upper and lower entrances of the coal bunker are operating at the same time.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Set up fences, warnings and management boards at the upper and lower entrances of the coal bunker to clarify safety risks.
2. Promote monitoring and alarm equipment such as personnel approach warning, infrared thermal imaging, and coal level gauges.
3. Investigate hidden dangers in mining systems, facilities and systems item by item in accordance with the requirements of the Double Full Day and implement rectifications accordingly.
4. The superior company and regulatory authorities conduct full-scale checks on three violations and three violations through video, audio recording, and random inspections.
5. Illegal subcontracting of underground projects and fraudulent use of qualifications to respond to inspections are strictly prohibited.
6. Improve coal bunker design, management system, dredging devices and reliable safety facilities; formulate measures before dealing with bunker blockage, and mine leaders will monitor on-site and complete safety confirmation.

- 2024-05-07 03:25: After cleaning part of the waste rock, restarting still failed; the driver of the conveyor forced it to start continuously, and the chain came off the groove and floated to the sidewalk, injuring two people.
- 2024-05-07 03:30: The scraper conveyor stopped running, and on-site personnel organised rescue and reported the accident.
- 2024-05-07 03:40: The captain of the coal mining team reported to the mine director underground that the conveyor chain drifted and injured people.

- 2024-05-07 05:15: The coal mine reported the accident to the superior department; the investigation determined that the report was late.
- 2024-05-07 05:40: The second injured person is admitted to the hospital and his condition is stable.
- 2024-05-07 06:11: The first wounded person is received at the hospital.
- 2024-05-07 07:00: The first injured person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The scraper conveyor at the tail section of the working face machine was uneven, straight and severely bent, and waste rock from the top of the fault area crushed the conveyor to death. After part of the waste rock was cleared at the scene, the driver of the conveyor forced it to start continuously. The scraper stuck on the waste rock caused the chain to detach from the tail of the machine and float to the sidewalk, injuring and dragging two people.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the scraper conveyor was severely bent and crushed by waste rock, it was forcibly started on site in violation of regulations, and the chain came out of the groove and floated to the sidewalk, injuring people.
2. key contributing factors: The fault roof support and engineering quality are not in place, the hidden danger of the conveyor chain floating many times has not been dealt with; the overload protection setting value has been raised illegally, and training, risk identification, on-site surveillance and equipment maintenance have failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Identify the structural impact before crossing the fault, formulate special measures and reinforce the broken roof.
2. Implement the responsibility system for mechanical and electrical transportation managers and standardize equipment operation and maintenance.
3. Strengthen risk identification and closed-loop management of hidden dangers, and have safety officers monitor high-risk project sites.
4. Implement the requirements of no video and no work and check for three violations.
5. Report accident information strictly according to time limits and procedures.
6. Strengthen the inspection, maintenance, maintenance and testing and setting of protective devices of conveyors. It is strictly prohibited to operate in a sick condition and intentionally increase the current setting value.

【Accident Mechanism】
When lowering the No. 59 powered support in the transportation contact lane of the lower cut eye, the wire rope of the winch drum was unevenly arranged, the rope head section was damaged, and the sports car protection and safety rope were not installed. After the powered support was lowered about 80 metres, the steel wire rope broke near the rope head snap ring, and the flatbed truck ran away; on-site security failed to prevent people from entering the transportation line, and the workers were bumped and squeezed by the No. 59 and No. 58 hydraulic supports.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The steel wire rope broke when the powered support was lowered, causing the flatbed truck to run away. People who entered the transportation line in violation of regulations were hit by the support.
2. key contributing factors: poor maintenance of wire ropes, tracks and transportation facilities, failure to install sports car protection and safety ropes; failure to implement driving and pedestrian warning systems, failure to arrange mine-level leaders to monitor, and winch drivers to work without certificates.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve the on-site monitoring of key links of transportation by management personnel and implement alert management.
2. Carry out full-coverage inspections based on actual measurements and real-name systems, and conduct closed-loop rectification of hidden dangers in transportation facilities.
3. Manage safety personnel and strengthen on-site supervision to check for three violations and three violations.
4. The superior company urges its coal mines to carry out risk management and control, hidden danger management and standardization construction.
5. Report accidents strictly and truthfully in a timely manner, and avoid concealment, false reporting, omissions and late reporting.
6. Improve the transportation management system, strengthen the inspection and maintenance of wire ropes, tracks, winches and safety facilities, and strictly prohibit the operation of equipment with diseases.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-07-07 07:50: The third excavation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for the on-site safety manager to lead two operators to the 2# auxiliary inclined shaft to use a hydraulic anchor drilling rig to construct monorail crane track anchors.
- Around 09:00 on 2024-07-07: 3 operators arrived about 180 metres down the auxiliary inclined shaft #2 and started constructing the roof bolts.
- Around 11:00 on July 7, 2024: The anchor failed when constructing the seventh roof bolt; with the consent of the team leader, the operator moved the drilling rig to about 200 metres down from the mine entrance to continue construction.
- 2024-07-07 13:06: When the operator swings the drilling arm of the drilling rig, the drilling rig tilts to the right and squeezes it.
- 2024-07-07 13:25: Mining area personnel arrived at the scene, lifted the drilling rig with a hoist, rescued the casualty, and sent them to the hospital.
- 2024-07-07 13:47: The coal mine reported the accident to the relevant departments of Panzhou City and the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-07-07 15:06: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The floor of the tunnel at the working site has been eroded by water flow for a long time and is uneven. The operators did not follow the measures to level the floor, nor did they push the front support mechanism of the drilling rig against the roof. When the operator swung the drill arm to aim at the anchor construction point, the hydraulic anchor drill became unstable and tipped to the right, squeezing it. He died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When operating the hydraulic anchor drilling truck to construct the roof bolt, the tunnel floor was not leveled and the drilling rig was not stabilized. The drilling rig became unstable and rolled over after swinging the drill arm, squeezing the operator.
2. key contributing factors: There was no adequate risk assessment of the uneven tunnel floor before construction, equipment operation training and procedures were incomplete, and on-site safety officers, video surveillance, and hidden danger investigation and management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Implement pre-event risk analysis, in-process supervision and post-event summary for key projects, and strengthen on-site safety management and control during key periods.
2. Develop targeted operating procedures and safety technical measures based on on-site conditions, and organise and implement study and supervision inspections.
3. Strictly implement the requirements of "two safety personnel" and "no work without video", and improve the reward mechanism for hidden danger discovery and the accountability mechanism for violation registration.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-07-12 08:13: The safety inspector went to the 12071 transportation lane to inspect and found that the anchors on the working face were not fully installed.
- 2024-07-12 08:43: Five people on duty arrived at the working face, and the safety inspector instructed to replenish the anchors first.
- 2024-07-12 09:11: The squad leader moved the camera facing the working face, and the video could not clearly see the working location.
- 2024-07-12 09:17: The deputy district chief came to the working face to inspect and asked to make additional anchors first.
- 2024-07-12 13:30: After adding anchors, the excavation was 1.8 metres and stopped; the squad leader still did not use temporary support after sound the roof and ribs.
- 2024-07-12 14:30: When the squad leader and deputy squad leader were performing roof-bolt support in the empty roof area, waste rock from the roof fell and overwhelmed the deputy squad leader.
- 2024-07-12 14:35: After receiving the report, the dispatching room reported the accident to the mine manager and relevant government and industry departments, and contacted the ambulance.
- 2024-07-12 15:52: The mine rescue team received the casualty outside the wind gate and performed first aid.
- 2024-07-12 16:25: The casualties were transported to the ground and continued to be treated by ambulances.
- 2024-07-12 16:28: The doctor declared the casualty clinically dead and the on-site rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the 12071 transport tunnel was excavated 1.8 metres, the airborne temporary support could be used but was not used on site. The squad leader also moved the video camera away, and then worked with the deputy squad leader to provide permanent support in the 1.8-meter empty ceiling area. The rock above the deputy squad leader suddenly fell and crushed him.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The squad leader violated regulations and organised personnel to carry out anchor construction in the empty roof area without using temporary support. The roof fell and injured people.
2. key contributing factors: Safety officers, deputy district chiefs and mine leaders did not effectively supervise temporary supports and short excavations; the video was manually removed and the video check for three violations failed, on-site lighting and safety personnel were insufficient, and technical approval and management by the superior company were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Allocate two security personnel to implement on-site inspections of three violations and three violations.
2. Strictly enforce no work without video and no work without clear video.
3. Carry out all-person anti-three violations through video, phone recording and other means.
4. Improve the technical management system and accountability mechanism.
5. The superior company establishes responsibility linkage and full-time assessment, and urges the rectification of on-site violations.
6. Strictly use temporary supports for short excavation and short support operations; mine leaders will lead teams to monitor high-risk operation points and ensure that unsafe operations are not allowed.

- 2024-08-02 05:39: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the slope change of 11601 return air tunnel, the airborne forward probing support of the tunnel boring machine could not be used normally. The site did not switch to π-shaped steel beam probing support, nor did the roofing inspection and safety confirmation be completed. The squad leader organised personnel to enter the approximately 2-meter empty roof area to lay anchor nets, and the waste rock from the roof fell and buried the support workers.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: After the airborne temporary support failed, alternative support and help were not taken to ask for help. Personnel were organised to work in the empty ceiling area in violation of regulations, and the roof fell and injured people.
2. key contributing factors: Habitual empty-top operations have existed for a long time in the at the heading and the rectification after supervision was discovered was a mere formality; the two safety personnel failed to perform safety confirmation and monitoring responsibilities, and training, risk identification and supervision by superior companies were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Two safety personnel must monitor the entire process and conduct on-site safety confirmation, and no work will be performed if it is unsafe.
2. Make rectifications based on the hidden dangers discovered during self-examination and supervision, and make improvements on a rolling basis according to the full-day working method.
3. Regularly carry out inspections of three violations and stop long-term habitual violations.
4. The superior company strictly supervises the management of hidden dangers and investigates and punishes violations that persist despite repeated admonitions.
5. Strictly control the empty ceiling distance according to the regulations; when the airborne temporary support cannot be used, the specified π-shaped steel beams, etc., should be immediately used to replace the temporary support.
6. organise the study of operating procedures and technical measures, implement pre-job and annual training, and strengthen the ability of team leaders and key positions to perform their duties.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2024-08-03 16:33: The team member on duty received a call from underground and learned that the person was injured by waste rock and was seriously injured. He immediately reported to the mine dispatching room.
- 2024-08-03 16:35: The dispatch room contacted the ambulance to wait at the entrance of the main inclined shaft of the south wing.

- 2024-08-03 18:18: The coal mine reported the accident over the phone to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-08-03 18:40: The casualty arrived at Shuigang Hospital in Liupanshui City for rescue.
- 2024-08-03 19:30: The doctor declared the casualty dead and the rescue ended.

【Accident Mechanism】
Two drillers on duty were drilling holes in the geological field and cleaning up the waste rock without completing the safety confirmation and asking for help, failing to set the jacking posts as required, and failing to raise the rig struts to secure the rig. The rock mass suddenly collapsed, and one driller was pressed against the drill pipe by waste rock. He was sent to the hospital and died after ineffective rescue efforts.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator drilled at the heading without sound the roof and ribs or setting the roof pillar according to the measures, causing the rock mass to collapse and crush the workers.
2. key contributing factors: Lack of safety confirmation before operation and on-site roof management, the drilling rig is not fixed; insufficient implementation of risk identification, anti-violation, warning education and root cause treatment of the roof.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement all personnel to check violations and anti-violations, and inspect the site through video, recording and other methods.
2. Carry out system risk sorting, hidden danger investigation and improvement and repair.
3. The superior company shall establish an assessment mechanism and strengthen supervision and guidance on safety inspection, risk management and hidden danger management of its coal mines.
4. Carry out on-site safety confirmation and risk analysis before operation, assign dedicated personnel to guard high-risk operation points and deploy on-site safety personnel.
5. Carry out accident warning education, investigate work-related accidents in strict accordance with the "four no-misses" principle, and implement education and rectification.
6. Refine and implement the fundamental tasks of roof management and eliminate the hidden risks of similar roofs.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-08-03 After the accident: On-site personnel called out and rushed to the accident site, dismantled part of the new isolation wall, used single hydraulic props and wooden point pillars for temporary support, and then cleaned up the crushed waste rock and anchor nets.

- After about 16:30 on 2024-08-03: Workers withdrew some pillars between the old separation wall and the new old wall, and built them in front of the new wall; retaining two single pillars, they demolished the old wall and built a new wall behind it.
- After about 16:30 on 2024-08-03: When the old separation wall was demolished to a height of about 1 meter, personnel removed the roof bolts and cable bolts between the new and old walls, and withdrew the remaining two single columns to continue construction.
- 2024-08-03 21:30: Another worker went to Shangwei Lane to participate in building the isolation wall.
- 2024-08-03 22:13: A person went to the entrance of the return air lane to transport yellow mud; the worker who died continued to remove the sandbags from the old wall, and other people relayed them to the new wall.
- 2024-08-03 22:17: The worker who died entered the empty roof area near the No. 139 powered support to retrieve the remaining sandbags. The roof suddenly collapsed, hitting and burying it.
- 2024-08-03 22:20: After receiving the accident report, the mine manager reported to the general manager and arranged to report to the relevant departments.
- 2024-08-03 22:42: The trapped personnel were rescued and transported to the ground.
- 2024-08-03 23:23: The casualty was sent to the hospital immediately after coming out of the well.
- 2024-08-03 23:29: The coal mine reported the accident to Panzhou Energy Bureau.
- 2024-08-04 00:48: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty was confirmed dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
After dismantling the old isolation wall and anchor rigging and withdrawing the temporary support, the old wall was demolished and a new wall was built at the same time. When an operator entered the empty ceiling area to retrieve sandbags for the old wall, the roof collapsed and was hit by waste rock and buried. He died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The workers illegally entered the empty ceiling area to dismantle and transport old isolation wall sandbags, and were hit by falling waste rock and buried.
2. key contributing factors: The construction process and risk measures of the isolation wall are lacking, the old ones are demolished and new ones are built on site, and the supports are removed in advance. The two security personnel did not come to the site for inspection, and the video and anti-violation work failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Where more than 2 people are working, set up a video facing the work point, and arrange for personnel to video check violations in each shift.
2. Deepen full-time work and carry out system hidden danger investigation and risk analysis.
3. The superior company formulates the construction process and standards for the separation wall, supervises the procedures and measures, and implements anti-violation violations by all employees.
4. Conduct on-site risk analysis before formulating procedures and measures, clarify the isolation wall construction standards and procedures, and revise them in a timely manner as operating conditions change.
5. Carry out safety education and underground risk identification teaching according to the type of work and operating environment, formulate measures for accident warnings and communicate them to the front line.
6. It is strictly prohibited to demolish old and build new ones when constructing isolation walls. Strengthen on-site safety personnel, video surveillance and hidden danger investigation and management.
