The water pump driver suddenly fainted when passing near the tail of the scraper conveyor. Because there were no protective facilities above the equipment, he fell into the running scraper conveyor. He was then transported to multiple belt conveyors and chutes. He had no vital signs when he was rescued, and doctors confirmed his death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator suddenly fainted when passing the tail of a running scraper conveyor without upper protection, fell into the equipment and was strangled to death.
2. key contributing factors: Risk identification and hidden danger investigation did not find that there were no protective facilities above the equipment; a complete system of physical and mental health care, health monitoring and job adjustment for employees was not established.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish and implement a risk-level management and control mechanism to comprehensively evaluate the risk of equipment injury during the production process.
2. organise employee health examinations and manage them dynamically, and do not arrange for personnel with occupational taboos to engage in related work.
3. Improve the physical and mental health care system for employees and pay attention to the health risks of syncope.
4. Dynamically update the "Double Full Day" safety inspection form to achieve full coverage of hidden dangers in the coal washing system.
5. Add reliable protection facilities to dangerous areas such as scraper conveyors, and incorporate such risks into hierarchical control and hidden danger investigation.
6. Carry out equipment hazard area identification and on-site safety management training to improve workers’ awareness of protection.

- 2024-10-12 16:02: Two belt workers took the overhead crew device underground and went to the bottom of the main inclined shaft to collect debris.
- 2024-10-12 17:05: The workers at the bottom of the well opened the car barrier and prepared to pick up the car.
- 2024-10-12 17:18: The main inclined shaft winch starts and lowers 3 mine cars.
- 2024-10-12 17:22: The mine car was lowered to 351 metres in the main inclined shaft. The roof bolt slid down, causing the frame car to tilt forward, the connecting pin fell off, and the flatbed car ran and hit three people at the bottom of the shaft.

- 2024-10-12 20:26: The hospital announced that another injured person died after rescue efforts failed; the vital signs of the remaining injured were stable.

【Accident Mechanism】
When three mine cars were being lowered, the roof bolts that were not reliably fixed in the frame cars slid down, causing the car body to tilt forward, and the connecting pin hit the supporting pulley and fell off; the front flat car sports car also hit the workers cleaning debris and materials at the bottom of the mine, killing two people and injuring one person.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The connection pin of the mine car fell off when the material was lowered, and the flatbed truck hit the workers at the bottom of the well.
2. key contributing factors: illegal overhanging of mine cars, incorrect connection of safety ropes, weak roof bolts; unqualified protective devices of mine cars and sports cars, lack of inclined shaft transportation training and hidden danger management.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Equip emergency rescue supplies such as stretchers in underground parking lots and key operating sites, and strengthen disposal training.
2. Use industrial video to strictly investigate violations and implement no work without video.
3. Third-party service agencies and regulatory authorities carry out professional hazard inspections and inspections in accordance with the new standards.
4. Check the mine cars and connecting devices before lifting and transporting, strictly control the number of trains and reliably fix the transported materials, and stop using mine cars without safety signs.
5. Implement real and effective pre-job training for signal workers, handlebar workers, etc., and strengthen education on those who are unable to drive or walk on the road and against habitual violations.

- 2024-10-21 03:00: The operator sent the flatbed truck equipped with the bracket cylinder to the unloading platform; the other empty flatbed truck was attached to the No. 2 winch on site and prepared for return transportation.
- 2024-10-21 03:40: The empty flatbed truck reached the leveling point between No. 2 and No. 3 winches and connected the hook head of No. 3 winch; after the driver of No. 2 winch started the rope retracting winch, the flatbed truck instantly flipped toward the turnout, knocking down the workers in the operating area.

- 2024-10-21 06:37: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty was confirmed dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
A pair of pull winches were used to transport the empty flatbed truck back without authorization. The driver of the rope retracting winch started the winch without confirming with the driver of the rope releasing winch. When the operator was walking in the running area between the winch and the wire rope, the flatbed truck flipped towards the turnout and hit him. He died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally entered the running area between the winch and the wire rope and was hit by an overturned flatbed truck.
2. key contributing factors: Risk analysis or supplementary measures were not re-carried out when the mode of transportation was changed, the winch signal device was missing, the driver of the rope retracting and releasing was not confirmed, and no pedestrians were allowed to operate on site.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Learn from the lessons of transportation accidents and carry out targeted investigations, and strictly implement the prohibition of driving and pedestrians.
2. Use videos and audio recordings to verify safety management personnel’s performance of duties and conduct strict assessments.
3. The superior company clarifies the monitoring responsibilities and assessment and accountability mechanism for key projects in the mine.
4. When construction conditions or environment change, stop work first, conduct risk assessment again and revise safety technical measures; improve and repair unreliable facilities.
5. Improve job understanding cards and conduct regular job risk and self-insurance and mutual insurance training.
6. Use the double full day as the starting point to complete the safety confirmation of the electromechanical transportation system, strengthen on-site supervision and all employees to combat violations.

- 2024-10-22 21:10: When the team leader was operating the valve group in this frame, the single column slipped, the bracket fell, and the top beam tilted forward, squeezing it.

【Accident Mechanism】
The base of the No. 92 powered support was buried in coal slime. The pneumatic pick, two single columns and anti-falling facilities were not used at the site as required, and adjacent support operations were not implemented. The team leader used a single column to hold up the top beam of the support and operated the valve group in the frame to lift the bottom. The single column slipped and fell, the support fell, and the top beam tilted forward, squeezing it between the support and the coal slime.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reason: Only one single column was used to lift the bottom of the frame. After the single column slipped, the powered support fell and the top beam tilted forward, squeezing the people in the frame.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to implement measures such as adjacent frame operation, two-column support, wooden hat-post shoes, and anti-falling ropes; insufficient on-site management and training for new workers; hidden dangers such as slime water accumulation on the mining surface that have not been rectified for a long time; three violations and inspections by superiors failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen on-site management, eliminate hidden dangers in a timely manner and implement procedures and measures.
2. Coordinate the installation, withdrawal and exit cleaning of fully mechanised mining to keep safe exits open.
3. Strictly implement no video, no work and hidden dangers, rectification and cancellation of accounts.
4. The superior company broadens the inspection coverage, tracks the rectification trends and reviews the acceptance.
5. According to the measures for drilling the bottom of the powered support, use a pneumatic pick undercover, two single columns, wooden hat post shoes and anti-falling ropes, and perform adjacent frame operations.
6. Strengthen the training of on-site safety personnel, team leaders and new employees to improve job risk identification and standard operation capabilities.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-11-02: The hospital issued a medical death certificate confirming that the victim died due to respiratory and cardiac arrest and multiple injuries.
- 2024-11-02 Night shift: The mine arranged for 14 people to work in the 10701 fully mechanised mining working face, such as the cleaning of the two back lanes, the maintenance of the transport lane, and the excavation of the return lane ditch.
- 2024-11-02 at approximately 01:10: The mine manager led the team to the safety exit of the 10701 working face and notified the deputy team leader to inspect the working face.
- After 2024-11-02 01:18: The coal mine notified all people underground to evacuate and activated the emergency plan; most personnel wore self-rescuers and evacuated on their own, and the mine manager lost contact.
- 2024-11-02 at approximately 01:18: A local gas explosion occurred at the 10701 fully mechanised mining working face. People near the working face and the upper safety exit felt the shock wave, and the CO sensor high value exceeded the limit and alarmed.
- 2024-11-02 01:45: The coal mine summoned the Zunyi City Emergency Rescue Brigade for rescue.
- 2024-11-02 at approximately 10:10: The rescue team found the missing mine manager between supports 39 and 38.
- 2024-11-02 at approximately 10:48: The missing persons were escorted out of the well and sent to the hospital, and the rescue was completed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The coal mine did not pre-treat the high-risk area. A large amount of polymer materials were directly injected into the high-risk area on the top of supports 38 to 53 in a short period of time. The material reacted to generate heat and gas accumulation, forming a long-term high-temperature environment. After high-temperature distillation created cracks, the high temperature came into contact with the gas in the high-risk area to form a fire source, triggering a local gas explosion. The mine manager lost contact and died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A large amount of polymer materials are directly injected into the high-risk area and an exothermic reaction occurs, forming a high-temperature environment; the high temperature contacts the gas in the high-risk area to form a fire source, triggering a local gas explosion.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient gas control and pretreatment in high-risk areas, illegal use of polymer materials and lack of controlled perfusion; inadequate technical measures, construction monitoring, risk control and special training.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Develop technical measures for gas control, pretreatment and fire prevention safety before construction in high-risk areas.
2. It is strictly prohibited to directly inject large amounts of reactive polymer materials in high-risk areas. Controlled infusion and full-process monitoring should be implemented when they are really needed.
3. Monitor CH4, CO, O2 and other gases and deal with abnormalities in a timely manner.
4. Clarify the construction safety responsibilities of multiple parties and strictly review new materials and new processes.
5. Stop using polymer material grouting technology without safety demonstration, and formulate and implement gas control and fire prevention measures in high-risk areas.
6. Carry out special safety knowledge and skills training on new processes and new materials.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-11-08 06:00: The shift leader held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for the deputy captain and 5 operators to carry out buried operations in the 10506 transportation lane.
- 2024-11-08 07:20: The deputy captain and the operating staff arrived at the 10506 transportation lane. The deputy captain arranged for one person to look at the belt, while the rest of the staff carried out buried operations.
- 2024-11-08 09:27: The operator reported to the dispatch room that the coal hole in Wuping Lane was slightly blocked, and the dispatcher asked him to contact the shift supervisor.
- 2024-11-08 09:31: The operator once again reported that he could not contact the supervisor.
- 2024-11-08 09:39: The shift leader called the dispatch room to inquire about the situation and learned that he needed to go to the site to deal with the blockage of the coal hole, but he did not arrive immediately to deal with it.
- 2024-11-08 10:30: The deputy captain and the operator checked the blockage of the coal hole; the operator called the on-site personnel to get the safety rope.
- 2024-11-08 11:06: The operator fastened a safety rope and entered the coal hole to deal with the blockage. He did not report it to the dispatch room or notify the shift leader.
- 2024-11-08 11:09: The coal and waste rock in the coal slide hole collapsed, burying the workers who entered the coal slide hole.

- 2024-11-08 12:40: The casualties were brought to the ground and taken to the hospital by ambulance.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the operator on duty discovered that the coal leak hole was blocked, the shift leader did not go to the scene in time to deal with it; the operator tied a safety rope and entered the coal leak hole without reporting to the dispatching room, notifying the shift leader, and establishing safety measures. The coal and waste rock in the coal tunnel suddenly collapsed and buried him. He died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator violated regulations and entered the blocked coal hole to deal with the blockage without reporting or taking special safety measures, and was buried under falling coal and waste rock.
2. key contributing factors: The mine has not perfected the coal hole management system and on-site disposal process, the shift leaders did not arrive at the scene in time, the coal hole safety protection and transformation were not in place, and safety education and anti-"three violations" management were ineffective.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strictly implement the team leader's downhole guidance and key operation site management, formulate safety measures and complete safety confirmation before dealing with coal hole blockage.
2. Improve the dual prevention mechanism, investigate and control risks in key locations such as coal holes, and strictly investigate illegal commands and illegal operations.
3. Promote the technological transformation of coal hole safety and improve the closure, protection, alarm and interlocking facilities.
4. Strengthen safety education and training and accident warning education for all employees, and improve job risk identification and emergency response capabilities.
5. Incorporate the treatment of coal hole blockage into key operation management, and clarify the requirements for on-site command, safety confirmation and special measures for shift leaders.
6. Carry out coal hole operation procedures, risk identification and warning education on illegal operations, and strengthen employees' reporting and operation according to procedures.

【Accident Mechanism】
the workers on duty manually assisted near the lower exit of the 110502 fully mechanised mining working face. This area was affected by the F19 fault and no strengthened support measures were taken. The waste rock slipped along the fault plane and pushed down the single hydraulic prop, burying an operator during the evacuation. He later died after the rescue failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The artificial opening of the gangway in the fault-affected area did not strengthen the support. The waste rock in the gangway slipped along the fault plane and pushed down the single hydraulic prop, burying the workers.
2. key contributing factors: incorrect description of fault tendencies in geological data and lax review; failure to re-evaluate the risk of large pieces of waste rock slipping in the Yangcai fault area; insufficient job transfer training, and failure to correct on-site support violations such as inconsistent pillar specifications and failure to wear pillar shoes.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the technical management and on-site support of manual construction across faults.
2. Comprehensively identify and control risks in various underground systems and operating points.
3. Strictly implement safety training and assessment for transferred personnel.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-11-17 14:30: The preparation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 18 people to transport and install the fully mechanised mining support for the 2402 working face.
- 2024-11-17 at approximately 15:30: Operators transported the 37# bracket to the winch platform of the second part of the 2402 transportation lane.
- 2024-11-17 at approximately 15:50: The deputy captain of the preparation team arranged to hoist the monorail to the bracket lifting position. the workers removed the bracket and flatbed truck fixing bolts and tied the bracket.
- 2024-11-17 16:25: When the deputy captain of the preparation team was operating the monorail lifting bracket, the lifting chain slipped and broke, and the unstable bracket rushed out and knocked it down.
- 2024-11-17 16:28: On-site personnel reported the accident to the dispatch room, and the coal mine initiated emergency procedures and organised rescue.
- 2024-11-17 17:05: The casualties were transported to the ground and transferred to the hospital for rescue.
- 2024-11-18 08:35: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The deputy captain of the preparation team operated the equipment to lift the fully mechanised mining support without being trained as a monorail crane driver. The height of the front and rear lifting beams was inconsistent, and the rear lifting chain hook slipped. The bracket became unstable and swung forward, the chain broke and rushed forward, knocking down the operator standing in the dangerous area, and he died after being sent to the hospital for emergency treatment. The mine failed to report the accident in accordance with the law.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Operators who were not trained as monorail crane drivers illegally operated the monorail lifting bracket, causing the lifting chain to slip and the bracket to become unstable and rush out and hit people.
2. key contributing factors: poor back roads in the lifting area, technical regulations that do not clearly define binding and hazardous area requirements, lifting chain maintenance inspections, on-site safety confirmation, video surveillance and mine-level supervision are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate hidden dangers and unsafe behaviors, establish a ledger and implement rectifications and account cancellations.
2. Strengthen the inspection and maintenance of lifting and transportation equipment such as monorail cranes, and improve the maintenance standards and procedures for mechanical and electrical equipment.
3. Strengthen the on-site safety management of teams and districts, shut down the machine immediately in case of abnormality and eliminate hidden dangers.
4. Superior companies should strengthen supervision of subordinate coal mine safety systems, training, risk identification and rescue team management.
5. Regulatory authorities should establish a tracking and dispatching and video spot check mechanism for key projects to severely crack down on concealed reporting of accidents.
6. Standardize the large-scale lifting process and clarify the requirements for bracket bundling, lifting beam balance and hazardous areas; if equipment abnormalities are found, immediately stop operation and make rectifications.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-11-17 23:00: The mine manager organised a pre-shift briefing and arranged for the 12406 retraction working face to withdraw the powered support.
- 2024-11-17 23:30: The comprehensive mining team held a pre-small class meeting and arranged for the squad leader to lead 8 people to 12406 to withdraw the working face operations.
- 2024-11-18 00:00: 9 operators entered the mine and went to the 12406 withdrawal working face.
- 2024-11-18 at approximately 02:30: During the adjustment of the 52# powered support, the safety inspector arrived at the working face but did not carry out hidden danger investigation and safety confirmation.
- 2024-11-18 03:12: When the workers were setting up wooden piles at the original protective position of the 52# support, the side roof of the goaf collapsed, causing one person to be buried and two people to be injured.
- 2024-11-18 03:20: The coal mine activated the emergency plan and arranged a full-time rescue team to enter the mine for rescue.
- 2024-11-18 03:41: Two injured people were rescued and sent to hospital for treatment.
- 2024-11-18 04:25: The coal mine reported to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau that a person was buried in waste rock and was being rescued.
- 2024-11-18 07:08: The buried pressure workers were rescued, lifted underground and sent to the hospital for rescue. The underground rescue ended.
- 2024-11-18 08:00: The hospital announced that the buried worker died after ineffective rescue efforts.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the retraction operation, protective hydraulic supports were not used as required, and the temporary support in the withdrawal area was unreliable. When the workers were building wooden stacks at the original shelter position of the 52# powered support near the goaf side, the roof of the goaf suddenly collapsed. One person was buried under waste rock and two people were injured. The buried personnel died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator ventured to build wooden piles in the goaf where the powered support had been withdrawn and the temporary support was unreliable, and he was buried and crushed to death by falling waste rock.
2. key contributing factors: The retraction operation did not use protective supports according to the measures, and the settings of steel wire ropes and wooden stacks did not meet the requirements; on-site safety confirmation, risk identification, shift supervision, and new worker mentoring and apprenticeship management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Lead the class to strengthen inspections of key parts and key links, eliminate hidden dangers in a timely manner and stop illegal operations.
2. Comprehensively identify the risks of water, fire, gas, roof and electromechanical transportation during the retraction operation based on the actual situation on site, and formulate operable measures.
3. Strictly train newly recruited and transferred personnel, implement mentoring and apprenticeship, and prevent new workers from taking risks independently.
4. Implement the "two safety personnel", no work without video and all-person anti-"three violations" mechanism.
5. Technical service companies and regulatory authorities strengthen supervision and guidance on risk identification, technical measures and on-site management.
6. Strictly implement the construction standards for shielding brackets, steel wire ropes and wooden stacks during the withdrawal operation, and specify temporary support measures for the withdrawal area before the operation.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-11-25 06:55: The deputy chief engineer of communications and coal mining team leader held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 18 coal mining team members to mine coal at the 1102 (mile section) mining face.
- 2024-11-25 07:30: 18 coal mining team members entered the mine one after another.
- 2024-11-25 14:53: The middle shift led the mine leaders into the mine.
- 2024-11-25 15:20: The leader of the middle shift mining follower entered the mine and went to 1102 (mile section) to follow the mining team, and the morning shift workers continued to work.
- 2024-11-25 15:30: Mining of the upper section of the intersection was completed. The shearer stops at the intersection section of the mining surface and the 1102 return air tunnel down the mountain. The fuselage is on the scraper conveyor trough plate and the drum is suspended in the air.
- 2024-11-25 16:00: Blasting operations in the lower section of the intersection, personnel evacuated to the outside of the liaison downhill wind gate and the exit below the mining face.
- 2024-11-25 16:50: When an operator was returning to the mining face from the contact point and crossing the machine road, the shearer's traction chain broke and the shearer slid down and injured him.
- 2024-11-25 16:54: On-site personnel stabilized the shearer and reported the accident by phone to the dispatch room.
- 2024-11-25 16:56: The dispatch room reported to the mine manager, who arranged for the deputy production manager to lead a team underground for rescue.
- 2024-11-25 17:36: The coal mine contacted Shichaoxiang Health Center and the ambulance came to the mine for rescue.
- 2024-11-25 18:06: The mine director reported accident information to the Industrial Energy and Science and Technology Bureau of Wuchuan Gelao and Miao Autonomous County.
- 2024-11-25 19:04: The casualty was transported out of the well and sent by ambulance to the Wuchuan Gelao and Miao Autonomous County People's Hospital for rescue.
- 2024-11-25 20:46: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the shearer stopped at the intersection between the mining face and the old roadway, the drum was suspended in the air, and the traction chain was continuously stressed and worn out due to fatigue. When the operator crossed the machine path from the dangerous area below the shearer, the traction chain broke, and the shearer slid down, injuring and crushing him, and eventually died.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The shearer drum stopped suspended in the air, causing the fatigue-worn traction chain to break due to stress. The shearer slid down, injuring and crushing the operator who illegally crossed the machine path.
2. key contributing factors: Failure to formulate and implement anti-skid measures for the shearer, failure to include the traction chain in inspection and maintenance; failure of on-site management to correct violations such as personnel crossing the machine path and suspending the drum to stop the machine.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. organise operations strictly according to procedures, and no production is allowed until hidden dangers are eliminated.
2. Include the shearer traction chain in special inspections and preventive maintenance.
3. Revise procedures for risks prompted by supervision and implement management and control.
4. Strengthen the performance of on-site safety personnel’s duties and combat three violations.
5. Report accidents strictly within the specified time limit.
6. Formulate and implement anti-skid measures for shearers, and carry out inspection, maintenance, testing and preventive maintenance of in-use electromechanical equipment.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-12-03 14:30: The deputy director of production organised the comprehensive mining team to hold a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 11 operators to go to the 10101 coal face for production operations.
- 2024-12-03 15:30: 11 operators from the fully mechanised mining team entered the mine and carried out coal mining operations according to division of labor.
- 2024-12-03 at approximately 22:48: The operator found that the on-site safety manager’s head was pressed against the cable trough by the top beam of the support at the 42# support.
- 2024-12-03 23:03: The dispatch room reported the accident to the mine manager and actual controller.
- 2024-12-03 23:58: The casualties were brought to the ground and transferred to the hospital by ambulance for treatment.
- 2024-12-04 03:32: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2024-12-04 03:59: The coal mine reported accident information to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The hydraulic system of the 42# powered support failed and the pressure was relieved. After the on-site safety manager operated the handle of the adjacent frame to raise the support, he prepared to use pit wood to support the top beam of the support in violation of regulations. After the pit log slipped, he was unable to avoid it. The top beam of the support fell and pressed his head on the cable trough. He was sent to the hospital and died after emergency treatment failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The hydraulic system of the 42# powered support failed to relieve pressure. When the operator used pit wood to support the roof beam in violation of regulations, he was squeezed by the descending roof beam.
2. key contributing factors: Many faults of the powered support were not repaired, and the mines still organised production despite knowing that the equipment was sick; confirmation of the start of key projects, on-site inspections, safety personnel deployment, and video surveillance management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the responsibilities for the management, use and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment, and strengthen the investigation and rectification of hidden dangers.
2. According to the design of safety facilities, on-site safety officers, shift leaders and "safety staff" will be deployed to supervise key mining fronts and key projects.
3. Strictly implement "no work without video", confirm safety before carrying out work under video surveillance and keep records.
4. Carry out regular inspections and countermeasures against "three violations" by all employees, and strictly punish violations of laws and regulations.
5. Strictly implement the time limit for reporting accident information to ensure that reports are timely, accurate and complete.
6. Repair and replace damaged hydraulic supports and components in a timely manner, strictly prohibit operating with sick equipment, and identify risks throughout the entire process of equipment disassembly, transportation, installation and use.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-12-03 06:30: The excavation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged 6 operators to drill, blast and support the 11903 eye-cut development heading.
- 2024-12-03 07:05: At the pre-shift briefing of the whole mine, the mine leaders required strict knocking and questioning, and empty-head operations were strictly prohibited.
- 2024-12-03 07:30: 6 operators entered the mine one after another to cut holes in 11903.
- 2024-12-03 09:50: The blasting at the working face was completed, and the operators then entered the working face for work.
- 2024-12-03 10:50: The mine director and other management personnel inspected and found that the front detection beam was lagging behind and the temporary support could not be used after encountering geological structures, but no order to stop excavation was issued.
- 2024-12-03 11:40: Operators use a crawler-type hydraulic slag scraper to remove slag.
- 2024-12-03 13:05: When the squad leader was driving the roof bolts at the heading without temporary support, a waste rock fell from the right side of the roof and hit it.

- 2024-12-03 16:00: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the working face encountered a fold structure, the roof of the coal seam rose. The forward beam was lagging behind and could not be effectively used as temporary support. Work on site has not been stopped and no structural measures have been formulated. When the squad leader was digging an roof bolt in an unsupported area about 1 meter away from the head, a piece of roof waste rock of about 150 kilograms fell and hit him. He died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The development heading encountered a structure and no temporary support was provided. The operator ventured into the empty ceiling area to construct roof bolts and was hit by falling waste rock and died.
2. key contributing factors: No operating procedures and structural measures were prepared at the working face; managers did not stop work after discovering the risk of temporary support failure; on-site safety management, risk identification and education and training were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a risk-level management and control and hidden danger investigation system to promptly discover and eliminate on-site dangers and violations.
2. No construction is allowed without prescribed measures; when operating conditions change, measures should be revised promptly and on-site implementation inspections should be strengthened.
3. Arrange mine-level leaders to follow you throughout key projects and key periods to ensure no work is done without video.
4. Strengthen the supervision and guidance of technical service companies on procedures and measures, training, risk identification and hidden danger management.
5. Stop work immediately when geological structures or operating conditions change, conduct on-site surveys and formulate and implement special safety technical measures and reliable temporary supports.
6. Carry out warning education and on-the-job training for empty roof operations, structural changes and roof risks to improve hazard identification, self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

- 2024-12-08 at approximately 18:20: The shearer drove to the 1# powered support and stopped.

- 2024-12-08 18:59: The floor partially collapsed and the falling waste rock jumped out from the unsealed waste rock blocking facility in front of the rack, hitting the lower drum driver on the head.
- 2024-12-08 19:01: After receiving the report, the mine director activated the mine-medicine joint rescue mechanism.

【Accident Mechanism】
The waste-blocking facilities in front of the fully mechanised mining working face frame are not completely closed and there is no waste-blocking net. The operators wearing ordinary safety helmets are still operating the shearer in front of the support. After the floor partially collapsed, a piece of waste rock rolled, rebounded and jumped out from the gap in front of the bracket, hitting his head. He was sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

1. Direct cause: The operator was operating the shearer in front of the powered support with unsealed waste rock retaining facilities, and was hit on the head by the waste rock that jumped out.
2. key contributing factors: The waste-blocking boards and waste-blocking nets are imperfectly set up and have not been rectified, and protective equipment suitable for special workplaces is not equipped; procedures, on-site leadership, training, video monitoring and safety confirmation are not implemented in place.

1. Standardize the preparation and approval of procedures and measures, appoint management personnel with on-site experience and implement shift leading responsibilities.
2. Risks will be comprehensively assessed at key project sites, job description cards will be drawn up, and no work will be done without video.
3. The superior company strengthens the review of procedures and measures, on-site implementation and supervision of the provision of labor protection equipment.
4. The resident mine safety supervisor supervises the rectification of hidden dangers discovered during inspections, and promptly handles major risks such as incomplete waste collection facilities.
5. Improve and seal the waste rock-blocking facilities in front of and between the racks. If the waste rock-blocking facilities are found to be unqualified, immediately stop debugging or production and make rectifications.
6. Strict operating procedures, powered support instructions and safety technical measures training, special types of work must hold a certificate to work, new workers implement 72 hours of training and mentoring.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2024-12-26 After the accident: Press the emergency stop at the scene, lift the flatbed truck to rescue the casualty and transport them to the entrance of the endless rope winch chamber, and then transport them out on a simple stretcher.
- 2024-12-26 06:00: The third development team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for 7 people to transport the mobile transformer to the mechanical and electrical cave of the belt downhill in the second mining area. The two safety personnel were not clearly arranged.

- 2024-12-26 16:02: When the flatbed truck reached 96 metres below the slope change point, the worker following the truck fell in the shuttle car and flatbed workshop and was crushed in the chest by the flatbed truck.
- 2024-12-26 16:19: The scene reported to the ground duty room of the Third Development Team that the casualty person was seriously injured, but it was not reported to the mine dispatching room and the hospital was not contacted.

- 2024-12-26 17:03: The rescue vehicle took the casualty from the mining area to the hospital.
- 2024-12-26 17:12: Contact the downstairs town health center for treatment.

- 2024-12-27 02:10: The coal mine reported the accident over the phone to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2024-12-31: After the investigation team obtained the physical evidence, it collected evidence again. The relevant personnel at the scene confessed the true cause of injuries caused by the flatbed truck.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the mobile transformer was transferred, the stepless rope winch went up empty; an operator violated regulations and fell while following the handheld shuttle car in the flatbed truck and shuttle workshop. His chest was crushed by the running flatbed truck and he died after ineffective rescue.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally followed the car between the flatbed truck and the shuttle car and fell down, and was run over by the running flatbed truck.
2. key contributing factors: Unlicensed operation of winches, illegal riding and following cars were not stopped; large-scale transportation was not included in key projects, and on-site safety personnel, video supervision, training and endless rope transportation management failed.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. After a work-related injury occurs, immediately activate the plan and contact the contracted hospital to implement two-way linkage between mine workers and doctors.
2. Establish and assess a two-member safety management system, focusing on supervising special areas, key links and important periods.
3. The superior company strengthens double full days, video anti-violation, measure approval, training and risk management and control supervision.
4. Implement the system of no pedestrians, no pedestrians, and standardized vehicle following, and comprehensively verify the transportation personnel’s certificates, training, and safety measures for large transport.
5. Strengthen mechanical and electrical transportation and pre-shift safety education, and continue to carry out accident reporting and anti-violation education in accordance with the law.
6. Hold on-site meetings for key projects and confirm safety, arrange for deputy chief engineers and above to follow throughout the entire process, and strictly implement no-video no-work and mine-medicine linkage.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-01-02 22:10: The mine leader and the coal mining team leader held a zero-hour pre-shift briefing and arranged for 11 people to go to the 21404 fully mechanised mining face for retreat operations.
- 2025-01-03 at approximately 06:00: The operator completed the preparations for the withdrawal of the No. 20 powered support, retreated to the back of the support column and sent a signal to start the winch lifting.
- Around 06:20 on 2025-01-03: The powered support was stuck and could not be pulled out, and the winch gear was pulled and displaced; a stop and rope retrieval signal was sent on site.
- Around 06:30 on 2025-01-03: The safety inspector found a gap in the winch drum gear and arranged for personnel to clean it; the wire rope was still not slack, and the workers walked along the ropeway.
- 2025-01-03 at approximately 06:34: The taut steel wire rope broke and rebounded at the rope head, injuring three workers and one safety inspector in the ropeway.
- 2025-01-03 06:46: After receiving the report, the mine manager launched the emergency rescue plan and organised the rescue.
- 2025-01-03 07:14: The wounded came out of the well one after another and were sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-01-03 08:46: The hospital announced that the safety inspector died after resuscitation failed.
- 2025-01-03 09:11: The mine manager reported the accident to the Zhijin County Energy Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The 21404 working face continued to withdraw when the withdrawal channel and wire rope configuration did not comply with the regulations and the powered support was crushed by the roof. After the winch was blocked in lifting, the rope was not released. The safety inspector and other personnel entered the taut steel wire ropeway to inspect and work. The wire rope broke at the rope head and rebounded, injuring four people. Among them, the safety inspector died after being sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator violated the regulations and walked in the tensioned winch wire rope path, and was injured by the broken and rebounding wire rope.
2. key contributing factors: The operation was organised without the conditions for safe retraction. The retraction channel, wire rope safety factor, safety rope and U-turn winch did not meet the requirements; on-site safety confirmation, transportation management improvement and third-party technical service supervision and rectification were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Procedures and measures should be formulated based on on-site risks and revised in a timely manner when operating conditions change.
2. Carry out special rectification of electromechanical transportation, improve the reliability of connecting devices and install safety ropes in accordance with regulations.
3. Insist on driving and pedestrians, and no one should stay or work in the dangerous area during the lifting period.
4. Third-party technical service agencies implement closed-loop management of discovered hidden dangers and urge coal mines to make timely rectifications.
5. Supervisory authorities shall verify the consistency and implementation of key link measures and on-site implementation.
6. Before retreating, facilities such as channels, tracks, wire ropes, and U-turn winches must be improved according to regulations. No retreat shall be organised unless safety conditions are met.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-01-11 15:10: The fully mechanised mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the installation of the powered support and winch operation of the 1307 coal face.
- 2025-01-11 15:30: Mid-shift workers enter the mine one after another.
- 2025-01-11 16:00: Personnel arrived at the construction site to maintain monitoring lines, clear debris and brush the area.
- 2025-01-11 21:00: The preliminary preparations for the installation of No. 124 powered support were completed and the installation begins.
- 2025-01-11 22:30: The No. 124 powered support was transported to the designated position and adjusted.
- 2025-01-11 23:30: After the bracket is adjusted in place, there is still a gap between the push-pull head and the push-pull rod, so prepare for fine adjustments.
- 2025-01-11 23:37: A signal was sent on site to start the winch to pull the No. 124 bracket; the push-pull rod of the bracket was stuck in the chute and was blocked from shifting. The winch was still running and was pulled away from the base, knocking down and crushing the winch operator.
- 2025-01-12 00:00: The operator reported the accident to the mine dispatching room, and the dispatcher reported to the mine director.
- 2025-01-12 00:19: The mine director went into the mine to participate in the rescue.
- 2025-01-12 01:05: The casualty was carried out of the well and taken to the hospital by ambulance.
- 2025-01-12 02:03: The casualties were sent to Anlong County People's Hospital; the mine director reported the accident to the Anlong County Energy Bureau.
- 2025-01-12 02:38: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty was confirmed dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the push-pull rod of the No. 124 powered support was stuck in the chute of the scraper conveyor and the traction was blocked, the winch operator continued to run the winch; the winch was pulled away from the base because the foundation and fixing did not meet the requirements, knocked down and crushed his lower leg, and he was sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The foundation and fixation of the winch did not meet the requirements. The winch was forced to run even when the traction bracket was blocked. The winch was pulled away from the base and the operator was injured.
2. key contributing factors: The winch did not carry out basic design, acceptance and load test operation; risk identification, full follow-up of key night shift projects, video supervision, training and safety management were lacking.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a two-person safety management system to ensure that there are people watching the work site and correcting violations.
2. Carry out the Three Realities and Four Repeats and fight against violations by all employees.
3. Third-party technical service agencies strengthen guidance on measure approval, double full days, risk management and control, and hidden danger management.
4. Strictly carry out winch foundation design, installation acceptance and load test operation, and standardize the preparation, review, implementation and supervision of safety technical measures for the installation of key equipment.
5. Implement pre-job, pre-shift, on-site and special training for key positions, carry out accident warning education, and improve the ability to identify hazard sources and protect themselves and each other.
6. Extend the dual prevention mechanism to all positions, arrange for mine-level leaders to follow you throughout key periods and projects, and ensure that no work is done without video.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-01-20 23:01: The Tongfang Work Area held a pre-shift briefing and arranged for three workers to construct gas drainage drilling in the transportation lane of the 112104 coal face.
- 2025-01-20 23:40: Three operators entered the mine and arrived at the construction site. They connected the previous drilling hole to the gas pipeline and started continuous pumping.
- 2025-01-21 at approximately 01:30: The operator moved the drilling rig to the 66# drilling position.
- 2025-01-21 01:56: Construction of drilling #66 started.
- 2025-01-21 04:54: After drilling, drilling was stopped to prepare for the installation of a blowout prevention device; slag fell on the upper side of the tunnel, but the on-site personnel did not report it or evacuate.
- 2025-01-21 05:16: When an operator went to fix the blowout prevention device under the gas pipeline, the coal mass in the roadway collapsed and buried it.
- 2025-01-21 05:20: The on-site security manager reported to the dispatch room that the person was trapped.
- 2025-01-21 05:25: The mine activated the emergency rescue mechanism and notified medical institutions and rescue teams to participate in the rescue.
- 2025-01-21 05:55: The workers who were buried under pressure were rescued, cardiopulmonary resuscitation was performed on site and then transported out of the well on a stretcher.
- 2025-01-21 06:16: After the casualty came out of the well, he was sent to the hospital for treatment by an ambulance waiting at the mouth of the well.
- 2025-01-21 08:12: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
The drilling construction point is located in the stress concentration area, and drilling disturbance and insufficient support lead to a decrease in the stability of the coal mass in the roadway. There were signs of roof collapse such as slag falling at the work site, but the workers did not report or evacuate. When an operator stepped over a running belt conveyor to fix the blowout preventer next to the gas pipeline, the coal mass in the roadway collapsed and buried him. He died after being rescued and sent to the hospital.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: During construction drilling, signs of roof collapse such as slag falling off the roadway were found and the workers continued to work near the roadway and were buried under the collapsed coal mass.
2. key contributing factors: The drilling design is located in a stress concentration area, the quality of the two supports and anchors at the drilling site is insufficient; the drilling measures did not assess the risks of the roof, and on-site training, special operation certification and anti-"three violations" management were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Borehole design and review should comprehensively consider stress concentration, support and construction disturbance risks.
2. Strengthen roadway support in areas where stress is concentrated, and review the torque and pre-tightening force of anchor bolts and cables after drilling.
3. Use anchoring agents in strict accordance with the regulations, and do not hang the gas drainage pipeline on the permanent support.
4. Use the "double full day" as the starting point to verify special operation certificates, job identification cards, and on-site safety managers' performance of duties.
5. The special inspection of the roof of the group company should be combined with geological data to urge the strengthening of support for stress concentration areas.
6. Optimize borehole design to avoid construction in stress concentration areas; strengthen support and formulate roof risk control measures when construction is necessary.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- Around 15:20 on 2025-02-06: The transportation team held a pre-shift briefing and arranged maintenance workers to inspect and deal with the main inclined shaft belt conveyor.
- Around 22:55 on 2025-02-06: The maintenance worker met other off-duty workers in the main inclined shaft and said he would leave later.
- Around 2025-02-06 22:56: The maintenance worker entered the bottom of the running belt conveyor to clean the waste rock, and his head and left arm were caught between the return belt and the roller.
- Around 22:58 on 2025-02-06: The off-duty personnel found that the casualty person was stuck by the roller, stopped the machine, pulled the emergency stop line, and reported to the dispatch room.
- 2025-02-06 23:16: The coal mine calls for an ambulance.
- Around 2025-02-06 23:44: The casualties were transported to the ground, and medical staff performed rescue operations.
- 2025-02-07 00:19: The casualty arrived at the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-02-07 01:25: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the belt conveyor was not shut down or locked due to a power outage, the maintenance worker carried a steel drill into the bottom of the equipment to clean the waste rock. His left arm and head were caught between the return belt and the return roller. On-site personnel stopped the machine to rescue and send him to the hospital, but the casualty person died after the rescue efforts failed; the mine subsequently concealed the accident.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance worker violated the shutdown and power outage locking requirements and cleaned the waste rock at the bottom of the running belt conveyor, and was involved in the return belt and rollers.
2. key contributing factors: Belt cleaning operation site management, video surveillance, risk identification and key position training were not in place, and the anti-"three violations" work was ineffective; after the accident, the mine concealed the report and destroyed and falsified relevant information.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate hidden dangers and unsafe behaviors, establish a rectification ledger and strictly cancel accounts.
2. Improve underground video surveillance and implement no operation without video and full-process on-site management.
3. The superior company will strengthen the supervision of key periods, high-risk mines and key positions, and strictly investigate violations.
4. Establish a multi-departmental information sharing and joint crackdown mechanism on concealed accident reports.
5. To clean the silt and floating cargo on the bottom belt, the machine must be shut down, locked out of power, and specially assigned to monitor, and the belt protection device and video surveillance must be improved.
6. Carry out training on operating procedures, warning information and on-site management negative lists for key positions such as maintenance workers to improve practical operations and risk identification capabilities.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-02-24 10:40: The food delivery personnel went to the entrance of the auxiliary inclined shaft, hung the lifting chair with the missing small block into the static loading device and rode it down.
- 2025-02-24 10:41: The chairlift slid down the wire rope from the slope change point of the auxiliary inclined shaft to the bottom of the shaft.
- 2025-02-24 10:42: The chair lift ejected after hitting the pressure wheel, and the passengers fell with the chair.
- 2025-02-24 10:46: The mine entrance operator reported the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2025-02-24 10:55: Rescuers transport the casualty out of the well and to the hospital.
- 2025-02-24 11:23: The casualties were sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-02-26 22:06: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.
- 2025-02-26 22:25: The coal mine reported the death to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.

【Accident Mechanism】
The operator hung the chair with a small holding piece missing from the rope into the overhead passenger device and then descended. After reaching the slope change point, the chairlift could not clamp the wire rope and accelerated its descent. It hit the rope pulley and ejected. The person fell to the floor of the tunnel and was seriously injured. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: A person was riding in a chairlift with a small holding block missing from the rope holder. The rope holder was unable to clamp the wire rope. The chair slid down, hit the rope pulley and then ejected, causing the person to fall.
2. key contributing factors: failure to inspect and replace the cable holder as required, failure to lock and manage the chairlift to be repaired, and unreasonable emergency stop settings; imperfect standards for chairlift integrity, major risk management and control, and pre-ride safety confirmation systems.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Improve and improve the transportation equipment inspection, maintenance and safety inspection system, and conduct regular risk research and assessment.
2. Clarify the full-day responsibilities, grid nodes and job description cards, and carry out system-wide hidden danger investigation.
3. Strengthen warning education and illegal investigation and punishment for key equipment such as overhead passenger equipment.
4. Deepen the linkage between mines and hospitals and coordinate the entire process from on-site rescue to medical treatment.
5. Establish the integrity standards, inspection, maintenance and locking management of chairlifts and cable grips, replace failed parts in a timely manner, and ensure that the protective devices are complete and effective.
6. Carry out special training on aerial passenger equipment rides, lift chair inspections and risk identification to improve self-protection and mutual protection capabilities.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-02-28 23:00: The whole mine held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the maintenance of the +942m water tank, the comprehensive excavator and other work.
- 2025-03-01 at approximately 00:33: Mechanical, electrical, excavation and other personnel arrived at the +942m water tank one after another and began to repair the mechanized excavator.
- 2025-03-01 at approximately 00:46: The safety inspector reported to the dispatch room that the safety confirmation on site was completed and the operating conditions were met.
- 2025-03-01 at approximately 01:32: When the maintenance personnel used a pneumatic anchor drill to push up the fuel tank, the drilling rig slipped sideways, the air leg popped out and hit the maintenance personnel standing on the track.
- 2025-03-01 01:45: The coal mine contacted the hospital and ambulance vehicles rushed to the mining area.
- 2025-03-01 01:51: The casualty was carried out of the auxiliary shaft mouth and sent to the hospital by the coal mine emergency vehicle.
- 2025-03-01 02:09: The hospital ambulance and the casualties were connected and transported about 5 kilometers away from the coal mine.
- 2025-03-01 at approximately 02:30: The casualties were sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-03-01 02:57: The hospital announced that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After the oil tank of the mechanized excavator was suspended and repaired, a pneumatic anchor drill was used to push up the oil tank and reset it, in violation of the instructions for special tools and equipment. When the maintenance personnel stood on the crawler track and used a wooden stick to pry the fuel tank and align it with the bolt hole, the drilling rig instantly slipped sideways. The air leg affected by wind pressure ejected and hit his chest. He was sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The maintenance personnel illegally used a pneumatic anchor drill to push up the fuel tank of the mechanized tunnel boring machine. After the drill slid sideways, the air leg popped out and hit the workers.
2. key contributing factors: No special safety technical measures have been formulated for the maintenance of mechanized excavators, pre-shift meetings, risk identification and on-site safety supervision are not implemented; there is insufficient training in relevant procedures and equipment instructions, and operations are still performed during video surveillance failures.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Revise the mine safety position responsibility system and strengthen the performance assessment of shift leaders, on-duty personnel and safety personnel.
2. Improve the technical management system, and do not blindly construct the procedures and measures without training.
3. Carry out in-depth inspections of three violations and severely punish violations of laws and regulations.
4. Equip the mining working face with stretchers to improve the conditions for joint rescue by mine doctors.
5. Supervisory departments should strengthen guarantee guarantees and mine-based supervision, and keep abreast of the rectification of hidden dangers and mine safety trends in coal mines.
6. Develop a maintenance plan for the mechanized excavator in accordance with one project and one measure. Use special tools or long-handled tools. It is strictly prohibited to push the fuel tank with a pneumatic anchor drill.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-03-05 16:20: The team leader and employees of the comprehensive mining team entered the mine.
- 2025-03-05 16:35: The operators arrived at the 11903 fully mechanised mining working face and held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the transportation of support materials and start-up operations.
- 2025-03-05 17:40: After knocking on the top of the No. 30 powered support and setting up three temporary single hydraulic supports, the support was opened downward from the No. 29 support.
- 2025-03-05 19:19: When the team leader was digging a column nest in the empty roof area in front of the No. 28 support, the top waste rock collapsed and knocked it down.
- 2025-03-05 19:38: The casualty was carried into a vehicle and sent to the hospital.
- 2025-03-05 20:50: The casualty arrived at the hospital for rescue.
- 2025-03-05 21:33: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty died.

【Accident Mechanism】
During the final mining and opening of the fully mechanised mining face, there was an empty roof in front of the No. 28 support. When the team leader was digging a pillar nest with a pickaxe on the side of the coal gang in the empty roof area and preparing to lay a single hydraulic prop, an irregular waste rock from the top fell and knocked him down. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator illegally built pillars in the empty roof area and was hit by waste rock from the roof collapse.
2. key contributing factors: On-site management personnel failed to detect and stop empty-top operations in time, safety training and warning education were insufficient, the video did not focus on the operation site, double full days and supervision by superiors were insufficiently implemented; the mine concealed the report after the accident.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the supervision and assessment of safety personnel, improve the video of the work site, and implement no work without video.
2. Carry out three truths and four re-examinations and investigate three violations and three violations, focusing on supervising key positions and links.
3. The superior company should strengthen safety training, warning education and inspections during key periods.
4. Provide education on accident reporting laws and regulations to investors, actual controllers and principal persons in charge.
5. For the dismantling of fully mechanised mining working faces, on-site investigation, technical measures, preparation, confirmation and construction procedures must be strictly implemented, and knock-on questions must be implemented to prevent empty-roof operations.
6. Combine the actual position learning warning information and on-site management negative list to improve risk identification and independent security capabilities.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-03-12 23:40: The third excavation team held a pre-night shift meeting to arrange normal excavation of the 131209 transport lane.
- 2025-03-13 02:00: The workers on duty arrived at 131209 Transport Lane and started operations.
- 2025-03-13 06:10: The mechanized excavator stopped cutting, and the methane examiners and safety personnel came to check head on; after knocking on the top of each gang at the scene, they began to build collision wedges from the middle to the two gangs.
- 2025-03-13 06:20: The safety inspector and the team leader report to the back of the working face, and the rest of the staff continue to work.
- 2025-03-13 06:30: Set up 17 impact wedges at the heading and hang up the wall protection net; after the safety inspector returned, he pointed out that there was a large gap between the net on the right side and the alley gang, and the workers adjusted their positions to continue to protect the wall.
- 2025-03-13 06:36: One person is viewing the mountain from the cutting arm of the mechanized excavator, while the other two people are pulling the wall protection net on the right side of the front and using logs to top the net.
- 2025-03-13 06:37: Mountain watchers discovered a crack in the roof and alerted; an operator was unable to escape and was hit by falling coal.
- 2025-03-13 06:39: The casualties were rescued on site and transported on stretchers. The safety inspector reported to the security inspection department dispatch room and then reported it to the mine dispatch room.
- 2025-03-13 06:45: The coal mine contacted Tucheng Mining Hospital and Panjiang General Hospital to initiate joint mine-medicine rescue.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-08-29 06:30: The Second Comprehensive Mining Team held a morning pre-shift briefing to arrange the relocation of the lighting comprehensive protection and the No. 1 water pump starting switch.
- 2025-08-29 08:10: 6 workers entered the mine to carry the lighting comprehensive protection to the electromechanical cave of the temporary distribution point.
- 2025-08-29 11:10: The electrician stopped the 660-volt power supply at the distribution point.
- 2025-08-29 11:10: The workers dismantled and transported the No. 1 water pump, and did not install a local grounding on the equipment shell when wiring.
- 2025-08-29 15:35: The 660-volt power supply is restored at the distribution point.
- 2025-08-29 15:59: When testing the No. 1 water pump, it was found that it was reversed and could not pump water.
- 2025-08-29 16:09: The electrician bypassed the mechanical lock and opened the lower chamber of the live water pump start switch for inspection.
- 2025-08-29 16:20: An electrician was shocked when he touched a live terminal in the switch.
- 2025-08-29 16:30: The water pump worker reported to the dispatching room, which arranged for a rescue team to enter the mine for rescue; the coal mine then reported by phone to the Pu'an County Energy Bureau.
- 2025-08-29 16:50: The coal mine reported the accident to the Pu'an County Energy Bureau over the phone.
- 2025-08-29 17:06: The ambulance team received the casualty at the 11700 working face.
- 2025-08-29 17:44: The ambulance team arrived at the mine entrance, and the doctor from the health center declared the casualty dead after his rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
After testing the reversal of the water pump, the electrician bypassed the mechanical lock and opened the lower cavity of the live switch to inspect the intelligent comprehensive protector without power outage, power inspection and discharge. His left hand touched the live terminal, and the current was conducted through the body and the earth, resulting in electrocution.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The electrician was charged while inspecting the start switch of the water pump, and he was electrocuted when he touched a live part of the explosion-proof cavity.
2. key contributing factors: The power outage system and the five-step maintenance method are not implemented, equipment protection and grounding are not perfect, and on-site supervision, mechanical and electrical management and safety training are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. All electrical maintenance strictly implements power outage, power inspection, discharge and lockout and tagout requirements.
2. Complete approval reports before equipment relocation and maintenance, and arrange for on-site supervision by dedicated personnel.
3. Comprehensively check grounding, protective devices and key components before use, and immediately shut down power for faulty equipment for maintenance.
4. Standardize the environment, communication and equipment layout of the electromechanical chamber, and investigate and eliminate hidden dangers such as water leakage.
5. Strengthen the investigation and training of violations such as live maintenance and unauthorized power transmission.
6. Strictly implement the approval system for power outages, power inspections, discharges and power outages, and live maintenance is strictly prohibited.

- 2025-09-06 20:28: The mine reported the accident to the relevant departments.
- 2025-09-06 20:54: Emergency doctors confirmed that one of the casualty was dead.

【Accident Mechanism】
The end of the 1018 fully mechanised mining working face lacks an end bracket. There is a large empty roof in the machine channel in front of the No. 98 and No. 99 hydraulic supports and support measures were not taken in time. When two operators entered the machine tunnel in front of No. 99 Support Stand to clean up coal and waste rock, the support operator started moving the rack without checking the positions of the workers. The roof collapsed immediately, hitting two people in the machine tunnel.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The powered support was operated illegally when the machine tunnel had an empty roof and people had not evacuated. The roof collapsed and hit the operator.
2. key contributing factors: The upper end is missing the end bracket, the empty roof in front of the No. 98 and No. 99 brackets was not dealt with in time; on-site safety management, certified induction and on-the-job training were not in place, and the operation was still organised after the video system was disconnected.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Assign qualified safety management personnel to major safety risk points and implement on-site surveillance.
2. Strictly implement the accident information reporting system to prevent late reporting.
3. Implement the requirement of no operation without video, and repair and manage the video surveillance system in a timely manner.
4. Improve the hidden danger investigation, violation investigation and closed-loop rectification mechanism.
5. Carry out risk analysis and formulate targeted measures when geological and site conditions change; review and approve technical measures before adjusting support design or technology and implement them on site.
6. Strictly require special operations personnel to hold certificates before taking up their posts; personnel must complete targeted practical training and assessment before transferring to another position.

【Accident Timeline】

- 2025-09-20 16:40: Lead the mine leaders, squad leaders, safety officers, etc. to the working face and start organizing the withdrawal of the powered support.
- 2025-09-20 21:18: The site began to withdraw the No. 36 powered support, and connected the steel wire rope and the support with a 40T scraper conveyor chain.
- 2025-09-20 22:25: In order to level the tilted support, two people were arranged on site to build a single powered support below the support; the support was operated without confirming the evacuation of the workers. The ring chain broke, the support fell, and the side guard fell off, hitting one of them.
- 2025-09-20 22:30: Rescue the casualty on site and report the accident to the dispatch room.
- 2025-09-20 23:08: The casualties were transported out of the well.
- 2025-09-20 23:27: The ambulance and the vehicle transporting the casualty met on the way.

- 2025-09-21 01:16: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty died.
- 2025-09-21 02:08: The mine reported the accident to the Jinsha County Energy Bureau, which was a late report.

【Accident Mechanism】
When withdrawing the No. 36 powered support, a 40T scraper conveyor chain that did not meet the requirements was used on site to connect the wire rope and the support. The locking pin of the side guard plate of the support was missing and the safety rope was not used. The bracket tilted downward toward the exit on an uneven, 20-degree slope floor. The bracket was operated without confirming the evacuation of personnel on site. The ring chain broke due to stress, the bracket became unstable and fell over, and the side guard fell off and hit the worker below the bracket.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The powered support was operated illegally without confirming the evacuation of people under the support. After the connecting chain broke, the support became unstable and fell, and the side guard fell off and hit the operator.
2. key contributing factors: Insufficient specifications of connectors, unlocked side guards, missing safety ropes, and lack of fallback prevention content in retreat measures; on-site surveillance, special training, hidden danger investigation, video inspection of three violations, and superior technical service supervision were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a dynamic risk analysis and judgment mechanism for team positions to evaluate the inclination angle and support status in real time.
2. Implement the hidden danger ledger and closed-loop rectification during the double full day, and improve the mechanism for checking three violations and three violations by all employees.
3. Strictly implement 5-minute phone calls, 15-minute written accident reports and linkage with mine doctors.
4. The superior technical service company returned to the site in depth to supervise the implementation of key processes and technical measures.
5. Regulatory authorities will strengthen wall chart operations for key projects and deal with violations of laws and regulations.
6. Technical measures for special retraction operations must clearly define the requirements for anti-falling, anti-skid and connecting parts. Key processes must be monitored on-site by management personnel and personnel evacuation confirmation must be carried out.

- 2025-09-23 16:20: The workers on duty arrived at the development heading, and the workers on the previous shift were still carrying out support operations.
- 2025-09-23 17:00: The team held a pre-shift briefing and started slag removal and excavation after identifying hidden dangers; the assistant driver stood on the tunnel boring machine to observe and direct.
- 2025-09-23 21:50: When the tunnel boring machine was cutting at the heading, the rock above the cutting head collapsed from the layer, knocking the co-driver down and falling to the tunnel floor behind the rear of the machine.
- 2025-09-23 22:04: On-site personnel organised rescue operations and reported to the first mining area dispatching room and the mine dispatching room.
- 2025-09-23 22:10: The coal mine launched the mine-medicine joint rescue mechanism.
