- 2025-09-24 00:02: The casualties were sent to the hospital to continue rescue operations.
- 2025-09-24 01:08: The hospital confirmed that the casualty person died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When the tunnel boring machine was cutting at the heading up the mountain, the rock above the cutting head collapsed and slid along the cutting part to the fuselage. The co-pilot who was standing on the fuselage to observe and command did not use the safety rope in accordance with the regulations. He was knocked down by the falling rock and fell to the floor of the tunnel at the rear of the machine. He was sent to the hospital and died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: When the tunnel boring machine was cutting, the rock separation layer above collapsed, knocking down the co-driver who did not use the safety rope as required, causing him to fall and be injured.
2. key contributing factors: Inadequate rockfall risk identification and rock-blocking measures for uphill excavation, and the cutting process, dust reduction, video lighting and on-site safety supervision were not effectively implemented.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Carry out special risk assessments for uphill excavation, large burial depths and stress concentration areas.
2. Carry out the cutting sequence and cutting process strictly according to the regulations, and correct any violations immediately.
3. Maintain the spray facilities of the tunnel boring machine and stop operations for rectification when visibility is low.
4. Workers working at heights must use safety ropes correctly and have the person in charge of the site confirm them one by one.
5. Optimize the location of underground lighting and video surveillance to ensure coverage of the working face.
6. Formulate and implement protective measures for waste blocking, cutting and high-altitude operations for uphill excavation.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-09-30 15:00: The blanking team held a four o'clock pre-shift briefing to arrange the delivery of belt rolls, rollers, sand and wood.
- 2025-09-30 17:30: Operators lifted the belt roll at the ground loading and unloading yard of the waste rock inclined shaft monorail crane; the log broke after the belt roll reached the lifting beam, and the belt roll fell and hit an operator.
- 2025-09-30 17:35: On-site personnel called nearby personnel for rescue and used a forklift to remove the belt roll pressing on the casualty person; then reported to the mine dispatch.
- 2025-09-30 17:41: The mine dispatcher reported the accident to the mine manager, who initiated the mine-medicine linkage mechanism.

- 2025-09-30 17:45: The mine dispatch notified the hospital to send rescue personnel, and the mine rescue team sent the casualty to the hospital.
- 2025-09-30 18:10: The casualty died after rescue efforts failed.

【Accident Mechanism】
When two operators used a monorail to lift a sling belt roll at the ground loading and unloading site, they passed the lifting chain connecting ring through the center hole of the belt roll and used a log to carry it. After the upper edge of the belt roll hit the lifting beam, it did not stop rising in time. The log broke under pressure and the belt roll fell and hit the operator below, causing his death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: Illegal use of logs with a monorail lifting belt roll. After the belt roll reached the lifting beam, the log broke, and the belt roll fell and hit the operator below.
2. key contributing factors: There was no on-site command during the hoisting and no special spreaders were used. Personnel were not evacuated to a safe location; safety responsibilities, risk management and control, training and loading and unloading site supervision and inspection were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Clarify the safety responsible person for each transport team and each monorail crane.
2. Use special spreaders for hoisting operations, securely bind and maintain a safe distance.
3. Set up risk notification and safety warning signs at the ground loading and unloading site.
4. Incorporate the monorail hoisting and unloading site into the scope of hidden danger investigation and video anti-violation.
5. The superior company inspects the implementation of the transportation system and risk control measures of its coal mines.
6. Clear instructions and operators for hoisting operations, use special hoisting tools and securely tie them, and operate after the workers evacuate to the specified safe position.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2025-10-10 14:10: Before the middle shift, ventilation, drilling, excavation, roof lifting and ventilation facility operations was assigned. The affected areas are not required to stop operations and evacuate people.
- 2025-10-10 14:30: Before the first drilling team shifts, two operators was assigned to use a raise drilling rig to dig ventilation holes.
- 2025-10-10 15:10: Mid-shift workers enter the mine one after another.
- 2025-10-10 15:45: Raise drilling rig operators arrived at the upper entrance of the ventilation eyelet to carry out handover and construction preparations.
- 2025-10-10 16:50: Adjust the ventilation facilities on site and open the relevant anti-surge doors.
- 2025-10-10 17:20: The monitoring personnel deleted the methane and carbon monoxide sensor measuring points of the 10106 return air tunnel drilling rig from the system.
- 2025-10-10 17:25: The raise drilling rig continues to dig ventilation holes.
- 2025-10-10 17:49: When the excavation reached a total of about 10.5 metres, pulverized coal and gas erupted from the borehole, and the person at the bottom of the tunnel was knocked down.
- 2025-10-10 17:52: The monitor found that methane exceeded the limit and reported the alarm to dispatch; the mine issued an order to evacuate the entire mine.
- 2025-10-10 17:53: The mine reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau over the phone.
- 2025-10-10 18:09: The superior company notified the mine rescue team to enter the mine for rescue.
- 2025-10-10 18:16: The mine contacted the medical institution and initiated the mine-medical linkage.
- 2025-10-10 18:18: The rescue team entered the mine to carry out rescue; 215 of the 219 people on duty successfully ascended to the well, and 4 people were lost.
- 2025-10-10 18:40: The mine reported the accident in writing to the relevant regulatory authorities.
- 2025-10-11 00:00: The last missing person was transported out of the well, and the rescue was completed; 2 of them died after being sent to the hospital, and the other 2 were not life-threatening.

【Accident Mechanism】
Before ventilating and erecting holes to uncover the coal, comprehensive outburst prevention measures were not taken and the danger of the No. 2 outburst coal seam was not eliminated. A raise drilling rig was still used to expand the hole and dig. When the excavation reached a total of about 10.5 metres, pulverized coal and gas erupted from the borehole, and people in the dangerous area under the tunnel were knocked down. Unreliable ventilation and monitoring management increased the risk, eventually causing 2 deaths and 2 injuries.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The danger of the No. 2 coal seam outburst was not eliminated before ventilating and opening the coal seam, and coal and gas outbursts were induced when using a raise drilling rig to dig and uncover the coal seam.
2. key contributing factors: No special design for outburst prevention was prepared, drainage was not up to standard and nozzle signs were not dealt with; ventilation was adjusted in violation of regulations, personnel were not evacuated, sensors were deleted and gas lockout failed, and key projects and superior supervision were lost.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Comprehensively investigate violations such as failure to implement emergency prevention measures and blocking monitoring systems.
2. Improve the design, construction and acceptance management of zoned ventilation, dedicated return air and ventilation facilities.
3. Install sensors according to regulations and set the power outage range in a standardized manner to ensure that the monitoring data is true and reliable.
4. The superior company shall appoint safety management personnel and strengthen the supervision of its coal mines.
5. Before mining coal in tunnels and outburst coal seams, a special anti-outburst design must be prepared and submitted for approval. Construction shall be carried out after the extraction is judged to meet the standards and outburst elimination is in place; raise drilling rigs are prohibited from uncovering coal.
6. Carry out emergency drills for outbursts, roofs, water damage and other accidents and training on the standard wearing of self-rescuers. Failure to pass the assessment is not allowed to enter the mine.

- 2025-12-14 15:00: The coal mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange the opening, frame adjustment and end support of the 1102 fully mechanised mining face.
- 2025-12-14 15:50: The workers on duty arrived at the mining surface one after another and started working.
- 2025-12-14 18:30: A roof leak occurred in the No. 79 to 81 bracket sections, and the on-site organisation was organised to deal with it.
- 2025-12-14 21:30: The first leaky roof was processed, and the site was notified to start the scraper conveyor but it failed to start.
- 2025-12-14 21:37: The roof of support sections 79 to 81 leaked again. The on-site notice was not to start the conveyor, and two operators entered the conveyor to deal with it.
- 2025-12-14 21:46: The on-site management personnel did not confirm the evacuation of the conveyor personnel and issued an instruction to directly start the scraper conveyor.
- 2025-12-14 21:49: The scraper conveyor started, two people in the conveyor were pulled down, and one of them was involved in coal and waste rock.
- 2025-12-14 21:50: After hearing shouts at the scene, the scraper conveyor was notified to stop; one injured person climbed out on his own, and the other was buried in coal and waste rock.
- 2025-12-14 21:54: Report the accident to the mine dispatch room on site and organise rescue.
- 2025-12-14 21:59: The mine notified the hospital and initiated the mine-doctor linkage.
- 2025-12-14 22:01: The mine reported the accident to the Shuicheng District Energy Bureau.

- 2025-12-14 22:11: The mine reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2025-12-14 23:23: Rescuers discovered and rescued the buried personnel at Support No. 78.
- 2025-12-14 23:40: The casualty was carried to the mine entrance and sent to the hospital.
- 2025-12-15 00:15: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty died.

【Accident Mechanism】
When handling the leaky roof in the No. 79 to No. 81 bracket sections, the operators entered the conveyor after being notified to stop the scraper conveyor. Due to the damage to the signal device of No. 83 support, the workers in the conveyor tunnel were not notified of the start; another on-site manager issued a start command without confirming the evacuation of the workers. After the conveyor started, two people were pulled down. One of them was involved in the coal and waste rock in the conveyor tunnel and was completely buried. He died after the rescue failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator started the conveyor illegally while he was still in the tunnel of the scraper conveyor, causing the operator to be pulled down and buried in coal and waste rock.
2. key contributing factors: The damaged signaling device was not shut down for repairs, the on-site command and safety personnel were missing; training, outsourcing team management, video surveillance and risk supervision by superior companies were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Strengthen the installation, testing and repair reporting system for electromechanical transportation protection devices.
2. Clean up illegal outsourcing projects and improve the safety management of self-built mining teams.
3. Implement the training and assessment of safety personnel and the rectification of hidden dangers throughout the day.
4. The superior company conducts inspections on major risks and consolidates the mine monitoring responsibilities.
5. Identify the person in charge of on-site operations and provide unified command; damaged protection devices and safety facilities must be shut down immediately for repairs.
6. Implement pre-job training and mentoring, and use methods such as practical operations, standard operation videos, and finger dictation to train on job risks.

The material truck rolled over, and the U-shaped cable bolts rebounded and were squeezed into the side of the tunnel, causing injuries to the head and chest before death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The material truck that was not placed stably and was not prevented from falling over rolled over, and the coiled cable bolt rebounded and squeezed the unloading workers on the side of the truck.
2. key contributing factors: Lack of material handling and unloading management system, material transport engineering procedures and job responsibilities in the three superconductors; risk identification did not identify the risk of flexible material rebound, and insufficient training, on-site safety confirmation, hidden danger investigation and technical service supervision.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Re-carry out the annual risk identification and complete material loading and unloading risks and control measures.
2. Implement real-name inspections, ledger management, and account cancellation rectification.
3. Continue to carry out system design inspections and on-site safety confirmation, and implement inspections of three violations and three violations.
4. Technical service companies strengthen risk identification, hidden danger management and technical measure guidance.
5. Improve the management system for material loading, unloading, transportation and use, and clarify the division of responsibilities and material transportation operation procedures; material trucks must be parked stably and reliably and the unloading process must be supervised throughout.
6. Carry out job procedures, risk identification and emergency response training for monorail crane drivers, new employees and transferred personnel, and take up their posts after passing the assessment.

【Accident Mechanism】
The roof of the development heading is broken, the support design and construction quality do not meet the requirements, and the cable bolt support lags behind for a long time. The team on duty during the accident blasted and installed cable bolts about 4 metres away from the head without confirming the safety of the roof and without first completing the support. The coal and rock mass of the roof on the right side of the head continued to collapse, burying and killing the team leader who could not evacuate in time.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct reasons: The support strength of the development heading was insufficient and the cable bolt support was lagging behind. When the cable bolt was installed, the coal and rock mass on the right roof fell off and buried the workers.
2. key contributing factors: The broken roof section did not adopt targeted strengthening support, the tunnel was too wide and the construction quality of roof bolts and cable bolts was unqualified; safety confirmation, quality acceptance, training, hidden danger closed loop and superior supervision were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Consolidate the responsibilities for quality control of compaction support, and carry out roof bolt and cable inspection and roof monitoring on a regular basis.
2. Refine the safety grid guarantee responsibilities, track and supervise the rectification of hidden dangers.
3. The superior company strengthens the investigation of potential safety hazards and guarantees the performance of duties.
4. Regulatory authorities implement a closed loop of actual measurement and quantity inspection and hidden danger rectification.
5. Improve the support design and match it with the geological conditions; strictly implement strengthened support and standardize the operation cycle in the broken roof section to eliminate support lag.
6. Implement training on operating procedures and roof management systems, and strengthen mentoring, on-site safety confirmation, and anti-three-violation education.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2026-04-15 13:00: The coal mining team held a pre-shift briefing to arrange operations such as mining and upper exit construction at the 1054 coal face.
- 2026-04-15 14:00: The operators arrived at the 1054 coal face and started coal mining operations after completing safety confirmation.
- 2026-04-15 20:30: The coal cutting shift ends.
- 2026-04-15 21:25: When the operator passed the passage between No. 23 and No. 24 hydraulic supports, he accidentally touched the operating handle of the reversing valve, and the top beam of the support fell and pinched his head.
- 2026-04-15 21:30: On-site personnel reported the accident to the mine dispatch room and organised rescue.
- 2026-04-15 21:34: The mine reported the accident to the Shuicheng District Energy Bureau.
- 2026-04-15 21:40: The mine reported the accident to Liupanshui Energy Bureau.
- 2026-04-15 21:42: The mine contacted medical institutions and initiated joint mine-medical rescue and treatment.
- 2026-04-15 22:06: The mine reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2026-04-15 22:13: The mine reported the accident to the Guizhou Provincial Energy Bureau.
- 2026-04-15 22:53: Underground rescue workers transported the casualty out of the well.
- 2026-04-15 22:55: Rescue efforts in the ambulance failed and the casualty died.

【Accident Mechanism】
Some hydraulic supports on the coal mining working face were not pushed away and floating coal in the channel was not cleared. The height of the pedestrian space was about 1 meter. When the operator was sliding backwards through the No. 23 and No. 24 supports, his body accidentally touched the operating handle of the reversing valve on the No. 24 support that does not have a self-locking function and controls the No. 23 support. The top beam of the No. 23 support fell, and his head was caught between the top beam and the cable trough, causing his death.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The operator accidentally touched the operating handle of the reversing valve without self-locking function in the pedestrian passage with insufficient space. The top beam of the powered support dropped and squeezed the head.
2. key contributing factors: The acceptance, installation and maintenance of the powered support are not standardized, the reversing valve group without self-locking function is used; floating coal and push-off are not cleaned, and risk identification, equipment inspection, training and outsourcing team safety management are not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Inspect equipment according to actual measurement, actual quantity, and real-name methods, and immediately deactivate and dispose of any defects found.
2. Clean up floating coal promptly and keep pedestrian passages clear.
3. Clean up illegal outsourcing projects and improve the safety management and team building of the mining team.
4. Superior technical service units implement closed-loop tracking and supervision of hidden dangers.
5. Accept, install and maintain the powered support in accordance with technical standards. It is prohibited to enter the mine or operate the equipment that does not meet the selected design or has defects.
6. Implement pre-job training and mentoring system for new employees, and carry out support operation and hidden danger identification training based on on-site risks.

messages.content: You are a coal-mine accident investigation and analysis assistant. Based on the accident timeline provided, summarise the Accident Mechanism, analyse the root causes and provide targeted preventative recommendations. Do not add accident facts that are not supported by the input.

【Accident Timeline】
- 2026-05-04 22:30: The mine leader organised a pre-night shift meeting to arrange the mining operations of the 21501 fully mechanised mining face.
- 2026-05-04 23:00: Night shift coal mining team members enter the mine one after another.
- 2026-05-04 23:30: The squad leader, safety inspector and coal machine driver arrived near the exit of the mining surface and continued to repair the coal machine that was not repaired in the previous shift.
- 2026-05-04 23:42: The shearer maintenance was completed, and the coal machine driver starts to start the shearer to cut coal.
- 2026-05-04 23:44: The exit umbrella eaves on the mining surface collapsed, knocking down the coal machine driver near the No. 122 powered support.
- 2026-05-04 23:46: On-site personnel reported the accident to the mine dispatch room and organised rescue.
- 2026-05-04 23:54: The ground duty staff notified the medical institution to rush for treatment.
- 2026-05-05 00:25: The ambulance arrives at Jinpo Coal Mine.
- 2026-05-05 00:31: The mine reported the accident to the Energy Bureau of Baili Dujuan Management Zone.
- 2026-05-05 00:35: The mine reported the accident to Bijie Energy Bureau.
- 2026-05-05 00:38: The mine reported the accident to the Guizhou Bureau of the National Mine Safety Supervision Bureau.
- 2026-05-05 00:57: The casualties were transported out of the well and sent to the hospital for rescue.
- 2026-05-05 01:44: The hospital failed to rescue and the casualty died.

【Accident Mechanism】
The end of the 21501 fully mechanised mining working face was affected by geological structures to form slope steps and multiple canopies. Measures such as undercover, waste rock blocking, and safety confirmation before operation were not implemented on site. After the shearer was repaired, the driver started the shearer to cut coal near the No. 122 powered support. The upper eaves collapsed and knocked it down. He died after rescue efforts failed.

【Cause Analysis】
1. Direct cause: The driver of the coal mining machine was cutting coal when there was an umbrella canopy at the upper end. The umbrella canopy collapsed and knocked him to death.
2. key contributing factors: Lack of safety confirmation before on-site handover and operation, failure to implement undercover, waste blocking and monitoring measures for key projects in structural areas; rectification of hidden dangers, special training, superior supervision and local supervision and tracking were not in place.

【Preventative Recommendations】
1. Establish a three-level hidden danger inspection mechanism of daily inspections by teams and teams, weekly inspections by district teams, and mine inspections.
2. Increase the weight of safety assessment and cancel the orientation of determining salary solely based on output.
3. The superior company monitors key projects in the mine, rectifies problems, and conducts review and accountability.
4. Supervisory departments shall clarify the responsibilities of pre-review, in-process inspection, post-review and cancellation of key projects upon completion.
5. Strict on-site handover and safety confirmation before operation. No operation is allowed before handover, confirmation or hidden dangers have not been eliminated; implement monitoring and video control of key projects.
6. Carry out targeted training based on job type, position and risk, and implement a closed loop of sign-in, study, examination, passing and induction of special measures.
